

===== Windows/Vireo.Core.Tests/ConnectionMonitorTests.cs =====
using System.Net;
using Vireo.Core.Api;

namespace Vireo.Core.Tests;

public sealed class ConnectionMonitorTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempFolder _folder = new();
    private readonly FakeMac _mac = new();
    private readonly ServerConnection _connection;
    private readonly ConnectionMonitor _monitor;

    public ConnectionMonitorTests()
    {
        _connection = new ServerConnection(_folder.File("connection.json"), new FakeProtector());
        _monitor = new ConnectionMonitor(_connection, new ChatApiClient(_connection, _mac));
    }

    public void Dispose() => _folder.Dispose();

    private void MacAnswers(bool paired) => _mac.Respond = request => request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath switch
    {
        "/api/pairing/status" => FakeMac.Json(HttpStatusCode.OK, $$"""{"local":false,"paired":{{(paired ? "true" : "false")}}}"""),
        "/api/metrics" => FakeMac.Json(HttpStatusCode.OK, """{"model":"gemma-4-E2B","runtime":"MLX","contextLimit":32768}"""),
        "/api/capabilities" => FakeMac.Json(HttpStatusCode.OK,
            """{"protocolVersion":1,"device":"windows","serverPlatform":"macos","tools":[{"name":"search_web","label":"","description":"","category":"","platforms":["windows"],"available":true}]}"""),
        _ => new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound),
    };

    [Fact]
    public async Task WithoutAnAddressThereIsNothingToCheck()
    {
        Assert.Equal(ConnectionState.NotSetUp, _monitor.State);
        await _monitor.RefreshAsync();
        Assert.Equal(ConnectionState.NotSetUp, _monitor.State);
        Assert.Empty(_mac.Requests);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task APairedPcLearnsTheModelAndTools()
    {
        _connection.SetPaired(new Uri("http://192.168.1.20:3000/"), "token");
        MacAnswers(paired: true);

        await _monitor.RefreshAsync();

        Assert.Equal(ConnectionState.Connected, _monitor.State);
        Assert.True(_monitor.IsConnected);
        Assert.Equal("gemma-4-E2B", _monitor.ModelName);
        Assert.Equal("MLX", _monitor.Runtime);
        Assert.Equal(32768, _monitor.ContextLimit);
        Assert.Equal(["search_web"], _monitor.AvailableTools);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AnUnpairedPcIsToldToPair()
    {
        _connection.SetAddress(new Uri("http://192.168.1.20:3000/"));
        MacAnswers(paired: false);
        await _monitor.RefreshAsync();
        Assert.Equal(ConnectionState.NotPaired, _monitor.State);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AMacThatDoesntAnswerIsUnreachable()
    {
        _connection.SetPaired(new Uri("http://192.168.1.20:3000/"), "token");
        _mac.Respond = _ => throw new HttpRequestException("timed out");
        await _monitor.RefreshAsync();
        Assert.Equal(ConnectionState.Unreachable, _monitor.State);
        Assert.StartsWith("Could not reach the Mac", _monitor.Problem);

        MacAnswers(paired: true);
        await _monitor.RefreshAsync();
        Assert.Equal(ConnectionState.Connected, _monitor.State);
        Assert.Null(_monitor.Problem);
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Api/PcTools.cs =====
// The tools the Mac's server lets a Windows client run on the PC (W2.5 in
// docs/dev/windows-native-plan.md). Git, project commands and the shell are in
// PcTools.Projects.cs. The file tools are ported from server/api_server.py: _tool_read_file,
// _tool_list_directory, _tool_file_exists, _tool_write_file, _tool_delete_file,
// _tool_rename_file, _tool_move_file and _tool_search_files_sync, with the same results
// so the model reads them the same way. The server asks for approval before a change;
// this only does the work, and records it in the reply's PcUndoJournal so it can be undone.
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using Vireo.Core.Models;
using Vireo.Core.Storage;

namespace Vireo.Core.Api;

/// <summary>What one chat's tools may reach: its access level, and the chosen folders
/// when that's "Folders I choose".</summary>
public sealed record PcAccess(AgentAccess Level, IReadOnlyList<string> Folders)
{
    public static readonly PcAccess Home = new(AgentAccess.Home, []);
}

public sealed partial class PcTools
{
    /// <summary>What this app tells the server it runs (clientTools).</summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> Names =
    [
        "read_file", "list_directory", "file_exists", "search_files",
        "write_file", "rename_file", "move_file", "delete_file",
        "git_status", "git_diff", "run_tests", "run_build", "run_linter", "run_shell_command",
        "create_docx", "create_pdf",
        "read_spreadsheet", "write_spreadsheet", "create_pptx", "fill_docx_template",
        // Not a tool: tells the server this app builds create_docx's Word documents itself.
        "build_docx",
        // Not a tool either: lets the server check a change can be made before asking the
        // user to approve it (PcTools.Changes.cs).
        "check_change",
    ];

    private const long MaxReadBytes = 1024 * 1024;
    private const long MaxSearchedFileBytes = 500 * 1024;
    private const int MaxSearchResults = 50;
    private const int MaxSearchDepth = 8;
    private const int MaxListingDepth = 3;
    private const int MaxListedEntries = 400;
    /// <summary>search_files looks inside these too, as text (the Mac's gauntlet 2 fix: a request
    /// that existed only as a Word file couldn't be found by searching). PDFs are read on the
    /// Mac, so a search here doesn't open them.</summary>
    private static readonly HashSet<string> SearchedDocuments = [".docx", ".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".pptx"];
    private const int MaxSearchedDocuments = 150;
    private const long MaxSearchedDocumentBytes = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
    /// <summary>A search started high up (the user's folder) stops after this long and says so.</summary>
    private static readonly TimeSpan SearchTimeLimit = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
    /// <summary>Dependency and package folders, which a search or a deep listing walks past.</summary>
    private static readonly HashSet<string> SkippedFolders = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        "node_modules", "venv", "__pycache__", "site-packages",
    };

    private readonly string _home;
    private readonly string _appData;
    private readonly ChatApiClient? _api;
    private readonly PcAccess _access;
    private readonly string[] _folders;
    private readonly PcUndoJournal? _journal;

    /// <param name="home">The user's folder (%USERPROFILE%), where relative paths start, and
    /// the only one the tools reach unless a chat's access says otherwise.</param>
    /// <param name="api">For PDFs and Word documents, which the Mac reads, and for downloading
    /// documents the Mac built.</param>
    public PcTools(string home, ChatApiClient? api = null) : this(home, api, PcAccess.Home, null) { }

    private PcTools(string home, ChatApiClient? api, PcAccess access, PcUndoJournal? journal)
    {
        _home = Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(Path.GetFullPath(home));
        _appData = Path.Combine(_home, "AppData");
        _api = api;
        _access = access;
        _folders = access.Folders.Select(f => Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(Path.GetFullPath(f))).ToArray();
        _journal = journal;
    }

    /// <summary>The same tools for one reply: reaching only what its chat's access allows, and
    /// recording its changes in <paramref name="journal"/> so they can be undone.</summary>
    public PcTools ForReply(PcAccess access, PcUndoJournal? journal = null) => new(_home, _api, access, journal);

    /// <summary>Runs one tool. Errors are thrown with a message for the model.</summary>
    public async Task<string> RunAsync(string tool, JsonElement args, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        switch (tool)
        {
            case "read_file": return await ReadFileAsync(Arg(args, "path"), cancellationToken);
            case "list_directory": return ListDirectory(Arg(args, "path"), IntArg(args, "depth"));
            case "file_exists": return FileExists(Arg(args, "path"));
            case "search_files":
                return SearchFiles(Arg(args, "pattern"), Arg(args, "directory"), OptionalArg(args, "file_ext"));
            case "write_file": return await WriteFileAsync(Arg(args, "path"), Arg(args, "content"), cancellationToken);
            case "rename_file": return RenameFile(Arg(args, "path"), Arg(args, "new_name"));
            case "move_file": return MoveFile(Arg(args, "source"), Arg(args, "destination"));
            case "delete_file": return DeleteFile(Arg(args, "path"));
            case "check_change": return CheckChange(args);
            case "git_status": return await GitStatusAsync(Arg(args, "path"), cancellationToken);
            case "git_diff": return await GitDiffAsync(Arg(args, "path"), cancellationToken);
            case "run_tests": return await RunProjectCommandAsync(Arg(args, "path"), "tests", cancellationToken);
            case "run_build": return await RunProjectCommandAsync(Arg(args, "path"), "build", cancellationToken);
            case "run_linter": return await RunProjectCommandAsync(Arg(args, "path"), "linter", cancellationToken);
            case "run_shell_command":
                string command = Arg(args, "command");
                // Noted first: a command that fails partway may still have changed things.
                _journal?.NoteShell(command);
                return await RunShellCommandAsync(command, cancellationToken);
            // A server from before build_docx sends a document it built to download.
            case "create_docx" when OptionalArg(args, "download") is null: return await CreateWordDocumentAsync(args);
            case "create_docx" or "create_pdf":
                return await SaveDocumentAsync(Arg(args, "path"), Arg(args, "download"), cancellationToken);
            case "read_spreadsheet": return await ReadSpreadsheetAsync(args);
            case "write_spreadsheet": return await WriteSpreadsheetAsync(args);
            case "create_pptx": return await CreateDeckAsync(args);
            case "fill_docx_template": return await FillTemplateAsync(args);
            default: throw new NotSupportedException($"{tool} can't run on this PC.");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A path this chat may reach. Relative ones ("Desktop\notes.txt") start in the
    /// user's folder, as on the Mac. With home access, AppData is left out, since it holds
    /// other apps' sign-ins; with chosen folders, only those are reached.</summary>
    public string Resolve(string path)
    {
        string expanded = path.Trim();
        if (expanded == "~" || expanded.StartsWith("~/", StringComparison.Ordinal) || expanded.StartsWith(@"~\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            expanded = expanded.Length <= 2 ? "" : expanded[2..];
        }
        string full = Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(Path.GetFullPath(Path.IsPathRooted(expanded) ? expanded : Path.Combine(_home, expanded)));
        switch (_access.Level)
        {
            case AgentAccess.Full:
                return full;
            case AgentAccess.Folders:
                if (_folders.Any(folder => IsWithin(full, folder))) return full;
                string allowed = _folders.Length > 0 ? string.Join(", ", _folders) : "none";
                throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                    $"{full} is outside the folders this chat may access ({allowed}). The user can change access in the menu "
                    + "above the chat box, or add the folder in Settings.");
        }
        if (!IsWithin(full, _home))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException($"{full} is outside the user's folder ({_home}), which is the only one these tools can reach. "
                + "The user can change access in the menu above the chat box.");
        }
        if (IsWithin(full, _appData))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException($"{full} is in AppData, which these tools can't reach.");
        }
        return full;
    }

    private static bool IsWithin(string path, string folder) =>
        path.Equals(folder, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        || path.StartsWith(folder + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private async Task<string> ReadFileAsync(string path, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        string file = Resolve(path);
        var info = new FileInfo(file);
        if (Directory.Exists(file)) throw new IOException($"{file} is a folder, not a file.");
        if (!info.Exists) throw new FileNotFoundException(NotFound(file, $"File not found: {file}"));
        // Word, Excel and PowerPoint are read here; PDFs still go to the Mac.
        if (await Task.Run(() => ReadOfficeFile(file), cancellationToken) is { } office) return office;
        if (info.Extension.ToLowerInvariant() is ".pdf")
        {
            if (_api is null) throw new NotSupportedException("PDFs are read on the Mac, which isn't connected.");
            var upload = await _api.UploadFileAsync(file, cancellationToken);
            return upload.ExtractedText ?? throw new InvalidDataException($"Couldn't read the text of {info.Name}.");
        }
        if (info.Length > MaxReadBytes) throw new InvalidDataException($"File too large ({info.Length / 1024} KB). Maximum is 1 MB.");
        byte[] bytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(file, cancellationToken);
        try
        {
            return new UTF8Encoding(false, throwOnInvalidBytes: true).GetString(bytes).TrimStart('');
        }
        catch (DecoderFallbackException)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException($"{info.Name} is not a text file. read_file can read text files, PDFs, and Word, Excel and PowerPoint files.");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A folder's contents, and with <paramref name="depth"/> 2 or 3 the folders inside
    /// it, indented, as the Mac's list_directory does since Nov 10.</summary>
    private string ListDirectory(string path, int? depth = null)
    {
        var folder = new DirectoryInfo(Resolve(path));
        if (!folder.Exists) throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(NotFound(folder.FullName, $"Folder not found: {folder.FullName}"));
        int levels = Math.Clamp(depth ?? 1, 1, MaxListingDepth);
        var lines = new List<string>();
        bool cut = false;
        Walk(folder, 0);
        if (lines.Count == 0) return "(empty directory)";
        // The full path first, so the next call can use it as it is.
        string text = (levels > 1 ? $"{folder.FullName}:\n" : "") + string.Join('\n', lines);
        if (cut) text += $"\n[... the first {MaxListedEntries} entries; list a subfolder for the rest ...]";
        return text;

        void Walk(DirectoryInfo current, int level)
        {
            List<FileSystemInfo> entries;
            try
            {
                entries = [.. current.EnumerateFileSystemInfos().OrderBy(e => e is FileInfo).ThenBy(e => e.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal)];
            }
            catch (Exception e) when (level > 0 && e is UnauthorizedAccessException or IOException)
            {
                lines.Add(new string(' ', 2 * level) + $"(could not be listed: {e.Message})");
                return;
            }
            foreach (var entry in entries)
            {
                // Below the folder asked for, hidden files and packages are noise.
                if (level > 0 && (entry.Name.StartsWith('.') || SkippedFolders.Contains(entry.Name))) continue;
                if (lines.Count >= MaxListedEntries)
                {
                    cut = true;
                    return;
                }
                bool isFolder = entry is DirectoryInfo;
                lines.Add(new string(' ', 2 * level) + (isFolder ? "[dir] " : "[file]") + " " + entry.Name);
                if (isFolder && level + 1 < levels && !entry.Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.ReparsePoint)
                    && !(_access.Level == AgentAccess.Home && IsWithin(entry.FullName, _appData)))
                {
                    Walk((DirectoryInfo)entry, level + 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private string FileExists(string path)
    {
        string full = Resolve(path);
        string? type = Directory.Exists(full) ? "directory" : File.Exists(full) ? "file" : null;
        return JsonSerializer.Serialize(new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["path"] = full, ["exists"] = type is not null, ["type"] = type });
    }

    private async Task<string> WriteFileAsync(string path, string content, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        string file = Resolve(path);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(file)!);
        await Recorded("write_file", file, async () =>
        {
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(file, content, new UTF8Encoding(false), cancellationToken);
            return true;
        });
        if (await File.ReadAllTextAsync(file, cancellationToken) != content)
        {
            throw new IOException($"File verification failed after writing: {file}");
        }
        return $"File written successfully: {file}";
    }

    private Task<T> Recorded<T>(string tool, string file, Func<Task<T>> write) =>
        _journal is null ? write() : _journal.RecordWriteAsync(tool, file, write);

    /// <summary>To the Recycle Bin, never deleted for good, as the Mac's goes to the Trash.</summary>
    private string DeleteFile(string path)
    {
        string file = Resolve(path);
        if (Directory.Exists(file)) throw new IOException($"{file} is a folder. delete_file deletes files only.");
        if (!File.Exists(file)) throw new FileNotFoundException(NotFound(file, $"File not found: {file}"));
        if (_journal is null) RecycleBin.Send(file);
        else _journal.RecordDelete("delete_file", file, () => RecycleBin.Send(file));
        return $"File moved to the Recycle Bin: {file}";
    }

    private string RenameFile(string path, string newName)
    {
        string source = Resolve(path);
        if (!File.Exists(source) && !Directory.Exists(source)) throw new FileNotFoundException(NotFound(source, $"File not found: {source}"));
        if (newName is "" or "." or ".." || Path.GetFileName(newName) != newName)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("New name must be a single file or folder name.");
        }
        string destination = Resolve(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(source)!, newName));
        Move(source, destination);
        _journal?.RecordMove("rename_file", source, destination);
        return $"Renamed successfully: {Path.GetFileName(source)} -> {Path.GetFileName(destination)}";
    }

    private string MoveFile(string sourcePath, string destinationPath)
    {
        string source = Resolve(sourcePath);
        string destination = Resolve(destinationPath);
        if (!File.Exists(source) && !Directory.Exists(source)) throw new FileNotFoundException(NotFound(source, $"File not found: {source}"));
        Move(source, destination);
        _journal?.RecordMove("move_file", source, destination);
        return $"Moved successfully: {source} -> {destination}";
    }

    private static void Move(string source, string destination)
    {
        // A case-only rename is the same path on Windows, so it isn't "already there".
        bool sameItem = source.Equals(destination, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (!sameItem && (File.Exists(destination) || Directory.Exists(destination)))
        {
            throw new IOException($"Destination already exists: {destination}");
        }
        if (Path.GetDirectoryName(destination) is { } parent && !Directory.Exists(parent))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Folder not found: {parent}");
        }
        if (Directory.Exists(source)) Directory.Move(source, destination);
        else File.Move(source, destination);
    }

    private string SearchFiles(string pattern, string directory, string? fileExtension)
    {
        string root = Resolve(directory);
        if (!Directory.Exists(root)) throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Folder not found: {root}");
        var results = new List<string>();
        // Every word of the search in a file or folder name counts ("STEM camp" finds
        // Northern-Lakes-STEM-Girls-Camp.docx), as on the Mac since Nov 9.
        string[] words = [.. WordPattern().Matches(pattern.ToLowerInvariant()).Select(m => m.Value)];
        // A file's name is looked for by name only: reading every file on the way is what
        // made a search of the home folder take minutes on the Mac.
        bool namesOnly = FileNamePattern().IsMatch(pattern.Trim());
        int documentsRead = 0;
        var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow + SearchTimeLimit;
        bool timedOut = false;

        // Breadth first, so files near the starting folder are found before deep ones.
        var queue = new Queue<(DirectoryInfo Folder, int Depth)>([(new DirectoryInfo(root), 0)]);
        while (queue.Count > 0 && results.Count < MaxSearchResults)
        {
            if (DateTime.UtcNow > deadline)
            {
                timedOut = true;
                break;
            }
            var (folder, depth) = queue.Dequeue();
            FileSystemInfo[] entries;
            try
            {
                entries = [.. folder.GetFileSystemInfos().OrderBy(e => e.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal)];
            }
            catch (Exception e) when (e is UnauthorizedAccessException or IOException)
            {
                continue;
            }
            foreach (var entry in entries)
            {
                if (results.Count >= MaxSearchResults) break;
                if (DateTime.UtcNow > deadline)
                {
                    timedOut = true;
                    break;
                }
                if (entry is DirectoryInfo sub)
                {
                    bool skipped = sub.Name.StartsWith('.') || SkippedFolders.Contains(sub.Name)
                        || sub.Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.ReparsePoint)
                        || (_access.Level == AgentAccess.Home && IsWithin(sub.FullName, _appData));
                    if (skipped) continue;
                    if (NameMatches(sub.Name, words)) results.Add($"{sub.FullName}\\ (folder name matches)");
                    if (depth < MaxSearchDepth) queue.Enqueue((sub, depth + 1));
                }
                else if (entry is FileInfo file)
                {
                    SearchFile(file);
                }
            }
        }

        if (results.Count == 0)
        {
            return $"No matches found for \"{pattern}\" in {root}"
                + (timedOut ? $" in the first {SearchTimeLimit.TotalSeconds:0} s. Search a smaller folder." : "");
        }
        string header = results.Count >= MaxSearchResults
            ? $"First {MaxSearchResults} matches"
            : $"{results.Count} match{(results.Count != 1 ? "es" : "")}";
        string note = timedOut
            ? $"\n\nStopped after {SearchTimeLimit.TotalSeconds:0} s before searching everything under {root}. Search a smaller folder for the rest."
            : "";
        return $"{header} for \"{pattern}\":\n\n" + string.Join('\n', results) + note;

        void SearchFile(FileInfo file)
        {
            if (fileExtension is { Length: > 0 } && !file.Name.EndsWith(fileExtension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return;
            if (NameMatches(file.Name, words))
            {
                results.Add($"{file.FullName} (file name matches)");
                return;
            }
            if (namesOnly) return;
            bool document = SearchedDocuments.Contains(file.Extension.ToLowerInvariant());
            if (file.Length > (document ? MaxSearchedDocumentBytes : MaxSearchedFileBytes)) return;
            if (document && documentsRead++ >= MaxSearchedDocuments) return;
            try
            {
                var lines = document ? (ReadOfficeFile(file.FullName) ?? "").Split('\n') : File.ReadLines(file.FullName);
                int number = 0;
                foreach (string line in lines)
                {
                    number++;
                    if (results.Count >= MaxSearchResults) break;
                    if (line.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) results.Add($"{file.FullName}:{number}: {line.Trim()}");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // Unreadable files, and documents that won't open, are skipped, as on the Mac.
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool NameMatches(string name, string[] words)
    {
        if (words.Length == 0) return false;
        string plain = NameSeparators().Replace(name.ToLowerInvariant(), " ");
        return words.All(plain.Contains);
    }

    [System.Text.RegularExpressions.GeneratedRegex(@"\w+")]
    private static partial System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex WordPattern();

    /// <summary>"Invoice-Register-FY2026.xlsx": a file's name, so only names are compared.</summary>
    [System.Text.RegularExpressions.GeneratedRegex(@"^[^\s/\\]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6}$")]
    private static partial System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex FileNamePattern();

    [System.Text.RegularExpressions.GeneratedRegex(@"[-_.]+")]
    private static partial System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex NameSeparators();

    /// <summary>A document the Mac built, downloaded to where the model asked for it.</summary>
    private async Task<string> SaveDocumentAsync(string path, string download, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (_api is null) throw new NotSupportedException("The Mac isn't connected.");
        string file = Resolve(path);
        if (Directory.Exists(file)) throw new IOException($"{file} is a folder.");
        byte[] bytes = await _api.FetchFileAsync(download, cancellationToken);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(file)!);
        await Recorded(Path.GetExtension(file).Equals(".pdf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "create_pdf" : "create_docx", file, async () =>
        {
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(file, bytes, cancellationToken);
            return true;
        });
        return file;
    }

    private static string Arg(JsonElement args, string name) =>
        OptionalArg(args, name) ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Missing argument: {name}");

    /// <summary>A whole number, sent as a number or as text ("2"); null when missing or not one.</summary>
    private static int? IntArg(JsonElement args, string name) =>
        OptionalArg(args, name) is { } text && double.TryParse(text, System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,
            System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double number) && double.IsFinite(number)
            ? (int)Math.Clamp(Math.Round(number), int.MinValue, int.MaxValue)
            : null;

    private static string? OptionalArg(JsonElement args, string name) =>
        args.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && args.TryGetProperty(name, out var value) && value.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Null
            ? (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String ? value.GetString() : value.GetRawText())
            : null;
}


===== Windows/Vireo.WinUI/ReplyNotifications.cs =====
// The Mac's notifyTaskComplete (ChatAreaView.swift): a notification when a reply finishes,
// shown only while the window isn't in front, as the Mac hides it then too. Clicking it
// opens that chat, which the Mac's AssistantFeed does for its own notifications. Those are
// here too: they show whether or not the window is in front, as on the Mac.
using Vireo.Core.Models;
using Microsoft.Windows.AppNotifications;
using Microsoft.Windows.AppNotifications.Builder;

namespace Vireo.WinUI;

/// <summary>What a clicked notification asks for: a chat, or a tab of the Assistant window.</summary>
internal sealed record NotificationTarget(string? ChatId, AssistantTab? Tab);

internal static class ReplyNotifications
{
    private const string ChatArgument = "chatId";
    private const string TabArgument = "tab";
    private static bool _registered;

    /// <summary>Set from the main window's Activated event.</summary>
    public static bool WindowIsActive { get; set; } = true;

    /// <param name="open">Called with what a clicked notification is for, on a background thread.</param>
    public static void Register(Action<NotificationTarget> open)
    {
        try
        {
            AppNotificationManager.Default.NotificationInvoked += (_, e) => open(Target(e.Arguments));
            AppNotificationManager.Default.Register();
            _registered = true;
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException or InvalidOperationException)
        {
            // Notifications are off for this app or unavailable; replies still arrive.
        }
    }

    public static void Unregister()
    {
        if (_registered) AppNotificationManager.Default.Unregister();
    }

    /// <summary>What a notification click launched the app for, if it did.</summary>
    public static NotificationTarget? LaunchTarget() =>
        Microsoft.Windows.AppLifecycle.AppInstance.GetCurrent().GetActivatedEventArgs() is
            { Kind: Microsoft.Windows.AppLifecycle.ExtendedActivationKind.AppNotification, Data: AppNotificationActivatedEventArgs args }
            ? Target(args.Arguments)
            : null;

    /// <summary>Only a reply that finished (the Mac checks its metadata), not one stopped or failed.</summary>
    public static void ReplyFinished(Chat? chat, ChatMessage? reply)
    {
        if (WindowIsActive || chat is null || reply?.Metadata is null || reply.IsError) return;
        if (!AppServices.Preferences.Current.NotifyReplyFinished) return;
        Show(new AppNotificationBuilder()
            .AddArgument(ChatArgument, chat.Id)
            .AddText("Vireo Prototype")
            .AddText("Your agent task is complete."));
    }

    /// <summary>Something the assistant did on its own.</summary>
    public static void AssistantUpdate(AssistantNotification notification)
    {
        // Still in the Assistant window and the sidebar's count; only the notification is off.
        if (!AppServices.Preferences.Current.NotifyAssistant) return;
        var builder = new AppNotificationBuilder().AddText(notification.Title);
        if (notification.Body.Length > 0) builder.AddText(notification.Body);
        if (notification.ChatId is { } chatId) builder.AddArgument(ChatArgument, chatId);
        if (notification.Tab is { } tab) builder.AddArgument(TabArgument, tab.ToString());
        Show(builder);
    }

    private static void Show(AppNotificationBuilder builder)
    {
        if (!_registered) return;
        try
        {
            AppNotificationManager.Default.Show(builder.BuildNotification());
        }
        catch (System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException)
        {
            // Notifications were turned off in Windows settings.
        }
    }

    private static NotificationTarget Target(IDictionary<string, string> arguments)
    {
        string? Argument(string name) => arguments.TryGetValue(name, out var value) ? value : null;
        return new NotificationTarget(
            Argument(ChatArgument),
            Enum.TryParse<AssistantTab>(Argument(TabArgument), out var tab) ? tab : null);
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.WinUI/Views/ChatFoldersSection.cs =====
// Ported from Sources/VireoMac/Views/AgentFoldersView.swift (Settings  Assistant 
// Chat folders). The list is kept on the PC, since the PC's tools are the ones that use it.
using Microsoft.UI.Text;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media;
using Vireo.Core.Storage;
using Windows.Storage.Pickers;

namespace Vireo.WinUI.Views;

/// <summary>The folders behind the "Folders I choose" access level.</summary>
internal sealed class ChatFoldersSection : StackPanel
{
    private readonly StackPanel _list = new() { Spacing = 4 };
    /// <summary>OneDrive and SharePoint folders synced here that aren't in the list yet.</summary>
    private readonly StackPanel _suggestions = new() { Spacing = 6 };
    private readonly TextBlock _error = new() { FontSize = 12, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed };

    public ChatFoldersSection()
    {
        Spacing = 10;
        // Its page in Settings has the title.
        Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = "When a chat's access is set to \"Folders I choose\" in the menu above the chat box, it can only read and "
                + "change files in these folders on this PC, and can't run shell commands. Changes still ask for approval.",
            FontSize = 12,
            Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary,
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
        });
        Children.Add(_list);
        var add = new Button { Content = "Add Folder" };
        add.Click += async (_, _) =>
        {
            if (await PickFolderAsync(SettingsWindow.Handle) is { } folder) Change(() => AppServices.ChatFolders.Add([folder]));
        };
        Children.Add(add);
        Children.Add(_suggestions);
        _error.Foreground = SettingsUI.Critical;
        Children.Add(_error);
        ShowFolders();
    }

    /// <summary>Asks for a folder to add; null if the user cancelled.</summary>
    /// <param name="owner">The window the picker belongs to; the main window if not given.</param>
    public static async Task<string?> PickFolderAsync(IntPtr owner = 0)
    {
        var picker = new FolderPicker { SuggestedStartLocation = PickerLocationId.DocumentsLibrary };
        picker.FileTypeFilter.Add("*");
        WinRT.Interop.InitializeWithWindow.Initialize(picker, owner == 0 ? App.MainWindowHandle : owner);
        return (await picker.PickSingleFolderAsync())?.Path;
    }

    private void Change(Action change)
    {
        try
        {
            change();
            _error.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            _error.Text = e.Message;
            _error.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }
        ShowFolders();
    }

    private void ShowFolders()
    {
        _list.Children.Clear();
        var folders = AppServices.ChatFolders.Load();
        ShowSuggestions(folders);
        if (folders.Count == 0)
        {
            _list.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = "No folders yet.", FontSize = 13, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary });
            return;
        }
        foreach (string folder in folders)
        {
            var row = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 10 };
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            var icon = Theme.Icon(Glyphs.Folder, 14, SettingsUI.Accent);
            icon.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
            row.Children.Add(icon);
            var text = new StackPanel
            {
                Spacing = 1,
                Children =
                {
                    new TextBlock { Text = Path.GetFileName(folder) is { Length: > 0 } name ? name : folder, FontSize = 13, FontWeight = FontWeights.Medium, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextPrimary },
                    new TextBlock { Text = folder, FontSize = 11, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis },
                },
            };
            Grid.SetColumn(text, 1);
            row.Children.Add(text);
            var show = IconButton(Glyphs.ArrowUpRight, "Show in File Explorer");
            show.Click += (_, _) => _ = Windows.System.Launcher.LaunchFolderPathAsync(folder);
            Grid.SetColumn(show, 2);
            row.Children.Add(show);
            var remove = IconButton(Glyphs.Delete, "Remove this folder");
            remove.Click += (_, _) => Change(() => AppServices.ChatFolders.Remove(folder));
            Grid.SetColumn(remove, 3);
            row.Children.Add(remove);
            _list.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Card(row));
        }
    }

    private void ShowSuggestions(IReadOnlyList<string> added)
    {
        _suggestions.Children.Clear();
        var suggested = CloudFolders.Find().Where(f => !added.Contains(f.Path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        if (suggested.Count == 0) return;
        _suggestions.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = "Synced from OneDrive and SharePoint", FontSize = 12, FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary,
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 6, 0, 0),
        });
        foreach (var folder in suggested)
        {
            var row = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 10 };
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            var icon = Theme.Icon(Glyphs.Cloud, 14, SettingsUI.TextSecondary);
            icon.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
            row.Children.Add(icon);
            var text = new StackPanel
            {
                Spacing = 1,
                Children =
                {
                    new TextBlock { Text = folder.Name, FontSize = 13, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextPrimary },
                    new TextBlock { Text = folder.Path, FontSize = 11, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis },
                },
            };
            Grid.SetColumn(text, 1);
            row.Children.Add(text);
            var add = new Button { Content = "Add", VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
            Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(add, $"Add {folder.Name}");
            add.Click += (_, _) => Change(() => AppServices.ChatFolders.Add([folder.Path]));
            Grid.SetColumn(add, 2);
            row.Children.Add(add);
            _suggestions.Children.Add(row);
        }
    }

    private static Button IconButton(string glyph, string name)
    {
        var button = new Button
        {
            Content = Theme.Icon(glyph, 12),
            Padding = new Thickness(6),
            Background = new SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Transparent),
            BorderThickness = new Thickness(0),
            Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary,
            VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
        };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(button, name);
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(button, name);
        return button;
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.WinUI/Views/BehaviourSettingsPage.cs =====
// Settings  Model behaviour: how each model family samples its replies. Each family starts
// with its makers' recommended settings, which Vireo's engine (vireo-server) applies by
// itself; a change here is saved in engine.json and sent with each chat that follows the
// model's settings, while that family's model runs on this PC (ChatStore.ModelSampling).
// Reset puts the recommended ones back. A chat's own Reply style still wins.
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Vireo.Core.Engine;

namespace Vireo.WinUI.Views;

internal sealed class BehaviourSettingsPage : StackPanel
{
    private readonly EngineSettingsStore _engine = AppServices.Engine;
    private readonly SelectorBar _families = new() { Margin = new Thickness(-8, 12, 0, 4) };
    private readonly StackPanel _settings = new();
    private ModelFamily _family;
    private Button? _reset;

    public BehaviourSettingsPage()
    {
        Children.Add(SettingsUI.Note("Each family of models is trained for its own settings. These start as their makers recommend; "
            + "change them only if replies come out too random or too repetitive."));

        var active = ActiveFamily();
        _family = active ?? ModelFamily.Qwen;
        foreach (var info in ModelFamilies.All)
        {
            var item = new SelectorBarItem { Text = info.Title, Tag = info.Family };
            _families.Items.Add(item);
            if (info.Family == _family) _families.SelectedItem = item;
        }
        _families.SelectionChanged += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (_families.SelectedItem?.Tag is ModelFamily family)
            {
                _family = family;
                Show();
            }
        };
        Children.Add(_families);
        Children.Add(_settings);
        Show();
    }

    /// <summary>The family of the model the engine runs, if one is chosen.</summary>
    private static ModelFamily? ActiveFamily()
    {
        if (AppServices.Engine.Current.ActiveModel is not { } path || !File.Exists(path)) return null;
        var model = AppServices.Library.Describe(path);
        return model.Family;
    }

    private void Show()
    {
        _settings.Children.Clear();
        var info = ModelFamilies.Info(_family);
        var current = _engine.Current.BehaviourFor(_family);
        bool recommended = _engine.Current.IsRecommended(_family);

        string source = recommended ? $"Using {info.Source}." : $"Changed from {info.Source}.";
        string active = ActiveFamily() == _family ? " The active model is in this family." : "";
        var reset = SettingsUI.Button("Reset to Recommended", () =>
        {
            _engine.Update(s => s.WithBehaviour(_family, null));
            Show();
        });
        reset.IsEnabled = !recommended;
        _reset = reset;
        _settings.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row("", info.Title, source + active, reset));

        _settings.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Header("Sampling"));
        var sampling = SettingsUI.Stack();
        sampling.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row("", "Temperature",
            "Higher gives more varied replies; lower, more predictable ones.",
            Slider(current.Temperature, 0, 2, 0.05, "0.00", (b, v) => b with { Temperature = v })));
        sampling.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row("", "Top P",
            "Picks from the likeliest words that together make up this share of the chance.",
            Slider(current.TopP, 0, 1, 0.01, "0.00", (b, v) => b with { TopP = v })));
        sampling.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row("", "Top K",
            "Picks from at most this many of the likeliest words. 0 turns it off.",
            Number(current.TopK, 0, 200, 1, (b, v) => b with { TopK = (int)v })));
        sampling.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row("", "Min P",
            "Leaves out words less likely than this share of the likeliest one. 0 turns it off.",
            Slider(current.MinP, 0, 0.5, 0.01, "0.00", (b, v) => b with { MinP = v })));
        _settings.Children.Add(sampling);

        _settings.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Header("Thinking"));
        _settings.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row("", "Thinking",
            "Vireo's engine answers straight away for now: models don't think first, whatever the family can do."));
    }

    private void Save(FamilyBehaviour behaviour)
    {
        _engine.Update(s => s.WithBehaviour(_family, behaviour));
        if (_reset is not null) _reset.IsEnabled = !_engine.Current.IsRecommended(_family);
    }

    /// <summary>A slider with its value beside it, saved as it moves.</summary>
    private StackPanel Slider(double value, double minimum, double maximum, double step, string format, Func<FamilyBehaviour, double, FamilyBehaviour> change)
    {
        var label = new TextBlock { Text = value.ToString(format), Width = 36, FontSize = 13, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Right };
        var slider = new Slider { Minimum = minimum, Maximum = maximum, StepFrequency = step, Value = value, Width = 200, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        slider.ValueChanged += (_, e) =>
        {
            label.Text = e.NewValue.ToString(format);
            double rounded = Math.Round(e.NewValue / step) * step;
            // Applied to the saved settings, so fields changed since the page was drawn are kept.
            Save(change(_engine.Current.BehaviourFor(_family), Math.Round(rounded, 4)));
        };
        return SettingsUI.Buttons(label, slider);
    }

    private NumberBox Number(int value, int minimum, int maximum, int step, Func<FamilyBehaviour, double, FamilyBehaviour> change)
    {
        var box = new NumberBox
        {
            Value = value,
            Minimum = minimum,
            Maximum = maximum,
            SmallChange = step,
            SpinButtonPlacementMode = NumberBoxSpinButtonPlacementMode.Inline,
            Width = 160,
        };
        box.ValueChanged += (_, e) =>
        {
            if (double.IsNaN(e.NewValue)) return;
            Save(change(_engine.Current.BehaviourFor(_family), Math.Round(e.NewValue)));
        };
        return box;
    }

}


===== tools/aurelia_run.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Plays the Aurelia gauntlet (docs/dev/test-gauntlet/aurelia_full.json, 32 prompts) in the
prototype Mac app, on vireo-server, and grades each prompt with the suite's own checks.

The prompts are typed into the real app by its test-script runner (Test > Run Test Script,
here started with --run-script), so the run can be watched: the chats, tool steps and
approval cards are the app's own. After each prompt the app writes that step's record and
waits; this script grades it against the files as that prompt left them, then lets the
next one start.

    python3 tools/aurelia_run.py --model <file.gguf> [--label gemma4-31b] [--only 2.1,2.2]
    python3 tools/aurelia_run.py --compare <new run folder> <old run folder> [--grades gemma]

What a run touches:

- The app's chats and chat cache (~/Library/Application Support/VireoPrototype/Chats and
  chat-cache) are DELETED before the run, so it starts with none. --keep-chats leaves them.
- Everything else is the run's own, in a scratch folder: a fresh copy of the test files
  (made by make_aurelia.py), the memory file, the approvals file and an empty skills
  folder. The user's memory, skills, saved approvals and ~/Documents are not used. The
  prompts that name "~/Documents/Vireo App Test/Aurelia Minerals" are sent with the
  scratch copy's path in its place (each record keeps the original as `prompt_as_written`).
- The chats get "Folders I choose" access to the scratch copy only, so nothing else on the
  Mac (the answer key included) can be read or changed. A file the model deletes goes to
  the Mac's Trash.
- The app's model becomes --model, and stays so afterwards.

Grading is run_full.py's: the suite's checks are hints (text in the answer, tools called,
text in the files, facts in memory), ported as they are. The grade here is worked out from
the hints alone: pass when every hint that applies passes, partial when at least half do,
fail otherwise. The 0.9 runs were graded by a person reading the answers, so compare hints
with hints (--compare does) and read the answers before calling a prompt better or worse.

Prompts the prototype can't run fairly are marked "not runnable" with the reason, and
still sent so what the model did is on record (none are, since 2026-11-13).

The calendar prompts (4.4, 9.1) run dry: the app pretends to add the events and reminders
(nothing goes on the Mac's own calendar) and each record lists what would have been added.
The automation prompts (11.1 to 11.3) use the server's tasks, kept in the scratch folder:
after 11.1 the waiting files are moved into the watched folder, after 11.2 the link task's
link is called, and 11.3 is made as a task and started with Run now. The app runs each task
as a chat of its own and leaves its record in the gate folder (task-run-<n>.json).

--thinking on|off sets the model's thinking for the run (on by default, as the 0.9 runs
had it).

Standard library only; openpyxl and python-docx are used to read the files when they are
there (server/venv/bin/python has them), as run_full.py did.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as dt
import glob
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROTO = HERE.parent
REPO = PROTO.parent
GAUNTLET = REPO / 'docs/dev/test-gauntlet'
SUITE = GAUNTLET / 'aurelia_full.json'
APP = PROTO / 'Mac/App/release/Vireo-Proto.app'
BUNDLE_ID = 'com.invurseai.vireo.prototype'
APP_DATA = Path.home() / 'Library/Application Support/VireoPrototype'
WRITTEN_FOLDER = '~/Documents/Vireo App Test/Aurelia Minerals'
PROMPT_TIMEOUT = 30 * 60
START_TIMEOUT = 12 * 60

# What vireo-server has no way to do on the Mac yet, so the prompt can't be run fairly.
# (Calendar, reminders, tasks and chat search came on 2026-11-13: none left.)
NOT_RUNNABLE: dict = {}
# Tools a check names that the Mac prototype doesn't offer: a check that wants one of
# only these is left out of the count.
NOT_ON_THE_MAC = {'run_shell_command'}
# How long the app's task runner may take to pick up a task that's due (it asks the server
# every 10 s, and a new file is left 3 s to settle).
TASK_PICKUP = 40


def log(*parts) -> None:
    print(time.strftime('%H:%M:%S'), *parts, flush=True)


#  Reading the files (run_quick.py's file_text) 
def _xml(archive: zipfile.ZipFile, name: str):
    return ElementTree.fromstring(archive.read(name))


def _local(tag: str) -> str:
    return tag.rsplit('}', 1)[-1]


def _xlsx_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Every sheet's rows, cells joined with " | " (what openpyxl gives, near enough)."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        shared = []
        if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
            for item in _xml(archive, 'xl/sharedStrings.xml'):
                shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in item.iter() if _local(t.tag) == 't'))
        lines = []
        for name in sorted(n for n in names if re.fullmatch(r'xl/worksheets/sheet\d+\.xml', n)):
            for row in (e for e in _xml(archive, name).iter() if _local(e.tag) == 'row'):
                cells = []
                for cell in (e for e in row if _local(e.tag) == 'c'):
                    kind = cell.get('t')
                    value = next((e.text or '' for e in cell if _local(e.tag) == 'v'), '')
                    if kind == 's' and value.isdigit():
                        value = shared[int(value)]
                    elif kind == 'inlineStr':
                        value = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in cell.iter() if _local(t.tag) == 't')
                    cells.append(value)
                lines.append(' | '.join(cells))
        return '\n'.join(lines)


def _docx_text(path: Path) -> str:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        body = _xml(archive, 'word/document.xml')
    return '\n'.join(''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter() if _local(t.tag) == 't')
                     for p in body.iter() if _local(p.tag) == 'p')


def file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    if path.suffix == '.xlsx':
        try:
            import openpyxl  # noqa: PLC0415
        except ImportError:
            return _xlsx_text(path)
        book = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
        return '\n'.join(' | '.join('' if c is None else str(c) for c in row)
                         for sheet in book.worksheets for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    if path.suffix == '.docx':
        try:
            import docx  # noqa: PLC0415
        except ImportError:
            return _docx_text(path)
        doc = docx.Document(path)
        parts = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]
        parts += [cell.text for table in doc.tables for row in table.rows for cell in row.cells]
        return '\n'.join(parts)
    return path.read_text(errors='replace')


def readers() -> str:
    found = []
    for name in ('openpyxl', 'docx'):
        try:
            __import__(name)
            found.append(name)
        except ImportError:
            pass
    return ', '.join(found) if len(found) == 2 else f'standard library (found: {", ".join(found) or "neither"})'


#  Checks (run_quick.py's check, with run_full.py's tools_any_*) 
def plain(text: str) -> str:
    """Lower case, thousands separators and currency signs removed, so 38,981.55 matches 38981.55."""
    text = re.sub(r'(?<=\d),(?=\d{3})', '', text or '')
    return text.replace('$', '').lower()


def check(item: dict, record: dict, folder: Path, docx_before: set, memories: list) -> list[str]:
    """One line per hint:  passed,  failed,  left out (it wants a tool the Mac
    prototype doesn't have)."""
    results = []
    checks = item.get('checks', {})
    answer = plain(record['answer'])
    tools = [t['tool'] for t in record['tools']]

    def mark(ok: bool, text: str) -> None:
        results.append(f'{"" if ok else ""} {text}')

    for key, wanted in checks.items():
        if key.startswith('answer_all'):
            for w in wanted:
                mark(plain(w) in answer, f'answer has "{w}"')
        elif key.startswith('answer_any'):
            mark(any(plain(w) in answer for w in wanted), f'answer has one of {wanted}')
        elif key.startswith('answer_none'):
            for w in wanted:
                mark(plain(w) not in answer, f'answer avoids "{w}"')
        elif key.startswith('tools_any'):
            if all(w in NOT_ON_THE_MAC for w in wanted):
                results.append(f' used one of {wanted} (not a tool of the Mac prototype)')
            else:
                mark(any(t in tools for t in wanted), f'used one of {wanted}')
        elif key == 'tools_none':
            mark(not any(t in tools for t in wanted), f'did not use {wanted}')
        elif key.startswith('memory_'):
            # The scratch folder's own name is not something the model chose to keep (a
            # temporary folder's name can hold "4000", which 12.2 looks for).
            texts = plain('\n'.join(memories).replace(str(folder), WRITTEN_FOLDER))
            if key == 'memory_all':
                for w in wanted:
                    mark(plain(w) in texts, f'a memory has "{w}"')
            elif key == 'memory_any':
                mark(any(plain(w) in texts for w in wanted), f'a memory has one of {wanted}')
            elif key == 'memory_none':
                for w in wanted:
                    mark(plain(w) not in texts, f'no memory has "{w}"')
        elif key == 'file':
            for spec in wanted:
                path = folder / spec['path']
                text = plain(file_text(path)) if path.exists() else ''
                for w in spec.get('all', []):
                    mark(plain(w) in text, f'{spec["path"]} has "{w}"')
                for w in spec.get('none', []):
                    mark(plain(w) not in text, f'{spec["path"]} avoids "{w}"')
                for w, n in spec.get('count', {}).items():
                    found = text.count(plain(w))
                    mark(found == n, f'{spec["path"]} has "{w}" {n}x (found {found})')
        elif key == 'new_docx':
            new = sorted(set(glob.glob(str(folder / '**/*.docx'), recursive=True)) - docx_before)
            record['new_files'] = [str(Path(p).relative_to(folder)) for p in new]
            mark(wanted['min'] <= len(new) <= wanted['max'],
                 f'{wanted["min"]}-{wanted["max"]} new .docx (found {len(new)}: {", ".join(record["new_files"])})')
            together = plain('\n'.join(file_text(Path(p)) for p in new))
            for w in wanted.get('all_together', []):
                mark(plain(w) in together, f'new .docx files have "{w}"')
    return results


def hint_counts(hints: list) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Hints passed, and hints that count (those left out with "" don't)."""
    return sum(h.startswith('') for h in hints), sum(h.startswith(('', '')) for h in hints)


def grade_from_hints(hints: list, error) -> str:
    """The grade the hints alone give. The 0.9 runs' grades were a person's, from the answers."""
    passed, counted = hint_counts(hints)
    if error:
        return 'fail'
    if counted == 0:
        return 'no hints'
    if passed == counted:
        return 'pass'
    return 'partial' if passed * 2 >= counted else 'fail'


#  The app 
APP_PROCESS = 'Vireo-Proto.app/Contents/MacOS/VireoMac'


def app_running() -> bool:
    return subprocess.run(['pgrep', '-f', APP_PROCESS],
                          capture_output=True).returncode == 0


def quit_app() -> None:
    if not app_running():
        return
    log('Quitting Vireo-Proto')
    # Asked as a user would; then, for a copy started some other way (which doesn't hear
    # that), told to end. Its chats are saved as they go, and its server stops with it.
    for ask in (['osascript', '-e', f'tell application id "{BUNDLE_ID}" to quit'],
                ['pkill', '-TERM', '-f', APP_PROCESS], ['pkill', '-KILL', '-f', APP_PROCESS]):
        subprocess.run(ask, capture_output=True)
        for _ in range(20):
            if not app_running():
                time.sleep(1)
                return
            time.sleep(1)
    raise SystemExit('Vireo-Proto did not quit; quit it by hand and run again.')


def delete_chats() -> list[str]:
    """The app's chats and their caches, so a run starts with none (the app is quit)."""
    gone = []
    for name in ('Chats', 'chat-cache'):
        path = APP_DATA / name
        if path.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(path)
            gone.append(str(path))
    return gone


def make_files(folder: Path, python: str | None, copy_from: str | None) -> str:
    """A fresh copy of the test files: built by make_aurelia.py, or copied."""
    if copy_from:
        shutil.copytree(Path(copy_from).expanduser(), folder)
        return f'copied from {copy_from}'
    python = python or str(REPO / 'server/venv/bin/python')
    made = subprocess.run([python, '-I', str(GAUNTLET / 'make_aurelia.py'), str(folder)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if made.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f'make_aurelia.py failed (it needs python-docx, openpyxl and reportlab; '
                         f'pass --python or --copy-from):\n{made.stderr[-800:]}')
    return f'built by make_aurelia.py with {python}'


def as_sent(text: str, folder: Path) -> str:
    return text.replace(WRITTEN_FOLDER, str(folder))


def server_api(method: str, path: str, body=None, timeout: float = 30):
    """A call to the app's vireo-server, with the app's own token (both from its settings)."""
    def setting(key: str) -> str:
        return subprocess.run(['defaults', 'read', BUNDLE_ID, key], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    base = (setting('invurse_server_url') or 'http://localhost:3100').rstrip('/')
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        base + path, method=method, data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),
        headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {setting("vireo_engine_server_token")}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
        return json.loads(response.read().decode() or 'null')


def task_runs(gate: Path) -> tuple[int, list]:
    """How many task runs the app has started, and the records of those that have ended."""
    started = len(list(gate.glob('task-run-*.started')))
    ended = sorted(gate.glob('task-run-*.json'), key=lambda p: int(re.findall(r'\d+', p.stem)[-1]))
    return started, ended


def wait_for_task_runs(gate: Path, seen: int, seconds: float) -> list:
    """The records of the task runs since `seen` of them, once the app has gone quiet: at
    least one has ended, none is under way, and no other starts for a while after."""
    began = time.time()
    deadline = began + seconds
    quiet_since = None
    while time.time() < deadline and app_running():
        started, ended = task_runs(gate)
        if started <= seen and time.time() - began > 2 * TASK_PICKUP:
            break  # nothing was set off: no task watches for it
        if len(ended) > seen and started == len(ended):
            quiet_since = quiet_since or time.time()
            if time.time() - quiet_since >= TASK_PICKUP:
                break
        else:
            quiet_since = None
        time.sleep(1)
    return [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in task_runs(gate)[1][seen:]]


def after_steps(item: dict, folder: Path, gate: Path, record: dict) -> None:
    """What the suite does after a prompt's reply (run_full.py's after_steps), for the
    prompts that set up a task: something lands in the watched folder, or the link is
    called, and the task's run is waited for. Its tools and answer go in `after`."""
    after = item.get('after') or {}
    seen = len(task_runs(gate)[1])
    began = time.time()
    if 'move_folder' in after:
        src, dst = (folder / part for part in after['move_folder'])
        dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        moved = []
        for path in sorted(src.iterdir()):
            if path.is_file():
                shutil.move(str(path), dst / path.name)
                moved.append(path.name)
        log(f'  moved into {dst.name}: {", ".join(moved)}')
        record['after'] = {'moved': moved}
    elif 'hook' in after:
        try:
            links = [t for t in server_api('GET', '/api/tasks').get('tasks', []) if t.get('link')]
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            record['after'] = {'error': f'The server\'s tasks could not be read: {error}'}
            return
        record['after'] = {'link_tasks': [{k: t.get(k) for k in ('name', 'prompt', 'schedule', 'link')} for t in links]}
        if not links:
            record['after']['error'] = 'No link task was created.'
            log('  no link task was created')
            return
        url = links[-1]['link']
        record['after']['link_in_reply'] = url in record['answer']
        try:
            request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=after['hook']['text'].encode(), method='POST',
                                             headers={'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                record['after']['post'] = response.read().decode()[:300]
        except OSError as error:
            record['after']['error'] = f'The link could not be called: {error}'
            return
        log(f'  posted to the link: {record["after"]["post"]}')
    else:
        return
    runs = wait_for_task_runs(gate, seen, after.get('wait_task_seconds', 600))
    record['after']['task_runs'] = runs
    record['after']['seconds'] = round(time.time() - began, 1)
    if not runs:
        record['after']['error'] = 'No task ran.'
    log(f'  {len(runs)} task run(s): ' + '; '.join(f'{len(r.get("tools", []))} tools' for r in runs))


def run_task_item(item: dict, folder: Path, gate: Path) -> dict:
    """11.3: a task made as the app's own form would make it, then Run now. Its record is
    the run's: the answer and tools of the chat the app played it in."""
    record = {'id': item['id'], 'title': item['title'], 'chatId': None, 'prompt': as_sent(item['prompt'], folder),
              'tools': [], 'approvals': [], 'events': [], 'answer': '', 'error': None, 'stats': {}, 'seconds': 0}
    seen = len(task_runs(gate)[1])
    began = time.time()
    schedule = item['task'].get('schedule', {})
    try:
        task = server_api('POST', '/api/tasks', {
            'name': item['task']['name'], 'prompt': record['prompt'],
            'when': f'daily {schedule.get("time", "08:00")}', 'access': 'folders', 'folders': [str(folder)]})
        server_api('POST', f'/api/tasks/{task["id"]}/run', {})
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
        record['error'] = f'the task could not be made or started: {error}'
        return record
    record['task'] = task
    log(f'  task "{task["name"]}" ({task.get("schedule")}) started with Run now')
    runs = wait_for_task_runs(gate, seen, (item.get('after') or {}).get('wait_task_seconds', 600))
    record['seconds'] = round(time.time() - began - (TASK_PICKUP if runs else 0), 1)
    if not runs:
        record['error'] = 'the task did not run'
        return record
    run = runs[-1]
    record['answer'] = run.get('reply', '')
    record['events'] = run.get('toolSteps') or []
    record['tools'] = [{'tool': s.get('tool'), 'detail': (s.get('detail') or '')[:200]}
                       for s in record['events'] if s.get('type') == 'tool_call']
    record['approvals'] = [{'tool': a.get('tool'), 'approved': a.get('approved'),
                            'preview': str(a.get('preview', ''))[:4000], 'args': a.get('args')}
                           for a in run.get('approvals') or []]
    if run.get('error'):
        record['error'] = 'the task\'s reply ended in an error'
    return record


def build_script(suite: dict, prompts: list, folder: Path, gate: Path, thinking: bool) -> dict:
    steps, chat = [], None
    for item in prompts:
        if item.get('task'):  # made as a task and started with Run now, not typed
            continue
        if not (item.get('chat') == 'same' and chat):
            chat = f'{item["id"]} {item["title"]}'
        step = {'prompt': as_sent(item['prompt'], folder), 'title': f'{item["id"]} {item["title"]}', 'chat': chat}
        policy = item.get('approvals', 'approve')
        if isinstance(policy, dict):
            step['approveIf'] = policy['approve_if']
        else:
            step['approve'] = policy != 'reject'
        steps.append(step)
    return {'name': 'Aurelia', 'access': 'folders', 'folders': [str(folder)], 'gate': str(gate),
            'thinking': thinking, 'steps': steps}


def record_from(step: dict, item: dict, folder: Path) -> dict:
    """The app's record of a step, in the shape of run_full.py's."""
    tool_steps = step.get('toolSteps') or []
    record = {
        'id': item['id'], 'title': item['title'], 'chatId': step.get('chat'),
        'prompt': step.get('prompt', ''), 'tools': [], 'approvals': [], 'events': tool_steps,
        'answer': step.get('reply', ''), 'error': 'the reply ended in an error' if step.get('error') else None,
        'stats': {'tokens': step.get('tokens'), 'tokensPerSecond': step.get('tokensPerSecond'),
                  'firstWordSeconds': step.get('firstWordSeconds')},
        'seconds': round(step.get('seconds', 0), 1),
    }
    if record['prompt'] != item['prompt']:
        record['prompt_as_written'] = item['prompt']
    calls = [s for s in tool_steps if s.get('type') == 'tool_call']
    if not calls:  # an app without the fuller record
        calls = [{'tool': t} for t in step.get('tools', [])]
    record['tools'] = [{'tool': c.get('tool'), 'detail': (c.get('detail') or '')[:200]} for c in calls]
    record['approvals'] = [{'tool': a.get('tool'), 'approved': a.get('approved'),
                            'preview': str(a.get('preview', ''))[:4000], 'args': a.get('args')}
                           for a in step.get('approvalsAsked') or []]
    if step.get('calendar'):  # what a dry run would have put on the calendar
        record['calendar'] = step['calendar']
    return record


def wait_for(path: Path, seconds: float) -> bool:
    deadline = time.time() + seconds
    while time.time() < deadline:
        if path.exists():
            time.sleep(0.2)  # written whole (atomically), but let the app settle
            return True
        if not app_running():
            return False
        time.sleep(0.5)
    return False


#  Report 
def summary_rows(records: list) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for r in records:
        passed, counted = hint_counts(r.get('checks', []))
        rows.append({'id': r['id'], 'title': r['title'], 'grade': r['grade'], 'hints_passed': passed,
                     'hints': counted, 'seconds': r['seconds'], 'tools': len(r['tools']),
                     'approvals': len(r['approvals']),
                     'approved': sum(1 for a in r['approvals'] if a['approved']),
                     **({'not_runnable': r['not_runnable']} if r.get('not_runnable') else {})})
    return rows


def table(rows: list) -> str:
    lines = ['| # | Title | Grade (hints) | Hints | Seconds | Tools | Approvals |', '|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|']
    for r in rows:
        asked = f'{r["approvals"]}' + (f' ({r["approvals"] - r["approved"]} declined)' if r['approvals'] != r['approved'] else '')
        lines.append(f'| {r["id"]} | {r["title"]} | {r["grade"]} | {r["hints_passed"]}/{r["hints"]} '
                     f'| {r["seconds"]:.0f} | {r["tools"]} | {asked} |')
    return '\n'.join(lines)


def totals(rows: list) -> dict:
    count = {g: sum(1 for r in rows if r['grade'] == g) for g in ('pass', 'partial', 'fail', 'not runnable', 'no hints')}
    ran = [r for r in rows if r['grade'] != 'not runnable']
    return {**count, 'prompts': len(rows),
            'hints_passed': sum(r['hints_passed'] for r in ran), 'hints': sum(r['hints'] for r in ran),
            'minutes': round(sum(r['seconds'] for r in rows) / 60, 1), 'tool_calls': sum(r['tools'] for r in rows)}


def report(out: Path, suite: dict, meta: dict, records: list) -> None:
    rows = summary_rows(records)
    total = totals(rows)
    (out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'meta': meta, 'totals': total, 'prompts': rows}, indent=1, default=str))
    lines = [f'# {suite["name"]} on the prototype, {meta["started"]}, {meta["label"]}', '',
             'Played in the prototype Mac app (vireo-server) by `VireoPrototype/tools/aurelia_run.py`. '
             'The grade is worked out from the hints alone; see that script for what it does and does not show.', '',
             '## Setup', '', '```json', json.dumps(meta, indent=2, default=str), '```', '',
             '## Summary', '', table(rows), '',
             f'Pass {total["pass"]}, partial {total["partial"]}, fail {total["fail"]}, not runnable {total["not runnable"]} '
             f'of {total["prompts"]}  hints {total["hints_passed"]}/{total["hints"]} on the prompts that ran  '
             f'{total["minutes"]} min  {total["tool_calls"]} tool calls', '']
    for r in records:
        item = next(p for p in suite['prompts'] if p['id'] == r['id'])
        lines += [f'## {r["id"]} {item["title"]}' + (' (same chat)' if item.get('chat') == 'same' else ''), '',
                  f'**Prompt:** {r["prompt"]}', '', f'**Expected:** {item["expect"]}', '',
                  f'**Time:** {r["seconds"]} s  **Stats:** {r.get("stats")}' + (f'  **Error:** {r["error"]}' if r.get('error') else ''), '',
                  '**Tools:** ' + (', '.join(f'{t["tool"]}({t["detail"]})' if t['detail'] else t['tool'] for t in r['tools']) or 'none'), '']
        if r.get('not_runnable'):
            lines += [f'**Not runnable:** this prompt {r["not_runnable"]}.', '']
        for a in r['approvals']:
            lines += [f'- {"Approved" if a["approved"] else "Declined"} `{a["tool"]}`:', '', '```', a['preview'], '```', '']
        if r.get('calendar'):
            lines += ['**Calendar (pretended, not added to the Mac\'s own):**', ''] + [f'- {c}' for c in r['calendar']] + ['']
        for run in (r.get('after') or {}).get('task_runs', []):
            lines += [f'**Task run "{run.get("task")}"** ({run.get("seconds", 0):.0f} s, tools: {", ".join(run.get("tools", [])) or "none"}):',
                      '', (run.get('reply') or '(empty)').strip(), '']
        if (r.get('after') or {}).get('error'):
            lines += [f'**After the reply:** {r["after"]["error"]}', '']
        lines += ['**Hints:**', ''] + [f'- {h}' for h in r.get('checks', [])] + [
            '', f'**Grade from the hints:** {r["grade"]}', '', '**Answer:**', '', r['answer'].strip() or '(empty)', '']
    (out / 'report.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines))


#  A run 
def run(args) -> None:
    model = Path(args.model).expanduser()
    if not model.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f'No model at {model}')
    binary = Path(args.app) / 'Contents/MacOS/VireoMac'
    if not binary.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f'No app at {args.app}; build it with Mac/App/build-test-app.sh')
    suite = json.loads(SUITE.read_text())
    only = set(args.only.split(',')) if args.only else None
    prompts = [p for p in suite['prompts'] if not only or p['id'] in only]
    if not prompts:
        raise SystemExit('No prompt has those ids.')

    stamp = dt.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d-%H%M')
    label = args.label or re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9.]+', '-', model.stem.lower()).strip('-')
    out = Path(args.out).expanduser() if args.out else GAUNTLET / 'runs' / f'proto-{stamp}-{label}'
    work = Path(os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='vireo-aurelia-', dir=args.work)))
    folder, gate = work / 'Aurelia Minerals', work / 'gate'
    memory_file, skills = work / 'memories.txt', work / 'skills'
    gate.mkdir()
    memory_file.write_text('')
    if args.skills:
        shutil.copytree(Path(args.skills).expanduser(), skills)
    else:
        skills.mkdir()
    built_in = REPO / 'server/builtin-skills'
    if args.builtin_skills == 'off':
        built_in = work / 'no-builtin-skills'
        built_in.mkdir()

    quit_app()
    deleted = [] if args.keep_chats else delete_chats()
    for path in deleted:
        log(f'Deleted {path}')
    files_from = make_files(folder, args.python, args.copy_from)
    log(f'Test files: {folder} ({files_from})')
    thinking = args.thinking == 'on'
    script = build_script(suite, prompts, folder, gate, thinking)
    if not script['steps']:
        raise SystemExit('A task prompt (11.3) needs a typed prompt in the same run to start the app\'s '
                         'script with, e.g. --only 8.2,11.3')
    (work / 'script.json').write_text(json.dumps(script, indent=1))

    commit = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO), 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    meta = {
        'label': label, 'started': stamp, 'model': model.name, 'app': str(args.app), 'commit': commit,
        'played_in': 'the prototype Mac app (its test-script runner), on vireo-server inside the app',
        'access': 'folders', 'folder': str(folder), 'files': files_from, 'thinking': args.thinking,
        'calendar': 'pretended by the app (a dry run): nothing is added to the Mac\'s calendar or reminders',
        'path_rewritten': f'"{WRITTEN_FOLDER}" in a prompt is sent as "{folder}"',
        'chat_settings': 'the app\'s defaults for a new chat (system prompt, sampling, reply length)',
        'chats_deleted_before_run': deleted, 'memory_file': str(memory_file),
        'user_skills': args.skills or 'none (an empty folder)',
        'builtin_skills': str(built_in) if args.builtin_skills == 'on' else 'none',
        'file_readers': readers(), 'prompts': [p['id'] for p in prompts],
        'grading': 'pass = every hint that applies passed; partial = at least half; fail = fewer, or the reply ended in an error',
        'seconds_note': 'as the app times a reply; each approval card is left up 1.5 s before it is answered',
    }
    # Opened as the Finder opens it (a new copy, in front), with the run's own memory,
    # approvals and skills; the server the app starts inherits them.
    env = {'VIREO_MEMORY_FILE': memory_file, 'VIREO_APPROVALS_FILE': work / 'approvals.txt',
           'VIREO_TASKS_FILE': work / 'tasks.json',
           'INVURSE_SKILLS_DIR': skills, 'VIREO_BUILTIN_SKILLS': built_in}
    opened = subprocess.run(
        ['open', '-n', '-a', str(args.app), '--stdout', str(work / 'app.log'), '--stderr', str(work / 'app.log')]
        + [part for key, value in env.items() for part in ('--env', f'{key}={value}')]
        + ['--args', '--run-script', str(work / 'script.json'), '--model', str(model)],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    if opened.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"The app didn't open: {opened.stderr.strip()}")
    time.sleep(3)
    log(f'Vireo-Proto started with {model.name}; {len(prompts)} prompts. Results: {out}')

    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    records: list = []

    def graded(item: dict, record: dict, docx_before: set) -> None:
        memories = [line for line in memory_file.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines() if line.strip()]
        record['memories'] = [m[:400] for m in memories]
        try:
            record['checks'] = check(item, record, folder, docx_before, memories)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            record['checks'] = [f' check error: {type(error).__name__}: {error}']
        record['grade_from_hints'] = grade_from_hints(record['checks'], record['error'])
        if item['id'] in NOT_RUNNABLE:
            record['not_runnable'] = NOT_RUNNABLE[item['id']]
        record['grade'] = 'not runnable' if record.get('not_runnable') else record['grade_from_hints']
        records.append(record)
        (out / f'{item["id"]}.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=1, default=str))
        passed, counted = hint_counts(record['checks'])
        log(f'  {record["grade"]}: {record["seconds"]} s, {len(record["tools"])} tools, '
            f'{len(record["approvals"])} approvals, hints {passed}/{counted}'
            + (f', ERROR {record["error"]}' if record['error'] else ''))
        report(out, suite, meta, records)

    # The app waits at each typed prompt's gate until its `.done` is written. That is held
    # back until the next typed prompt is wanted, so a task prompt in between (11.3) runs
    # while the app is waiting, not alongside the next reply.
    held_gate = None
    step = 0
    try:
        for item in prompts:
            docx_before = set(glob.glob(str(folder / '**/*.docx'), recursive=True))
            log(f'{item["id"]} {item["title"]}')
            if item.get('task'):
                if step == 0:  # nothing typed yet: the app is still starting its model
                    deadline = time.time() + START_TIMEOUT
                    while time.time() < deadline and app_running():
                        try:
                            server_api('GET', '/api/tasks', timeout=5)
                            break
                        except (OSError, ValueError):
                            time.sleep(2)
                graded(item, run_task_item(item, folder, gate), docx_before)
                continue
            if held_gate:
                held_gate.write_text('')
            step += 1
            step_file = gate / f'step-{step}.json'
            if not wait_for(step_file, PROMPT_TIMEOUT + (START_TIMEOUT if step == 1 else 0)):
                reason = 'the app quit' if not app_running() else 'no reply in time'
                log(f'  stopped: {reason}')
                meta['stopped'] = f'at {item["id"]}: {reason}'
                held_gate = None
                break
            held_gate = gate / f'step-{step}.done'
            record = record_from(json.loads(step_file.read_text()), item, folder)
            after_steps(item, folder, gate, record)
            graded(item, record, docx_before)
        if held_gate:
            held_gate.write_text('')
    finally:
        if records:
            report(out, suite, meta, records)
            if folder.exists():
                shutil.copytree(folder, out / 'files', dirs_exist_ok=True)
        if args.quit_after:
            quit_app()
    if records:
