        rows = summary_rows(records)
        print('\n' + table(rows) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps(totals(rows)))
    log(f'Report: {out / "report.md"}. The run\'s own files stay in {work}'
        + ('' if args.quit_after else '; the app is left open with the chats to read.'))


#  Comparing two runs 
def load_run(folder: Path) -> dict:
    records = {}
    for path in folder.glob('*.json'):
        if re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d+', path.stem):
            records[path.stem] = json.loads(path.read_text())
    return records


def compare(new: Path, old: Path, grades_key: str | None) -> None:
    """Prompt by prompt: the same hint rule applied to both runs' recorded hints, and the
    old run's grades as a person gave them (grades_after.py) when asked for."""
    new_run, old_run = load_run(new), load_run(old)
    by_hand = {}
    if grades_key:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(GAUNTLET))
        import grades_after  # noqa: PLC0415
        by_hand = {k: {'P': 'pass', 'H': 'partial', 'F': 'fail'}[v] for k, v in grades_after.AFTER[grades_key].items()}
    suite = json.loads(SUITE.read_text())
    order = {'fail': 0, 'partial': 1, 'pass': 2}
    print(f'| # | Title | Old: by hand | Old: hints | New: hints | Old s | New s | Old tools | New tools | By the hints |')
    print('|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|')
    count = {'same': 0, 'better': 0, 'worse': 0, 'not runnable': 0}
    for item in suite['prompts']:
        key = item['id']
        a, b = old_run.get(key), new_run.get(key)
        if not b:
            continue
        old_hints = a.get('checks', []) if a else []
        old_grade = grade_from_hints(old_hints, a.get('error')) if a else '-'
        op, oc = hint_counts(old_hints)
        np_, nc = hint_counts(b.get('checks', []))
        new_grade = b.get('grade_from_hints') or grade_from_hints(b.get('checks', []), b.get('error'))
        if b.get('not_runnable'):
            verdict = 'not runnable'
        elif old_grade in order and new_grade in order:
            verdict = 'same' if order[old_grade] == order[new_grade] else 'better' if order[new_grade] > order[old_grade] else 'worse'
        else:
            verdict = '-'
        if verdict in count:
            count[verdict] += 1
        old_seconds = (a['seconds'] + (a.get('after') or {}).get('seconds', 0)) if a else 0
        print(f'| {key} | {item["title"]} | {by_hand.get(key, "-")} | {old_grade} {op}/{oc} | {new_grade} {np_}/{nc} '
              f'| {old_seconds:.0f} | {b["seconds"]:.0f} | {len(a["tools"]) if a else "-"} | {len(b["tools"])} | {verdict} |')
    print(f'\nBy the hints: {json.dumps(count)}')


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split('\n\n')[0])
    parser.add_argument('--model', help='the GGUF file the app should run')
    parser.add_argument('--label', help='the model\'s name in the run folder (default: from the file name)')
    parser.add_argument('--only', help='comma-separated prompt ids, e.g. 2.1,2.2,7.1,12.3')
    parser.add_argument('--out', help='the run folder (default: docs/dev/test-gauntlet/runs/proto-<date>-<label>)')
    parser.add_argument('--app', default=str(APP), help='Vireo-Proto.app (default: Mac/App/release)')
    parser.add_argument('--work', help='where the run\'s scratch folder is made (default: the temporary folder)')
    parser.add_argument('--python', help='a Python with python-docx, openpyxl and reportlab, for make_aurelia.py '
                                         '(default: server/venv/bin/python)')
    parser.add_argument('--copy-from', help='copy the test files from this folder instead of building them')
    parser.add_argument('--skills', help='a folder of the user\'s skills to run with (default: none)')
    parser.add_argument('--builtin-skills', choices=['on', 'off'], default='on',
                        help='the repository\'s server/builtin-skills (default: on)')
    parser.add_argument('--keep-chats', action='store_true', help="don't delete the app's chats and chat cache first")
    parser.add_argument('--thinking', choices=['on', 'off'], default='on',
                        help='whether the model thinks before it answers (default: on)')
    parser.add_argument('--quit-after', action='store_true', help='quit the app when the run ends')
    parser.add_argument('--compare', nargs=2, metavar=('NEW', 'OLD'), help='compare two run folders and stop')
    parser.add_argument('--grades', help='with --compare: the old run\'s grades by hand, by model key in grades_after.py (gemma, muse, qwen)')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.compare:
        compare(Path(args.compare[0]), Path(args.compare[1]), args.grades)
        return
    if not args.model:
        parser.error('--model is needed (or --compare)')
    run(args)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()


===== Windows/Vireo.WinUI/Views/ToolStepsView.cs =====
// Ported from Sources/VireoMac/Views/ToolStepsView.swift: the steps of a reply. While it
// runs they show as a live checklist, with an approval for a simple action as its last
// step; once it's done they fold, with the model's reasoning, into one quiet line
// ("Thought, used 3 tools") that opens into the same list.
using Vireo.Core.Models;
using Microsoft.UI.Text;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Input;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes;

namespace Vireo.WinUI.Views;

internal sealed class ToolStepsView : StackPanel
{
    /// <summary>A long run shows its latest steps, so the checklist doesn't push the page away.</summary>
    private const int LiveStepLimit = 6;

    private readonly Button _summaryButton;
    private readonly StackPanel _summary = new() { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 6 };
    private readonly StackPanel _list = new() { Spacing = 8, Padding = new Thickness(4, 0, 0, 4) };
    // Kept across updates while the reply streams.
    private bool _expanded;
    private readonly HashSet<int> _openResults = [];
    private List<ToolStep> _steps = [];
    private List<PlanStep> _plan = [];
    private string? _reasoning;
    private bool _isLive;
    private ConfirmRequest? _approval;
    private Action<bool, bool>? _onAnswer;
    private bool _rendered;

    public ToolStepsView()
    {
        Spacing = 8;
        _summaryButton = new Button
        {
            Content = _summary,
            Padding = new Thickness(0),
            Background = new SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Transparent),
            BorderThickness = new Thickness(0),
        };
        _summaryButton.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            _expanded = !_expanded;
            Render();
        };
        Children.Add(_summaryButton);
        Children.Add(_list);
    }

    /// <param name="plan">The assistant's checklist for a longer job (update_plan). While the reply
    /// runs only the step it's on is shown, as one line; the whole plan is in the folded line after.</param>
    /// <param name="isLive">The reply is still being generated.</param>
    /// <param name="approval">A simple action waiting for an OK, shown as the checklist's last step.</param>
    /// <param name="onAnswer">Called with whether it was approved, and with "Don't ask again".</param>
    public void Update(IReadOnlyList<ToolStep> steps, string? reasoning, IReadOnlyList<PlanStep> plan, bool isLive,
        ConfirmRequest? approval = null, Action<bool, bool>? onAnswer = null)
    {
        _onAnswer = onAnswer;
        // A streamed reply calls this for every chunk; most change nothing here.
        if (_rendered && reasoning == _reasoning && isLive == _isLive && approval?.Id == _approval?.Id
            && steps.SequenceEqual(_steps) && plan.SequenceEqual(_plan)) return;
        // The checklist opens folded once the reply is done.
        if (_isLive && !isLive) _expanded = false;
        _rendered = true;
        _steps = [.. steps];
        _plan = [.. plan];
        _reasoning = reasoning;
        _isLive = isLive;
        _approval = approval;
        Render();
    }

    private void Render()
    {
        var runs = ToolRun.Pair(_steps);
        _list.Children.Clear();
        if (_isLive)
        {
            RenderLive(runs);
            return;
        }
        Visibility = runs.Count > 0 || _reasoning is not null || _plan.Count > 0 ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        _summaryButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        int failures = runs.Count(r => r.Outcome(stillRunning: false) is ToolOutcome.Retrying or ToolOutcome.Failure);
        string summary = ToolLabels.Summary(runs, _reasoning is not null, _plan.Count);
        _summary.Children.Clear();
        _summary.Children.Add(Theme.Icon(_expanded ? Glyphs.ChevronDown : Glyphs.ChevronRight, 9, Theme.TextSecondary));
        _summary.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = summary, FontSize = 13, Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary });
        if (failures > 0)
        {
            _summary.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = $" {failures} failed", FontSize = 13, Foreground = Theme.Danger });
        }
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(_summaryButton, _expanded ? "Hide the steps" : "Show the steps");
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(_summaryButton, failures > 0 ? $"{summary}, {failures} failed" : summary);

        _list.Visibility = _expanded ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        if (!_expanded) return;
        if (_plan.Count > 0)
        {
            var planList = PlanList(_plan);
            planList.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, runs.Count == 0 && _reasoning is null ? 0 : 4);
            _list.Children.Add(planList);
        }
        if (_reasoning is not null)
        {
            _list.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = _reasoning.Length == 0 ? "" : _reasoning,
                FontSize = 13,
                Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary,
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                IsTextSelectionEnabled = true,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, runs.Count == 0 ? 0 : 4),
            });
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < runs.Count; i++) _list.Children.Add(RunRow(i, runs[i], runs[i].Outcome(stillRunning: false)));
    }

    private void RenderLive(List<ToolRun> runs)
    {
        // The approval's own tool call is still running, so the approval takes its row.
        if (_approval is { } approval && runs.Count > 0 && runs[^1].Result is null && runs[^1].Call.Tool == approval.Tool)
        {
            runs.RemoveAt(runs.Count - 1);
        }
        _summaryButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        _list.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        var current = ToolLabels.CurrentPlanStep(_plan);
        Visibility = runs.Count > 0 || _approval is not null || current is not null ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        if (current is { } step)
        {
            var line = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 6 };
            line.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = step.Position, FontSize = 13, Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary });
            if (step.Text is { } text)
            {
                line.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = "", FontSize = 13, Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary });
                line.Children.Add(new TextBlock
                {
                    Text = text,
                    FontSize = 13,
                    Foreground = Theme.TextPrimary,
                    MaxWidth = 520,
                    TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis,
                });
            }
            Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(line, step.Text is null ? step.Position : $"{step.Position}, {step.Text}");
            _list.Children.Add(line);
        }
        int hidden = _expanded ? 0 : Math.Max(0, runs.Count - LiveStepLimit);
        if (hidden > 0)
        {
            var earlier = new Button
            {
                Content = new TextBlock
                {
                    Text = $"{hidden} earlier step{(hidden == 1 ? "" : "s")}",
                    FontSize = 12,
                    FontFamily = Theme.Monospace,
                    Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary,
                },
                Padding = new Thickness(23, 0, 0, 0),
                Background = new SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Transparent),
                BorderThickness = new Thickness(0),
            };
            ToolTipService.SetToolTip(earlier, "Show every step");
            earlier.Click += (_, _) =>
            {
                _expanded = true;
                Render();
            };
            _list.Children.Add(earlier);
        }
        // Indexes from the whole list, so an open result stays open as earlier rows hide.
        for (int i = hidden; i < runs.Count; i++) _list.Children.Add(RunRow(i, runs[i], runs[i].Outcome(stillRunning: true)));
        if (_approval is { } request) _list.Children.Add(ApprovalStep(request));
    }

    /// <summary>The plan, inside the folded line: numbered steps in the same quiet type as the
    /// rest. A skipped step is struck through; one left open says "not done".</summary>
    private static StackPanel PlanList(IReadOnlyList<PlanStep> plan)
    {
        var list = new StackPanel { Spacing = 4 };
        for (int i = 0; i < plan.Count; i++)
        {
            var step = plan[i];
            bool skipped = step.Status == "skipped";
            bool open = step.Status is "pending" or "in_progress";
            var text = new TextBlock { FontSize = 13, Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap };
            text.Inlines.Add(new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Documents.Run { Text = $"{i + 1}.  " });
            text.Inlines.Add(new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Documents.Run
            {
                Text = step.Text,
                TextDecorations = skipped ? global::Windows.UI.Text.TextDecorations.Strikethrough : global::Windows.UI.Text.TextDecorations.None,
            });
            if (open) text.Inlines.Add(new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Documents.Run { Text = "   not done", Foreground = Theme.Danger });
            Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(text,
                $"Step {i + 1}, {step.Text}{(skipped ? ", skipped" : open ? ", not done" : "")}");
            list.Children.Add(text);
        }
        return list;
    }

    /// <summary>How a step stands: the leading mark of each row.</summary>
    private static FrameworkElement StepMark(ToolOutcome outcome)
    {
        FrameworkElement mark = outcome switch
        {
            ToolOutcome.Pending => new ProgressRing { Width = 13, Height = 13, IsActive = true },
            ToolOutcome.Success => Theme.Icon(Glyphs.CircleDone, 14, Theme.Accent),
            ToolOutcome.Retrying => Theme.Icon(Glyphs.Retrying, 13, new SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Orange)),
            ToolOutcome.Failure => Theme.Icon(Glyphs.Failed, 14, Theme.Danger),
            _ => Theme.Icon(Glyphs.CircleEmpty, 14, Theme.TextSecondary),
        };
        mark.Width = 14;
        mark.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
        return mark;
    }

    private UIElement RunRow(int index, ToolRun run, ToolOutcome outcome)
    {
        string label = ToolLabels.Label(run.Call.Tool, outcome);
        string? note = ToolLabels.Note(outcome);
        var line = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 9 };
        line.Children.Add(StepMark(outcome));
        line.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = label, FontSize = 12, FontFamily = Theme.Monospace, Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary });
        if (ToolLabels.ShortDetail(run.Call.Detail) is { } detail)
        {
            line.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = detail,
                FontSize = 12,
                FontFamily = Theme.Monospace,
                Foreground = Theme.TextPrimary,
                MaxWidth = 420,
                TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis,
            });
        }
        if (note is not null)
        {
            line.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = note, FontSize = 12, FontFamily = Theme.Monospace, Foreground = Theme.Danger });
        }

        var button = new Button
        {
            Content = line,
            Padding = new Thickness(0),
            Background = new SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Transparent),
            BorderThickness = new Thickness(0),
        };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(button, run.Call.Detail ?? (_openResults.Contains(index) ? "Hide the result" : "Show the result"));
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(button, $"{label} {run.Call.Detail} {note}".Trim());
        button.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (run.Result is null) return;
            if (!_openResults.Remove(index)) _openResults.Add(index);
            Render();
        };

        var row = new StackPanel { Spacing = 4, Children = { button } };
        if (_openResults.Contains(index) && run.ResultText is { } text)
        {
            row.Children.Add(new Border
            {
                Background = Theme.BgTertiary,
                CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(6),
                Padding = new Thickness(8),
                Margin = new Thickness(23, 0, 0, 0),
                Child = new TextBlock
                {
                    Text = text,
                    FontFamily = Theme.Monospace,
                    FontSize = 11,
                    Foreground = outcome is ToolOutcome.Failure or ToolOutcome.Retrying ? Theme.Danger : Theme.TextSecondary,
                    TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                    MaxLines = 14,
                    IsTextSelectionEnabled = true,
                },
            });
        }
        return row;
    }

    /// <summary>A simple action waiting for an OK. It says the same as the dialog would: what
    /// will happen, when, and whether to ask again.</summary>
    private UIElement ApprovalStep(ConfirmRequest request)
    {
        var ring = new Ellipse { Width = 13, Height = 13, Stroke = Theme.Violet, StrokeThickness = 1.5, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top, Margin = new Thickness(0, 2, 0, 0) };
        var body = new StackPanel { Spacing = 6 };
        body.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = request.Preview ?? "Approve this action?",
            FontSize = 13,
            FontWeight = FontWeights.Medium,
            Foreground = Theme.TextPrimary,
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
        });
        foreach (string detail in request.Details)
        {
            body.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = detail,
                FontSize = 12,
                FontFamily = Theme.Monospace,
                Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary,
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                IsTextSelectionEnabled = true,
            });
        }
        var remember = new CheckBox { Content = request.RememberLabel, FontSize = 12, Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary, MinWidth = 0 };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(remember, "You can make it ask again in the Mac's Settings  Agent.");
        // No default button, as in the dialog: a stray Enter must not approve. Escape rejects.
        var approve = new Button
        {
            Content = new TextBlock { Text = "Approve", FontSize = 12, FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold },
            Background = Theme.TextPrimary,
            Foreground = Theme.BgPrimary,
            BorderThickness = new Thickness(0),
            CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(12),
            Padding = new Thickness(12, 4, 12, 4),
        };
        approve.Click += (_, _) => _onAnswer?.Invoke(true, remember.IsChecked == true);
        var reject = new Button
        {
            Content = new TextBlock { Text = "Reject", FontSize = 12, FontWeight = FontWeights.Medium },
            Background = new SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Transparent),
            Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary,
            BorderThickness = new Thickness(0),
            Padding = new Thickness(4),
        };
        reject.KeyboardAccelerators.Add(new KeyboardAccelerator { Key = Windows.System.VirtualKey.Escape });
        reject.Click += (_, _) => _onAnswer?.Invoke(false, false);
        var buttons = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 12, Margin = new Thickness(0, 2, 0, 0), Children = { approve, reject } };
        if (request.RememberLabel is not null) buttons.Children.Add(remember);
        body.Children.Add(buttons);

        var row = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 9 };
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        row.Children.Add(ring);
        Grid.SetColumn(body, 1);
        row.Children.Add(body);
        return row;
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core.Tests/ChatSearchTests.cs =====
using Vireo.Core.Models;
using Vireo.Core.Storage;

namespace Vireo.Core.Tests;

public sealed class ChatSearchTests
{
    private static (List<Chat> Chats, Dictionary<string, List<ChatMessage>> Messages) Sample()
    {
        var day = new DateTimeOffset(2026, 11, 10, 9, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);
        var chats = new List<Chat>
        {
            new("A", "Process the November invoices", day) { UpdatedAt = day },
            new("B", "Gala numbers", day.AddHours(1)) { UpdatedAt = day.AddHours(1) },
            new("C", "Which invoices did we send back?", day.AddHours(2)) { UpdatedAt = day.AddHours(2) },
        };
        var messages = new Dictionary<string, List<ChatMessage>>
        {
            ["A"] =
            [
                new("user", "Process the invoices in Invoices/November."),
                new("assistant", "Four invoices can go ahead.\n\nCan't go ahead:\n- KST-0042 has no PO, so it goes back to the vendor.\n- Lumen L-310 lines add to 1,180.00, not 1,280.00: ask for a corrected invoice.\n\nThe register has the new rows."),
            ],
            ["B"] = [new("user", "How many seats?"), new("assistant", "12 seats.")],
            ["C"] = [new("user", "Which invoices did we send back?")],
        };
        return (chats, messages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FindsTheChatThatHoldsTheAnswerAndLeavesOutTheAskingOne()
    {
        var (chats, messages) = Sample();
        string found = ChatSearch.Search(chats, id => messages[id], "invoices sent back", excludeChatId: "C");
        Assert.StartsWith("1 earlier chat matches.", found);
        Assert.Contains("## Process the November invoices (November 10, 2026)", found);
        Assert.Contains("Asked: Process the invoices in Invoices/November.", found);
        Assert.Contains("KST-0042 has no PO", found);
        Assert.Contains("1,180.00", found);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("Gala", found);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SaysWhenNothingMatches()
    {
        var (chats, messages) = Sample();
        Assert.Equal("No earlier chat mentions hockey.", ChatSearch.Search(chats, id => messages[id], "the hockey", "C"));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ChatSearch.Search(chats, id => messages[id], "what did we", "C"));
        Assert.Contains(ChatStore.SearchChatsTool, ChatStore.ClientToolNames);
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Office/MarkdownBlocks.cs =====
// The Markdown a model writes for create_docx, split into blocks and styled runs. Ported from
// server/document_writer.py (parse_blocks, inline_runs, _split_title), so a Word document built
// on the PC has the same headings, lists, tables, quotes, code and rules as one the Mac builds.
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace Vireo.Core.Office;

public enum BlockKind { Heading, Paragraph, Bullet, Numbered, Quote, Code, Table, Rule }

public enum CellAlignment { Left, Center, Right }

/// <param name="Level">A heading's level, or a list item's nesting depth (0 at the top).</param>
/// <param name="Rows">A table's rows, its header first.</param>
public sealed record Block(
    BlockKind Kind, string Text = "", int Level = 0, int Number = 0,
    IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<string>>? Rows = null, IReadOnlyList<CellAlignment>? Alignments = null);

/// <summary>A piece of text and its styles. <paramref name="Link"/> is the URL it links to.</summary>
public sealed record InlineRun(string Text, bool Bold = false, bool Italic = false, bool Code = false, string? Link = null);

public static partial class MarkdownBlocks
{
    public static List<Block> Parse(string content)
    {
        string[] lines = content.Replace("\r\n", "\n").Split('\n');
        var blocks = new List<Block>();
        var paragraph = new List<(string Raw, string Stripped)>();

        void Flush()
        {
            if (paragraph.Count == 0) return;
            blocks.Add(new Block(BlockKind.Paragraph, JoinLines(paragraph)));
            paragraph.Clear();
        }

        int i = 0;
        while (i < lines.Length)
        {
            string line = lines[i];
            string stripped = line.Trim();
            if (stripped.StartsWith("```", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                Flush();
                var code = new List<string>();
                i++;
                while (i < lines.Length && !lines[i].Trim().StartsWith("```", StringComparison.Ordinal)) code.Add(lines[i++]);
                blocks.Add(new Block(BlockKind.Code, string.Join('\n', code)));
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            if (stripped.Length == 0)
            {
                Flush();
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            if (stripped.Contains('|') && i + 1 < lines.Length)
            {
                var header = Cells(stripped);
                var separator = Cells(lines[i + 1]);
                if (separator.Count == header.Count && separator.All(c => SeparatorCell().IsMatch(c)))
                {
                    Flush();
                    var alignments = separator.Select(c =>
                        c.Length > 1 && c.StartsWith(':') && c.EndsWith(':') ? CellAlignment.Center
                        : c.EndsWith(':') ? CellAlignment.Right : CellAlignment.Left).ToList();
                    var rows = new List<IReadOnlyList<string>> { header };
                    i += 2;
                    while (i < lines.Length && lines[i].Contains('|') && lines[i].Trim().Length > 0)
                    {
                        var cells = Cells(lines[i]).Take(header.Count).ToList();
                        rows.Add([.. cells, .. Enumerable.Repeat("", header.Count - cells.Count)]);
                        i++;
                    }
                    blocks.Add(new Block(BlockKind.Table, Rows: rows, Alignments: alignments));
                    continue;
                }
            }
            Match m;
            if (Rule().IsMatch(stripped))
            {
                Flush();
                blocks.Add(new Block(BlockKind.Rule));
            }
            else if ((m = Heading().Match(stripped)).Success)
            {
                Flush();
                blocks.Add(new Block(BlockKind.Heading, m.Groups[2].Value, Level: m.Groups[1].Length));
            }
            else if ((m = NumberedItem().Match(line)).Success)
            {
                Flush();
                int.TryParse(m.Groups[2].Value, out int number);
                blocks.Add(new Block(BlockKind.Numbered, m.Groups[3].Value.Trim(), Level: Depth(m.Groups[1].Value), Number: number));
            }
            else if ((m = BulletItem().Match(line)).Success)
            {
                Flush();
                blocks.Add(new Block(BlockKind.Bullet, m.Groups[2].Value.Trim(), Level: Depth(m.Groups[1].Value)));
            }
            else if (stripped.StartsWith('>'))
            {
                Flush();
                blocks.Add(new Block(BlockKind.Quote, stripped.TrimStart('>').Trim()));
            }
            else
            {
                paragraph.Add((line, stripped));
            }
            i++;
        }
        Flush();
        return blocks;
    }

    /// <summary>A paragraph's lines: wrapped prose is joined with spaces, but a field line ("To: CFO",
    /// "**Date:** 4 November"), or a line after a Markdown hard break (two spaces or a backslash at
    /// its end), starts a new line, kept as a line break (_join_lines).</summary>
    private static string JoinLines(List<(string Raw, string Stripped)> lines)
    {
        var text = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
        {
            string line = lines[i].Stripped;
            if (i > 0)
            {
                string previous = lines[i - 1].Raw;
                bool hard = previous.EndsWith("  ", StringComparison.Ordinal) || previous.TrimEnd().EndsWith('\\');
                text.Append(hard || FieldLine().IsMatch(line) ? '\n' : ' ');
            }
            text.Append(line.EndsWith('\\') ? line[..^1].TrimEnd() : line);
        }
        return text.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>A document that opens with a top-level heading uses it as its title, rather than
    /// showing the title and then nearly the same heading again.</summary>
    public static (string Title, List<Block> Blocks) SplitTitle(string title, List<Block> blocks)
    {
        int first = blocks.FindIndex(b => b.Kind != BlockKind.Rule);
        if (first >= 0 && blocks[first] is { Kind: BlockKind.Heading, Level: 1 } heading)
        {
            return (Plain(heading.Text), blocks[(first + 1)..]);
        }
        return (title, blocks);
    }

    /// <summary>Text split into runs with their styles: bold, italic, code and links.</summary>
    public static List<InlineRun> Runs(string text)
    {
        var runs = new List<InlineRun>();

        void Add(string piece, InlineRun style)
        {
            if (!style.Code) piece = Escaped().Replace(piece, "$1");
            if (piece.Length > 0) runs.Add(style with { Text = piece });
        }

        void Walk(string source, InlineRun style)
        {
            int position = 0;
            foreach (Match m in Inline().Matches(source))
            {
                Add(source[position..m.Index], style);
                string token = m.Value;
                if (m.Groups[1].Success) Add(token[1..^1], style with { Code = true });
                else if (m.Groups[2].Success) Walk(token[2..^2], style with { Bold = true });
                else if (m.Groups[3].Success) Walk(token[1..^1], style with { Italic = true });
                else
                {
                    var link = Link().Match(token);
                    Walk(link.Groups[1].Value, style with { Link = link.Groups[2].Value });
                }
                position = m.Index + m.Length;
            }
            Add(source[position..], style);
        }

        Walk(text, new InlineRun(""));
        return runs;
    }

    public static string Plain(string text) => string.Concat(Runs(text).Select(r => r.Text));

    /// <summary>A table row's cells: split on pipes that aren't escaped or in `code`.</summary>
    private static List<string> Cells(string line)
    {
        string row = line.Trim();
        if (row.StartsWith('|')) row = row[1..];
        if (row.EndsWith('|') && !row.EndsWith("\\|", StringComparison.Ordinal)) row = row[..^1];
        var cells = new List<string>();
        var cell = new StringBuilder();
        bool inCode = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < row.Length; i++)
        {
            char c = row[i];
            if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < row.Length && row[i + 1] == '|')
            {
                cell.Append('|');
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            if (c == '|' && !inCode)
            {
                cells.Add(cell.ToString().Trim());
                cell.Clear();
            }
            else
            {
                if (c == '`') inCode = !inCode;
                cell.Append(c);
            }
        }
        cells.Add(cell.ToString().Trim());
        return cells;
    }

    private static int Depth(string indent) => Math.Min(indent.Replace("\t", "    ").Length / 2, 3);

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^(#{1,6})\s+(.*?)\s*#*\s*$")]
    private static partial Regex Heading();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^(\s*)[-*+]\s+(.*)$")]
    private static partial Regex BulletItem();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^(\s*)(\d+)[.)]\s+(.*)$")]
    private static partial Regex NumberedItem();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^\s*([-*_])(\s*\1){2,}\s*$")]
    private static partial Regex Rule();

    /// <summary>A line that stands on its own inside a paragraph, as in a memo header or an address block.</summary>
    [GeneratedRegex(@"^(\*\*|__)?[A-Za-z][\w &/().'-]{0,30}:(\*\*|__)?(\s|$)")]
    private static partial Regex FieldLine();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^:?-+:?$")]
    private static partial Regex SeparatorCell();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"(`[^`]+`)|(\*\*[^*]+?\*\*|__[^_]+?__)|(\*[^*\s][^*]*?\*|(?<![\w])_[^_\s][^_]*?_(?![\w]))|(\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))")]
    private static partial Regex Inline();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)")]
    private static partial Regex Link();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"\\([\\`*_\[\]#|])")]
    private static partial Regex Escaped();
}


===== Mac/App/Tests/VireoMacTests/ChatGroupTests.swift =====
import XCTest
@testable import VireoMac

final class ChatGroupTests: XCTestCase {
    private let calendar: Calendar = {
        var calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian)
        calendar.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: "America/Toronto")!
        return calendar
    }()
    private var now: Date { calendar.date(from: DateComponents(year: 2026, month: 11, day: 2, hour: 9))! }

    private func chat(_ id: String, daysAgo: Int, hours: Int = 0, pinned: Bool = false) -> Chat {
        let date = calendar.date(byAdding: .hour, value: -(daysAgo * 24 + hours), to: now)!
        return Chat(id: id, title: id, createdAt: date, isPinned: pinned)
    }

    private func grouped(_ chats: [Chat]) -> [String: [String]] {
        Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: ChatGroup.grouping(chats, now: now, calendar: calendar).map { ($0.title, $0.chats.map(\.id)) })
    }

    func testChatsFallUnderTodayThisWeekAndOlder() {
        let groups = ChatGroup.grouping(
            [chat("now", daysAgo: 0), chat("yesterday", daysAgo: 0, hours: 10), chat("sixDays", daysAgo: 6), chat("sevenDays", daysAgo: 7)],
            now: now, calendar: calendar
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(groups.map(\.title), ["Today", "This week", "Older"])
        XCTAssertEqual(groups.map { $0.chats.map(\.id) }, [["now"], ["yesterday", "sixDays"], ["sevenDays"]])
    }

    func testPinnedChatsStayTogetherAheadOfTheDates() {
        let groups = grouped([chat("old pin", daysAgo: 40, pinned: true), chat("today", daysAgo: 0)])
        XCTAssertEqual(groups["Pinned"], ["old pin"])
        XCTAssertEqual(groups["Today"], ["today"])
    }

    func testGroupingKeepsTheListOrder() {
        let chats = [chat("pin", daysAgo: 3, pinned: true), chat("a", daysAgo: 0), chat("b", daysAgo: 2), chat("c", daysAgo: 30)]
        let flat = ChatGroup.grouping(chats, now: now, calendar: calendar).flatMap(\.chats).map(\.id)
        XCTAssertEqual(flat, chats.map(\.id))
    }

    func testAnEmptyListHasNoHeadings() {
        XCTAssertTrue(ChatGroup.grouping([], now: now, calendar: calendar).isEmpty)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testSourceTagComesFromWhereTheChatStarted() {
        XCTAssertEqual(Chat(id: "q", title: "", createdAt: now, tags: [QuickAskController.chatTag]).sourceTag, "quick ask")
        XCTAssertEqual(Chat(id: "s", title: "", createdAt: now, tags: [IntentRunner.chatTag]).sourceTag, "shortcuts")
        XCTAssertNil(Chat(id: "n", title: "", createdAt: now, tags: ["work"]).sourceTag)
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Tests/VireoMacTests/ScriptRunnerTests.swift =====
import XCTest
@testable import VireoMac

final class ScriptRunnerTests: XCTestCase {
    func testAScriptIsReadWithItsOptionalParts() throws {
        let json = """
        {"name": "Short", "systemPrompt": "Be brief.", "steps": [
          {"prompt": "First", "title": "note", "expect": ["412"]},
          {"prompt": "Aside", "chat": "side"},
          {"prompt": "Delete it", "approve": false}]}
        """
        let script = try JSONDecoder().decode(TestScript.self, from: Data(json.utf8))
        XCTAssertEqual(script.name, "Short")
        XCTAssertEqual(script.systemPrompt, "Be brief.")
        XCTAssertEqual(script.steps.count, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(script.steps[0].expect, ["412"])
        XCTAssertNil(script.steps[0].chat)
        XCTAssertEqual(script.steps[1].chat, "side")
        XCTAssertEqual(script.steps[2].approve, false)
    }

    func testAGradedRunsPartsAreRead() throws {
        let json = """
        {"name": "Graded", "access": "folders", "folders": ["/tmp/x"], "gate": "/tmp/gate", "steps": [
          {"prompt": "Delete the copy", "approveIf": "scan-0912"}]}
        """
        let script = try JSONDecoder().decode(TestScript.self, from: Data(json.utf8))
        XCTAssertEqual(script.access, "folders")
        XCTAssertEqual(script.folders, ["/tmp/x"])
        XCTAssertEqual(script.gate, "/tmp/gate")
        XCTAssertEqual(script.steps[0].approveIf, "scan-0912")
    }

    func testAnApprovalIsAnsweredAsTheStepSays() {
        let delete = ConfirmRequest(id: "1", tool: "delete_file", args: ["path": "/a/scan-0912.pdf"], preview: "Delete /a/scan-0912.pdf")
        let other = ConfirmRequest(id: "2", tool: "delete_file", args: ["path": "/a/invoice.pdf"], preview: "Delete /a/invoice.pdf")
        let only = TestScript.Step(prompt: "", approveIf: "scan-0912")
        XCTAssertTrue(ScriptRunner.answer(for: delete, step: only))
        XCTAssertFalse(ScriptRunner.answer(for: other, step: only))
        XCTAssertTrue(ScriptRunner.answer(for: other, step: TestScript.Step(prompt: "")))
        XCTAssertFalse(ScriptRunner.answer(for: other, step: TestScript.Step(prompt: "", approve: false)))
    }

    func testANumberIsFoundWithOrWithoutItsThousandsSeparator() {
        XCTAssertEqual(ScriptRunner.withoutThousandsSeparators("CAD 12,085.35 and 1,234,567"), "CAD 12085.35 and 1234567")
        XCTAssertEqual(ScriptRunner.withoutThousandsSeparators("Lyon, 412 units, 3 days"), "Lyon, 412 units, 3 days")
    }
}


===== Mac/App/release/Vireo-Proto.app/Contents/Frameworks/Sparkle.framework/Versions/B/Headers/SUUpdater.h =====
//
//  SUUpdater.h
//  Sparkle
//
//  Created by Andy Matuschak on 1/4/06.
//  Copyright 2006 Andy Matuschak. All rights reserved.
//

#ifndef SUUPDATER_H
#define SUUPDATER_H

#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>

#if defined(BUILDING_SPARKLE_SOURCES_EXTERNALLY)
// Ignore incorrect warning
#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wquoted-include-in-framework-header"
#import "SUExport.h"
#import "SUVersionComparisonProtocol.h"
#import "SUVersionDisplayProtocol.h"
#import "SUUpdaterDelegate.h"
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
#else
#import <Sparkle/SUExport.h>
#import <Sparkle/SUVersionComparisonProtocol.h>
#import <Sparkle/SUVersionDisplayProtocol.h>
#import <Sparkle/SUUpdaterDelegate.h>
#endif

@class SUAppcastItem, SUAppcast, NSMenuItem;

@protocol SUUpdaterDelegate;

/**
 The legacy API in Sparkle for controlling the update mechanism.

 This class is now deprecated and acts as a thin wrapper around `SPUUpdater` and `SPUStandardUserDriver`.
 
 If you are migrating to Sparkle 2, use `SPUStandardUpdaterController` instead, or `SPUUpdater` if you need more control.
 */
__deprecated_msg("Deprecated in Sparkle 2. Use SPUStandardUpdaterController instead, or SPUUpdater if you need more control.")
SU_EXPORT @interface SUUpdater : NSObject

@property (unsafe_unretained, nonatomic) IBOutlet id<SUUpdaterDelegate> delegate;

/*!
 The shared updater for the main bundle.
 
 This is equivalent to passing [NSBundle mainBundle] to SUUpdater::updaterForBundle:
 */
+ (SUUpdater *)sharedUpdater;

/*!
 The shared updater for a specified bundle.
 If an updater has already been initialized for the provided bundle, that shared instance will be returned.
 */
+ (SUUpdater *)updaterForBundle:(NSBundle *)bundle;

/*!
 Designated initializer for SUUpdater.
 
 If an updater has already been initialized for the provided bundle, that shared instance will be returned.
 */
- (instancetype)initForBundle:(NSBundle *)bundle;

/*!
 Explicitly checks for updates and displays a progress dialog while doing so.

 This method is meant for a main menu item.
 Connect any menu item to this action in Interface Builder,
 and Sparkle will check for updates and report back its findings verbosely
 when it is invoked.

 This will find updates that the user has opted into skipping.
 */
- (IBAction)checkForUpdates:(id)sender;

/*!
 The menu item validation used for the -checkForUpdates: action
 */
- (BOOL)validateMenuItem:(NSMenuItem *)menuItem;

/*!
 Checks for updates, but does not display any UI unless an update is found.

 This is meant for programmatically initiating a check for updates. That is,
 it will display no UI unless it actually finds an update, in which case it
 proceeds as usual.

 If automatic downloading of updates it turned on and allowed, however,
 this will invoke that behavior, and if an update is found, it will be downloaded
 in the background silently and will be prepped for installation.

 This will not find updates that the user has opted into skipping.
 */
- (void)checkForUpdatesInBackground;

/*!
 A property indicating whether or not to check for updates automatically.

 Setting this property will persist in the host bundle's user defaults.
 The update schedule cycle will be reset in a short delay after the property's new value is set.
 This is to allow reverting this property without kicking off a schedule change immediately
 */
@property (nonatomic) BOOL automaticallyChecksForUpdates;

/*!
 A property indicating whether or not updates can be automatically downloaded in the background.

 Note that automatic downloading of updates can be disallowed by the developer.
 In this case, -automaticallyDownloadsUpdates will return NO regardless of how this property is set.

 Setting this property will persist in the host bundle's user defaults.
 */
@property (nonatomic) BOOL automaticallyDownloadsUpdates;

/*!
 A property indicating the current automatic update check interval.

 Setting this property will persist in the host bundle's user defaults.
 The update schedule cycle will be reset in a short delay after the property's new value is set.
 This is to allow reverting this property without kicking off a schedule change immediately
 */
@property (nonatomic) NSTimeInterval updateCheckInterval;

/*!
 Begins a "probing" check for updates which will not actually offer to
 update to that version.

 However, the delegate methods
 SUUpdaterDelegate::updater:didFindValidUpdate: and
 SUUpdaterDelegate::updaterDidNotFindUpdate: will be called,
 so you can use that information in your UI.

 Updates that have been skipped by the user will not be found.
 */
- (void)checkForUpdateInformation;

/*!
 The URL of the appcast used to download update information.

 Setting this property will persist in the host bundle's user defaults.
 If you don't want persistence, you may want to consider instead implementing
 SUUpdaterDelegate::feedURLStringForUpdater: or SUUpdaterDelegate::feedParametersForUpdater:sendingSystemProfile:

 This property must be called on the main thread.
 */
@property (nonatomic, copy) NSURL *feedURL;

/*!
 The host bundle that is being updated.
 */
@property (readonly, nonatomic) NSBundle *hostBundle;

/*!
 The bundle this class (SUUpdater) is loaded into.
 */
@property (nonatomic, readonly) NSBundle *sparkleBundle;

/*!
 The user agent used when checking for and downloading updates.

 The default implementation can be overridden.
 */
@property (nonatomic, copy) NSString *userAgentString;

/*!
 The HTTP headers used when checking for and downloading updates.

 The keys of this dictionary are HTTP header fields (NSString) and values are corresponding values (NSString)
 */
@property (copy, nonatomic) NSDictionary<NSString *, NSString *> *httpHeaders;

/*!
 A property indicating whether or not the user's system profile information is sent when checking for updates.

 Setting this property will persist in the host bundle's user defaults.
 */
@property (nonatomic) BOOL sendsSystemProfile;

/*!
 A property indicating the decryption password used for extracting updates shipped as Apple Disk Images (dmg)
 */
@property (nonatomic, copy) NSString *decryptionPassword;

/*!
 Returns the date of last update check.

 \returns \c nil if no check has been performed.
 */
@property (nonatomic, readonly, copy) NSDate *lastUpdateCheckDate;

/*!
 Appropriately schedules or cancels the update checking timer according to
 the preferences for time interval and automatic checks.

 This call does not change the date of the next check,
 but only the internal NSTimer.
 */
- (void)resetUpdateCycle;

/*!
 A property indicating whether or not an update is in progress.

 Note this property is not indicative of whether or not user initiated updates can be performed.
 Use SUUpdater::validateMenuItem: for that instead.
 */
@property (nonatomic, readonly) BOOL updateInProgress;

@end

#endif


===== Windows/Vireo.Core.Tests/OfficeTests.cs =====
// The Office tools on the PC: Word, Excel and PowerPoint read, written and checked with the
// Open XML SDK's own validator, which reports what Office would refuse to open.
using System.Text.Json;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Packaging;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Validation;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Wordprocessing;
using Vireo.Core.Api;
using Vireo.Core.Office;
using Vireo.Core.Storage;
using X = DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Spreadsheet;

namespace Vireo.Core.Tests;

public sealed class OfficeTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempFolder _home = new();
    private readonly PcUndoJournal _journal;
    private readonly PcTools _tools;

    public OfficeTests()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_home.File("Documents"));
        _journal = new PcUndoJournal(_home.File("undo"), "chat-1");
        _tools = new PcTools(_home.Path).ForReply(PcAccess.Home, _journal);
    }

    public void Dispose() => _home.Dispose();

    private string Doc(string name) => _home.File(Path.Combine("Documents", name));

    private Task<string> Run(string tool, object args) => _tools.RunAsync(tool, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(args));

    private static void AssertValid(OpenXmlPackage package)
    {
        var errors = new OpenXmlValidator(FileFormatVersions.Office2019).Validate(package).ToList();
        Assert.True(errors.Count == 0, string.Join("\n", errors.Select(e => $"{e.Path?.XPath}: {e.Description}")));
    }

    // Cell references

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("A1", 1, 1)]
    [InlineData("$AB$12", 28, 12)]
    [InlineData("xfd1048576", 16384, 1048576)]
    public void CellsAreParsed(string text, int column, int row) => Assert.Equal(new CellAddress(column, row), CellReference.ParseCell(text));

    [Fact]
    public void RangesArePutInOrderAndBadOnesRefused()
    {
        Assert.Equal("B2:D9", CellReference.ParseRange("Sheet1!D9:B2")?.ToString());
        Assert.Null(CellReference.ParseRange("A0"));
        Assert.Null(CellReference.ParseRange("XFE1"));
        Assert.Null(CellReference.ParseRange("hello"));
        Assert.Equal("AA", CellReference.ColumnName(27));
    }

    // Excel

    [Fact]
    public async Task AWorkbookIsWrittenThenReadBack()
    {
        string written = await Run("write_spreadsheet", new
        {
            path = @"Documents\budget",
            rows = new object?[][] { ["Item", "Cost"], ["Rent", 1200], ["Food", 350.5], ["Total", "=SUM(B2:B3)"], [null, true] },
        });

        Assert.StartsWith($"Spreadsheet written successfully: {Doc("budget.xlsx")}\nWrote 9 cells to Sheet1!A1:B5 in a new workbook.", written);
        using (var document = SpreadsheetDocument.Open(Doc("budget.xlsx"), false)) AssertValid(document);

        string read = await Run("read_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\budget.xlsx" });
        Assert.Contains("Sheet \"Sheet1\", A1:B5 (used range A1:B5)", read);
        Assert.Contains("2 | Rent | 1200", read);
        Assert.Contains("3 | Food | 350.5", read);
        // A formula written here has no result until Excel works it out.
        Assert.Contains("4 | Total | =SUM(B2:B3)", read);
        Assert.Contains("5 |  | TRUE", read);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task WritingIntoAnExistingSheetKeepsTheRestAndAddsSheets()
    {
        await Run("write_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\data.xlsx", rows = new[] { new object[] { "a", "b", "c" } } });
        await Run("write_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\data.xlsx", start_cell = "B1", rows = new[] { new object[] { "B!" } } });
        await Run("write_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\data.xlsx", sheet = "Summary", start_cell = "C3", rows = new[] { new object[] { 1, 2 } } });

        string all = await Run("read_file", new { path = @"Documents\data.xlsx" });
        Assert.StartsWith("Excel workbook with 2 sheets: Sheet1, Summary", all);
        Assert.Contains("1 | a | B! | c", all);
        Assert.Contains("Sheet \"Summary\", C3:D3", all);
        using (var document = SpreadsheetDocument.Open(Doc("data.xlsx"), false)) AssertValid(document);

        var formulas = await Run("read_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\data.xlsx", sheet = "summary", range = "A1:D4", formulas = true });
        Assert.Contains("Sheet \"Summary\", A1:D4", formulas);
        var missing = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<ArgumentException>(() => Run("read_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\data.xlsx", sheet = "Nope" }));
        Assert.Contains("The sheets are: Sheet1, Summary", missing.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ANewWorkbookHasOnlyTheSheetAskedFor()
    {
        await Run("write_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\named.xlsx", sheet = "Budget", rows = new[] { new object[] { 1 } } });
        Assert.StartsWith("Excel workbook with 1 sheet: Budget", await Run("read_file", new { path = @"Documents\named.xlsx" }));

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<ArgumentException>(() => Run("write_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\bad.xlsx", sheet = "a/b", rows = new[] { new object[] { 1 } } }));
        Assert.False(File.Exists(Doc("bad.xlsx")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SharedTextAndDatesReadAsExcelShowsThem()
    {
        string file = Doc("made-in-excel.xlsx");
        using (var document = SpreadsheetDocument.Create(file, SpreadsheetDocumentType.Workbook))
        {
            var workbookPart = document.AddWorkbookPart();
            workbookPart.Workbook = new X.Workbook(new X.Sheets());
            var strings = workbookPart.AddNewPart<SharedStringTablePart>();
            strings.SharedStringTable = new X.SharedStringTable(new X.SharedStringItem(new X.Text("Due")));
            var styles = workbookPart.AddNewPart<WorkbookStylesPart>();
            styles.Stylesheet = new X.Stylesheet(new X.CellFormats(new X.CellFormat(), new X.CellFormat { NumberFormatId = 14 }));
            var sheetPart = workbookPart.AddNewPart<WorksheetPart>();
            sheetPart.Worksheet = new X.Worksheet(new X.SheetData(new X.Row(
                new X.Cell { CellReference = "A1", DataType = X.CellValues.SharedString, CellValue = new X.CellValue("0") },
                new X.Cell { CellReference = "B1", StyleIndex = 1, CellValue = new X.CellValue("46329") }) { RowIndex = 1 }));
            workbookPart.Workbook.Sheets!.Append(new X.Sheet { Id = workbookPart.GetIdOfPart(sheetPart), SheetId = 1, Name = "Plan" });
        }

        Assert.Contains("1 | Due | 2026-11-03", Spreadsheet.Read(file, null, null, formulas: false));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ALongSheetSaysWhatWasLeftOut()
    {
        var rows = Enumerable.Range(1, Spreadsheet.MaxRows + 5).Select(i => new object[] { i }).ToArray();
        await Run("write_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\long.xlsx", rows });

        string read = await Run("read_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\long.xlsx" });
        Assert.Contains($"5 more rows with values, up to row {Spreadsheet.MaxRows + 5}. Read a range to see them.", read);
    }

    // PowerPoint

    [Fact]
    public async Task ADeckIsMadeFromAnOutlineAndReadBack()
    {
        string saved = await Run("create_pptx", new
        {
            path = @"Documents\Plan",
            title = "Q4 plan",
            subtitle = "Draft & ideas",
            slides = new object[]
            {
                new { title = "Goals", bullets = new[] { "Ship the Windows app", "  Signed installer", "Grow testers <50>" }, notes = "Keep it short." },
                new { title = "Thanks" },
            },
        });

        Assert.StartsWith($"Slide deck saved successfully: {Doc("Plan.pptx")}", saved);
        using (var document = PresentationDocument.Open(Doc("Plan.pptx"), false)) AssertValid(document);

        string read = await Run("read_file", new { path = @"Documents\Plan.pptx" });
        Assert.StartsWith("PowerPoint deck with 3 slides", read);
        Assert.Contains("## Slide 1: Q4 plan\n- Draft & ideas", read);
        Assert.Contains("## Slide 2: Goals\n- Ship the Windows app\n- Signed installer\n- Grow testers <50>\nNotes: Keep it short.", read);
        Assert.Contains("## Slide 3: Thanks", read);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ListsSentAsJsonTextStillWork()
    {
        // Models sometimes send a list as JSON inside a string, or a slide as just its title.
        await Run("create_pptx", new { path = @"Documents\loose.pptx", title = "T", slides = """[{"title":"One","bullets":["a"]},"Two"]""" });
        await Run("write_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\loose.xlsx", rows = """[["x", 1], ["y", 2]]""" });

        Assert.Contains("## Slide 3: Two", await Run("read_file", new { path = @"Documents\loose.pptx" }));
        Assert.Contains("2 | y | 2", await Run("read_spreadsheet", new { path = @"Documents\loose.xlsx" }));
    }

    // Word

    private string MakeWordDocument(string name, params OpenXmlElement[] body)
    {
        string file = Doc(name);
        using var document = WordprocessingDocument.Create(file, WordprocessingDocumentType.Document);
        var main = document.AddMainDocumentPart();
        main.Document = new Document(new Body(body));
        return file;
    }

    private static Paragraph Para(string? style, params string[] runs)
    {
        var paragraph = new Paragraph(runs.Select(r => new Run(new Text(r) { Space = SpaceProcessingModeValues.Preserve })));
        if (style is not null) paragraph.PrependChild(new ParagraphProperties(new ParagraphStyleId { Val = style }));
        return paragraph;
    }

    }

                + "| Region | Sales |\n|:--|--:|\n| East | 40 |\n\n> Worth it\n\n```\nprint(1)\n  indented\n```\n---\n3. Third\n4. Fourth",
        });

        Assert.EndsWith("- Third\n- Fourth", read);
    }

        Assert.StartsWith("broken.xlsx couldn't be read as an Office file", broken.Message);
    }
