    // ---- Git

    // macOS only: files.rs is the Mac's server-run tools (/tmp is /private/tmp there, /etc
    // is there, Git is looked for where the Mac keeps it). On Windows the app runs these
    // tools itself (PcTools); files.rs on Windows is a step of its own (HANDOFF.md).
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    #[test]
    fn git_status_and_diff_of_a_project() {
        let h = home();
        let t = tools(&h, Access::Home);
        let project = format!("{}/Projects/vireo", h.0);
        for args in [
            vec!["init", "-q"],
            vec!["add", "."],
            vec![
                "-c",
                "user.name=t",
                "-c",
                "user.email=t@example.com",
                "commit",
                "-qm",
                "start",
            ],
        ] {
            let all: Vec<&str> = ["-C", project.as_str()].into_iter().chain(args).collect();
            let (code, output) = git(&all, &project).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(code, 0, "{output}");
        }
        assert_eq!(
            run(&t, "git_status", &[("path", "Projects/vireo")]),
            format!(r#"{{"ok":true,"path":"{project}","status":"clean"}}"#)
        );
        make(
            &h,
            "Projects/vireo/README.md",
            "# Vireo\nA chat app for the Mac.",
        );
        let changed = run(&t, "git_status", &[("path", "Projects/vireo/docs")]);
        assert!(changed.contains(r#""status":"M README.md""#), "{changed}");
        let diff = run(&t, "git_diff", &[("path", "Projects/vireo/README.md")]);
        assert!(diff.contains("+A chat app for the Mac."), "{diff}");
        assert_eq!(
            run(
                &t,
                "git_diff",
                &[("path", "Projects/vireo/docs/secret.txt")]
            ),
            format!("No tracked Git diff for {project}/docs/secret.txt")
        );
        assert_eq!(
            failure(&t, "git_status", &[("path", "Documents")]),
            format!("No Git repository found for {}/Documents", h.0)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            failure(&t, "git_status", &[("path", "Nowhere")]),
            format!("Project directory not found: {}/Nowhere", h.0)
        );
    }
}

#[cfg(all(test, windows))]
mod windows_tests {
    //! The tools on Windows: its paths, its home folder without AppData, and documents read
    //! with the server's own readers.
    use super::*;

    struct Home(String);

    impl Drop for Home {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
        }
    }

    fn home() -> Home {
        let base = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("FileTools-{:016x}", crate::random_u64()));
        let home = Home(standardized(&base.to_string_lossy()));
        for (file, text) in [
            (r"Documents\notes.txt", "The code word for Friday is PELICAN."),
            (r"Documents\Invoices\acme-november.txt", "Acme, CAD 1,200"),
            (r"Projects\garden\plan.md", "Plant tomatoes in May."),
            (r"AppData\Local\secret.txt", "secret"),
        ] {
            let path = join(&home.0, file);
            fs::create_dir_all(parent(&path)).unwrap();
            fs::write(path, text).unwrap();
        }
        let fixtures = concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), r"\tests\fixtures");
        for name in ["note.pdf", "report.docx"] {
            fs::copy(
                format!(r"{fixtures}\{name}"),
                join(&home.0, &format!(r"Documents\{name}")),
            )
            .unwrap();
        }
        home
    }

    fn run(files: &Files, tool: &str, args: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<String, String> {
        files.run(&Call {
            tool: tool.into(),
            args: args
                .iter()
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), Arg::Text(v.to_string())))
                .collect(),
        })
    }

    #[test]
    fn paths_are_windows_paths() {
        assert_eq!(standardized(r"c:\Users\me\.\Documents\..\Desktop\"), r"C:\Users\me\Desktop");
        assert_eq!(standardized("C:/Users/me/Documents"), r"C:\Users\me\Documents");
        assert_eq!(standardized(r"C:\"), r"C:\");
        assert_eq!(standardized(r"C:\.."), r"C:\");
        assert_eq!(standardized(r"\\server\share\a\..\b"), r"\\server\share\b");
        assert!(is_absolute(r"D:\x") && is_absolute(r"\\server\share") && !is_absolute(r"Documents\x"));
        assert!(is_within(r"C:\Users\Me\documents", r"c:\users\me"));
        assert!(!is_within(r"C:\Users\meg", r"C:\Users\me"));
        assert!(is_within(r"C:\anything", r"C:\"));
        assert_eq!(parent(r"C:\Users\me"), r"C:\Users");
        assert_eq!(parent(r"C:\Users"), r"C:\");
        assert_eq!(file_name(r"C:\Users\me\notes.txt"), "notes.txt");
        assert_eq!(join(r"C:\", "Users"), r"C:\Users");
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_home_folder_without_appdata() {
        let h = home();
        let t = Files::new(&h.0, Access::Home);
        let notes = join(&h.0, r"Documents\notes.txt");
        // Relative, with either slash, from ~, and in full.
        for path in [r"Documents\notes.txt", "Documents/notes.txt", r"~\Documents\notes.txt", &notes] {
            assert_eq!(t.resolve(path), Ok(notes.clone()), "{path}");
        }
        assert!(t.resolve(r"AppData\Local\secret.txt").unwrap_err().contains("AppData"));
        assert!(t.resolve(r"C:\Windows\win.ini").unwrap_err().contains("outside the user's folder"));
        assert_eq!(
            run(&t, "read_file", &[("path", r"Documents\notes.txt")]),
            Ok("The code word for Friday is PELICAN.".into())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            run(&t, "list_directory", &[("path", "Documents")]),
            Ok("[dir]  Invoices\n[file] note.pdf\n[file] notes.txt\n[file] report.docx".into())
        );
        // Listing the home folder leaves AppData's insides out of a deep listing.
        let deep = run(&t, "list_directory", &[("path", "~"), ("depth", "3")]).unwrap();
        assert!(!deep.contains("secret.txt"), "{deep}");
        let found = run(&t, "search_files", &[("pattern", "invoices"), ("directory", "~")]).unwrap();
        assert!(
            found.contains(&format!(r"{}\Documents\Invoices\ (folder name matches)", h.0)),
            "{found}"
        );
        let found = run(&t, "search_files", &[("pattern", "tomatoes"), ("directory", "Projects")]).unwrap();
        assert!(found.contains(r"garden\plan.md:1: Plant tomatoes in May."), "{found}");
        assert_eq!(
            run(&t, "read_file", &[("path", r"Documents\nowhere.txt")]),
            Err(format!(r"File not found: {}\Documents\nowhere.txt", h.0))
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn pdfs_and_word_documents_are_read_with_the_servers_readers() {
        let h = home();
        let t = Files::new(&h.0, Access::Home);
        let pdf = run(&t, "read_file", &[("path", r"Documents\note.pdf")]).unwrap();
        assert!(pdf.contains("The launch code is BLUE HERON 42."), "{pdf}");
        let docx = run(&t, "read_file", &[("path", r"Documents\report.docx")]).unwrap();
        assert!(docx.starts_with("Quarterly report\n"), "{docx}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn git_is_found_on_the_path() {
        if git_program().is_none() {
            return; // no Git on this PC
        }
        let h = home();
        let project = join(&h.0, r"Projects\garden");
        git(&["init", "-q"], &project).unwrap();
        let t = Files::new(&h.0, Access::Home);
        let status = run(&t, "git_status", &[("path", r"Projects\garden")]).unwrap();
        assert!(status.contains("plan.md"), "{status}");
        assert!(status.contains(&crate::json::string(&project)), "{status}");
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Networking/LocalEngine.swift =====
import Foundation

/// The prototype's own engine: `vireo-server` from the prototype's one Cargo workspace
/// (`VireoPrototype/`, shared with Windows), which runs a GGUF model on
/// this Mac's GPU and serves the app's chat API itself. `LocalServerManager` starts it on
/// the API port, with the app's token and `--with-app` (it stops when its standard input,
/// which the app holds open, closes). The Windows prototype's `LocalEngine.cs` does the
/// same on a PC.
extension LocalServerManager {
    nonisolated static let engineProgram = "vireo-server"
    /// The longest reply the engine writes when a chat sets no limit (`DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS`
    /// in vireo-server).
    nonisolated static let engineDefaultMaxTokens = 2048

    /// Where `vireo-server` is: `VIREO_ENGINE_SERVER` when set (a build of the engine to
    /// try), inside the app (`build-test-app.sh` copies it there), or, run from the
    /// repository, the engine's release build (`VireoPrototype/target/release`).
    nonisolated static var engineServerURL: URL? {
        if let chosen = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["VIREO_ENGINE_SERVER"],
           FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: chosen) {
            return URL(fileURLWithPath: chosen)
        }
        var starts: [URL] = []
        if let executable = Bundle.main.executableURL?.resolvingSymlinksInPath() {
            starts.append(executable.deletingLastPathComponent())
        }
        starts.append(Bundle.main.bundleURL)
        return engineServer(searchingFrom: starts)
    }

    nonisolated static func engineServer(searchingFrom starts: [URL], fileManager: FileManager = .default) -> URL? {
        if let first = starts.first {
            let beside = first.appendingPathComponent(engineProgram)
            if fileManager.isExecutableFile(atPath: beside.path) { return beside }
        }
        for start in starts {
            var folder = start.standardizedFileURL
            while folder.path != "/" {
                for built in ["target/release"] {
                    let candidate = folder.appendingPathComponent(built).appendingPathComponent(engineProgram)
                    if fileManager.isExecutableFile(atPath: candidate.path) { return candidate }
                }
                folder = folder.deletingLastPathComponent()
            }
        }
        return nil
    }

    /// `vireo-server`'s command line. The context is the engine's own choice ("auto": what
    /// the GPU's memory holds, up to what it's been checked for).
    nonisolated static func engineServerArguments(modelPath: String, port: Int, token: String) -> [String] {
        [modelPath, "--port", "\(port)", "--context", "auto", "--token", token, "--with-app"]
    }
}

// Ported from Sources/VireoMac/Models/ChatModels.swift. Chats are saved as
// JSON on this PC only, so dates are ISO 8601 rather than Swift's reference-date numbers.
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace Vireo.Core.Models;

public sealed record ToolStep(
    string Type,   // "tool_call" | "tool_result"
    string Tool,
    string? Detail = null,   // query/path/url/pattern/command extracted from args
    string? Result = null,
    string? Args = null);    // the call's whole arguments, as JSON

/// <summary>One line of the checklist the assistant keeps for a longer job (the server's
/// update_plan). Status is "pending", "in_progress", "done" or "skipped".</summary>
public sealed record PlanStep(string Text, string Status);

public sealed record MessageMetadata(int? Tokens = null, string? Duration = null, string? TokensPerSecond = null);

/// <summary>How much of the PC a chat's replies may reach, picked above the chat box
/// (the Mac's AgentAccess). PcTools enforces it, since the file tools run here.</summary>
[JsonConverter(typeof(AgentAccessJsonConverter))]
public enum AgentAccess
{
    /// <summary>Only the folders chosen in Settings, and no shell commands.</summary>
    Folders,
    Home,
    Full,
}

public static class AgentAccessInfo
{
    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<AgentAccess> All = [AgentAccess.Folders, AgentAccess.Home, AgentAccess.Full];

    /// <summary>The name the server and the saved chats use.</summary>
    public static string WireName(this AgentAccess access) => access switch
    {
        AgentAccess.Folders => "folders",
        AgentAccess.Full => "full",
        _ => "home",
    };

    /// <summary>Chats from before the access menu, and names this version doesn't know, reach the user's folder.</summary>
    public static AgentAccess Parse(string? name) => name switch
    {
        "folders" => AgentAccess.Folders,
        "full" => AgentAccess.Full,
        _ => AgentAccess.Home,
    };

    public static string Title(this AgentAccess access) => access switch
    {
        AgentAccess.Folders => "Folders I choose",
        AgentAccess.Full => "Full access",
        _ => "Home folder",
    };

    public static string Summary(this AgentAccess access) => access switch
    {
        AgentAccess.Folders => "Only the folders in Settings. No shell commands.",
        AgentAccess.Full => "Files anywhere on this PC.",
        _ => "Files in your user folder, except AppData.",
    };
}

internal sealed class AgentAccessJsonConverter : JsonConverter<AgentAccess>
{
    public override AgentAccess Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options) =>
        AgentAccessInfo.Parse(reader.TokenType == JsonTokenType.String ? reader.GetString() : null);

    public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, AgentAccess value, JsonSerializerOptions options) =>
        writer.WriteStringValue(value.WireName());
}

/// <summary>"Undo this run" on a reply that changed files: on the Mac (the server's run), on
/// this PC (PcUndoJournal), or both.</summary>
public sealed record RunUndo
{
    /// <summary>The server's run, when it changed files on the Mac.</summary>
    public string? RunId { get; init; }
    /// <summary>This PC's journal of the run, when the PC's tools changed files.</summary>
    public string? PcRunId { get; init; }
    /// <summary>What the last attempt did, in the server's words.</summary>
    public string? Summary { get; init; }
    /// <summary>Nothing is left to try, so the button goes.</summary>
    public bool IsFinished { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>One answer to a message. A regenerated reply keeps the earlier ones.</summary>
public sealed record ReplyVersion
{
    public string Content { get; init; } = "";
    public List<ToolStep> ToolSteps { get; init; } = [];
    public MessageMetadata? Metadata { get; init; }
    public bool IsError { get; init; }
    public RunUndo? Undo { get; init; }
    public List<PlanStep> Plan { get; init; } = [];
    public string? Record { get; init; }
}

public sealed class ChatMessage : IJsonOnDeserialized
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    [JsonRequired] public string Role { get; set; } = "user";   // "user" | "assistant"
    [JsonRequired] public string Content { get; set; } = "";
    public DateTimeOffset CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTimeOffset.Now;
    public bool IsError { get; set; }
    public string? FilePath { get; set; }
    /// <summary>The attached document's id in document search, so an edited or
    /// regenerated turn can still search it.</summary>
    public string? DocId { get; set; }
    public List<ToolStep> ToolSteps { get; set; } = [];
    public MessageMetadata? Metadata { get; set; }
    public RunUndo? Undo { get; set; }
    /// <summary>The assistant's checklist for this reply, if it kept one.</summary>
    public List<PlanStep> Plan { get; set; } = [];
    /// <summary>What this reply's tools were called with and returned, as the server wrote
    /// it (`turn_record`). Sent back with the message on later turns, so the model still has
    /// what its tools read; null for a reply without tools or from a server that keeps none.</summary>
    public string? Record { get; set; }
    /// <summary>Every version of a regenerated reply, including the one shown; empty
    /// until the reply is regenerated. The shown one's fields mirror Versions[VersionIndex].</summary>
    public List<ReplyVersion> Versions { get; set; } = [];
    public int VersionIndex { get; set; }

    public ChatMessage() { }

    public ChatMessage(string role, string content, bool isError = false, string? filePath = null)
    {
        Role = role;
        Content = content;
        IsError = isError;
        FilePath = filePath;
    }

    public ReplyParts Parts => Role == "assistant" ? ReplyParts.Parse(Content) : new ReplyParts(null, Content);

    // A field missing from an older or newer version must not make the conversation fail to load.
    void IJsonOnDeserialized.OnDeserialized()
    {
        ToolSteps ??= [];
        Plan ??= [];
        Versions ??= [];
        VersionIndex = Math.Clamp(VersionIndex, 0, Math.Max(Versions.Count - 1, 0));
    }

    private ReplyVersion CurrentVersion => new()
    {
        Content = Content, ToolSteps = [.. ToolSteps], Metadata = Metadata, IsError = IsError, Undo = Undo,
        Plan = [.. Plan], Record = Record,
    };

    private void Apply(ReplyVersion version)
    {
        Content = version.Content;
        ToolSteps = [.. version.ToolSteps];
        Metadata = version.Metadata;
        IsError = version.IsError;
        Undo = version.Undo;
        // Saved before plans existed, a version's list can be missing.
        Plan = [.. version.Plan ?? []];
        Record = version.Record;
    }

    /// <summary>Keeps the shown reply as a version and starts an empty one to stream into.</summary>
    public void StartNewVersion()
    {
        if (Versions.Count == 0) Versions.Add(CurrentVersion);
        else Versions[VersionIndex] = CurrentVersion;
        Versions.Add(new ReplyVersion());
        VersionIndex = Versions.Count - 1;
        Apply(Versions[VersionIndex]);
    }

    /// <summary>Records the shown reply in its version slot, once it has finished.</summary>
    public void SaveCurrentVersion()
    {
        if (VersionIndex >= 0 && VersionIndex < Versions.Count) Versions[VersionIndex] = CurrentVersion;
    }

    public void ShowVersion(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= Versions.Count || index == VersionIndex) return;
        Versions[VersionIndex] = CurrentVersion;
        VersionIndex = index;
        Apply(Versions[index]);
    }

    /// <summary>A copy that shares nothing with this message, for branched chats.</summary>
    public ChatMessage Clone() =>
        JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ChatMessage>(JsonSerializer.Serialize(this, ChatJson.Options), ChatJson.Options)!;
}

public static class ConversationHistory
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The turns to send to the model. A failed or empty reply is dropped together
    /// with the user turn that produced it: the error text ("Connection error: ")
    /// is not something the assistant said, and keeping the user turn alone would
    /// put two user turns in a row, which some chat templates reject.
    /// </summary>
    public static List<ChatMessage> ForModel(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages)
    {
        var history = new List<ChatMessage>();
        foreach (var original in messages)
        {
            var message = original;
            // Replies stopped before this was fixed may still hold their unfinished thinking.
            if (message.Role == "assistant" && WithoutUnfinishedThinking(message.Content) is var trimmed
                && trimmed != message.Content)
            {
                message = message.Clone();
                message.Content = trimmed;
            }
            bool isFailedReply = message.Role == "assistant"
                && (message.IsError || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.Content));
            if (!isFailedReply)
            {
                history.Add(NoteUndo(message));
                continue;
            }
            if (history.Count > 0 && history[^1].Role == "user") history.RemoveAt(history.Count - 1);
        }
        return history;
    }

    /// <summary>A reply's text without thinking that was never finished. A reply stopped while
    /// the model was still thinking ended in an open &lt;think&gt; block, which was then saved and
    /// shown as the reply: raw thoughts that can repeat what the user typed, a card number
    /// included (the Mac's fix of 2026-11-10). Finished thinking is left as it is.</summary>
    public static string WithoutUnfinishedThinking(string text)
    {
        int open = text.LastIndexOf("<think>", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (open < 0 || text.IndexOf("</think>", open + "<think>".Length, StringComparison.Ordinal) >= 0) return text;
        return text[..open].Trim();
    }

    /// <summary>The reply still says what it changed, so the model is told what went back.</summary>
    private static ChatMessage NoteUndo(ChatMessage message)
    {
        if (message.Undo?.Summary is not { } summary) return message;
        var noted = message.Clone();
        noted.Content += $"\n\n[The user then pressed Undo on this reply's file changes. {summary}]";
        return noted;
    }
}

public sealed record WorkspaceDocument(
    string Id, string FilePath, string Name, string ChatId, string ChatTitle, DateTimeOffset AddedAt);

public sealed class Chat : IJsonOnDeserialized
{
    public const string BriefingTag = "briefing";

    [JsonRequired] public string Id { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonRequired] public string Title { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonRequired] public DateTimeOffset CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTimeOffset UpdatedAt { get; set; }
    public bool IsPinned { get; set; }
    public bool IsFavorite { get; set; }
    public List<string> Tags { get; set; } = [];
    public string? Collection { get; set; }
    /// <summary>Added to the built-in system prompt for this chat. Empty means none.</summary>
    public string SystemPrompt { get; set; } = "";
    public GenerationSettings Generation { get; set; } = GenerationSettings.Standard;
    /// <summary>What this chat's replies may reach on the PC. Chats from before the access menu reached the home folder.</summary>
    public AgentAccess Access { get; set; } = AgentAccess.Home;

    public Chat() { }

    public Chat(string id, string title, DateTimeOffset createdAt)
    {
        Id = id;
        Title = title;
        CreatedAt = createdAt;
        UpdatedAt = createdAt;
    }

    /// <summary>Where the chat came from, when it wasn't the main window. Shown in the sidebar.</summary>
    [JsonIgnore]
    public string? SourceTag => Tags.FirstOrDefault(tag => tag is "quick ask" or "shortcuts" or BriefingTag);

    void IJsonOnDeserialized.OnDeserialized()
    {
        if (UpdatedAt == default) UpdatedAt = CreatedAt;
        Tags ??= [];
        SystemPrompt ??= "";
        Generation ??= GenerationSettings.Standard;
    }
}

/// <summary>A run of chats under one heading in the sidebar.</summary>
public sealed record ChatGroup(string Title, List<Chat> Chats)
{
    /// <summary>Keeps the order it's given: pinned chats first, then newest first, so each
    /// heading appears once and moving through the list stays in step with it.</summary>
    public static List<ChatGroup> Grouping(IEnumerable<Chat> chats, DateTimeOffset now)
    {
        var today = new DateTimeOffset(now.Date, now.Offset);
        var weekAgo = today.AddDays(-6);
        var groups = new List<ChatGroup>();
        foreach (var chat in chats)
        {
            string title = chat.IsPinned ? "Pinned"
                : chat.UpdatedAt >= today ? "Today"
                : chat.UpdatedAt >= weekAgo ? "This week"
                : "Older";
            if (groups.Count > 0 && groups[^1].Title == title) groups[^1].Chats.Add(chat);
            else groups.Add(new ChatGroup(title, [chat]));
        }
        return groups;
    }
}

/// <summary>An agent action waiting for approval. Not saved; cleared once answered.</summary>
public sealed record ConfirmRequest(
    string Id,
    string Tool,
    IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Args,
    string? Preview,
    /// Set when this kind of action can be always allowed, e.g. "Don't ask again to add calendar events".
    string? RememberLabel = null)
{
    /// <summary>Small actions the user can see and put right themselves. They're approved
    /// inside the reply; file changes, deletes, sends and commands keep the dialog.</summary>
    private static readonly HashSet<string> InlineTools =
        ["create_event", "move_event", "create_reminder", "complete_reminder", "remember"];

    /// <summary>The chat whose reply asked.</summary>
    public string? ChatId { get; init; }

    public bool CanApproveInline => InlineTools.Contains(Tool);

    /// <summary>The lines the server gave about the action (when, which list), if any.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Details =>
        Args.TryGetValue("details", out var details) ? details.Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries) : [];
}

===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Engine/ModelLibrary.cs =====
// The GGUF models on this PC: those downloaded into the models folder and those in folders
// the user added. Each file's header is read once (and again only if the file changes), so
// the list can say what each model is and whether the engine runs it.
namespace Vireo.Core.Engine;

public sealed record InstalledModel(string Path, long Size, DateTime Modified, GgufInfo? Info, string? Problem, bool Downloaded)
{
    public string FileName => System.IO.Path.GetFileName(Path);

    /// <summary>The model's own name from its header, or the file name when the header's
    /// says nothing (Google's Gemma 4 files are named "Hf").</summary>
    public string Title => Info?.Name is { Length: >= 4 } name ? name : System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(Path);

    public ModelFamily Family => ModelFamilies.Detect(Info?.Architecture, Info?.Name ?? FileName);

    public SupportVerdict Support => Info is null
        ? new SupportVerdict(SupportLevel.Unsupported, Problem ?? "Couldn't read the file")
        : EngineSupport.Check(Info);

    /// <summary>Downloads in progress (.part) and projectors aren't models to choose.</summary>
    public bool IsChat => Info is { IsVisionProjector: false };
}

public sealed class ModelLibrary(string modelsRoot)
{
    public static string DefaultRoot => System.IO.Path.Combine(
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "VireoPrototype", "Models");

    /// <summary>LM Studio keeps models four levels down (models\publisher\repository\file).</summary>
    private const int MaxDepth = 4;

    private readonly Dictionary<string, InstalledModel> _cache = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private readonly Lock _lock = new();

    public string ModelsRoot => modelsRoot;

    /// <summary>Every GGUF file in the models folder and the added folders, newest first.
    /// Slow on a cold disk: call it off the UI thread.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<InstalledModel> Scan(IEnumerable<string> addedFolders)
    {
        var found = new List<InstalledModel>();
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var (folder, downloaded) in addedFolders.Select(f => (f, false)).Prepend((modelsRoot, true)))
        {
            foreach (var file in GgufFiles(folder))
            {
                if (seen.Add(file)) found.Add(Describe(file, downloaded));
            }
        }
        return found.OrderByDescending(m => m.Modified).ToList();
    }

    public InstalledModel Describe(string file, bool downloaded = false)
    {
        var fileInfo = new FileInfo(file);
        lock (_lock)
        {
            if (_cache.TryGetValue(file, out var cached) && cached.Size == fileInfo.Length && cached.Modified == fileInfo.LastWriteTimeUtc)
            {
                return cached;
            }
        }
        GgufInfo? info = null;
        string? problem = null;
        try
        {
            info = GgufReader.Read(file);
        }
        catch (GgufFormatException e)
        {
            problem = e.Message;
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            problem = $"Couldn't open the file: {e.Message}";
        }
        var model = new InstalledModel(file, fileInfo.Length, fileInfo.LastWriteTimeUtc, info, problem, downloaded);
        lock (_lock) _cache[file] = model;
        return model;
    }

    /// <summary>Deletes a downloaded model's file, and its folders if that leaves them empty.</summary>
    public void Delete(InstalledModel model)
    {
        File.Delete(model.Path);
        lock (_lock) _cache.Remove(model.Path);
        if (!IsInside(model.Path, modelsRoot)) return;
        var folder = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(model.Path);
        while (folder is not null && IsInside(folder, modelsRoot) && !PathsEqual(folder, modelsRoot)
            && Directory.Exists(folder) && !Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(folder).Any())
        {
            Directory.Delete(folder);
            folder = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(folder);
        }
    }

    public static bool IsInside(string path, string folder)
    {
        string full = System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(path).TrimEnd('\\', '/');
        string root = System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(folder).TrimEnd('\\', '/');
        return full.Equals(root, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || full.StartsWith(root + System.IO.Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private static bool PathsEqual(string a, string b) =>
        System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(a).TrimEnd('\\', '/').Equals(System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(b).TrimEnd('\\', '/'), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private static IEnumerable<string> GgufFiles(string folder)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(folder)) return [];
        var options = new EnumerationOptions { RecurseSubdirectories = true, MaxRecursionDepth = MaxDepth, IgnoreInaccessible = true };
        try
        {
            return Directory.EnumerateFiles(folder, "*.gguf", options).ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            return [];
        }
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-server/src/http.rs =====
//! A small HTTP/1.1 server side: one request per connection, read whole (the app's
//! requests are small), and replies written whole or streamed (server-sent events).

use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Read, Write};
use std::net::TcpStream;

pub struct Request {
    pub method: String,
    /// The path without its query.
    pub path: String,
    pub query: String,
    pub bearer: Option<String>,
    pub content_type: Option<String>,
    /// Who's asking, as the client says (`stats::Source` tells the app from a script).
    pub user_agent: Option<String>,
    pub body: Vec<u8>,
}

/// The largest body read: an attachment (up to 30 MB) and its form.
const MAX_BODY: usize = 32 << 20;

/// A request that can't be read: the status to answer and why.
pub type Refusal = (u16, String);

fn bad(e: impl ToString) -> Refusal {
    (400, e.to_string())
}

fn too_large() -> Refusal {
    (
        413,
        "The request is too large: attachments can be up to 30 MB.".into(),
    )
}

pub fn read_request(stream: &TcpStream) -> Result<Request, Refusal> {
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(stream);
    let mut line = String::new();
    reader.read_line(&mut line).map_err(bad)?;
    let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
    let method = parts
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| bad("empty request"))?
        .to_string();
    let target = parts.next().ok_or_else(|| bad("no path"))?.to_string();
    let (path, query) = match target.split_once('?') {
        Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), q.to_string()),
        None => (target, String::new()),
    };
    let mut length = 0usize;
    let mut chunked = false;
    let mut bearer = None;
    let mut content_type = None;
    let mut user_agent = None;
    loop {
        let mut header = String::new();
        if reader.read_line(&mut header).map_err(bad)? == 0 {
            break;
        }
        let header = header.trim_end();
        if header.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        let Some((name, value)) = header.split_once(':') else {
            continue;
        };
        let value = value.trim();
        if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("content-length") {
            length = value.parse().map_err(|_| bad("bad Content-Length"))?;
        } else if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("transfer-encoding") {
            // .NET's PostAsJsonAsync sends its body in chunks, with no length up front.
            chunked = value.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("chunked");
        } else if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("authorization") {
            bearer = value.strip_prefix("Bearer ").map(|t| t.trim().to_string());
        } else if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("content-type") {
            content_type = Some(value.to_string());
        } else if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("user-agent") {
            user_agent = Some(value.to_string());
        }
    }
    let body = if chunked {
        read_chunks(&mut reader)?
    } else {
        if length > MAX_BODY {
            return Err(too_large());
        }
        let mut body = vec![0; length];
        reader.read_exact(&mut body).map_err(bad)?;
        body
    };
    Ok(Request {
        method,
        path,
        query,
        bearer,
        content_type,
        user_agent,
        body,
    })
}

/// A chunked body: hex sizes, each chunk, a zero-sized last one, then any trailers.
fn read_chunks(reader: &mut impl BufRead) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal> {
    let mut body = Vec::new();
    loop {
        let mut size = String::new();
        reader.read_line(&mut size).map_err(bad)?;
        let hex = size.trim().split(';').next().unwrap_or("");
        let n = usize::from_str_radix(hex, 16).map_err(|_| bad("bad chunk size"))?;
        if n == 0 {
            // Trailers, up to a blank line.
            loop {
                let mut line = String::new();
                if reader.read_line(&mut line).map_err(bad)? == 0 || line.trim().is_empty() {
                    return Ok(body);
                }
            }
        }
        if body.len() + n > MAX_BODY {
            return Err(too_large());
        }
        let start = body.len();
        body.resize(start + n, 0);
        reader.read_exact(&mut body[start..]).map_err(bad)?;
        let mut end = [0u8; 2];
        reader.read_exact(&mut end).map_err(bad)?; // the chunk's CRLF
    }
}

pub fn respond(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, json: &str) {
    respond_with(stream, status, "application/json", json.as_bytes());
}

/// A whole reply of any type (a kept attachment's bytes).
pub fn respond_with(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, content_type: &str, body: &[u8]) {
    let reason = match status {
        200 => "OK",
        400 => "Bad Request",
        401 => "Unauthorized",
        404 => "Not Found",
        409 => "Conflict",
        413 => "Content Too Large",
        415 => "Unsupported Media Type",
        422 => "Unprocessable Content",
        _ => "Error",
    };
    let head = format!(
        "HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\r\nContent-Type: {content_type}\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nX-Content-Type-Options: nosniff\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
        body.len()
    );
    let _ = stream.write_all(head.as_bytes());
    let _ = stream.write_all(body);
    let _ = stream.flush();
}

/// Starts a text/event-stream reply; then write events with [`event`].
pub fn start_events(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    stream.write_all(
        b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/event-stream\r\nCache-Control: no-cache\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
    )?;
    stream.flush()
}

/// One "data:" event. Fails once the client has gone.
pub fn event(stream: &mut TcpStream, data: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    stream.write_all(format!("data: {data}\n\n").as_bytes())?;
    stream.flush()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn reads_chunked_bodies() {
        let mut input: &[u8] = b"5\r\nhello\r\n7;x=1\r\n, world\r\n0\r\n\r\n";
        assert_eq!(read_chunks(&mut input).unwrap(), b"hello, world");
    }

    #[test]
    fn refuses_bodies_past_the_limit() {
        let mut input: &[u8] = b"2000001\r\n";
        assert_eq!(read_chunks(&mut input).unwrap_err().0, 413);
    }
}

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

/// Settings  Tasks: what Vireo has been asked to do later on its own (`schedule_task`).
/// The server keeps them; each can be run now, switched off or deleted here.
struct TasksSettingsPage: View {
    let serverRunning: Bool

    @State private var tasks: [ScheduledTask] = []
    @State private var loaded = false
    @State private var deleting: ScheduledTask?

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            SettingsGroup("Tasks", note: "Things you've asked Vireo to do later: at a time of day, when a file lands in a folder, or when a link is opened. Ask for one in a chat (\u{201c}every weekday at 8, list what's due\u{201d}). Each run is a new chat, with the file access of the chat that set it up, and it asks before changing anything. Tasks run while Vireo is open.") {
                if !serverRunning {
                    SettingsNote("Start the model to see your tasks.")
                } else if !loaded {
                    ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
                } else if tasks.isEmpty {
                    SettingsNote("No tasks yet.")
                } else {
                    VStack(spacing: 0) {
                        ForEach(tasks) { task in
                            row(task)
                            if task.id != tasks.last?.id { Divider() }
                        }
                    }
                    .background(AppTheme.bgSecondary)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
                    .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8).stroke(AppTheme.border))
                }
            }
        }
        .task(id: serverRunning) { await load() }
        .confirmationDialog(
            "Delete \u{201c}\(deleting?.name ?? "")\u{201d}?",
            isPresented: Binding(get: { deleting != nil }, set: { if !$0 { deleting = nil } }),
            titleVisibility: .visible
        ) {
            Button("Delete Task", role: .destructive) {
                guard let task = deleting else { return }
                Task {
                    await ChatAPIClient.shared.deleteTask(task.id)
                    await load()
                }
            }
        } message: {
            Text("It won't run again. Chats from its earlier runs stay.")
        }
    }

    private func row(_ task: ScheduledTask) -> some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 12) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(task.name).font(.body.weight(.medium))
                Text("Runs \(task.schedule). \(task.lastRunShown).")
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                Text(task.prompt)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .lineLimit(3)
                    .textSelection(.enabled)
                if let link = task.link {
                    HStack(spacing: 6) {
                        Text(link)
                            .font(.caption.monospaced())
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                            .lineLimit(1)
                            .truncationMode(.middle)
                            .textSelection(.enabled)
                        Button("Copy Link") {
                            NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()
                            NSPasteboard.general.setString(link, forType: .string)
                        }
                        .controlSize(.small)
                    }
                }
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 12)
            VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 8) {
                Toggle("On", isOn: Binding(
                    get: { task.enabled },
                    set: { on in
                        Task {
                            await ChatAPIClient.shared.setTask(task.id, enabled: on)
                            await load()
                        }
                    }
                ))
                .toggleStyle(.switch)
                .controlSize(.small)
                .labelsHidden()
                .accessibilityLabel("\(task.name) is on")
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Button("Run Now") {
                        Task { await ChatAPIClient.shared.runTask(task.id) }
                    }
                    Button("Delete", role: .destructive) { deleting = task }
                }
                .controlSize(.small)
            }
        }
        .padding(12)
    }

    private func load() async {
        guard serverRunning else {
            loaded = false
            return
        }
        if let fetched = await ChatAPIClient.shared.tasks() { tasks = fetched }
        loaded = true
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Services/GlobalHotkey.swift =====
import Carbon.HIToolbox
import Foundation

/// A system-wide keyboard shortcut through Carbon's `RegisterEventHotKey`,
/// which works from any app without the Accessibility permission. Reports
/// both press and release, so holding the key can mean push-to-talk.
@MainActor
final class GlobalHotkey {
    enum RegistrationError: LocalizedError {
        case inUse
        case failed(OSStatus)

        var errorDescription: String? {
            switch self {
            case .inUse: return "Another app already uses that shortcut."
            case .failed(let status): return "The shortcut couldn't be set (error \(status))."
            }
        }
    }

    var onPress: (() -> Void)?
    var onRelease: (() -> Void)?

    private var hotKeyRef: EventHotKeyRef?
    private var handlerRef: EventHandlerRef?
    private static let signature: OSType = 0x494E_5643  // "INVC"

    func register(_ combo: KeyCombo) throws {
        unregister()
        try installHandlerIfNeeded()
        var ref: EventHotKeyRef?
        let id = EventHotKeyID(signature: Self.signature, id: 1)
        let status = RegisterEventHotKey(combo.keyCode, combo.carbonModifiers, id, GetApplicationEventTarget(), 0, &ref)
        guard status == noErr, let ref else {
            throw status == OSStatus(eventHotKeyExistsErr) ? RegistrationError.inUse : RegistrationError.failed(status)
        }
        hotKeyRef = ref
    }

    func unregister() {
        if let hotKeyRef { UnregisterEventHotKey(hotKeyRef) }
        hotKeyRef = nil
    }

    private func installHandlerIfNeeded() throws {
        guard handlerRef == nil else { return }
        var types = [
            EventTypeSpec(eventClass: OSType(kEventClassKeyboard), eventKind: UInt32(kEventHotKeyPressed)),
            EventTypeSpec(eventClass: OSType(kEventClassKeyboard), eventKind: UInt32(kEventHotKeyReleased)),
        ]
        let context = Unmanaged.passUnretained(self).toOpaque()
        let status = InstallEventHandler(GetApplicationEventTarget(), { _, event, context in
            guard let event, let context else { return OSStatus(eventNotHandledErr) }
            let hotkey = Unmanaged<GlobalHotkey>.fromOpaque(context).takeUnretainedValue()
            let pressed = GetEventKind(event) == UInt32(kEventHotKeyPressed)
            // Carbon delivers these on the main thread.
            MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                if pressed { hotkey.onPress?() } else { hotkey.onRelease?() }
            }
            return noErr
        }, types.count, &types, context, &handlerRef)
        guard status == noErr else { throw RegistrationError.failed(status) }
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-engine/tests/gemma_assistant.rs =====
//! Google's draft model for Gemma 4 (`gemma-4-31B-it-assistant`, and the E2B's and E4B's
//! with their centroid heads) as a draft: how often
//! its guesses are the tokens the model goes on to pick (greedy), as `tests/mtp.rs` does
//! for Qwen's layer. A wrong reading of the main model's state or keys shows as guesses
//! that are almost never right. Ignored by default; run with
//! `VIREO_GEMMA_MODEL=<gemma-4-31B-it.gguf> [VIREO_GEMMA_ASSISTANT=<folder>] cargo test --release -p vireo-engine --test gemma_assistant -- --ignored --nocapture`
//! (the draft model is found beside the model or in the app's DraftModels folder when
//! VIREO_GEMMA_ASSISTANT isn't set).

use std::path::Path;
use std::time::Instant;

use vireo_engine::cuda::Gpu;
use vireo_engine::models::Logits;
use vireo_engine::models::gemma4_cuda::{Gemma4Cuda, assistant};
use vireo_engine::{GgufFile, Tokenizer};

fn argmax(v: &[f32]) -> u32 {
    v.iter()
        .enumerate()
        .fold(
            (0, f32::NEG_INFINITY),
            |b, (i, &x)| if x > b.1 { (i, x) } else { b },
        )
        .0 as u32
}

#[test]
#[ignore]
fn the_draft_model_guesses_what_gemma_picks() {
    let Ok(path) = std::env::var("VIREO_GEMMA_MODEL") else {
        eprintln!("skipped: VIREO_GEMMA_MODEL isn't set");
        return;
    };
    let draft = std::env::var_os("VIREO_GEMMA_ASSISTANT")
        .map(Into::into)
        .or_else(|| assistant::find(Path::new(&path)))
        .expect("no draft model found: set VIREO_GEMMA_ASSISTANT");
    let file = GgufFile::open(&path).unwrap();
    let tokenizer = Tokenizer::from_gguf(&file).unwrap();
    let mut m = Gemma4Cuda::load(&file, Gpu::open().unwrap()).unwrap();
    let started = Instant::now();
    m.load_assistant(&draft).unwrap();
    eprintln!("draft model loaded in {:.1?}", started.elapsed());
    let prompts = [
        "Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.",
        "Explain how a hash map works, with a small example in Python.",
        "List five things to check before a long road trip, one line each.",
    ];
    let k = 3;
    let (mut steps, mut first, mut runs) = (0usize, 0usize, vec![0usize; k + 1]);
    let mut drafting = 0f64;
    // By how sure the draft is of a guess (tenths), for the first, second and third guess:
    // guesses, those the model's greedy pick, and the model's own probability for them
    // (what a sampler at temperature 1 would take).
    let mut sure = vec![[(0usize, 0usize, 0f64); 10]; k];
    for prompt in prompts {
        let text =
            format!("<|turn>user\n{prompt}<turn|>\n<|turn>model\n<|channel>thought\n<channel|>");
        let ids = tokenizer.encode(&text, true, true);
        let mut s = m.session(4096).unwrap();
        m.use_mtp(&mut s).unwrap();
        let mut pick = argmax(
            m.forward_batch(&mut s, &ids, Logits::Last)
                .unwrap()
                .unwrap(),
        );
        let mut written = vec![pick];
        let mut guesses = Vec::new();
        let mut scored = Vec::new();
        // The model's probability, after each token written, for any token.
        let mut chances: Vec<Vec<(u32, f32)>> = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..120 {
            let started = Instant::now();
            let g = m.mtp_draft_sure(&mut s, pick, k, 0.0).unwrap();
            drafting += started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            assert_eq!(g.len(), k, "a guess for each of {k} tokens");
            guesses.push(g.iter().map(|g| g.0).collect::<Vec<u32>>());
            scored.push(g);
            let logits = m.forward(&mut s, pick, true).unwrap().unwrap();
            pick = argmax(logits);
            let top = logits[pick as usize];
            let sum: f32 = logits.iter().map(|v| (v - top).exp()).sum();
            chances.push(
                logits
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .filter(|(_, v)| **v > top - 12.0)
                    .map(|(i, v)| (i as u32, (v - top).exp() / sum))
                    .collect(),
            );
            written.push(pick);
        }
        for (i, g) in scored.iter().enumerate() {
            // Guess j is for the token written at i + 1 + j; it's only read after the
            // guesses before it were right.
            for (j, &(token, p)) in g.iter().enumerate() {
                if i + j >= chances.len() || g[..j].iter().zip(&written[i + 1..]).any(|(a, b)| a.0 != *b) {
                    break;
                }
                let cell = &mut sure[j][((p * 10.0) as usize).min(9)];
                cell.0 += 1;
                cell.1 += usize::from(token == written[i + 1 + j]);
                cell.2 += chances[i + j]
                    .iter()
                    .find(|c| c.0 == token)
                    .map_or(0.0, |c| f64::from(c.1));
            }
        }
        for (i, g) in guesses.iter().enumerate() {
            let truth = &written[i + 1..];
            if truth.len() < k {
                break;
            }
            steps += 1;
            first += usize::from(g[0] == truth[0]);
            let run = g.iter().zip(truth).take_while(|(a, b)| a == b).count();
            runs[run] += 1;
        }
        eprintln!(
            "{prompt:.40} {:?}",
            tokenizer.decode(&written[..40], false)
        );
    }
    let taken: usize = runs.iter().enumerate().map(|(n, c)| n * c).sum();
    eprintln!(
        "{steps} rounds of {k}: first guess right {:.0}%, runs of 0..={k} right {:?}, {:.2} guesses taken a round; drafting {:.1} ms a round",
        100.0 * first as f64 / steps as f64,
        runs,
        taken as f64 / steps as f64,
        drafting * 1e3 / steps as f64
    );
    for (j, cells) in sure.iter().enumerate() {
        let line: Vec<String> = cells
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, c)| c.0 > 0)
            .map(|(b, c)| {
                format!(
                    "{:.1}+: {} ({:.0}% right, {:.0}% sampled)",
                    b as f64 / 10.0,
                    c.0,
                    100.0 * c.1 as f64 / c.0 as f64,
                    100.0 * c.2 / c.0 as f64
                )
            })
            .collect();
        eprintln!("guess {} by how sure the draft is: {}", j + 1, line.join("  "));
    }
    assert!(
        first * 2 > steps,
        "the first guess should be right most of the time"
    );
}

/// Writing with the draft model as the server does (guesses read with the last pick in one
/// pass, the session taken back past a wrong one) against one token at a time: the same
/// text, greedy, and how much faster. Ignored, as above.
#[test]
#[ignore]
fn drafting_writes_the_same_text_faster() {
    let Ok(path) = std::env::var("VIREO_GEMMA_MODEL") else {
        eprintln!("skipped: VIREO_GEMMA_MODEL isn't set");
        return;
    };
    let draft = std::env::var_os("VIREO_GEMMA_ASSISTANT")
        .map(Into::into)
        .or_else(|| assistant::find(Path::new(&path)))
        .expect("no draft model found: set VIREO_GEMMA_ASSISTANT");
    let file = GgufFile::open(&path).unwrap();
    let tokenizer = Tokenizer::from_gguf(&file).unwrap();
    let mut m = Gemma4Cuda::load(&file, Gpu::open().unwrap()).unwrap();
    m.load_assistant(&draft).unwrap();
    let n = 200;
    // Guesses a round at most, and how sure the draft must be of each (0: any guess).
    let ways: Vec<(usize, f32)> = match std::env::var("VIREO_DRAFT_WAYS") {
        Ok(v) => v
            .split(',')
            .filter_map(|w| {
                let (k, floor) = w.split_once('@')?;
                Some((k.parse().ok()?, floor.parse().ok()?))
            })
            .collect(),
        Err(_) => vec![(2, 0.0), (3, 0.0), (4, 0.0), (3, 0.7), (5, 0.7), (7, 0.7)],
    };
    for (k, floor) in ways {
        let mut plain_s = 0f64;
        let mut drafted_s = 0f64;
        let (mut rounds, mut taken, mut guessed) = (0usize, 0usize, 0usize);
        for prompt in [
            "Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.",
            "Explain how a hash map works, with a small example in Python.",
        ] {
            let text = format!(
                "<|turn>user\n{prompt}<turn|>\n<|turn>model\n<|channel>thought\n<channel|>"
            );
            let ids = tokenizer.encode(&text, true, true);
            // One token at a time.
            let mut s = m.session(4096).unwrap();
            let mut pick = argmax(
                m.forward_batch(&mut s, &ids, Logits::Last)
                    .unwrap()
                    .unwrap(),
            );
            let started = Instant::now();
            let mut plain = vec![pick];
            while plain.len() < n {
                pick = argmax(m.forward(&mut s, pick, true).unwrap().unwrap());
                plain.push(pick);
            }
            plain_s += started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            // Drafted.
            let mut s = m.session(4096).unwrap();
            m.use_mtp(&mut s).unwrap();
            let mut pick = argmax(
                m.forward_batch(&mut s, &ids, Logits::Last)
                    .unwrap()
                    .unwrap(),
            );
            let started = Instant::now();
            let mut out = vec![pick];
            while out.len() < n {
                let guesses: Vec<u32> = m
                    .mtp_draft_sure(&mut s, pick, k, floor)
                    .unwrap()
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|g| g.0)
                    .collect();
                guessed += guesses.len();
                let before = s.len();
                let mut batch = vec![pick];
                batch.extend(&guesses);
                let vocab = m.config.vocab;
                let rows = m
                    .forward_batch(&mut s, &batch, Logits::All)
                    .unwrap()
                    .unwrap()
                    .to_vec();
                rounds += 1;
                // Row i's pick follows batch[i]; a guess is kept while it's that pick.
                let mut kept = 0;
                loop {
                    pick = argmax(&rows[kept * vocab..(kept + 1) * vocab]);
                    out.push(pick);
                    if kept < guesses.len() && guesses[kept] == pick {
                        kept += 1;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                taken += kept;
                // Back to the last token kept (the pick after it is read next round).
                assert_eq!(s.truncate(before + 1 + kept), before + 1 + kept);
            }
            drafted_s += started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            out.truncate(n);
            assert_eq!(
                tokenizer.decode(&out, false),
                tokenizer.decode(&plain, false),
                "drafting changed the text (k = {k}, floor {floor})"
            );
        }
        eprintln!(
            "up to {k} guesses, sure to {floor}: one at a time {:.1} tokens/s, drafted {:.1} tokens/s ({:.2}x), {:.2} guessed and {:.2} taken a round",
            2.0 * n as f64 / plain_s,
            2.0 * n as f64 / drafted_s,
            plain_s / drafted_s,
            guessed as f64 / rounds as f64,
            taken as f64 / rounds as f64
        );
    }
}

/// What a round costs: a check of the last pick and n guesses (every token's logits), a
/// read of as many for the last token's only, and the draft's guesses. Ignored, as above.
#[test]
#[ignore]
fn what_a_round_costs() {
    let Ok(path) = std::env::var("VIREO_GEMMA_MODEL") else {
        eprintln!("skipped: VIREO_GEMMA_MODEL isn't set");
        return;
    };
    let draft = std::env::var_os("VIREO_GEMMA_ASSISTANT")
        .map(Into::into)
        .or_else(|| assistant::find(Path::new(&path)))
        .expect("no draft model found: set VIREO_GEMMA_ASSISTANT");
    let file = GgufFile::open(&path).unwrap();
    let tokenizer = Tokenizer::from_gguf(&file).unwrap();
    let mut m = Gemma4Cuda::load(&file, Gpu::open().unwrap()).unwrap();
    m.load_assistant(&draft).unwrap();
    let text = "<|turn>user\nExplain how a hash map works, with a small example in Python.<turn|>\n<|turn>model\n<|channel>thought\n<channel|>A hash map stores pairs of keys and values so that a value can be found from its key in about the same time however many pairs there are.";
    let ids = tokenizer.encode(text, true, true);
    let (start, tail) = ids.split_at(ids.len() - 8);
    let mut s = m.session(4096).unwrap();
    m.use_mtp(&mut s).unwrap();
    m.forward_batch(&mut s, start, Logits::Last).unwrap();
    let at = s.len();
    let best = |f: &mut dyn FnMut()| {
        let mut best = f64::MAX;
        for _ in 0..12 {
            let t = Instant::now();
            f();
            best = best.min(t.elapsed().as_secs_f64() * 1e3);
        }
        best
    };
    let one = best(&mut || {
        m.forward(&mut s, tail[0], true).unwrap();
        s.truncate(at);
    });
    eprintln!("one token written: {one:.2} ms");
    for n in 1..=5 {
        let all = best(&mut || {
            m.forward_batch(&mut s, &tail[..n], Logits::All).unwrap();
            s.truncate(at);
        });
        let last = best(&mut || {
            m.forward_batch(&mut s, &tail[..n], Logits::Last).unwrap();
            s.truncate(at);
        });
        eprintln!("{n} tokens: every token's logits {all:.2} ms, the last one's {last:.2} ms");
    }
    m.forward(&mut s, tail[0], true).unwrap();
    for k in 1..=4 {
        let d = best(&mut || {
            assert_eq!(m.mtp_draft(&mut s, tail[1], k).unwrap().len(), k);
        });
        eprintln!("{k} guesses drafted: {d:.2} ms");
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.WinUI/Views/ModelsSettingsPage.cs =====
// Settings  Models: the model manager. The model the engine runs, downloads in progress,
// and two tabs: Installed (GGUF files in Vireo's models folder and folders the user added,
// each with what its header says and whether the engine runs it) and Discover (a short list
// of small models that suit this PC, and a search of Hugging Face's GGUF repositories).
using Microsoft.UI.Text;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media;
using Vireo.Core.Engine;
using Windows.System;

namespace Vireo.WinUI.Views;

internal sealed class ModelsSettingsPage : StackPanel
{
    private const string ModelGlyph = "";

    // Hugging Face's answers, kept while the app runs so going back to the page is instant.
    private static string _lastQuery = "";
    private static IReadOnlyList<HubModel>? _lastResults;
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, IReadOnlyList<HubFile>> RepositoryFiles = new();

    private readonly EngineSettingsStore _engine = AppServices.Engine;
    private readonly ModelDownloads _downloads = AppServices.Downloads;
    private readonly StackPanel _active = new();
    private readonly StackPanel _downloadsSection = new() { Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed };
    private readonly StackPanel _downloadList = SettingsUI.Stack();
    private readonly Dictionary<string, DownloadRow> _downloadRows = [];
    private readonly SelectorBar _tabs = new() { Margin = new Thickness(-8, 20, 0, 4) };
    private readonly ContentControl _tab = new() { HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch };
    private readonly StackPanel _installed = new();
    private readonly StackPanel _discover = new();
    private readonly StackPanel _results = SettingsUI.Stack();
    private readonly TextBlock _searchStatus = SettingsUI.Note("");
    // The Download/Installed control for each file shown in Discover, by download id.
    private readonly Dictionary<string, List<StackPanel>> _actionHosts = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<InstalledModel> _models = [];
    private bool _scanned;
    private InstalledModel? _activeModel;
    private bool _searching;

    public ModelsSettingsPage()
    {
        Children.Add(SettingsUI.Note("Models run on this PC with Vireo's own engine. They're GGUF files: download one below, "
            + "or add a folder of models you already have."));
        Children.Add(SettingsUI.Header("Active model"));
        Children.Add(_active);

        _downloadsSection.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Header("Downloads"));
        _downloadsSection.Children.Add(_downloadList);
        Children.Add(_downloadsSection);

        _tabs.Items.Add(new SelectorBarItem { Text = "Installed", Icon = new FontIcon { Glyph = "" } });
        _tabs.Items.Add(new SelectorBarItem { Text = "Discover", Icon = new FontIcon { Glyph = "" } });
        _tabs.SelectionChanged += (_, _) => ShowTab();
        Children.Add(_tabs);
        Children.Add(_tab);

        BuildDiscover();
        ShowActive();
        ShowDownloads();
        ShowInstalled();
        _tabs.SelectedItem = _tabs.Items[0];

        _downloads.Changed += OnDownloadChanged;
        _downloads.Installed += OnDownloadInstalled;
        _engine.Changed += OnEngineChanged;
        AppServices.LocalEngine.PropertyChanged += OnLocalEngineChanged;
        Unloaded += (_, _) =>
        {
            _downloads.Changed -= OnDownloadChanged;
            _downloads.Installed -= OnDownloadInstalled;
            _engine.Changed -= OnEngineChanged;
            AppServices.LocalEngine.PropertyChanged -= OnLocalEngineChanged;
        };
        _ = ScanAsync();
    }

    private void ShowTab()
    {
        bool installed = _tabs.SelectedItem == _tabs.Items[0];
        _tab.Content = installed ? _installed : _discover;
    }

    private void OnEngineChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(() =>
    {
        ShowActive();
        ShowInstalled();
    });

    private void OnDownloadChanged(object? sender, DownloadItem item) => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(() =>
    {
        ShowDownloads();
        RenderAction(item.Id);
    });

    private void OnDownloadInstalled(object? sender, DownloadItem item) => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(async () =>
    {
        await ScanAsync();
        // The first model downloaded becomes the one the engine runs.
        if (_engine.Current.ActiveModel is null && _models.FirstOrDefault(m => PathsEqual(m.Path, item.Destination)) is { } model
            && model.Support.CanRun)
        {
            _engine.Update(s => s with { ActiveModel = model.Path });
        }
    });

    private async Task ScanAsync()
    {
        var folders = _engine.Current.ModelFolders.ToList();
        _models = await Task.Run(() => AppServices.Library.Scan(folders));
        _scanned = true;
        ShowActive();
        ShowInstalled();
        foreach (var id in _actionHosts.Keys.ToList()) RenderAction(id);
    }

    // Active model ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void ShowActive()
    {
        _active.Children.Clear();
        string? path = _engine.Current.ActiveModel;
        if (path is null)
        {
            _active.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row(ModelGlyph, "No model chosen",
                "Choose one under Installed, or download one under Discover. The first model you download is chosen for you."));
            return;
        }
        if (!File.Exists(path))
        {
            _active.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row("", "The chosen model is missing", path,
                SettingsUI.Button("Clear", () => _engine.Update(s => s with { ActiveModel = null }))));
            return;
        }
        var model = _models.FirstOrDefault(m => PathsEqual(m.Path, path))
            ?? (_activeModel is { } read && PathsEqual(read.Path, path) ? read : null);
        if (model is null)
        {
            // Its own header first: the whole scan can take seconds on a cold disk.
            _ = Task.Run(() => AppServices.Library.Describe(path)).ContinueWith(
                t => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(() =>
                {
                    _activeModel = t.Result;
                    ShowActive();
                }), TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnRanToCompletion);
            _active.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row(ModelGlyph, Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path), _scanned ? path : "Reading the model"));
            return;
        }
        var extra = new StackPanel { Spacing = 8 };
        extra.Children.Add(ModelBadges(model, showLocation: false));
        extra.Children.Add(EngineStatus(path));
        var content = SettingsUI.RowContent(ModelGlyph, model.Title, Details(model), EngineButtons(path, model), extra);
        _active.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Card(content, new Thickness(16, 14, 16, 14)));

        var startOnLaunch = new ToggleSwitch { IsOn = _engine.Current.StartOnLaunch, OnContent = "On", OffContent = "Off", MinWidth = 0 };
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(startOnLaunch, "Start the model when Vireo opens");
        startOnLaunch.Toggled += (_, _) => _engine.Update(s => s with { StartOnLaunch = startOnLaunch.IsOn });
        var launchRow = SettingsUI.Row("", "Start the model when Vireo opens",
            "Loads it in the background as the app starts, so chats can begin straight away.", startOnLaunch);
        launchRow.Margin = new Thickness(0, 4, 0, 0);
        _active.Children.Add(launchRow);
    }

    private void OnLocalEngineChanged(object? sender, System.ComponentModel.PropertyChangedEventArgs e) =>
        DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(ShowActive);

    /// <summary>Whether the engine is running this model, and how fast.</summary>
    private static UIElement EngineStatus(string path)
    {
        var engine = AppServices.LocalEngine;
        bool thisModel = engine.Model is { } running && PathsEqual(running, path);
        var line = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 8 };
        void Text(string text, Brush brush) =>
            line.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = text, FontSize = 12, Foreground = brush, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center });
        switch (engine.State)
        {
            case EngineState.Loading when thisModel:
                line.Children.Add(new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 14, Height = 14 });
                Text($"Loading on the {(engine.OnGpu ? "GPU" : "CPU")}", SettingsUI.TextSecondary);
                break;
            case EngineState.Running when thisModel:
                line.Children.Add(new FontIcon { Glyph = "", FontSize = 12, Foreground = SettingsUI.Success });
                Text($"Running on the {(engine.OnGpu ? "GPU" : "CPU")}"
                    + (engine.TokensPerSecond is { } rate ? $"  {rate:0} tokens/s in the last reply" : "  chats on this PC use it"), SettingsUI.Success);
                break;
            case EngineState.Stopping:
                Text("Stopping", SettingsUI.TextSecondary);
                break;
            case EngineState.Failed when thisModel:
                Text(engine.Error ?? "It couldn't start.", SettingsUI.Critical);
                break;
            case EngineState.Running or EngineState.Loading:
                Text($"The engine is running {Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(engine.Model)}. Start this one to switch.", SettingsUI.TextSecondary);
                break;
            default:
                Text("Not running. Start it to chat on this PC.", SettingsUI.TextSecondary);
                break;
        }
        return line;
    }

    private static StackPanel EngineButtons(string path, InstalledModel model)
    {
        var engine = AppServices.LocalEngine;
        bool thisModel = engine.Model is { } running && PathsEqual(running, path);
        var buttons = SettingsUI.Buttons();
        if (thisModel && engine.State is EngineState.Loading or EngineState.Running)
        {
            if (engine.State == EngineState.Running)
            {
                var restart = SettingsUI.Button("Restart", () => _ = AppServices.StartModelAsync());
                ToolTipService.SetToolTip(restart, "Loads it again with the current Model behaviour and Hardware settings.");
                buttons.Children.Add(restart);
            }
            buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Button("Stop", () => _ = engine.StopAsync()));
        }
        else
        {
            var start = SettingsUI.Button(engine.State == EngineState.Failed && thisModel ? "Try Again" : "Start",
                () => _ = AppServices.StartModelAsync(), accent: true);
            start.IsEnabled = model.Support.CanRun && engine.State != EngineState.Stopping;
            buttons.Children.Add(start);
        }
        return buttons;
    }

    // Downloads ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void ShowDownloads()
    {
        var items = _downloads.Items;
        foreach (var id in _downloadRows.Keys.Except(items.Select(i => i.Id)).ToList())
        {
            _downloadList.Children.Remove(_downloadRows[id].Card);
            _downloadRows.Remove(id);
        }
        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            if (!_downloadRows.TryGetValue(item.Id, out var row))
            {
                row = new DownloadRow(item, this);
                _downloadRows[item.Id] = row;
                _downloadList.Children.Add(row.Card);
            }
            row.Update();
        }
        _downloadsSection.Visibility = items.Count > 0 ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
    }

    /// <summary>A download's card. Kept between updates, so its buttons don't flicker
    /// while the progress moves.</summary>
    private sealed class DownloadRow
    {
        private readonly DownloadItem _item;
        private readonly ModelsSettingsPage _page;
        private readonly ProgressBar _progress = new() { Maximum = 1, Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 2) };
        private readonly TextBlock _status = new() { FontSize = 12, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap };
        private readonly StackPanel _buttons = SettingsUI.Buttons();
        private DownloadState? _shownState;

        public Border Card { get; }

        public DownloadRow(DownloadItem item, ModelsSettingsPage page)
        {
            _item = item;
            _page = page;
            var details = new StackPanel { Children = { _progress, _status } };
            Card = SettingsUI.Card(SettingsUI.RowContent("", item.FileName, item.Repository, _buttons, details));
        }

        public void Update()
        {
            var item = _item;
            _progress.Value = item.Fraction;
            _progress.IsIndeterminate = item.State is DownloadState.Preparing or DownloadState.Verifying;
            _progress.ShowPaused = item.State == DownloadState.Paused;
            _progress.ShowError = item.State == DownloadState.Failed;
            string amount = item.Size > 0
                ? $"{ModelFit.FormatBytes(item.Received)} of {ModelFit.FormatBytes(item.Size)}"
                : ModelFit.FormatBytes(item.Received);
            _status.Foreground = item.State == DownloadState.Failed ? SettingsUI.Critical : SettingsUI.TextSecondary;
            _status.Text = item.State switch
            {
                DownloadState.Downloading => item.Speed > 0
                    ? $"{amount}  {ModelFit.FormatBytes((long)item.Speed)}/s" + (item.Remaining is { } left ? $"  {FormatDuration(left)} left" : "")
                    : $"{amount}  starting",
                DownloadState.Preparing => item.Received > 0 ? $"Checking the {ModelFit.FormatBytes(item.Received)} already downloaded" : "Connecting to Hugging Face",
                DownloadState.Verifying => "Checking the file against Hugging Face's checksum",
                DownloadState.Paused => $"Paused  {amount}",
                DownloadState.Failed => item.Error ?? "Failed",
                _ => "Done",
            };
            if (_shownState == item.State) return;
            _shownState = item.State;
            _buttons.Children.Clear();
            var downloads = AppServices.Downloads;
            switch (item.State)
            {
                case DownloadState.Downloading or DownloadState.Preparing:
                    _buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.IconButton("", "Pause", () => downloads.Pause(item)));
                    _buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.IconButton(Glyphs.Close, "Cancel download", () => downloads.Cancel(item)));
                    break;
                case DownloadState.Paused:
                    _buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.IconButton("", "Resume", () => downloads.Resume(item)));
                    _buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.IconButton(Glyphs.Close, "Cancel download", () => downloads.Cancel(item)));
                    break;
                case DownloadState.Failed:
                    _buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Button("Retry", () => downloads.Resume(item)));
                    _buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.IconButton(Glyphs.Close, "Remove", () => downloads.Dismiss(item)));
                    break;
                case DownloadState.Completed:
                    _buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Badge("Installed", Tone.Success, Glyphs.Check));
                    _buttons.Children.Add(SettingsUI.IconButton(Glyphs.Close, "Remove from the list", () => downloads.Dismiss(item)));
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    private static string FormatDuration(TimeSpan time) =>
        time.TotalHours >= 1 ? $"{(int)time.TotalHours} h {time.Minutes} min"
        : time.TotalMinutes >= 1 ? $"{(int)time.TotalMinutes} min"
        : $"{Math.Max(1, time.Seconds)} s";

    // Installed ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void ShowInstalled()
    {
        _installed.Children.Clear();
        var chatModels = _models.Where(m => m.Info is null || m.IsChat).ToList();
        if (!_scanned)
        {
            var reading = SettingsUI.Buttons(new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 20, Height = 20 },
                new TextBlock { Text = "Reading the models on this PC", FontSize = 13, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center });
            reading.Spacing = 12;
            _installed.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Card(reading));
        }
        else if (chatModels.Count == 0)
        {
            var discover = SettingsUI.Button("Discover models", () => _tabs.SelectedItem = _tabs.Items[1], accent: true);
            _installed.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row(ModelGlyph, "No models yet",
                "Download a recommended model under Discover, or add a folder that already has GGUF files.", discover));
        }
        else
        {
            var list = SettingsUI.Stack();
            foreach (var model in chatModels) list.Children.Add(InstalledCard(model));
            _installed.Children.Add(list);
        }

        _installed.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Header("Model folders"));
        var folders = SettingsUI.Stack();
        var root = AppServices.Library.ModelsRoot;
        folders.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row(Glyphs.Folder, "Vireo's models folder", root + "\nDownloads go here.",
            SettingsUI.Button("Open", () => OpenFolder(root))));
        foreach (var folder in _engine.Current.ModelFolders)
        {
            var remove = SettingsUI.IconButton(Glyphs.Delete, $"Stop listing {folder}", () =>
            {
                _engine.Update(s => s with
                {
                    ModelFolders = s.ModelFolders.Where(f => f != folder).ToList(),
                    ActiveModel = s.ActiveModel is { } active && ModelLibrary.IsInside(active, folder) ? null : s.ActiveModel,
                });
                _ = ScanAsync();
            });
            folders.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row(Glyphs.Folder, Path.GetFileName(folder.TrimEnd('\\')) is { Length: > 0 } name ? name : folder, folder,
                SettingsUI.Buttons(SettingsUI.Button("Open", () => OpenFolder(folder)), remove)));
        }
        folders.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Row(Glyphs.NewFolder, "Add a folder of models",
            "List GGUF files kept elsewhere, such as LM Studio's models folder, without copying them.",
            SettingsUI.Button("Add Folder", () => _ = AddFolderAsync())));
        _installed.Children.Add(folders);
    }

    private Border InstalledCard(InstalledModel model)
    {
        bool active = PathsEqual(model.Path, _engine.Current.ActiveModel);
        UIElement action;
        if (active)
        {
            action = SettingsUI.Badge("In use", Tone.Accent, Glyphs.Check);
        }
        else
        {
            var use = SettingsUI.Button("Use", () => _engine.Update(s => s with { ActiveModel = model.Path }));
            use.IsEnabled = model.Support.CanRun;
            if (!model.Support.CanRun) ToolTipService.SetToolTip(use, model.Support.Summary);
            action = use;
        }
        var menu = new MenuFlyout();
        var show = new MenuFlyoutItem { Text = "Show in File Explorer", Icon = new FontIcon { Glyph = Glyphs.Folder } };
        show.Click += (_, _) => FileCard.ShowInExplorer(model.Path);
        menu.Items.Add(show);
        var copy = new MenuFlyoutItem { Text = "Copy path", Icon = new FontIcon { Glyph = Glyphs.Copy } };
        copy.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            var package = new Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer.DataPackage();
            package.SetText(model.Path);
            Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer.Clipboard.SetContent(package);
        };
        menu.Items.Add(copy);
        if (model.Downloaded)
        {
            menu.Items.Add(new MenuFlyoutSeparator());
            var delete = new MenuFlyoutItem { Text = "Delete", Icon = new FontIcon { Glyph = Glyphs.Delete } };
            delete.Click += async (_, _) => await DeleteAsync(model);
            menu.Items.Add(delete);
        }
        var more = SettingsUI.IconButton(Glyphs.More, $"More for {model.Title}", () => { });
        more.Flyout = menu;
        var content = SettingsUI.RowContent(ModelGlyph, model.Title, Details(model), SettingsUI.Buttons(action, more), ModelBadges(model, showLocation: true));
        return SettingsUI.Card(content, new Thickness(16, 14, 12, 14));
    }

    private static string Details(InstalledModel model)
    {
        if (model.Info is not { } info) return $"{model.FileName}  {ModelFit.FormatBytes(model.Size)}";
        var parts = new List<string> { ModelFamilies.Info(model.Family).Title };
        if (info.ParameterCount > 0) parts.Add($"{ModelFit.FormatParameters(info.ParameterCount)} parameters");
        parts.Add(info.Quantization);
        parts.Add(ModelFit.FormatBytes(model.Size));
        if (info.ContextLength is { } context) parts.Add($"{context / 1024:N0}K context");
        return string.Join("  ", parts);
    }

    private static StackPanel ModelBadges(InstalledModel model, bool showLocation)
    {
        var support = model.Support;
        var badges = SettingsUI.Badges(SupportBadge(support.Level, support.Summary));
        if (support.CanRun) badges.Children.Add(FitBadge(model.Size, support.Level));
        if (showLocation && !model.Downloaded) badges.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Badge("Added folder"));
        return badges;
    }

    private static Border SupportBadge(SupportLevel level, string summary)
    {
        var badge = level switch
        {
            SupportLevel.Gpu => SettingsUI.Badge("Runs on GPU", Tone.Success, ""),
            SupportLevel.CpuOnly => SettingsUI.Badge("CPU only for now", Tone.Neutral, ""),
            _ => SettingsUI.Badge("Not supported yet", Tone.Critical, ""),
        };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(badge, summary);
        return badge;
    }

    /// <summary>Whether a model of this size fits, on the GPU if it runs there, else in memory.</summary>
    private static Border FitBadge(long size, SupportLevel level)
    {
        var budget = HardwareInfo.Budget;
        if (level == SupportLevel.CpuOnly) budget = budget with { GpuBytes = 0 };
        var fit = ModelFit.Assess(size, budget);
        var badge = fit.Level switch
        {
