            FitLevel.Gpu => SettingsUI.Badge("Fits in GPU memory", Tone.Success),
            FitLevel.SystemMemory => SettingsUI.Badge(level == SupportLevel.CpuOnly ? "Fits in memory" : "Slower: exceeds GPU memory",
                level == SupportLevel.CpuOnly ? Tone.Success : Tone.Caution),
            FitLevel.TooLarge => SettingsUI.Badge("Too large for this PC", Tone.Critical),
            _ => SettingsUI.Badge(fit.Summary),
        };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(badge, fit.Summary);
        return badge;
    }

    private async Task DeleteAsync(InstalledModel model)
    {
        bool confirmed = await SettingsDialogs.Confirm(XamlRoot, $"Delete {model.Title}?",
            $"This deletes {model.FileName} ({ModelFit.FormatBytes(model.Size)}) from this PC. You can download it again later.", "Delete", destructive: true);
        if (!confirmed) return;
        try
        {
            AppServices.Library.Delete(model);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            await SettingsDialogs.Error(XamlRoot, $"{model.FileName} couldn't be deleted: {e.Message}");
            return;
        }
        if (PathsEqual(model.Path, _engine.Current.ActiveModel)) _engine.Update(s => s with { ActiveModel = null });
        await ScanAsync();
    }

    private async Task AddFolderAsync()
    {
        if (await ChatFoldersSection.PickFolderAsync(SettingsWindow.Handle) is not { } folder) return;
        if (_engine.Current.ModelFolders.Any(f => PathsEqual(f, folder)) || ModelLibrary.IsInside(folder, AppServices.Library.ModelsRoot)) return;
        _engine.Update(s => s with { ModelFolders = [.. s.ModelFolders, folder] });
        await ScanAsync();
    }

    private static void OpenFolder(string folder)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
        _ = Launcher.LaunchFolderPathAsync(folder);
    }

    // Discover ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void BuildDiscover()
    {
        var gpu = HardwareInfo.MainGpu;
        string machine = gpu is not null && HardwareInfo.HasCudaGpu
            ? $"{gpu.Name} ({ModelFit.FormatBytes(gpu.MemoryBytes)}) and {ModelFit.FormatBytes(HardwareInfo.SystemMemoryBytes)} of memory"
            : $"{ModelFit.FormatBytes(HardwareInfo.SystemMemoryBytes)} of memory";
        _discover.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Note($"Small models of each family the engine runs, chosen for this PC: {machine}."));
        var list = SettingsUI.Stack();
        list.Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 0);
        foreach (var model in RecommendedModels.All) list.Children.Add(RecommendedCard(model));
        _discover.Children.Add(list);

        _discover.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Header("Search Hugging Face"));
        var search = new TextBox
        {
            PlaceholderText = "Search GGUF models, for example \"qwen3.5\" or \"gemma 4\"",
            Text = _lastQuery,
        };
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(search, "Search Hugging Face");
        var go = new Button { Content = new SymbolIcon(Symbol.Find), Padding = new Thickness(10, 7, 10, 7) };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(go, "Search");
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(go, "Search");
        go.Click += (_, _) => _ = SearchAsync(search.Text);
        search.KeyDown += (_, e) =>
        {
            if (e.Key != VirtualKey.Enter) return;
            e.Handled = true;
            _ = SearchAsync(search.Text);
        };
        // Also searches once typing pauses.
        var typing = DispatcherQueue.CreateTimer();
        typing.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(700);
        typing.IsRepeating = false;
        typing.Tick += (_, _) => _ = SearchAsync(search.Text);
        search.TextChanged += (_, _) =>
        {
            typing.Stop();
            if (search.Text.Trim().Length >= 3 && search.Text.Trim() != _lastQuery) typing.Start();
        };
        var bar = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 8, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 4) };
        bar.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        bar.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        bar.Children.Add(search);
        Grid.SetColumn(go, 1);
        bar.Children.Add(go);
        _discover.Children.Add(bar);
        _discover.Children.Add(_searchStatus);
        _results.Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 0);
        _discover.Children.Add(_results);
        if (_lastResults is not null) ShowResults(_lastResults);
    }

    private Border RecommendedCard(RecommendedModel model)
    {
        var level = RecommendedModels.Support(model);
        var badges = SettingsUI.Badges(
            SettingsUI.Badge(ModelFit.FormatBytes(model.ApproximateSize)),
            SupportBadge(level, level == SupportLevel.Gpu ? "Runs on the GPU" : "Runs on the CPU; GPU support for this architecture is coming"),
            FitBadge(model.ApproximateSize, level));
        var action = ActionHost(model.Repository, model.FileName, () => DownloadRecommendedAsync(model), model.ApproximateSize);
        var content = SettingsUI.RowContent(ModelGlyph, model.Title, model.Summary, action, badges);
        return SettingsUI.Card(content, new Thickness(16, 14, 16, 14));
    }

    private async Task DownloadRecommendedAsync(RecommendedModel model)
    {
        try
        {
            var files = await FilesAsync(model.Repository);
            var file = files.FirstOrDefault(f => f.Path == model.FileName)
                ?? throw new HttpRequestException($"{model.FileName} is no longer in {model.Repository}.");
            await DownloadAsync(file);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is HttpRequestException or TaskCanceledException or System.Text.Json.JsonException)
        {
            await SettingsDialogs.Error(XamlRoot, $"Couldn't reach Hugging Face: {e.Message}");
        }
    }

    private static async Task<IReadOnlyList<HubFile>> FilesAsync(string repository)
    {
        if (RepositoryFiles.TryGetValue(repository, out var cached)) return cached;
        var files = await AppServices.Hub.GgufFilesAsync(repository);
        RepositoryFiles[repository] = files;
        return files;
    }

    private async Task DownloadAsync(HubFile file)
    {
        var level = ModelFit.Assess(file.Size, HardwareInfo.Budget).Level;
        if (level == FitLevel.TooLarge && !await SettingsDialogs.Confirm(XamlRoot, "Download anyway?",
                $"{file.FileName} is {ModelFit.FormatBytes(file.Size)}, more than this PC can run.", "Download"))
        {
            return;
        }
        var root = Path.GetPathRoot(Path.GetFullPath(AppServices.Library.ModelsRoot))!;
        long free = new DriveInfo(root).AvailableFreeSpace;
        if (free < file.Size + (1L << 30))
        {
            await SettingsDialogs.Error(XamlRoot, $"{file.FileName} needs {ModelFit.FormatBytes(file.Size)}, and {root} has "
                + $"{ModelFit.FormatBytes(free)} free. Free some space, then try again.");
            return;
        }
        _downloads.Start(file);
    }

    /// <summary>The control for one file in Discover: Download, its progress, or Installed.
    /// Redrawn when the file's download changes.</summary>
    private StackPanel ActionHost(string repository, string path, Func<Task> download, long size)
    {
        var host = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 8, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        host.Tag = (repository, path, download, size);
        string id = $"{repository}/{path}";
        if (!_actionHosts.TryGetValue(id, out var hosts)) _actionHosts[id] = hosts = [];
        hosts.Add(host);
        Render(host);
        return host;
    }

    private void RenderAction(string id)
    {
        if (_actionHosts.TryGetValue(id, out var hosts)) foreach (var host in hosts) Render(host);
    }

    private void Render(StackPanel host)
    {
        var (repository, path, download, _) = ((string, string, Func<Task>, long))host.Tag;
        host.Children.Clear();
        string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
        var installed = _models.FirstOrDefault(m => m.FileName.Equals(fileName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        var item = _downloads.Find(repository, path);
        if (installed is not null && item is not { IsActive: true })
        {
            host.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Badge("Installed", Tone.Success, Glyphs.Check));
            if (!PathsEqual(installed.Path, _engine.Current.ActiveModel) && installed.Support.CanRun)
            {
                host.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Button("Use", () => _engine.Update(s => s with { ActiveModel = installed.Path })));
            }
            return;
        }
        if (item is { State: not DownloadState.Completed })
        {
            string state = item.State switch
            {
                DownloadState.Paused => "Paused",
                DownloadState.Failed => "Failed",
                DownloadState.Verifying => "Verifying",
                _ => $"{item.Fraction:P0}",
            };
            host.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = state, FontSize = 12, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center });
            return;
        }
        Button button = null!;
        button = SettingsUI.Button("Download", async () =>
        {
            button.IsEnabled = false;
            await download();
            button.IsEnabled = true;
        });
        host.Children.Add(button);
    }

    private async Task SearchAsync(string query)
    {
        query = query.Trim();
        if (query.Length < 2 || (query == _lastQuery && _searching)) return;
        _searching = true;
        _lastQuery = query;
        _searchStatus.Text = "Searching";
        _results.Children.Clear();
        try
        {
            _lastResults = await AppServices.Hub.SearchAsync(query);
            ShowResults(_lastResults);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is HttpRequestException or TaskCanceledException or System.Text.Json.JsonException)
        {
            _searchStatus.Text = $"Couldn't reach Hugging Face: {e.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _searching = false;
        }
    }

    private void ShowResults(IReadOnlyList<HubModel> results)
    {
        _results.Children.Clear();
        _searchStatus.Text = results.Count == 0 ? "No GGUF models match." : $"{results.Count} repositories, most downloaded first. Open one to see its files.";
        foreach (var model in results) _results.Children.Add(ResultExpander(model));
    }

    private Expander ResultExpander(HubModel model)
    {
        var header = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 12, Padding = new Thickness(0, 10, 0, 10) };
        header.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        header.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        var names = new StackPanel { Spacing = 2 };
        names.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = model.Name, FontSize = 14, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextPrimary, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis });
        names.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = model.Publisher, FontSize = 12, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary });
        header.Children.Add(names);
        var stats = SettingsUI.Badges(SettingsUI.Badge($"{FormatCount(model.Downloads)} downloads", Tone.Neutral, ""));
        stats.Margin = new Thickness(0);
        if (model.Gated) stats.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Badge("Needs a Hugging Face account", Tone.Caution, ""));
        Grid.SetColumn(stats, 1);
        header.Children.Add(stats);

        var files = new StackPanel { Spacing = 8 };
        var expander = new Expander
        {
            Header = header,
            Content = files,
            HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
            HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
        };
        bool loaded = false;
        expander.Expanding += async (_, _) =>
        {
            if (loaded) return;
            loaded = true;
            files.Children.Add(new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 20, Height = 20, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left });
            try
            {
                ShowFiles(files, model, await FilesAsync(model.Repository));
            }
            catch (Exception e) when (e is HttpRequestException or TaskCanceledException or System.Text.Json.JsonException)
            {
                loaded = false;
                files.Children.Clear();
                files.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Note($"Couldn't load the files: {e.Message}"));
            }
        };
        return expander;
    }

    private void ShowFiles(StackPanel panel, HubModel model, IReadOnlyList<HubFile> files)
    {
        panel.Children.Clear();
        var models = files.Where(f => !f.IsVisionProjector).ToList();
        if (models.Count == 0)
        {
            panel.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Note("No GGUF model files in this repository."));
            return;
        }
        var family = ModelFamilies.Detect(null, model.Repository);
        panel.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Note($"{ModelFamilies.Info(family).Title}. Whether the engine runs a file is a guess from its name "
            + "until it's downloaded and its header is read."));
        var budget = HardwareInfo.Budget;
        // The largest quantized file that fits the GPU: past 8 bits, a bigger file is slower
        // without being noticeably better. Unquantized files only when there's nothing else.
        var candidates = models.Where(f => f.Parts == 1 && EngineSupport.QuantizationLikelySupported(f.Quantization)
            && ModelFit.Assess(f.Size, budget).Level == FitLevel.Gpu).ToList();
        var best = candidates.Where(f => f.Quantization is not ("F16" or "BF16" or "F32")).MaxBy(f => f.Size)
            ?? candidates.MinBy(f => f.Size);
        foreach (var file in models)
        {
            var row = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 12 };
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
            row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            var text = new StackPanel { Spacing = 2 };
            var title = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 8 };
            title.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = file.Quantization, FontSize = 14, FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextPrimary });
            if (file == best) title.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Badge("Suggested", Tone.Accent));
            text.Children.Add(title);
            text.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = file.Path, FontSize = 12, Foreground = SettingsUI.TextSecondary, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis });
            var badges = SettingsUI.Badges(SettingsUI.Badge(ModelFit.FormatBytes(file.Size)));
            bool likely = EngineSupport.QuantizationLikelySupported(file.Quantization);
            if (file.Parts > 1) badges.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Badge($"Split in {file.Parts} files: not supported yet", Tone.Critical));
            else if (!likely) badges.Children.Add(SettingsUI.Badge($"{file.Quantization} isn't supported yet", Tone.Critical));
            else badges.Children.Add(FitBadge(file.Size, SupportLevel.Gpu));
            text.Children.Add(badges);
            row.Children.Add(text);
            if (file.Parts == 1 && !model.Gated)
            {
                var action = ActionHost(file.Repository, file.Path, () => DownloadAsync(file), file.Size);
                Grid.SetColumn(action, 1);
                row.Children.Add(action);
            }
            panel.Children.Add(row);
        }
        var page = SettingsUI.Link("Open on Hugging Face", HuggingFaceClient.PageUrl(model.Repository));
        panel.Children.Add(page);
    }

    private static string FormatCount(long count) => count switch
    {
        >= 1_000_000 => $"{count / 1e6:0.#}M",
        >= 1_000 => $"{count / 1e3:0.#}K",
        _ => $"{count}",
    };

    private static bool PathsEqual(string? a, string? b) =>
        a is not null && b is not null && string.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(a), Path.GetFullPath(b), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
}

/// <summary>Message boxes in the Settings window's theme (a ContentDialog takes the app's
/// theme otherwise, which is dark).</summary>
internal static class SettingsDialogs
{
    public static async Task<bool> Confirm(XamlRoot root, string title, string message, string confirm, bool destructive = false)
    {
        var dialog = new ContentDialog
        {
            XamlRoot = root,
            Title = title,
            Content = new TextBlock { Text = message, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap },
            PrimaryButtonText = confirm,
            CloseButtonText = "Cancel",
            DefaultButton = destructive ? ContentDialogButton.Close : ContentDialogButton.Primary,
            RequestedTheme = SettingsUI.IsLight ? ElementTheme.Light : ElementTheme.Dark,
        };
        return await Dialogs.Show(dialog) == ContentDialogResult.Primary;
    }

    public static Task Error(XamlRoot root, string message) => Dialogs.Show(new ContentDialog
    {
        XamlRoot = root,
        Title = "Something went wrong",
        Content = new TextBlock { Text = message, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap },
        CloseButtonText = "OK",
        RequestedTheme = SettingsUI.IsLight ? ElementTheme.Light : ElementTheme.Dark,
    });
}


===== crates/vireo-engine/src/grammar/mod.rs =====
//! Grammars for constrained generation: what a tool call (or any structured output) may
//! say, enforced on the bytes the model writes.
//!
//! A [`Schema`] (a JSON value's shape: objects with fixed keys, strings, numbers, choices
//! among given strings, arrays) compiles into a [`Grammar`]. A [`Matcher`] follows one
//! generation through it a byte at a time. [`TokenTrie`] holds a vocabulary's tokens as
//! bytes, so the matcher can say which tokens may come next ([`Matcher::allowed`]) without
//! trying all of them: it walks the trie, and drops a whole branch at its first wrong
//! byte. Where the grammar leaves only one way on, [`Matcher::forced`] gives those bytes,
//! so they can be added without sampling ("write ahead").
//!
//! The JSON is written one way only: keys in the schema's order, `": "` and `", "` between
//! parts, no other spaces. That's the form models write unprompted (Python's
//! `json.dumps`), so it costs them nothing, and it leaves more text forced.

mod trie;

pub use trie::TokenTrie;

/// The shape of a value.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Schema {
    /// An object with these keys, in this order; optional ones may be left out.
    Object(Vec<Property>),
    /// The same in other punctuation: Qwen's `<parameter=key>` lines, Gemma's `{key:value}`.
    Record {
        fields: Vec<Property>,
        style: RecordStyle,
    },
    /// Raw text, up to and including `until` (which must be ASCII and can't be in the
    /// text): a value in a format that isn't JSON. At most `max_bytes` bytes before `until`.
    Text {
        until: String,
        max_bytes: Option<usize>,
    },
    /// Any string (as JSON: quoted, escaped), of at most `max_bytes` bytes inside the quotes.
    String {
        max_bytes: Option<usize>,
    },
    /// One of these strings (as JSON strings): an enum, or values to copy (paths, links).
    OneOf(Vec<String>),
    Integer,
    Number,
    Boolean,
    Null,
    /// A list of `items`, at most `max_items` of them, as JSON writes it (`[a, b]`).
    Array {
        items: Box<Schema>,
        max_items: Option<usize>,
    },
    /// A list in other punctuation: Gemma 4's `[a,b]`, or an object with keys of its own
    /// (`{` and `}`, each item a key and its value). `open` and `close` are single ASCII
    /// bytes, and no item may start with `close`.
    List {
        items: Box<Schema>,
        max_items: Option<usize>,
        open: u8,
        separator: String,
        close: u8,
    },
    /// One of these values, told apart by their first byte (a string's quote, a number's
    /// digit, `t`/`f`/`n`): no two may start with the same byte.
    AnyOf(Vec<Schema>),
    /// These bytes exactly (not a JSON value: for the text around one).
    Literal(String),
    /// These one after another.
    Seq(Vec<Schema>),
    /// One of these texts, then what follows it: a tool's name, then that tool's
    /// arguments. No text may be the start of another. A branch is a decision worth
    /// making whole: [`Matcher::scored_options`] offers its texts to be scored.
    Branch(Vec<(String, Schema)>),
}

/// An object's punctuation: what opens and closes it, and what goes around each key.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct RecordStyle {
    pub open: String,
    pub key_open: String,
    pub key_close: String,
    /// Between one value and the next key.
    pub separator: String,
    pub close: String,
    /// Keys written as JSON strings (in `key_open` and `key_close`'s place, quotes and all).
    pub json_keys: bool,
}

impl RecordStyle {
    /// `{"key": value, "key": value}`.
    pub fn json() -> Self {
        RecordStyle {
            open: "{".into(),
            key_open: String::new(),
            key_close: ": ".into(),
            separator: ", ".into(),
            close: "}".into(),
            json_keys: true,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Property {
    pub name: String,
    pub schema: Schema,
    pub required: bool,
}

impl Property {
    pub fn required(name: &str, schema: Schema) -> Self {
        Self {
            name: name.into(),
            schema,
            required: true,
        }
    }

    pub fn optional(name: &str, schema: Schema) -> Self {
        Self {
            name: name.into(),
            schema,
            required: false,
        }
    }
}

impl Schema {
    pub fn string() -> Self {
        Schema::String { max_bytes: None }
    }

    /// The call `{"name": "<tool>", "arguments": {...}}` for one of `tools` (a name and
    /// its arguments' schema each), the form most models write tool calls in.
    pub fn tool_call(tools: &[(String, Schema)]) -> Self {
        Schema::Seq(vec![
            Schema::Literal("{\"name\": ".into()),
            Schema::Branch(
                tools
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(name, args)| {
                        (
                            format!("{}, \"arguments\": ", json_string(name)),
                            args.clone(),
                        )
                    })
                    .collect(),
            ),
            Schema::Literal("}".into()),
        ])
    }
}

/// `text` as a JSON string, quotes included.
pub fn json_string(text: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len() + 2);
    out.push('"');
    for c in text.chars() {
        match c {
            '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
            '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
            '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
            '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
            '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
            c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32)),
            c => out.push(c),
        }
    }
    out.push('"');
    out
}

// ---- The compiled grammar -------------------------------------------------------------

/// What happens when a choice is made.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
enum Then {
    Nothing,
    /// Go on with this node.
    Push(u32),
    /// In the object below: its property `j` comes next.
    Property(u16),
    /// The object below is closed.
    CloseObject,
    /// The array below gets another item.
    NextItem,
    /// The array below is closed.
    CloseArray,
}

/// A trie of byte strings, each ending in one option.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct Options {
    /// Per node: its edges (byte, node), sorted.
    edges: Vec<Vec<(u8, u32)>>,
    /// Per node: the option that ends there.
    ends: Vec<Option<u16>>,
    then: Vec<Then>,
    /// A decision to score whole (a branch), not to take a token at a time.
    scored: bool,
}

impl Options {
    fn new(options: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Then)>) -> Self {
        let mut o = Options {
            edges: vec![Vec::new()],
            ends: vec![None],
            then: Vec::new(),
            scored: false,
        };
        for (k, (bytes, then)) in options.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let mut at = 0usize;
            for &b in &bytes {
                at = match o.edges[at].binary_search_by_key(&b, |e| e.0) {
                    Ok(i) => o.edges[at][i].1 as usize,
                    Err(i) => {
                        let n = o.edges.len() as u32;
                        o.edges[at].insert(i, (b, n));
                        o.edges.push(Vec::new());
                        o.ends.push(None);
                        n as usize
                    }
                };
            }
            assert!(
                o.ends[at].is_none() && o.edges[at].is_empty(),
                "two choices are the same, or one starts another: {:?}",
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes)
            );
            o.ends[at] = Some(k as u16);
            o.then.push(then);
        }
        // No option may run on past another's end, either.
        for (node, end) in o.ends.iter().enumerate() {
            assert!(
                end.is_none() || o.edges[node].is_empty(),
                "one choice starts another"
            );
        }
        o
    }

    fn step(&self, at: u32, b: u8) -> Option<u32> {
        let edges = &self.edges[at as usize];
        edges
            .binary_search_by_key(&b, |e| e.0)
            .ok()
            .map(|i| edges[i].1)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
enum Node {
    Choice(Options),
    Str {
        max: u32,
    },
    Text {
        until: Vec<u8>,
        /// KMP's failure function over `until`.
        fail: Vec<u8>,
        max: u32,
    },
    Num {
        integer: bool,
    },
    Obj {
        values: Vec<u32>,
        /// Per (next property, first?): the choice of what comes next.
        menus: Vec<u32>,
    },
    Arr {
        item: u32,
        max: u16,
        /// The choice after an item: another, or the end; and the end alone (at `max`).
        more: u32,
        last: u32,
        open: u8,
        close: u8,
    },
    Any(Vec<u32>),
    Seq(Vec<u32>),
}

/// A compiled [`Schema`]. Shared by every [`Matcher`] that follows it.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Grammar {
    nodes: Vec<Node>,
    root: u32,
}

impl Grammar {
    pub fn new(schema: &Schema) -> Self {
        let mut g = Grammar {
            nodes: Vec::new(),
            root: 0,
        };
        g.root = g.add(schema);
        g
    }

    fn push(&mut self, node: Node) -> u32 {
        self.nodes.push(node);
        (self.nodes.len() - 1) as u32
    }

    fn choice(&mut self, options: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Then)>) -> u32 {
        self.push(Node::Choice(Options::new(options)))
    }

    fn add(&mut self, schema: &Schema) -> u32 {
        match schema {
            Schema::Literal(text) => self.choice(vec![(text.as_bytes().to_vec(), Then::Nothing)]),
            Schema::OneOf(values) => self.choice(
                values
                    .iter()
                    .map(|v| (json_string(v).into_bytes(), Then::Nothing))
                    .collect(),
            ),
            Schema::Boolean => self.choice(vec![
                (b"true".to_vec(), Then::Nothing),
                (b"false".to_vec(), Then::Nothing),
            ]),
            Schema::Null => self.choice(vec![(b"null".to_vec(), Then::Nothing)]),
            Schema::String { max_bytes } => self.push(Node::Str {
                max: max_bytes.map_or(u32::MAX, |m| m.min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32),
            }),
            Schema::Integer => self.push(Node::Num { integer: true }),
            Schema::Number => self.push(Node::Num { integer: false }),
            Schema::Seq(parts) => {
                let parts = parts.iter().map(|p| self.add(p)).collect();
                self.push(Node::Seq(parts))
            }
            Schema::Branch(options) => {
                let compiled: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Then)> = options
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(text, rest)| (text.as_bytes().to_vec(), Then::Push(self.add(rest))))
                    .collect();
                let mut options = Options::new(compiled);
                options.scored = true;
                self.push(Node::Choice(options))
            }
            Schema::Array { items, max_items } => self.list(items, *max_items, b'[', ", ", b']'),
            Schema::List {
                items,
                max_items,
                open,
                separator,
                close,
            } => self.list(items, *max_items, *open, separator, *close),
            Schema::AnyOf(options) => {
                let options = options.iter().map(|o| self.add(o)).collect();
                self.push(Node::Any(options))
            }
            Schema::Object(props) => self.record(props, &RecordStyle::json()),
            Schema::Record { fields, style } => self.record(fields, style),
            Schema::Text { until, max_bytes } => {
                let until = until.as_bytes().to_vec();
                assert!(
                    !until.is_empty() && until.is_ascii() && until.len() < 255,
                    "a text's end must be short ASCII"
                );
                let mut fail = vec![0u8; until.len()];
                let mut k = 0usize;
                for i in 1..until.len() {
                    while k > 0 && until[i] != until[k] {
                        k = fail[k - 1] as usize;
                    }
                    if until[i] == until[k] {
                        k += 1;
                    }
                    fail[i] = k as u8;
                }
                self.push(Node::Text {
                    until,
                    fail,
                    max: max_bytes.map_or(u32::MAX, |m| m.min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32),
                })
            }
        }
    }

    fn list(&mut self, items: &Schema, max_items: Option<usize>, open: u8, separator: &str, close: u8) -> u32 {
        assert!(open.is_ascii() && close.is_ascii(), "a list's brackets must be ASCII");
        let item = self.add(items);
        let more = self.choice(vec![
            (separator.as_bytes().to_vec(), Then::NextItem),
            (vec![close], Then::CloseArray),
        ]);
        let last = self.choice(vec![(vec![close], Then::CloseArray)]);
        self.push(Node::Arr {
            item,
            max: max_items.map_or(u16::MAX, |m| m.min(u16::MAX as usize) as u16),
            more,
            last,
            open,
            close,
        })
    }

    /// An object (any punctuation): its opening text, then its keys and values.
    fn record(&mut self, props: &[Property], style: &RecordStyle) -> u32 {
        let body = {
            {
                let values: Vec<u32> = props.iter().map(|p| self.add(&p.schema)).collect();
                let n = props.len();
                let mut menus = Vec::with_capacity((n + 1) * 2);
                for next in 0..=n {
                    for first in [false, true] {
                        let mut options = Vec::new();
                        // Properties from `next` up to the first required one.
                        for (j, p) in props.iter().enumerate().skip(next) {
                            let mut key = Vec::new();
                            if !first {
                                key.extend_from_slice(style.separator.as_bytes());
                            }
                            key.extend_from_slice(style.key_open.as_bytes());
                            if style.json_keys {
                                key.extend_from_slice(json_string(&p.name).as_bytes());
                            } else {
                                key.extend_from_slice(p.name.as_bytes());
                            }
                            key.extend_from_slice(style.key_close.as_bytes());
                            options.push((key, Then::Property(j as u16)));
                            if p.required {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if props[next..].iter().all(|p| !p.required) {
                            options.push((style.close.as_bytes().to_vec(), Then::CloseObject));
                        }
                        menus.push(self.choice(options));
                    }
                }
                self.push(Node::Obj { values, menus })
            }
        };
        if style.open.is_empty() {
            body
        } else {
            let open = self.choice(vec![(style.open.as_bytes().to_vec(), Then::Nothing)]);
            self.push(Node::Seq(vec![open, body]))
        }
    }

    /// A matcher at the start.
    pub fn matcher(&self) -> Matcher<'_> {
        let mut m = Matcher {
            grammar: self,
            stack: Stack::default(),
        };
        m.stack.push(Frame::new(self, self.root));
        m
    }
}

// ---- Following a generation -------------------------------------------------------------

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
enum Frame {
    /// In a choice's trie, at this node.
    Choice {
        node: u32,
        at: u32,
    },
    /// A string: `open` once past its opening quote; `escape` 1 after a backslash, then
    /// the hex digits of a \u escape still to come + 1; `utf8` the continuation bytes a
    /// character still needs.
    Str {
        max: u32,
        len: u32,
        open: bool,
        escape: u8,
        utf8: u8,
    },
    /// Raw text: how much of its end it has seen, its length, and the continuation
    /// bytes a character still needs.
    Text {
        node: u32,
        matched: u8,
        utf8: u8,
        len: u32,
    },
    /// A number, in the phase of JSON's number syntax it's at, and its length so far.
    Num {
        integer: bool,
        phase: u8,
        len: u8,
    },
    /// An object: `open` past its `{`; then waiting for the choice of what comes next.
    Obj {
        node: u32,
        next: u16,
        first: bool,
        open: bool,
    },
    /// An array: past its `[` (`open`), with `items` so far.
    Arr {
        node: u32,
        items: u16,
        open: bool,
    },
    /// One of several values, before its first byte picks which.
    Any {
        node: u32,
    },
    Seq {
        node: u32,
        next: u16,
    },
}

impl Frame {
    fn new(g: &Grammar, node: u32) -> Frame {
        match &g.nodes[node as usize] {
            Node::Choice(_) => Frame::Choice { node, at: 0 },
            Node::Str { max } => Frame::Str {
                max: *max,
                len: 0,
                open: false,
                escape: 0,
                utf8: 0,
            },
            Node::Text { .. } => Frame::Text {
                node,
                matched: 0,
                utf8: 0,
                len: 0,
            },
            Node::Num { integer } => Frame::Num {
                integer: *integer,
                phase: 0,
                len: 0,
            },
            Node::Obj { .. } => Frame::Obj {
                node,
                next: 0,
                first: true,
                open: false,
            },
            Node::Arr { .. } => Frame::Arr {
                node,
                items: 0,
                open: false,
            },
            Node::Any(_) => Frame::Any { node },
            Node::Seq(_) => Frame::Seq { node, next: 0 },
        }
    }
}

/// How deep values may nest (objects in arrays in objects...).
const DEPTH: usize = 32;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Stack {
    frames: [Frame; DEPTH],
    len: usize,
}

impl Default for Stack {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Stack {
            frames: [Frame::Seq { node: 0, next: 0 }; DEPTH],
            len: 0,
        }
    }
}

impl Stack {
    fn push(&mut self, f: Frame) -> bool {
        if self.len == DEPTH {
            return false;
        }
        self.frames[self.len] = f;
        self.len += 1;
        true
    }

    fn pop(&mut self) {
        self.len -= 1;
    }

    fn top(&mut self) -> Option<&mut Frame> {
        self.len.checked_sub(1).map(|i| &mut self.frames[i])
    }
}

/// Where one generation is in a [`Grammar`]. Cheap to copy, so trying a token is a copy
/// and a few steps.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Matcher<'g> {
    grammar: &'g Grammar,
    stack: Stack,
}

impl<'g> Matcher<'g> {
    /// Whether the whole value has been written.
    pub fn is_complete(&self) -> bool {
        let mut m = *self;
        m.settle_end();
        m.stack.len == 0
    }

    /// Takes the next byte, if the grammar allows it (else leaves the matcher as it was,
    /// and says no).
    pub fn advance(&mut self, b: u8) -> bool {
        let mut m = *self;
        if m.step(b) {
            *self = m;
            true
        } else {
            false
        }
    }

    /// Takes these bytes, if the grammar allows all of them (else changes nothing).
    pub fn advance_all(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
        let mut m = *self;
        for &b in bytes {
            if !m.step(b) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        *self = m;
        true
    }

    /// Whether these bytes may come next.
    pub fn allows(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
        let mut m = *self;
        bytes.iter().all(|&b| m.step(b))
    }

    /// The bytes that must come next, as long as there's only one way on: text that can be
    /// added without asking the model.
    pub fn forced(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut m = *self;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        while !m.is_complete() {
            let mut only = None;
            for b in 0..=255u8 {
                let mut t = m;
                if t.step(b) {
                    if only.is_some() {
                        return out;
                    }
                    only = Some((b, t));
                }
            }
            match only {
                Some((b, t)) => {
                    out.push(b);
                    m = t;
                }
                None => break,
            }
        }
        out
    }

    /// When the next part is a branch (a tool's name), the rest of each of its texts:
    /// the options to score whole and choose between, rather than a token at a time.
    pub fn scored_options(&self) -> Option<Vec<Vec<u8>>> {
        // Parts not yet entered (a sequence's next) are entered here, as the next byte
        // would enter them.
        let mut m = *self;
        while let Some(Frame::Seq { node, next }) = m.stack.top().copied() {
            let Node::Seq(parts) = &self.grammar.nodes[node as usize] else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            if next as usize >= parts.len() {
                return None;
            }
            *m.stack.top().unwrap() = Frame::Seq {
                node,
                next: next + 1,
            };
            if !m.stack.push(Frame::new(self.grammar, parts[next as usize])) {
                return None;
            }
        }
        let top = m.stack.len.checked_sub(1).map(|i| m.stack.frames[i])?;
        let Frame::Choice { node, at } = top else {
            return None;
        };
        let Node::Choice(options) = &self.grammar.nodes[node as usize] else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        if !options.scored {
            return None;
        }
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut stack = vec![(at, Vec::new())];
        while let Some((n, bytes)) = stack.pop() {
            if options.ends[n as usize].is_some() {
                out.push(bytes);
                continue;
            }
            for &(b, child) in options.edges[n as usize].iter().rev() {
                let mut next = bytes.clone();
                next.push(b);
                stack.push((child, next));
            }
        }
        Some(out)
    }

    /// Pops frames that are finished without more input (a number at the end, a sequence
    /// with nothing left).
    fn settle_end(&mut self) {
        loop {
            match self.stack.top() {
                Some(Frame::Num { integer, phase, .. }) if num_can_end(*integer, *phase) => {
                    self.stack.pop();
                }
                Some(Frame::Seq { node, next }) => {
                    let Node::Seq(parts) = &self.grammar.nodes[*node as usize] else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    if (*next as usize) < parts.len() {
                        return;
                    }
                    self.stack.pop();
                }
                _ => return,
            }
        }
    }

    fn step(&mut self, b: u8) -> bool {
        let g = self.grammar;
        loop {
            let Some(top) = self.stack.top() else {
                return false; // complete: nothing more may come
            };
            match *top {
                Frame::Seq { node, next } => {
                    let Node::Seq(parts) = &g.nodes[node as usize] else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    if (next as usize) < parts.len() {
                        *top = Frame::Seq {
                            node,
                            next: next + 1,
                        };
                        if !self.stack.push(Frame::new(g, parts[next as usize])) {
                            return false;
                        }
                    } else {
                        self.stack.pop();
                    }
                }
                Frame::Choice { node, at } => {
                    let Node::Choice(options) = &g.nodes[node as usize] else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    let Some(to) = options.step(at, b) else {
                        return false;
                    };
                    match options.ends[to as usize] {
                        None => *top = Frame::Choice { node, at: to },
                        Some(k) => {
                            self.stack.pop();
                            return self.then(options.then[k as usize]);
                        }
                    }
                    return true;
                }
                Frame::Str {
                    max,
                    len,
                    open,
                    escape,
                    utf8,
                } => {
                    let mut f = (max, len, open, escape, utf8);
                    let ok = str_step(&mut f, b);
                    if ok == StrStep::Closed {
                        self.stack.pop();
                        return true;
                    }
                    if ok == StrStep::No {
                        return false;
                    }
                    *top = Frame::Str {
                        max: f.0,
                        len: f.1,
                        open: f.2,
                        escape: f.3,
                        utf8: f.4,
                    };
                    return true;
                }
                Frame::Text {
                    node,
                    matched,
                    utf8,
                    len,
                } => {
                    let Node::Text { until, fail, max } = &g.nodes[node as usize] else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    let (mut matched, mut utf8) = (matched as usize, utf8);
                    if utf8 > 0 {
                        if b & 0xC0 != 0x80 {
                            return false;
                        }
                        utf8 -= 1;
                        matched = 0;
                    } else {
                        match b {
                            b'\n' | b'\t' | 0x20..=0x7E => {}
                            0xC2..=0xDF => utf8 = 1,
                            0xE0..=0xEF => utf8 = 2,
                            0xF0..=0xF4 => utf8 = 3,
                            _ => return false,
                        }
                        if utf8 > 0 {
                            matched = 0;
                        } else {
                            while matched > 0 && until[matched] != b {
                                matched = fail[matched - 1] as usize;
                            }
                            if until[matched] == b {
                                matched += 1;
                            }
                            if matched == until.len() {
                                self.stack.pop();
                                return true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if len >= *max && matched == 0 {
                        return false;
                    }
                    *top = Frame::Text {
                        node,
                        matched: matched as u8,
                        utf8,
                        len: len + 1,
                    };
                    return true;
                }
                Frame::Num {
                    integer,
                    phase,
                    len,
                } => match num_step(integer, phase, b) {
                    Some(next) if len < 24 => {
                        *top = Frame::Num {
                            integer,
                            phase: next,
                            len: len + 1,
                        };
                        return true;
                    }
                    Some(_) => return false,
                    None if num_can_end(integer, phase) => {
                        // The number ended before this byte: it's the parent's.
                        self.stack.pop();
                    }
                    None => return false,
                },
                Frame::Obj {
                    node,
                    next,
                    first,
                    open,
                } => {
                    let Node::Obj { menus, .. } = &g.nodes[node as usize] else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    if !open {
                        *top = Frame::Obj {
                            node,
                            next,
                            first,
                            open: true,
                        };
                        let menu = menus[next as usize * 2 + usize::from(first)];
                        if !self.stack.push(Frame::new(g, menu)) {
                            return false;
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    // Back from a value: what comes next.
                    let menu = menus[next as usize * 2 + usize::from(first)];
                    if !self.stack.push(Frame::new(g, menu)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                Frame::Any { node } => {
                    let Node::Any(options) = &g.nodes[node as usize] else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    // The first option this byte starts is the value (they start apart).
                    self.stack.pop();
                    for &option in options {
                        let mut t = *self;
                        if t.stack.push(Frame::new(g, option)) && t.step(b) {
                            *self = t;
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    return false;
                }
                Frame::Arr { node, items, open } => {
                    let Node::Arr {
                        item,
                        max,
                        more,
                        last,
                        open: open_byte,
                        close,
                    } = g.nodes[node as usize]
                    else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    if !open {
                        if b != open_byte {
                            return false;
                        }
                        *top = Frame::Arr {
                            node,
                            items,
                            open: true,
                        };
                        return true;
                    }
                    if items == 0 {
                        // Just past the opening: the end, or the first item.
                        if b == close {
                            self.stack.pop();
                            return true;
                        }
                        if max == 0 {
                            return false;
                        }
                        *top = Frame::Arr {
                            node,
                            items: 1,
                            open,
                        };
                        if !self.stack.push(Frame::new(g, item)) {
                            return false;
                        }
                    } else {
                        let menu = if items >= max { last } else { more };
                        if !self.stack.push(Frame::new(g, menu)) {
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// After a choice: what it leads to, for the frame below it.
    fn then(&mut self, then: Then) -> bool {
        let g = self.grammar;
        match then {
            Then::Nothing => true,
            Then::Push(node) => self.stack.push(Frame::new(g, node)),
            Then::Property(j) => {
                let Some(Frame::Obj { node, .. }) = self.stack.top().copied() else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                let Node::Obj { values, .. } = &g.nodes[node as usize] else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                *self.stack.top().unwrap() = Frame::Obj {
                    node,
                    next: j + 1,
                    first: false,
                    open: true,
                };
                self.stack.push(Frame::new(g, values[j as usize]))
            }
            Then::CloseObject | Then::CloseArray => {
                self.stack.pop();
                true
            }
            Then::NextItem => {
                let Some(Frame::Arr { node, items, open }) = self.stack.top().copied() else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                let Node::Arr { item, .. } = g.nodes[node as usize] else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                *self.stack.top().unwrap() = Frame::Arr {
                    node,
                    items: items + 1,
                    open,
                };
                self.stack.push(Frame::new(g, item))
            }
        }
    }

    /// When the matcher is in raw text, past any partial character and with none of its
    /// end seen: the end's first byte, and the room left. Then any token of whole
    /// characters without that byte fits.
    fn in_plain_text(&self) -> Option<(u8, u32)> {
        match self.stack.len.checked_sub(1).map(|i| self.stack.frames[i]) {
            Some(Frame::Text {
                node,
                matched: 0,
                utf8: 0,
                len,
            }) => {
                let Node::Text { until, max, .. } = &self.grammar.nodes[node as usize] else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                Some((until[0], max - len))
            }
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    /// Whether the matcher is inside a free string, past any escape or partial character,
    /// with room for at least `room` more bytes: then any token of plain text fits.
    fn in_plain_string(&self, room: u32) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self.stack.len.checked_sub(1).map(|i| self.stack.frames[i]),
            Some(Frame::Str { max, len, open: true, escape: 0, utf8: 0 }) if max - len >= room
        )
    }
}

#[derive(PartialEq)]
enum StrStep {
    No,
    Yes,
    Closed,
}

fn str_step(f: &mut (u32, u32, bool, u8, u8), b: u8) -> StrStep {
    let (max, len, open, escape, utf8) = f;
    if !*open {
        if b != b'"' {
            return StrStep::No;
        }
        *open = true;
        return StrStep::Yes;
    }
    if *escape == 1 {
        match b {
            b'"' | b'\\' | b'/' | b'b' | b'f' | b'n' | b'r' | b't' => *escape = 0,
            b'u' => *escape = 5,
            _ => return StrStep::No,
        }
    } else if *escape > 1 {
        if !b.is_ascii_hexdigit() {
            return StrStep::No;
        }
        *escape = if *escape == 2 { 0 } else { *escape - 1 };
    } else if *utf8 > 0 {
        if b & 0xC0 != 0x80 {
            return StrStep::No;
        }
        *utf8 -= 1;
    } else {
        match b {
            b'"' => return StrStep::Closed,
            b'\\' => *escape = 1,
            0x00..=0x1F | 0x7F => return StrStep::No,
            0x20..=0x7E => {}
            0xC2..=0xDF => *utf8 = 1,
            0xE0..=0xEF => *utf8 = 2,
            0xF0..=0xF4 => *utf8 = 3,
            _ => return StrStep::No,
        }
    }
    // Room for the closing quote is never needed: at `max`, only it is allowed.
    if *len >= *max {
        return StrStep::No;
    }
    *len += 1;
    StrStep::Yes
}

/// JSON's number syntax: the phase after `b`, if `b` may come in `phase`.
fn num_step(integer: bool, phase: u8, b: u8) -> Option<u8> {
    let digit = b.is_ascii_digit();
    match (phase, b) {
        (0, b'-') => Some(1),
        (0 | 1, b'0') => Some(3),
        (0 | 1, _) if digit => Some(2),
        (2, _) if digit => Some(2),
        (2 | 3, b'.') if !integer => Some(4),
        (2 | 3 | 5, b'e' | b'E') if !integer => Some(6),
        (4 | 5, _) if digit => Some(5),
        (6, b'+' | b'-') => Some(7),
        (6..=8, _) if digit => Some(8),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn num_can_end(integer: bool, phase: u8) -> bool {
    matches!(phase, 2 | 3) || (!integer && matches!(phase, 5 | 8))
}

===== crates/vireo-engine/tests/decode_attention_speed.rs =====
//! How long one generated token's attention takes deep in a context, for the big models'
//! layer shapes. Not a check: run with
//! `cargo test --release --test decode_attention_speed -- --ignored --nocapture`.

use std::time::Instant;

use vireo_engine::cuda::Gpu;

#[test]
#[ignore]
fn one_token_attention_deep_in_a_context() {
    let gpu = Gpu::open().unwrap();
    // (name, head size, query heads, key/value heads, sliding window)
    let shapes = [
        ("Qwen 3.8 27B", 256, 24, 4, 0),
        ("Gemma 4 31B global", 512, 32, 4, 0),
        ("Gemma 4 31B sliding", 256, 32, 16, 1024),
        ("Muse 30B global", 128, 32, 2, 0),
        ("Muse 30B sliding", 128, 32, 2, 2048),
    ];
    for (name, hd, heads, kv_heads, window) in shapes {
        for len in [64usize, 2_300, 8_000, 30_000] {
            let kv_dim = kv_heads * hd;
            let keys = gpu.alloc(len * kv_dim * 2).unwrap();
            let values = gpu.alloc(len * kv_dim * 2).unwrap();
            gpu.zero(&keys).unwrap();
            gpu.zero(&values).unwrap();
            let q = gpu.upload_f32(&vec![0.01; heads * hd]).unwrap();
            let out = gpu.alloc(heads * hd * 4).unwrap();
            let pos = gpu.alloc(4).unwrap();
            pos.write_i32(&[len as i32 - 1]).unwrap();
            let run = || {
                gpu.attention(
                    true,
                    q.ptr(),
                    keys.ptr(),
                    values.ptr(),
                    out.ptr(),
                    pos.ptr(),
                    window,
                    heads,
                    1,
                    hd,
                    kv_dim,
                    heads / kv_heads,
                    0.06,
                )
                .unwrap()
            };
            for _ in 0..20 {
                run();
            }
            gpu.synchronize().unwrap();
            let n = 200;
            let t = Instant::now();
            for _ in 0..n {
                run();
            }
            gpu.synchronize().unwrap();
            let us = t.elapsed().as_secs_f64() * 1e6 / n as f64;
            let read = if window > 0 { len.min(window) } else { len };
            let gb = (2 * read * kv_dim * 2) as f64 / 1e9;
            eprintln!(
                "{name:20} {len:6} positions: {us:7.1} s ({:.0} GB/s of cache read once)",
                gb / (us / 1e6)
            );
        }
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Views/AgentFoldersView.swift =====
import AppKit
import SwiftUI

/// The folders a chat may reach when its access is "Folders I choose".
@MainActor
enum AgentFolders {
    private nonisolated static let key = "vireo_agent_folders"

    /// The chosen folders, kept by the app and sent with each chat whose access is
    /// "Folders I choose": `vireo-server` runs the file tools, within these.
    nonisolated static var saved: [String] {
        UserDefaults.standard.stringArray(forKey: key) ?? []
    }

    static func load() async throws -> [String] {
        saved
    }

    @discardableResult
    static func save(_ folders: [String]) async throws -> [String] {
        var seen = Set<String>()
        let kept = folders.map(standardized).filter { seen.insert($0.lowercased()).inserted }
        UserDefaults.standard.set(kept, forKey: key)
        return kept
    }

    /// A folder's path without `..`, `.` or a trailing `/`, as the server compares them.
    nonisolated static func standardized(_ path: String) -> String {
        var result = (path as NSString).standardizingPath
        while result.count > 1, result.hasSuffix("/") { result.removeLast() }
        return result
    }

    /// Asks for folders to add; nil if the user cancelled.
    static func pick() -> [String]? {
        let panel = NSOpenPanel()
        panel.canChooseDirectories = true
        panel.canChooseFiles = false
        panel.allowsMultipleSelection = true
        panel.message = "Choose folders chats can reach when access is set to \"Folders I choose\"."
        panel.prompt = "Allow"
        guard panel.runModal() == .OK else { return nil }
        return panel.urls.map(\.path)
    }
}

/// Settings  Chats: the folders behind the "Folders I choose" access level.
struct AgentFoldersView: View {
    let serverRunning: Bool

    @State private var folders: [String]?
    @State private var error = ""

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Text("Chat folders").font(.headline)
            Text("When a chat's access is set to \"Folders I choose\" in the menu above the chat box, it can only read and change files in these folders, and can't run shell commands. Changes still ask for approval.")
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            if let folders {
                if folders.isEmpty {
                    Text("No folders yet.").foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                ForEach(folders, id: \.self) { folder in
                    HStack {
                        Image(systemName: "folder").foregroundStyle(AppTheme.accent)
                        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                            Text(URL(fileURLWithPath: folder).lastPathComponent).font(.body.weight(.medium))
                            Text((folder as NSString).abbreviatingWithTildeInPath)
                                .font(.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                                .lineLimit(1)
                                .truncationMode(.middle)
                        }
                        Spacer()
                        Button { NSWorkspace.shared.open(URL(fileURLWithPath: folder)) } label: {
                            Image(systemName: "arrow.up.forward.app")
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(.borderless)
                        .help("Show in Finder")
                        Button { save(folders.filter { $0 != folder }) } label: {
                            Image(systemName: "minus.circle")
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(.borderless)
                        .help("Remove this folder")
                    }
                }
                Button("Add Folder") {
                    if let picked = AgentFolders.pick() { save(folders + picked) }
                }
            } else if error.isEmpty {
                ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
            }
            if !error.isEmpty {
                Text(error).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(AppTheme.danger)
            }
        }
        .task {
            do {
                folders = try await AgentFolders.load()
                error = ""
            } catch {
                self.error = error.localizedDescription
            }
        }
    }

    private func save(_ folders: [String]) {
        Task {
            do {
                self.folders = try await AgentFolders.save(folders)
                error = ""
            } catch {
                self.error = error.localizedDescription
            }
        }
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Services/PromptLibrary.swift =====
import Foundation

/// A prompt the composer offers when a message starts with "/". Typing
/// "/name rest" sends the template with `{{input}}` replaced by the rest, or the
/// template followed by the rest when it has no placeholder.
struct SlashCommand: Codable, Identifiable, Equatable {
    var id = UUID()
    var name: String
    var template: String
    var kind: Kind = .custom

    enum Kind: String, Codable {
        case builtIn, custom
    }

    static let placeholder = "{{input}}"

    /// Names are lowercase words joined by hyphens, as typed after the slash.
    static func normalizedName(_ name: String) -> String {
        let allowed = name.lowercased().map { $0.isLetter || $0.isNumber ? $0 : "-" }
        return String(allowed).split(separator: "-").joined(separator: "-")
    }

    var summary: String {
        let line = template.replacingOccurrences(of: Self.placeholder, with: "")
            .components(separatedBy: .newlines).first ?? ""
        return line.count > 70 ? String(line.prefix(69)) + "" : line
    }

    static let builtIns: [SlashCommand] = [
        .init(name: "summarize", template: "Summarize this in a few sentences, then list the key points:\n\n{{input}}", kind: .builtIn),
        .init(name: "explain", template: "Explain this clearly and simply, with an example if it helps:\n\n{{input}}", kind: .builtIn),
        .init(name: "translate", template: "Translate this into English (or into the language I name first), keeping the formatting:\n\n{{input}}", kind: .builtIn),
        .init(name: "fix", template: "Fix the spelling, grammar and punctuation in this without changing its meaning or tone. Reply with only the corrected text:\n\n{{input}}", kind: .builtIn),
        .init(name: "shorter", template: "Make this about half as long, keeping everything important. Reply with only the new text:\n\n{{input}}", kind: .builtIn),
        .init(name: "bullets", template: "Turn this into a short, well-organized bullet list:\n\n{{input}}", kind: .builtIn),
        .init(name: "eli5", template: "Explain this as if I were five years old:\n\n{{input}}", kind: .builtIn),
        .init(name: "email", template: "Write a clear, friendly email that says the following. Include a subject line:\n\n{{input}}", kind: .builtIn),
    ]

    /// Commands that start with what's typed after the slash, for the suggestion list.
    /// Nothing once a space is typed, since the command is then chosen.
    static func suggestions(for draft: String, in commands: [SlashCommand]) -> [SlashCommand] {
        guard draft.hasPrefix("/"), !draft.contains(where: \.isWhitespace) else { return [] }
        let typed = draft.dropFirst().lowercased()
        let starts = commands.filter { $0.name.hasPrefix(typed) }
        let contains = commands.filter { !$0.name.hasPrefix(typed) && $0.name.contains(typed) }
        return starts + contains
    }

    /// The message to send for a draft, or nil when it doesn't start with a known command.
    static func expand(_ draft: String, with commands: [SlashCommand]) -> String? {
        guard draft.hasPrefix("/") else { return nil }
        let body = draft.dropFirst()
        let name = body.prefix { !$0.isWhitespace }.lowercased()
        guard let command = commands.first(where: { $0.name == name }) else { return nil }
        let rest = body.dropFirst(name.count).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        if command.template.contains(placeholder) {
            return command.template.replacingOccurrences(of: placeholder, with: rest)
                .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        }
        return rest.isEmpty ? command.template : "\(command.template)\n\n\(rest)"
    }
}

/// The user's own slash commands, plus the built-in ones.
@MainActor
final class PromptLibrary: ObservableObject {
    static let shared = PromptLibrary()

    @Published var custom: [SlashCommand] = [] {
        didSet { save() }
    }

    private let key = "invurse_slash_commands"

    private init() {
        if let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: key),
           let saved = try? JSONDecoder().decode([SlashCommand].self, from: data) {
            custom = saved
        }
    }

    /// Custom commands first, so one can replace a built-in of the same name.
    var all: [SlashCommand] {
        var seen = Set<String>()
        return (custom + SlashCommand.builtIns).filter { seen.insert($0.name).inserted }
    }

    private func save() {
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(custom) {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: key)
        }
    }
}

// Ported from Tests/VireoMacTests/ToolRunTests.swift.
using Vireo.Core.Models;

namespace Vireo.Core.Tests;

public class ToolRunTests
{
    private static ToolStep Call(string tool, string? detail = null) => new("tool_call", tool, detail);
    private static ToolStep Result(string tool, string text) => new("tool_result", tool, Result: text);

    [Fact]
    public void CallsArePairedWithResultsInOrder()
    {
        var runs = ToolRun.Pair([Call("read_file", "/a"), Call("read_file", "/b"), Result("read_file", "A")]);
        Assert.Equal(["A", null], runs.Select(r => r.Result));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WrittenFileComesFromTheResult()
    {
        var runs = ToolRun.Pair([Call("write_file", "notes.md"), Result("write_file", "File written successfully: /tmp/x/notes.md")]);
        Assert.Equal("/tmp/x/notes.md", runs[0].ProducedPath);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExportedDocumentIgnoresTheDownloadLine()
    {
        const string text = """{"ok": true, "output": "PDF created successfully: /tmp/report.pdf\nDownload: /files/abc"}""";
        var runs = ToolRun.Pair([Call("create_pdf"), Result("create_pdf", text)]);
        Assert.Equal("/tmp/report.pdf", runs[0].ProducedPath);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MovedAndRenamedFilesPointAtTheNewLocation()
    {
        var moved = ToolRun.Pair([Call("move_file", "/a/x.txt"), Result("move_file", "Moved successfully: /a/x.txt -> /b/x.txt")]);
        Assert.Equal("/b/x.txt", moved[0].ProducedPath);
        var renamed = ToolRun.Pair([Call("rename_file", "/a/x.txt"), Result("rename_file", "Renamed successfully: x.txt -> y.txt")]);
        Assert.Equal("/a/y.txt", renamed[0].ProducedPath);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FilesThePcWroteHaveWindowsPaths()
    {
        var written = ToolRun.Pair([Call("write_file"), Result("write_file", @"File written successfully: C:\Users\me\Desktop\notes.txt")]);
        Assert.Equal(@"C:\Users\me\Desktop\notes.txt", written[0].ProducedPath);
        var saved = ToolRun.Pair([Call("create_docx"), Result("create_docx", @"DOCX created and saved on the PC: C:\Users\me\Desktop\Report.docx")]);
        Assert.Equal(@"C:\Users\me\Desktop\Report.docx", saved[0].ProducedPath);
        var renamed = ToolRun.Pair([Call("rename_file", @"C:\Users\me\a.txt"), Result("rename_file", "Renamed successfully: a.txt -> b.txt")]);
        Assert.Equal(@"C:\Users\me\b.txt", renamed[0].ProducedPath);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FailedOrReadOnlyToolsProduceNoFile()
    {
        Assert.Null(ToolRun.Pair([Call("write_file"), Result("write_file", """{"ok": false, "message": "Denied"}""")])[0].ProducedPath);
        Assert.Null(ToolRun.Pair([Call("read_file", "/a"), Result("read_file", "contents")])[0].ProducedPath);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RetryableFailureIsOnlyRetryingWhileToolsRun()
    {
        var run = new ToolRun(Call("fetch_url"), """{"ok": false, "retryable": true}""");
        Assert.Equal(ToolOutcome.Retrying, run.Outcome(stillRunning: true));
        Assert.Equal(ToolOutcome.Failure, run.Outcome(stillRunning: false));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ResultTextUnwrapsTheEnvelope()
    {
        Assert.Equal("42 results", new ToolRun(Call("search_web"), """{"ok": true, "output": "42 results"}""").ResultText);
        Assert.Equal("Denied", new ToolRun(Call("write_file"), """{"ok": false, "message": "Denied"}""").ResultText);
        Assert.Equal("Completed", new ToolRun(Call("remember"), """{"ok": true}""").ResultText);
        Assert.Equal("plain text", new ToolRun(Call("read_file"), "plain text").ResultText);
        Assert.Equal(ToolOutcome.Failure, new ToolRun(Call("read_file"), "Error: not found").Outcome(false));
    }

    [Fact]

        Assert.Equal("Thought, used 1 tool", ToolLabels.Summary(done, hasReasoning: true));
        Assert.Equal("Used 1 tool", ToolLabels.Summary(done, hasReasoning: false));

        Assert.Equal(ToolOutcome.Stopped, run.Outcome(stillRunning: false));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheStatusLineSaysWhenItWaitsOrReconnects()

        Assert.Equal("Waiting for your OK", ReplyStatus.Text(null, reply, awaitingApproval: true));
        Assert.Equal("Reconnecting to the Mac", ReplyStatus.Text(null, reply, reconnecting: true));
        Assert.Equal("Adding a reminder", ReplyStatus.Text(null, reply));

    [Fact]
    public void UnlistedToolsGetReadableNames()

        Assert.Equal("List open issues", ToolLabels.RunningLabel("list_open_issues"));
        Assert.Equal("Searched", ToolLabels.DoneLabel("search_web"));
        Assert.Equal("Get weather", ToolLabels.DoneLabel("get-weather"));
        // A step that didn't work keeps its "-ing" form, with a note after it.
        Assert.Equal("Creating slide deck", ToolLabels.Label("create_pptx", ToolOutcome.Failure));
        Assert.Equal("failed", ToolLabels.Note(ToolOutcome.Failure));
        Assert.Equal("Created", ToolLabels.Label("create_pptx", ToolOutcome.Success));
        Assert.Null(ToolLabels.Note(ToolOutcome.Success));

    [Fact]

        Assert.Equal("Projects", ToolLabels.ShortDetail("~/Projects/"));

    // Ported from Tests/VireoMacTests/ReplyStatusTests.swift.
