===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Office/WordDocument.cs =====
// Word documents (.docx) on the PC: read as Markdown for read_file, and templates filled
// for fill_docx_template, keeping their formatting.
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Packaging;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Wordprocessing;

namespace Vireo.Core.Office;

public static partial class WordDocument
{
    /// <summary>The document as Markdown: headings, lists and tables, with headers and footers left out.</summary>
    public static string Read(string path)
    {
        using var stream = OfficeFile.OpenShared(path);
        using var document = WordprocessingDocument.Open(stream, false);
        var main = document.MainDocumentPart ?? throw new InvalidDataException("This file has no document in it.");
        var styleNames = main.StyleDefinitionsPart?.Styles?.Elements<Style>()
            .Where(s => s.StyleId?.Value is not null)
            .ToDictionary(s => s.StyleId!.Value!, s => s.StyleName?.Val?.Value ?? "", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? [];
        var text = new StringBuilder();
        if (main.Document?.Body is { } body) AppendBlocks(body.ChildElements, styleNames, text);
        return Regex.Replace(text.ToString(), @"\n{3,}", "\n\n").Trim();
    }

    private static void AppendBlocks(IEnumerable<OpenXmlElement> blocks, Dictionary<string, string> styleNames, StringBuilder text)
    {
        foreach (var block in blocks)
        {
            switch (block)
            {
                case Paragraph paragraph:
                    text.Append(ParagraphMarkdown(paragraph, styleNames)).Append('\n');
                    if (HeadingLevel(paragraph, styleNames) is not null) text.Append('\n');
                    break;
                case Table table:
                    text.Append('\n').Append(TableMarkdown(table)).Append('\n');
                    break;
                // Content controls wrap ordinary paragraphs and tables.
                case SdtBlock sdt when sdt.SdtContentBlock is { } content:
                    AppendBlocks(content.ChildElements, styleNames, text);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    private static string ParagraphMarkdown(Paragraph paragraph, Dictionary<string, string> styleNames)
    {
        string content = ParagraphText(paragraph).Trim();
        if (content.Length == 0) return "";
        if (HeadingLevel(paragraph, styleNames) is int level) return $"{new string('#', level)} {content}";
        if (paragraph.ParagraphProperties?.NumberingProperties is { } numbering)
        {
            int depth = numbering.NumberingLevelReference?.Val?.Value ?? 0;
            return $"{new string(' ', depth * 2)}- {content}";
        }
        return content + "\n";
    }

    /// <summary>1 for Title and Heading 1, up to 6; null for body text. Styles are matched by
    /// name too, since a document made in another language has other style ids.</summary>
    private static int? HeadingLevel(Paragraph paragraph, Dictionary<string, string> styleNames)
    {
        string? id = paragraph.ParagraphProperties?.ParagraphStyleId?.Val?.Value;
        if (id is null) return null;
        string name = styleNames.GetValueOrDefault(id, id);
        foreach (string candidate in (string[])[id, name])
        {
            if (candidate.Equals("Title", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return 1;
            var match = HeadingPattern().Match(candidate);
            if (match.Success) return Math.Clamp(int.Parse(match.Groups[1].Value), 1, 6);
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>A paragraph's own text, with tabs and line breaks, but not that of text boxes inside it.</summary>
    private static string ParagraphText(Paragraph paragraph)
    {
        var text = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var element in paragraph.Descendants())
        {
            if (element.Ancestors<Paragraph>().FirstOrDefault() != paragraph) continue;
            switch (element)
            {
                case Text t: text.Append(t.Text); break;
                case TabChar: text.Append('\t'); break;
                case Break or CarriageReturn: text.Append('\n'); break;
            }
        }
        return text.ToString();
    }

    private static string TableMarkdown(Table table)
    {
        var rows = table.Elements<TableRow>()
            .Select(row => row.Elements<TableCell>()
                .Select(cell => string.Join(" ", cell.Elements<Paragraph>().Select(p => ParagraphText(p).Trim()).Where(t => t.Length > 0))
                    .Replace("|", "\\|").Replace("\n", " "))
                .ToList())
            .Where(row => row.Count > 0)
            .ToList();
        if (rows.Count == 0) return "";
        int width = rows.Max(r => r.Count);
        var text = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
        {
            var cells = rows[i].Concat(Enumerable.Repeat("", width - rows[i].Count));
            text.Append("| ").AppendJoin(" | ", cells).Append(" |\n");
            if (i == 0) text.Append('|').Append(string.Concat(Enumerable.Repeat(" --- |", width))).Append('\n');
        }
        return text.ToString();
    }

    // Templates

    public sealed record FillResult(IReadOnlyList<string> Filled, IReadOnlyList<string> LeftEmpty, IReadOnlyList<string> NotInTemplate);

    /// <summary>
    /// Saves a copy of <paramref name="template"/> at <paramref name="output"/> with each
    /// {{placeholder}} replaced by its value, in the body, headers and footers. A placeholder
    /// split across runs (as Word often stores typed text) keeps the first run's formatting.
    /// </summary>
    public static FillResult Fill(string template, string output, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> values)
    {
        var lookup = values.ToDictionary(v => v.Key.Trim(), v => v.Value, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var filled = new SortedSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var leftEmpty = new SortedSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        File.Copy(template, output, overwrite: true);
        try
        {
            using var document = WordprocessingDocument.Open(output, true);
            var main = document.MainDocumentPart ?? throw new InvalidDataException("The template has no document in it.");
            var roots = new List<OpenXmlPartRootElement>();
            if (main.Document is { } body) roots.Add(body);
            roots.AddRange(main.HeaderParts.Select(p => p.Header).OfType<OpenXmlPartRootElement>());
            roots.AddRange(main.FooterParts.Select(p => p.Footer).OfType<OpenXmlPartRootElement>());
            foreach (var root in roots)
            {
                foreach (var paragraph in root.Descendants<Paragraph>().ToList()) FillParagraph(paragraph, lookup, filled, leftEmpty);
                root.Save();
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            File.Delete(output);
            throw;
        }
        var notInTemplate = lookup.Keys.Where(k => !filled.Contains(k)).Order(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();
        return new FillResult([.. filled], [.. leftEmpty], notInTemplate);
    }

    private static void FillParagraph(Paragraph paragraph, Dictionary<string, string> values, SortedSet<string> filled, SortedSet<string> leftEmpty)
    {
        var texts = paragraph.Descendants<Text>().Where(t => t.Ancestors<Paragraph>().FirstOrDefault() == paragraph).ToList();
        if (texts.Count == 0) return;
        var starts = new List<int>();
        var whole = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var t in texts)
        {
            starts.Add(whole.Length);
            whole.Append(t.Text);
        }
        // Last first, so earlier offsets stay right.
        foreach (Match match in PlaceholderPattern().Matches(whole.ToString()).Reverse())
        {
            string name = match.Groups[1].Value.Trim();
            if (!values.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
            {
                leftEmpty.Add(name);
                continue;
            }
            filled.Add(name);
            Replace(texts, starts, match.Index, match.Index + match.Length, value);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Puts <paramref name="value"/> where [start, end) was: in the text the
    /// placeholder starts in, taking the rest of it out of the texts after.</summary>
    private static void Replace(List<Text> texts, List<int> starts, int start, int end, string value)
    {
        for (int i = texts.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            int segmentStart = starts[i], segmentEnd = segmentStart + texts[i].Text.Length;
            if (segmentEnd <= start || segmentStart >= end) continue;
            int from = Math.Max(start, segmentStart) - segmentStart;
            int to = Math.Min(end, segmentEnd) - segmentStart;
            string current = texts[i].Text;
            bool first = start >= segmentStart && start < segmentEnd;
            string inserted = first ? value : "";
            string[] lines = inserted.Replace("\r\n", "\n").Split('\n');
            texts[i].Text = current[..from] + lines[0] + (lines.Length == 1 ? current[to..] : "");
            texts[i].Space = SpaceProcessingModeValues.Preserve;
            // More lines become line breaks in the same run, the last with the text after.
            OpenXmlElement after = texts[i];
            for (int line = 1; line < lines.Length; line++)
            {
                after = after.InsertAfterSelf(new Break());
                string rest = line == lines.Length - 1 ? lines[line] + current[to..] : lines[line];
                after = after.InsertAfterSelf(new Text(rest) { Space = SpaceProcessingModeValues.Preserve });
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The placeholder names in a template, for read_file to point out.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Placeholders(string markdown) =>
        PlaceholderPattern().Matches(markdown).Select(m => m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()).Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^heading\s*([1-9])$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex HeadingPattern();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"\{\{\s*([^{}]+?)\s*\}\}")]
    private static partial Regex PlaceholderPattern();
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Models/ModelScanner.swift =====
import Foundation

enum ModelFormat: String, Codable, Hashable {
    /// A single .gguf file (or the first of its parts), run by Vireo's engine.
    case gguf
}

/// Finds GGUF models on disk, a few levels deep so
/// libraries laid out as publisher/model/ (LM Studio's, for one) are found too.
enum ModelScanner {
    static let maxDepth = 3

    /// Every model at or under `url`, which may be a folder or a .gguf file.
    static func models(at url: URL, depth: Int = 0) -> [LocalModel] {
        let fileManager = FileManager.default
        var isDirectory: ObjCBool = false
        guard fileManager.fileExists(atPath: url.path, isDirectory: &isDirectory) else { return [] }
        if !isDirectory.boolValue {
            return ggufModel(at: url).map { [$0] } ?? []
        }
        guard depth < maxDepth else { return [] }
        // Hidden entries include in-progress ".download-*" folders.
        let entries = (try? fileManager.contentsOfDirectory(
            at: url, includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isDirectoryKey], options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
        )) ?? []
        return entries
            .flatMap { entry -> [LocalModel] in
                if (try? entry.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isDirectoryKey]).isDirectory) == true {
                    return models(at: entry, depth: depth + 1)
                }
                return ggufModel(at: entry).map { [$0] } ?? []
            }
            .sorted { $0.name.localizedStandardCompare($1.name) == .orderedAscending }
    }

    /// "name-00002-of-00003.gguf": one part of a model split across files.
    private static let partPattern = #"-(\d{5})-of-(\d{5})\.gguf$"#

    /// A model for a .gguf file, or nil for a vision projector or a later part of
    /// a split model (the first part stands for the whole).
    static func ggufModel(at url: URL) -> LocalModel? {
        let fileName = url.lastPathComponent
        let lowercased = fileName.lowercased()
        guard lowercased.hasSuffix(".gguf"), !lowercased.contains("mmproj") else { return nil }

        var name = String(fileName.dropLast(".gguf".count))
        var size = fileSize(url)
        if let part = lowercased.range(of: partPattern, options: .regularExpression) {
            guard lowercased[part].hasPrefix("-00001-") else { return nil }
            let stem = String(fileName[..<part.lowerBound])
            name = stem
            let folder = url.deletingLastPathComponent()
            let siblings = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: folder.path)) ?? []
            size = siblings
                .filter { $0.hasPrefix(stem + "-") && $0.lowercased().range(of: partPattern, options: .regularExpression) != nil }
                .reduce(Int64(0)) { $0 + fileSize(folder.appendingPathComponent($1)) }
        }
        return LocalModel(
            path: url.path, name: name, sizeBytes: size,
            modelType: GGUFMetadata.architecture(ofFileAt: url), format: .gguf
        )
    }

    private static func fileSize(_ url: URL) -> Int64 {
        Int64((try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.fileSizeKey]).fileSize) ?? 0)
    }
}

===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Office/OfficePreview.cs =====
// Word, Excel and PowerPoint files as Markdown, for the preview pane and for attaching one:
// Windows has no Quick Look, and a PC may have no Office to open them in.
using System.Text;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Packaging;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Spreadsheet;

namespace Vireo.Core.Office;

public static class OfficePreview
{
    /// <summary>A sheet shows this much in a preview; the file itself has the rest.</summary>
    public const int MaxRows = 200;
    public const int MaxColumns = 20;

    public static bool CanRead(string path) =>
        Path.GetExtension(path).ToLowerInvariant() is ".docx" or ".dotx" or ".xlsx" or ".xlsm" or ".pptx";

    /// <summary>The file as Markdown: a Word document as it reads, each sheet as a table, each slide
    /// with its text and notes.</summary>
    public static string Markdown(string path) => Path.GetExtension(path).ToLowerInvariant() switch
    {
        ".docx" or ".dotx" => WordDocument.Read(path),
        ".xlsx" or ".xlsm" => Workbook(path),
        ".pptx" => Deck(path),
        _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"{Path.GetFileName(path)} isn't a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file."),
    };

    /// <summary>Each sheet under its name, as a table whose first row is the header.</summary>
    private static string Workbook(string path)
    {
        var text = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var (name, rows) in Spreadsheet.Cells(path, MaxRows + 1))
        {
            text.Append("## ").Append(name).Append("\n\n");
            if (rows.Count == 0)
            {
                text.Append("*Empty sheet*\n\n");
                continue;
            }
            int width = Math.Min(rows.Max(r => r.Count), MaxColumns);
            string Row(IReadOnlyList<string> cells) =>
                "| " + string.Join(" | ", Enumerable.Range(0, width).Select(i => i < cells.Count ? cells[i].Replace("|", "\\|") : "")) + " |\n";
            text.Append(Row(rows[0]));
            text.Append('|').Append(string.Concat(Enumerable.Repeat(" --- |", width))).Append('\n');
            foreach (var row in rows.Skip(1).Take(MaxRows - 1)) text.Append(Row(row));
            if (rows.Count > MaxRows) text.Append($"\n*Showing the first {MaxRows} rows.*\n");
            text.Append('\n');
        }
        return text.ToString().TrimEnd();
    }

    /// <summary>The slides as the model reads them, with each slide's notes set apart.</summary>
    private static string Deck(string path) =>
        string.Join('\n', SlideDeck.Read(path).Split('\n').Skip(1)
            .Select(line => line.StartsWith("Notes: ", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "*Notes: " + line[7..].Trim() + "*" : line)).Trim();
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Views/ChatInspectorView.swift =====
import SwiftUI

enum ChatInspectorVisibility {
    /// Shared by the chat view and the Chat menu, so both show the same state.
    static let key = "invurse_show_chat_inspector"
}

/// Side panel with the chat's own instructions and sampling settings.
struct ChatInspectorView: View {
    @EnvironmentObject private var store: ChatStore
    @EnvironmentObject private var serverManager: LocalServerManager
    @EnvironmentObject private var modelManager: ModelManager
    let chatId: String

    /// Edited locally and saved after a pause, so typing doesn't rewrite the chat list on every key.
    @State private var systemPromptDraft = ""
    @State private var showAdvanced = false
    @State private var savedAsDefault = false

    private var chat: Chat? { store.chats.first { $0.id == chatId } }

    private var generation: Binding<GenerationSettings> {
        Binding(
            get: { chat?.generation ?? .standard },
            set: { store.setGeneration($0, for: chatId) }
        )
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
                modelSection
                systemPromptSection
                samplingSection
                footer
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
        .background(AppTheme.bgSecondary)
        .onAppear { systemPromptDraft = chat?.systemPrompt ?? "" }
        .task(id: systemPromptDraft) {
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(500))
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            store.setSystemPrompt(systemPromptDraft, for: chatId)
        }
        // Save a pending edit when the panel closes or the chat changes.
        .onDisappear { store.setSystemPrompt(systemPromptDraft, for: chatId) }
    }

    // MARK: - Model

    private var modelSection: some View {
        section("Model") {
            ModelChoicePicker(title: "Use for this chat", selection: Binding(
                get: { chat?.modelPath },
                set: { store.setModelPath($0, for: chatId) }
            ))
            Text("A chosen model is loaded before this chat replies, in place of the current one.")
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                LabeledContent("Model", value: loadedModelName)
                LabeledContent("Status", value: serverManager.isRunning ? "Loaded" : serverManager.overallStatus.label)
                LabeledContent("Runtime", value: "Vireo engine")
                LabeledContent("Context window", value: "\(store.contextLimit.formatted()) tokens")
                LabeledContent("Max reply (engine)", value: "\(LocalServerManager.engineDefaultMaxTokens.formatted()) tokens")
            }
            .font(.system(size: 12))
            .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
        }
    }

    private var loadedModelName: String {
        let name = serverManager.configuration.activeModelName
        guard !name.isEmpty else { return "None" }
        return ModelPickerView.displayName(for: name, catalog: modelManager.catalogModels)
    }

    // MARK: - System prompt

    private var systemPromptSection: some View {
        section("Instructions for this chat") {
            TextEditor(text: $systemPromptDraft)
                .font(.system(size: 12))
                .scrollContentBackground(.hidden)
                .padding(6)
                .frame(minHeight: 110, maxHeight: 220)
                .background(AppTheme.bgTertiary)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
                .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                    if systemPromptDraft.isEmpty {
                        Text("For example: Answer briefly. Use Canadian spelling.")
                            .font(.system(size: 12))
                            .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary.opacity(0.7))
                            .padding(.horizontal, 11)
                            .padding(.vertical, 6)
                            .allowsHitTesting(false)
                    }
                }
            Text("Added to Vireo's built-in instructions, which keep tools and approvals working.")
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Sampling

    private var samplingSection: some View {
        section("Sampling") {
            Picker("Preset", selection: presetSelection) {
                ForEach(GenerationPreset.allCases) { preset in
                    Text(preset.title).tag(Optional(preset))
                }
                if GenerationPreset.matching(generation.wrappedValue) == nil {
                    Text("Custom").tag(GenerationPreset?.none)
                }
            }
            .pickerStyle(.menu)
            if let preset = GenerationPreset.matching(generation.wrappedValue) {
                Text(preset == .recommended
                     ? preset.summary + " Moving a slider switches to your own settings."
                     : preset.summary)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
            }

            slider(
                "Temperature", value: generation.temperature, range: GenerationSettings.temperatureRange, step: 0.05,
                help: "Higher is more varied, lower is more predictable."
            )
            maxTokensControl

            DisclosureGroup("Advanced", isExpanded: $showAdvanced) {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
                    slider(
                        "Top P", value: generation.topP, range: GenerationSettings.topPRange, step: 0.01,
                        help: "Picks only from the most likely words that add up to this share."
                    )
                    intSlider(
                        "Top K", value: generation.topK, range: GenerationSettings.topKRange, step: 5,
                        offLabel: "Off", help: "Picks only from this many of the most likely words."
                    )
                    slider(
                        "Min P", value: generation.minP, range: GenerationSettings.minPRange, step: 0.01,
                        offLabel: "Off", help: "Skips words much less likely than the top choice."
                    )
                    slider(
                        "Repeat penalty", value: generation.repetitionPenalty,
                        range: GenerationSettings.repetitionPenaltyRange, step: 0.01,
                        offValue: 1, offLabel: "Off", help: "Above 1 makes repeating words less likely."
                    )
                }
                .padding(.top, 10)
            }
            .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .medium))
        }
    }

    private var presetSelection: Binding<GenerationPreset?> {
        Binding(
            get: { GenerationPreset.matching(generation.wrappedValue) },
            set: { preset in
                guard let preset else { return }
                generation.wrappedValue = preset.applied(to: generation.wrappedValue)
            }
        )
    }

    private var maxTokensControl: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            Toggle("Limit reply length", isOn: Binding(
                get: { generation.wrappedValue.maxTokens != nil },
                set: { generation.wrappedValue.maxTokens = $0 ? LocalServerManager.engineDefaultMaxTokens : nil }
            ))
            .toggleStyle(.switch)
            .controlSize(.small)
            .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .medium))
            if let maxTokens = generation.wrappedValue.maxTokens {
                HStack {
                    Text("Max tokens")
                    Spacer()
                    TextField("", value: Binding(
                        get: { maxTokens },
                        set: { generation.wrappedValue.maxTokens = min(max($0, GenerationSettings.maxTokensRange.lowerBound), GenerationSettings.maxTokensRange.upperBound) }
                    ), format: .number)
                    .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                    .frame(width: 80)
                }
                .font(.system(size: 12))
            } else {
                Text("Uses the server setting (\(LocalServerManager.engineDefaultMaxTokens.formatted()) tokens).")
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Footer

    private var footer: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            HStack {
                Button("Reset") {
                    systemPromptDraft = ""
                    generation.wrappedValue = .standard
                }
                .help("Clear this chat's instructions and use the standard settings.")
                Spacer()
                Button(savedAsDefault ? "Saved" : "Use for New Chats") {
                    store.setSystemPrompt(systemPromptDraft, for: chatId)
                    store.saveAsDefaultSettings(from: chatId)
                    savedAsDefault = true
                }
                .disabled(savedAsDefault || isDefault)
                .help("New chats will start with these instructions and settings.")
            }
            .controlSize(.small)
        }
        .onChange(of: chat?.generation) { savedAsDefault = false }
        .onChange(of: systemPromptDraft) { savedAsDefault = false }
    }

    private var isDefault: Bool {
        let defaults = store.defaultChatSettings
        return defaults.systemPrompt == systemPromptDraft && defaults.generation == generation.wrappedValue
    }

    // MARK: - Building blocks

    private func section<Content: View>(_ title: String, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Text(title.uppercased())
                .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .semibold))
                .tracking(0.6)
                .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
            content()
        }
    }

    private func slider(
        _ title: String, value: Binding<Double>, range: ClosedRange<Double>, step: Double,
        offValue: Double = 0, offLabel: String? = nil, help: String
    ) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
            HStack {
                Text(title).font(.system(size: 12, weight: .medium))
                Spacer()
                Text(offLabel != nil && value.wrappedValue == offValue ? offLabel! : value.wrappedValue.formatted(.number.precision(.fractionLength(2))))
                    .font(.system(size: 12, design: .monospaced))
                    .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
            }
            // Snapped to the step, then to two decimals (0.7, not 0.7000000000000001),
            // so presets are still recognised after dragging.
            Slider(value: Binding(
                get: { value.wrappedValue },
                set: { value.wrappedValue = (($0 / step).rounded() * step * 100).rounded() / 100 }
            ), in: range)
            .controlSize(.small)
            Text(help)
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
        }
    }

    private func intSlider(
        _ title: String, value: Binding<Int>, range: ClosedRange<Int>, step: Int,
        offLabel: String, help: String
    ) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
            HStack {
                Text(title).font(.system(size: 12, weight: .medium))
                Spacer()
                Text(value.wrappedValue == 0 ? offLabel : "\(value.wrappedValue)")
                    .font(.system(size: 12, design: .monospaced))
                    .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
            }
            Slider(value: Binding(
                get: { Double(value.wrappedValue) },
                set: { value.wrappedValue = Int(($0 / Double(step)).rounded()) * step }
            ), in: Double(range.lowerBound)...Double(range.upperBound))
            .controlSize(.small)
            Text(help)
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
        }
    }
}

/// Choose a model for a chat or Quick Ask: nil keeps whichever model is loaded.
struct ModelChoicePicker: View {
    @EnvironmentObject private var modelManager: ModelManager
    let title: String
    @Binding var selection: String?

    var body: some View {
        Picker(title, selection: $selection) {
            Text("Whichever is loaded").tag(String?.none)
            Divider()
            ForEach(modelManager.installedLocalModels) { model in
                Text(ModelPickerView.displayName(for: model.name, catalog: modelManager.catalogModels))
                    .tag(String?.some(model.path))
            }
            // A chosen model that has since been deleted or moved stays visible.
            if let selection, !modelManager.installedLocalModels.contains(where: { $0.path == selection }) {
                Text("\(URL(fileURLWithPath: selection).lastPathComponent) (not found)").tag(String?.some(selection))
            }
        }
        .onAppear { modelManager.refresh() }
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Services/ScriptRunner.swift =====
import AppKit
import SwiftUI

/// A test to watch in the app: prompts sent one after another as if typed, each in the
/// chat it names. `tools/long_run.py --export-script` writes one; so can anything else.
///
///     {"name": "Long run", "systemPrompt": "...", "steps": [
///       {"prompt": "...", "title": "note", "expect": ["412"]},
///       {"prompt": "...", "chat": "side"},
///       {"prompt": "...", "approve": false}]}
///
/// A step's `chat` names its chat ("main" when left out): the first step for a name
/// starts a new chat, later ones go on in it. `expect` lists what the reply must contain.
/// `approve` is the answer given to any approval the reply asks for (yes when left out);
/// `approveIf` approves only an approval whose tool, preview or arguments contain that text.
///
/// `thinking` turns the model's thinking on or off for the script's chats (the app's own
/// setting when left out). Calendar events and reminders a reply adds are pretended, not
/// put on the user's calendar, unless `calendar` is "real"; each step's record lists what
/// it would have added. `approveTasks` is the answer given to approvals asked by tasks
/// that run while the script does (yes when left out).
///
/// For a graded run (`tools/aurelia_run.py`): `access` ("folders", "home" or "full") and
/// `folders` are the file access the script's chats get, whatever the app's own settings
/// say, and `gate` names a folder: after each step its record is written there as
/// `step-<n>.json`, and the script waits for `step-<n>.done` to appear before the next,
/// so a grader can look at the files as that step left them.
struct TestScript: Codable {
    struct Step: Codable {
        var prompt: String
        var title: String?
        var chat: String?
        var expect: [String]?
        var approve: Bool?
        var approveIf: String?
    }

    var name: String
    var systemPrompt: String?
    var access: String?
    var folders: [String]?
    var gate: String?
    var thinking: Bool?
    var calendar: String?
    var approveTasks: Bool?
    var steps: [Step]
}

/// What a run of a script recorded, written beside the others when it ends.
struct TestScriptResults: Codable {
    /// An approval a reply asked for, and the answer the script gave.
    struct Approval: Codable {
        var tool: String
        var approved: Bool
        var preview: String
        var args: [String: String]
    }

    struct Step: Codable {
        var step: Int
        var title: String?
        var chat: String
        var prompt: String
        var reply: String
        var tools: [String]
        /// Each call and result as the chat shows it (what it was about, the result's start).
        var toolSteps: [ToolStep]?
        var approvals: Int
        var approvalsAsked: [Approval]?
        /// The events and reminders the step would have added (a dry run's).
        var calendar: [String]?
        var firstWordSeconds: Double?
        var seconds: Double
        var tokens: Int?
        var tokensPerSecond: String?
        var right: Bool?
        var error: Bool
    }

    var name: String
    var model: String
    var started: Date
    var seconds: Double
    var stopped: Bool
    var steps: [Step]
}

/// Plays a `TestScript` into the app: the same chat store, replies, tool steps and
/// approval cards as typing each prompt, so a test can be watched as it runs.
@MainActor
final class ScriptRunner: ObservableObject {
    static let shared = ScriptRunner()

    struct Progress: Equatable {
        var name: String
        var step: Int
        var total: Int
        var title: String
        var right: Int
        var wrong: Int
        /// Set when the run is over: where its results were written, or what went wrong.
        var finished: String?
    }

    @Published private(set) var progress: Progress?
    private var task: Task<Void, Never>?
    /// The running script's gate folder, where a task that runs meanwhile leaves its
    /// record too (`TaskRunner`), and the answer its approvals get.
    private(set) var gate: URL?
    private(set) var taskApprovals = true

    var isRunning: Bool { task != nil }

    /// How long an approval card stays up before the script answers it, so it can be seen.
    private static let approvalPause: Duration = .milliseconds(1500)

    static var resultsFolder: URL {
        let base = FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        return base.appendingPathComponent("VireoPrototype/test-runs", isDirectory: true)
    }

    /// The script named on the command line (`--run-script <file>`), if any.
    static var launchScript: URL? {
        let args = CommandLine.arguments
        guard let i = args.firstIndex(of: "--run-script"), i + 1 < args.count else { return nil }
        return URL(fileURLWithPath: (args[i + 1] as NSString).expandingTildeInPath)
    }

    /// The model to run it on (`--model <file.gguf>`), which becomes the app's model; without
    /// it the script runs on the model the app is set to.
    static var launchModel: String? {
        let args = CommandLine.arguments
        guard let i = args.firstIndex(of: "--model"), i + 1 < args.count else { return nil }
        return (args[i + 1] as NSString).expandingTildeInPath
    }

    func chooseAndRun(store: ChatStore, capabilityStore: CapabilityStore) {
        let panel = NSOpenPanel()
        panel.title = "Run Test Script"
        panel.allowedContentTypes = [.json]
        panel.allowsMultipleSelection = false
        guard panel.runModal() == .OK, let url = panel.url else { return }
        run(url, store: store, capabilityStore: capabilityStore)
    }

    func run(_ url: URL, model: String? = nil, store: ChatStore, capabilityStore: CapabilityStore) {
        guard task == nil else { return }
        let script: TestScript
        do {
            script = try JSONDecoder().decode(TestScript.self, from: Data(contentsOf: url))
        } catch {
            progress = Progress(name: url.lastPathComponent, step: 0, total: 0, title: "", right: 0, wrong: 0,
                                finished: "Couldn't read the script: \(error.localizedDescription)")
            return
        }
        task = Task { [weak self] in
            await self?.play(script, model: model, store: store, capabilityStore: capabilityStore)
            self?.task = nil
        }
    }

    func stop() {
        task?.cancel()
    }

    func dismiss() {
        if task == nil { progress = nil }
    }

    private func play(_ script: TestScript, model: String?, store: ChatStore, capabilityStore: CapabilityStore) async {
        var progress = Progress(name: script.name, step: 0, total: script.steps.count,
                                title: "Starting the model", right: 0, wrong: 0)
        self.progress = progress
        let server = LocalServerManager.shared
        let switching = model.map { $0 != server.configuration.activeModelPath } ?? false
        if switching || !server.isRunning {
            if let model, switching {
                server.switchModel(to: model)
            } else {
                server.startAll()
            }
            // Starting (or stopping the model before) is under way before the status is read.
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2))
            let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(600)
            while !server.isRunning, server.overallStatus != .error, Date() < deadline, !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(500))
            }
            guard server.isRunning else {
                progress.finished = Task.isCancelled ? "Stopped." : "The model didn't start, so the script wasn't run."
                self.progress = progress
                return
            }
        }
        await capabilityStore.refresh()
        let capabilities = capabilityStore.response == nil ? nil : capabilityStore.availableTools.map(\.name)

        store.scriptThinking = script.thinking
        if script.calendar != "real" { CalendarTools.shared.startDryRun() }
        gate = script.gate.map { URL(fileURLWithPath: $0, isDirectory: true) }
        taskApprovals = script.approveTasks ?? true
        defer {
            store.scriptThinking = nil
            CalendarTools.shared.endDryRun()
            gate = nil
        }

        var chats: [String: String] = [:]
        var results = TestScriptResults(
            name: script.name,
            model: URL(fileURLWithPath: server.configuration.activeModelPath).lastPathComponent,
            started: Date(), seconds: 0, stopped: false, steps: []
        )
        for (index, step) in script.steps.enumerated() {
            if Task.isCancelled { break }
            // Never on top of a reply the user started themselves.
            while store.replyActivity != nil, !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(200))
            }
            if Task.isCancelled { break }
            let chatName = step.chat ?? "main"
            let chatId: String
            if let known = chats[chatName], store.chats.contains(where: { $0.id == known }) {
                chatId = known
                store.currentChatId = known
            } else {
                let title = chatName == "main" ? script.name : "\(script.name): \(chatName)"
                chatId = store.newChat(title: title, tags: ["test"])
                if let system = script.systemPrompt { store.setSystemPrompt(system, for: chatId) }
                if let access = script.access.flatMap(AgentAccess.init(rawValue:)) {
                    store.setScriptAccess(access, folders: script.folders, for: chatId)
                }
                chats[chatName] = chatId
            }
            progress.step = index + 1
            progress.title = step.title ?? chatName
            self.progress = progress

            store.appendMessage(ChatMessage(role: "user", content: step.prompt), to: chatId)
            let activity = ChatStore.ReplyActivity(chatId: chatId)
            store.replyActivity = activity
            let started = Date()
            let calendarBefore = CalendarTools.shared.pretended.count
            let watch = Task { @MainActor () -> (firstWord: Double?, approvals: [TestScriptResults.Approval]) in
                var firstWord: Double?
                var approvals: [TestScriptResults.Approval] = []
                while !Task.isCancelled {
                    if firstWord == nil, let last = store.messages(for: chatId).last,
                       last.role == "assistant", !last.content.isEmpty {
                        firstWord = Date().timeIntervalSince(started)
                    }
                    if let request = store.confirmRequest, request.chatId == chatId {
                        try? await Task.sleep(for: Self.approvalPause)
                        if store.confirmRequest?.id == request.id {
                            let approved = Self.answer(for: request, step: step)
                            store.answerConfirmation(request, approved: approved)
                            approvals.append(.init(tool: request.tool, approved: approved,
                                                   preview: request.preview ?? "", args: request.args))
                        }
                    }
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
                }
                return (firstWord, approvals)
            }
            let reply = await store.streamReply(chatId: chatId, activityID: activity.id, capabilities: capabilities)
            watch.cancel()
            let watched = await watch.value
            if store.replyActivity?.id == activity.id { store.replyActivity = nil }

            var right: Bool?
            if let expect = step.expect, !expect.isEmpty {
                let text = Self.withoutThousandsSeparators(reply.content)
                right = expect.allSatisfy { text.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains($0) }
                if right == true { progress.right += 1 } else { progress.wrong += 1 }
            }
            results.steps.append(.init(
                step: index + 1, title: step.title, chat: chatName, prompt: step.prompt,
                reply: reply.content,
                tools: reply.toolSteps.filter { $0.type == "tool_call" }.map(\.tool),
                toolSteps: reply.toolSteps,
                approvals: watched.approvals.count, approvalsAsked: watched.approvals,
                calendar: Array(CalendarTools.shared.pretended.dropFirst(calendarBefore)),
                firstWordSeconds: watched.firstWord,
                seconds: Date().timeIntervalSince(started),
                tokens: reply.metadata?.tokens, tokensPerSecond: reply.metadata?.tokensPerSecond,
                right: right, error: reply.isError
            ))
            self.progress = progress
            // A beat between turns, so the reply can be read as it goes by.
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(400))
            if let gate = script.gate, let record = results.steps.last {
                await Self.wait(at: URL(fileURLWithPath: gate, isDirectory: true), for: record)
            }
        }
        results.stopped = Task.isCancelled
        results.seconds = Date().timeIntervalSince(results.started)
        progress.title = results.stopped ? "Stopped" : "Done"
        progress.finished = Self.write(results)
        self.progress = progress
    }

    /// The answer to an approval: `approveIf` approves only what names its text (a delete
    /// of one file and no other); otherwise `approve`, yes when left out.
    nonisolated static func answer(for request: ConfirmRequest, step: TestScript.Step) -> Bool {
        guard let wanted = step.approveIf else { return step.approve ?? true }
        let shown = [request.tool, request.preview ?? ""] + request.args.values
        return shown.contains { $0.contains(wanted) }
    }

    /// Writes a step's record into the gate folder and waits for the grader's go-ahead
    /// (`step-<n>.done`), or for Stop.
    private static func wait(at gate: URL, for record: TestScriptResults.Step) async {
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        encoder.outputFormatting = [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys]
        let file = gate.appendingPathComponent("step-\(record.step).json")
        let done = gate.appendingPathComponent("step-\(record.step).done")
        do {
            try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: gate, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
            try encoder.encode(record).write(to: file, options: .atomic)
        } catch {
            return
        }
        while !Task.isCancelled, !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: done.path) {
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(200))
        }
    }

    /// "12,085" and "12085" are the same number to a check.
    nonisolated static func withoutThousandsSeparators(_ text: String) -> String {
        text.replacingOccurrences(of: #"(?<=\d),(?=\d{3})"#, with: "", options: .regularExpression)
    }

    private static func write(_ results: TestScriptResults) -> String {
        let stamp = DateFormatter()
        stamp.dateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd-HHmmss"
        let safeName = results.name.replacingOccurrences(of: #"[^A-Za-z0-9]+"#, with: "-", options: .regularExpression)
        let file = resultsFolder.appendingPathComponent("\(safeName)-\(stamp.string(from: results.started)).json")
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        encoder.outputFormatting = [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys]
        encoder.dateEncodingStrategy = .iso8601
        do {
            try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: resultsFolder, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
            try encoder.encode(results).write(to: file, options: .atomic)
            return "Results saved to \(file.path)"
        } catch {
            return "The results couldn't be saved: \(error.localizedDescription)"
        }
    }
}

/// The strip across the top of the window while a script runs, and once it has ended.
struct ScriptRunBanner: View {
    @ObservedObject var runner: ScriptRunner

    var body: some View {
        if let progress = runner.progress {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                if runner.isRunning {
                    ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
                }
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(headline(progress))
                        .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textPrimary)
                    if let finished = progress.finished {
                        Text(finished)
                            .font(.system(size: 11))
                            .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
                            .lineLimit(2)
                            .textSelection(.enabled)
                    }
                }
                Spacer(minLength: 12)
                if runner.isRunning {
                    Button("Stop") { runner.stop() }
                } else {
                    Button("Close") { runner.dismiss() }
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 14)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
            .frame(maxWidth: 560)
            .background(AppTheme.bgTertiary)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
            .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(AppTheme.border))
            .shadow(radius: 10)
            .padding(.top, 10)
        }
    }

    private func headline(_ p: ScriptRunner.Progress) -> String {
        guard p.total > 0 else { return "Test: \(p.name)" }
        var text = "Test: \(p.name)  step \(p.step) of \(p.total)"
        if !p.title.isEmpty { text += "  \(p.title)" }
        if p.right + p.wrong > 0 { text += "  \(p.right) right, \(p.wrong) wrong" }
        return text
    }
}

import AppKit
import SwiftUI

/// Settings  Model: which model runs, and starting and stopping it.
/// How it runs is under Settings  Advanced.
struct ModelSettingsPage: View {
    @Environment(\.openWindow) private var openWindow
    @EnvironmentObject private var serverManager: LocalServerManager
    @EnvironmentObject private var modelManager: ModelManager
    @Binding var configuration: LocalServerConfiguration
    let serverRunning: Bool

    @State private var scanStatus = ""

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            activeModel
            Divider()
            LocalServerControls()
        }
        .onAppear { modelManager.refresh() }
    }

    private var activeModel: some View {
        SettingsGroup("Active model", note: "Choosing a model here loads it now, as choosing one above a chat does.") {
            Picker("Model", selection: activeModelSelection) {
                ForEach(displayedModels) { model in
                    Text("\(model.name) (\(formattedSize(model.sizeBytes)))").tag(model.path)
                }
            }
            .labelsHidden()
            HStack {
                Button("Download and Manage Models") { openWindow(id: ModelsWindow.id) }
                Button("Add Model Folder") { chooseModelFolder() }
                Button("Rescan") { rescan() }
            }
            if !scanStatus.isEmpty { SettingsNote(scanStatus) }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Models

    private var displayedModels: [LocalModel] {
        let downloaded = modelManager.installedLocalModels
        let activePath = configuration.activeModelPath
        if activePath.isEmpty || downloaded.contains(where: { $0.path == activePath }) { return downloaded }
        return [LocalModel(path: activePath, name: URL(fileURLWithPath: activePath).lastPathComponent, sizeBytes: 0)] + downloaded
    }

    /// Picking a model loads it, the same as the model menu above a chat.
    private var activeModelSelection: Binding<String> {
        Binding(
            get: { configuration.activeModelPath },
            set: { path in
                guard path != configuration.activeModelPath else { return }
                if serverManager.overallStatus == .stopped {
                    serverManager.useModel(at: path)
                } else {
                    serverManager.switchModel(to: path)
                }
            }
        )
    }

    /// Models kept outside the models folder: a .gguf file, or a folder of them.
    private func chooseModelFolder() {
        let panel = NSOpenPanel()
        panel.canChooseDirectories = true
        panel.canChooseFiles = true
        panel.allowedContentTypes = [.init(filenameExtension: "gguf") ?? .data, .folder]
        panel.message = "Choose a .gguf model, or a folder of models, such as ~/.lmstudio/models."
        guard panel.runModal() == .OK, let url = panel.url else { return }
        switch modelManager.addModelFolder(url) {
        case .added(let count): scanStatus = "Added \(count) model\(count == 1 ? "" : "s")."
        case .alreadyAdded: scanStatus = "That folder is already added."
        case .notAModel: scanStatus = "No .gguf models found there."
        }
    }

    private func rescan() {
        modelManager.refresh()
        let count = modelManager.installedLocalModels.count
        scanStatus = count == 0 ? "No downloaded models found. Open Models to download one." : "\(count) model\(count == 1 ? "" : "s") found."
    }

}

private func formattedSize(_ bytes: Int64) -> String {
    guard bytes > 0 else { return "Unknown size" }
    return ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: bytes, countStyle: .file)
}
