===== crates/vireo-engine/src/half.rs =====
//! 16-bit floats, as GGUF stores them: IEEE half precision (f16) and bfloat16.
//!
//! Quantized blocks keep their scales as f16, so this runs for every block of every
//! weight. Written out bit by bit rather than relying on Rust's `f16`, which isn't
//! stable.

/// An IEEE 754 half-precision float's bits, as an f32 (exactly: every f16 is an f32).
#[inline]
pub fn f16_to_f32(h: u16) -> f32 {
    let sign = u32::from(h & 0x8000) << 16;
    let exponent = u32::from((h >> 10) & 0x1f);
    let mantissa = u32::from(h & 0x3ff);
    let bits = match exponent {
        0 if mantissa == 0 => sign,
        0 => {
            // Subnormal: shift the mantissa up until it has its leading 1, lowering the
            // exponent to match. The value is mantissa  2^-24.
            let mut e = 127 - 15 + 1;
            let mut m = mantissa;
            while m & 0x400 == 0 {
                m <<= 1;
                e -= 1;
            }
            sign | (e << 23) | ((m & 0x3ff) << 13)
        }
        0x1f => sign | 0x7f80_0000 | (mantissa << 13), // infinity and NaN
        _ => sign | ((exponent + 127 - 15) << 23) | (mantissa << 13),
    };
    f32::from_bits(bits)
}

/// The nearest f16 to `x` (ties to even, as hardware rounds), as its bits. Too large
/// becomes infinity; too small, zero or a subnormal.
pub fn f32_to_f16(x: f32) -> u16 {
    let bits = x.to_bits();
    let sign = ((bits >> 16) & 0x8000) as u16;
    let exponent = ((bits >> 23) & 0xff) as i32;
    let mantissa = bits & 0x7f_ffff;
    if exponent == 0xff {
        return sign | 0x7c00 | if mantissa != 0 { 0x200 } else { 0 };
    }
    let e = exponent - 127 + 15;
    if e >= 0x1f {
        return sign | 0x7c00;
    }
    if e <= 0 {
        // A subnormal f16: the value in units of 2^-24, rounded.
        if e < -10 {
            return sign;
        }
        let m = mantissa | 0x80_0000;
        let shift = (14 - e) as u32;
        let (whole, rest, halfway) = (m >> shift, m & ((1 << shift) - 1), 1 << (shift - 1));
        let rounded = whole + u32::from(rest > halfway || (rest == halfway && whole & 1 == 1));
        return sign | rounded as u16;
    }
    let mut h = ((e as u32) << 10) | (mantissa >> 13);
    let rest = mantissa & 0x1fff;
    if rest > 0x1000 || (rest == 0x1000 && h & 1 == 1) {
        h += 1; // a carry into the exponent is still right, up to infinity
    }
    sign | h as u16
}

/// `x` rounded to the nearest f16, back as an f32.
#[inline]
pub fn round_to_f16(x: f32) -> f32 {
    f16_to_f32(f32_to_f16(x))
}

/// A bfloat16's bits, as an f32: bfloat16 is the top half of an f32.
#[inline]
pub fn bf16_to_f32(h: u16) -> f32 {
    f32::from_bits(u32::from(h) << 16)
}

/// Reads a little-endian f16 from the start of `bytes`.
#[inline]
pub fn read_f16(bytes: &[u8]) -> f32 {
    f16_to_f32(u16::from_le_bytes([bytes[0], bytes[1]]))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn f16_values() {
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0x0000), 0.0);
        assert!(f16_to_f32(0x8000).is_sign_negative());
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0x3C00), 1.0);
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0xC000), -2.0);
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0x3555), 0.333_251_95);
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0x7BFF), 65504.0); // the largest f16
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0x0400), 2f32.powi(-14)); // the smallest normal
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0x0001), 2f32.powi(-24)); // the smallest subnormal
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0x03FF), 1023.0 * 2f32.powi(-24));
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0x7C00), f32::INFINITY);
        assert_eq!(f16_to_f32(0xFC00), f32::NEG_INFINITY);
        assert!(f16_to_f32(0x7E00).is_nan());
    }

    #[test]
    fn every_f16_matches_its_definition() {
        for h in 0..=u16::MAX {
            let exponent = i32::from((h >> 10) & 0x1f);
            let mantissa = f64::from(h & 0x3ff);
            let magnitude = match exponent {
                0 => mantissa * 2f64.powi(-24),
                0x1f => continue,
                _ => (1.0 + mantissa / 1024.0) * 2f64.powi(exponent - 15),
            };
            let expected = if h & 0x8000 != 0 {
                -magnitude
            } else {
                magnitude
            };
            assert_eq!(f64::from(f16_to_f32(h)), expected, "{h:#06x}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn f32_to_f16_round_trips_and_rounds_to_even() {
        for h in 0..=u16::MAX {
            let x = f16_to_f32(h);
            if x.is_nan() {
                assert!(f16_to_f32(f32_to_f16(x)).is_nan());
            } else {
                assert_eq!(f32_to_f16(x), h, "{h:#06x}");
            }
        }
        // Halfway between 1.0 (0x3C00) and the next f16 (0x3C01): ties go to even.
        assert_eq!(f32_to_f16(1.0 + 2f32.powi(-11)), 0x3C00);
        assert_eq!(f32_to_f16(1.0 + 3.0 * 2f32.powi(-11)), 0x3C02);
        assert_eq!(f32_to_f16(1e6), 0x7C00);
        assert_eq!(f32_to_f16(1e-9), 0);
        assert_eq!(f32_to_f16(2f32.powi(-25) * 1.5), 0x0001); // rounds up to the smallest subnormal
    }

    #[test]
    fn bf16_values() {
        assert_eq!(bf16_to_f32(0x3F80), 1.0);
        assert_eq!(bf16_to_f32(0xC040), -3.0);
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core.Tests/PcUndoJournalTests.cs =====
// The PC's side of "Undo this run". Follows server/tests/test_undo.py, which tests the
// Mac's journal the same way.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text.Json;
using Vireo.Core.Api;
using Vireo.Core.Storage;

namespace Vireo.Core.Tests;

internal static class RecycleBinForTests
{
    /// <summary>Files the tests "recycle" are only deleted, so the real Recycle Bin stays as it was.</summary>
    [ModuleInitializer]
    internal static void Install() => RecycleBin.ForTests = path =>
    {
        if (Directory.Exists(path)) Directory.Delete(path, recursive: true);
        else File.Delete(path);
    };
}

public sealed class PcUndoJournalTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempFolder _folder = new();
    private readonly PcUndoJournal _journal;
    private readonly PcTools _tools;

    public PcUndoJournalTests()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_folder.File(@"home\Desktop"));
        _journal = new PcUndoJournal(UndoRoot, "chat-1");
        _tools = new PcTools(_folder.File("home")).ForReply(PcAccess.Home, _journal);
    }

    public void Dispose() => _folder.Dispose();

    private string UndoRoot => _folder.File("undo");
    private string Home(string path) => _folder.File(Path.Combine("home", path));

    private Task<string> Run(string tool, object args) =>
        _tools.RunAsync(tool, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(args));

    private UndoOutcome Undo() => PcUndoJournal.Load(UndoRoot, _journal.RunId)!.Undo();

    [Fact]
    public async Task NothingIsKeptUntilSomethingChanges()
    {
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\a.txt"), "same");
        await Run("read_file", new { path = @"Desktop\a.txt" });
        await Run("write_file", new { path = @"Desktop\a.txt", content = "same" });

        Assert.False(_journal.HasChanges);
        Assert.Null(PcUndoJournal.Load(UndoRoot, _journal.RunId));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task UndoPutsBackOverwrittenMovedAndDeletedFilesAndRecyclesNewOnes()
    {
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\notes.txt"), "before");
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\old.txt"), "keep me");
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\plan.txt"), "plan");

        await Run("write_file", new { path = @"Desktop\notes.txt", content = "after" });
        await Run("write_file", new { path = @"Desktop\new.txt", content = "new" });
        await Run("rename_file", new { path = @"Desktop\plan.txt", new_name = "plan-v2.txt" });
        Assert.StartsWith("File moved to the Recycle Bin", await Run("delete_file", new { path = @"Desktop\old.txt" }));
        await Run("run_shell_command", new { command = "Write-Output hi" });

        var outcome = Undo();

        Assert.True(outcome.Finished);
        Assert.Equal("before", File.ReadAllText(Home(@"Desktop\notes.txt")));
        Assert.False(File.Exists(Home(@"Desktop\new.txt")));
        Assert.Equal("plan", File.ReadAllText(Home(@"Desktop\plan.txt")));
        Assert.False(File.Exists(Home(@"Desktop\plan-v2.txt")));
        Assert.Equal("keep me", File.ReadAllText(Home(@"Desktop\old.txt")));
        Assert.Equal(
            "Undid 4 changes.\nA shell command was also run, which can't be undone:\nWrite-Output hi",
            outcome.Message);
        // Once nothing is left to try, the copies go.
        Assert.False(Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(UndoRoot, _journal.RunId)));
        Assert.Null(PcUndoJournal.Load(UndoRoot, _journal.RunId));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AFileChangedSinceIsLeftAloneUntilItCanBeUndone()
    {
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\notes.txt"), "before");
        await Run("write_file", new { path = @"Desktop\notes.txt", content = "agent" });
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\notes.txt"), "user's own edit");

        var first = Undo();

        Assert.False(first.Finished);
        Assert.Equal("user's own edit", File.ReadAllText(Home(@"Desktop\notes.txt")));
        Assert.Equal(
            "No changes were undone.\nCouldn't undo 1 change:\nnotes.txt: It changed after the agent last touched it, so it was left alone.",
            first.Message);

        // Put back as the agent left it, undo can go ahead.
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\notes.txt"), "agent");
        Assert.True(Undo().Finished);
        Assert.Equal("before", File.ReadAllText(Home(@"Desktop\notes.txt")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ADeletedFileIsNotPutOverSomethingNew()
    {
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\a.txt"), "old");
        await Run("delete_file", new { path = @"Desktop\a.txt" });
        File.WriteAllText(Home(@"Desktop\a.txt"), "new");

        var outcome = Undo();

        Assert.False(outcome.Finished);
        Assert.Contains($"a.txt: Something else is now at {Home(@"Desktop\a.txt")}.", outcome.Message);
        Assert.Equal("new", File.ReadAllText(Home(@"Desktop\a.txt")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OldRunsAreSweptAway()
    {
        string old = Path.Combine(UndoRoot, new string('a', 32));
        string recent = Path.Combine(UndoRoot, new string('b', 32));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(old);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(recent);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(old, "manifest.json"), "{}");
        File.SetLastWriteTimeUtc(Path.Combine(old, "manifest.json"), DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-(PcUndoJournal.KeepDays + 1)));

        PcUndoJournal.Sweep(UndoRoot);

        Assert.False(Directory.Exists(old));
        Assert.True(Directory.Exists(recent));
        Assert.Null(PcUndoJournal.Load(UndoRoot, "../escape"));
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.WinUI/Views/DocumentPreviewPanel.cs =====
// Ported from DocumentPreviewView in Sources/VireoMac/Views/DocumentPreviewView.swift:
// a file beside the chat. Markdown is rendered (or shown as source), code is highlighted,
// PDFs open in WebView2's viewer and images are drawn. Windows has no Quick Look, so Word,
// Excel and PowerPoint files are read here and shown as formatted text, and anything else
// offers its default app.
using System.Text;
using Vireo.Core.Api;
using Vireo.Core.Models;
using Vireo.Core.Office;
using Microsoft.UI.Text;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Input;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media.Imaging;
using Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer;
using Windows.System;

namespace Vireo.WinUI.Views;

internal sealed class DocumentPreviewPanel : Grid
{
    /// <summary>Larger text files are cut here; the full file is a click away in its own app.</summary>
    private const int TextLimit = 1_000_000;

    private readonly PreviewFile _file;
    private readonly Border _content = new();
    private readonly StackPanel _buttons = new() { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 2 };
    private readonly SelectorBar _view = new();
    private string? _localPath;
    private string? _text;

    public event EventHandler? CloseRequested;

    public DocumentPreviewPanel(PreviewFile file)
    {
        _file = file;
        Background = Theme.BgPrimary;
        RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto });
        RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });

        var header = new Grid
        {
            Padding = new Thickness(16, 8, 8, 8),
            ColumnSpacing = 8,
            BorderBrush = Theme.Border,
            BorderThickness = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 1),
        };
        header.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        header.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        header.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        var title = new TextBlock
        {
            Text = file.Name,
            FontSize = 13,
            FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold,
            Foreground = Theme.TextPrimary,
            TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis,
            VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
        };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(title, file.Location);
        header.Children.Add(title);
        if (file.Kind == PreviewKind.Markdown)
        {
            _view.Items.Add(new SelectorBarItem { Text = "Preview", IsSelected = true });
            _view.Items.Add(new SelectorBarItem { Text = "Source" });
            _view.SelectionChanged += (_, _) => ShowContent();
            Grid.SetColumn(_view, 1);
            header.Children.Add(_view);
        }
        Grid.SetColumn(_buttons, 2);
        header.Children.Add(_buttons);
        Children.Add(header);
        SetRow(_content, 1);
        Children.Add(_content);

        // Escape closes the preview, as on the Mac.
        var escape = new KeyboardAccelerator { Key = VirtualKey.Escape };
        escape.Invoked += (_, e) => { e.Handled = true; CloseRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty); };
        KeyboardAccelerators.Add(escape);

        UpdateButtons();
        _content.Child = new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 28, Height = 28 };
        _ = LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            string path;
            if (_file.IsLocal)
            {
                if (!File.Exists(_file.Location))
                {
                    ShowError("It may have been moved or deleted.");
                    return;
                }
                path = _file.Location;
            }
            else
            {
                // On the Mac: downloaded with the pairing token, as attached images are.
                byte[] bytes = await AppServices.Api.FetchFileAsync(_file.Location);
                path = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"VireoPreview-{Guid.NewGuid():N}-{_file.Name}");
                await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(path, bytes);
            }
            if (_file.Kind is PreviewKind.Markdown or PreviewKind.Text)
            {
                await using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
                byte[] buffer = new byte[Math.Min(stream.Length, TextLimit)];
                int read = await stream.ReadAtLeastAsync(buffer, buffer.Length, throwOnEndOfStream: false);
                _text = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(buffer, 0, read);
            }
            else if (_file.Kind == PreviewKind.Office)
            {
                string file = path;
                _text = await Task.Run(() => OfficePreview.Markdown(file));
            }
            _localPath = path;
            UpdateButtons();
            ShowContent();
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or ApiException)
        {
            ShowError(e.Message);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is InvalidDataException or InvalidOperationException
                                      or DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Packaging.OpenXmlPackageException or System.Xml.XmlException)
        {
            ShowError($"It couldn't be read as a {_file.KindLabel} file. Open it in its own app to see it.");
        }
    }

    private void ShowContent()
    {
        if (_localPath is not { } path) return;
        bool source = _view.SelectedItem is { } selected && _view.Items.IndexOf(selected) == 1;
        var rendered = new MarkdownView();
        if (_file.Kind is PreviewKind.Markdown or PreviewKind.Office && !source) rendered.Render(_text ?? "", Theme.TextPrimary);
        _content.Child = _file.Kind switch
        {
            PreviewKind.Markdown when !source => Scrolling(rendered, 20),
            PreviewKind.Markdown => SourceView("markdown"),
            PreviewKind.Text => SourceView(_file.Language),
            // Text wraps to the pane; only a workbook's tables need to scroll sideways.
            PreviewKind.Office when _file.KindLabel == "Excel" => WideScrolling(rendered),
            PreviewKind.Office => Scrolling(rendered, 20),
            PreviewKind.Pdf => PdfView(path),
            PreviewKind.Image => ImageView(path),
            _ => NoPreview(path),
        };
    }

    private ScrollViewer SourceView(string? language)
    {
        var scroller = Scrolling(CodeBlockView.Highlighted(_text ?? "", language, 12), 16);
        scroller.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto;
        scroller.HorizontalScrollMode = ScrollMode.Auto;
        return scroller;
    }

    private static ScrollViewer Scrolling(UIElement content, double padding) =>
        new() { Content = content, Padding = new Thickness(padding) };

    /// <summary>A sheet can be wider than the pane, so it scrolls sideways too.</summary>
    private static ScrollViewer WideScrolling(UIElement content)
    {
        var scroller = Scrolling(content, 20);
        scroller.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto;
        scroller.HorizontalScrollMode = ScrollMode.Auto;
        return scroller;
    }

    /// <summary>WebView2's own PDF viewer: pages, zoom and search, like the Mac's PDFView.</summary>
    private static UIElement PdfView(string path)
    {
        var web = new WebView2();
        _ = ShowPdfAsync(web, path);
        return web;
    }

    private static async Task ShowPdfAsync(WebView2 web, string path)
    {
        try
        {
            string data = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "VireoPrototype", "WebView2");
            var environment = await Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Core.CoreWebView2Environment.CreateWithOptionsAsync(
                null, data, new Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Core.CoreWebView2EnvironmentOptions());
            await web.EnsureCoreWebView2Async(environment);
            web.CoreWebView2.Settings.AreDevToolsEnabled = false;
            web.Source = new Uri(path);
        }
        catch (System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException)
        {
            // WebView2 is missing or failed to start; the default app still opens it.
        }
    }

    private static UIElement ImageView(string path)
    {
        var image = new Image { Source = new BitmapImage(new Uri(path)), Stretch = Stretch.Uniform, Margin = new Thickness(16) };
        return new ScrollViewer
        {
            Content = image,
            ZoomMode = ZoomMode.Enabled,
            HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto,
            HorizontalScrollMode = ScrollMode.Auto,
        };
    }

    private static UIElement NoPreview(string path)
    {
        var open = new Button { Content = "Open with Default App", HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center };
        open.Click += (_, _) => FileCard.OpenWithDefaultApp(path);
        return Message(Glyphs.Document, "No preview for this kind of file", "Open it in its own app to see it.", open);
    }

    private void ShowError(string message) =>
        _content.Child = Message(Glyphs.Warning, "Can't preview this file", message, null);

    private static UIElement Message(string glyph, string title, string detail, UIElement? action)
    {
        var panel = new StackPanel
        {
            Spacing = 8,
            MaxWidth = 280,
            HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center,
            VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
            Children =
            {
                Theme.Icon(glyph, 28, Theme.TextSecondary),
                new TextBlock { Text = title, FontSize = 15, FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold, Foreground = Theme.TextPrimary, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center },
                new TextBlock { Text = detail, FontSize = 12, Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center },
            },
        };
        if (action is not null) panel.Children.Add(action);
        return panel;
    }

    private void UpdateButtons()
    {
        _buttons.Children.Clear();
        if (_text is { } text)
        {
            var copy = HeaderButton(Glyphs.Copy, "Copy contents");
            copy.Click += async (_, _) =>
            {
                var package = new DataPackage();
                package.SetText(text);
                Clipboard.SetContent(package);
                copy.Content = Theme.Icon(Glyphs.Check, 13);
                ToolTipService.SetToolTip(copy, "Copied");
                await Task.Delay(1500);
                copy.Content = Theme.Icon(Glyphs.Copy, 13);
                ToolTipService.SetToolTip(copy, "Copy contents");
            };
            _buttons.Children.Add(copy);
        }
        if (_localPath is { } path)
        {
            var open = HeaderButton(Glyphs.ArrowUpRight, "Open with default app");
            open.Click += (_, _) => FileCard.OpenWithDefaultApp(path);
            _buttons.Children.Add(open);
            if (_file.IsLocal)
            {
                var show = HeaderButton(Glyphs.Folder, "Show in File Explorer");
                show.Click += (_, _) => FileCard.ShowInExplorer(path);
                _buttons.Children.Add(show);
            }
        }
        var close = HeaderButton(Glyphs.Close, "Close preview (Esc)");
        close.Click += (_, _) => CloseRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        _buttons.Children.Add(close);
    }

    private static Button HeaderButton(string glyph, string help)
    {
        var button = new Button
        {
            Content = Theme.Icon(glyph, 13),
            Padding = new Thickness(6),
            Background = new SolidColorBrush(Microsoft.UI.Colors.Transparent),
            BorderThickness = new Thickness(0),
            Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary,
        };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(button, help);
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(button, help);
        return button;
    }
}


===== Mac/App/release/Vireo-Proto.app/Contents/Frameworks/Sparkle.framework/Versions/B/Headers/SUUpdaterDelegate.h =====
//
//  SUUpdaterDelegate.h
//  Sparkle
//
//  Created by Mayur Pawashe on 3/12/16.
//  Copyright  2016 Sparkle Project. All rights reserved.
//

#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>

#if defined(BUILDING_SPARKLE_SOURCES_EXTERNALLY)
// Ignore incorrect warning
#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wquoted-include-in-framework-header"
#import "SUExport.h"
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
#else
#import <Sparkle/SUExport.h>
#endif

@protocol SUVersionComparison, SUVersionDisplay;
@class SUUpdater, SUAppcast, SUAppcastItem;

NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_BEGIN

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SUUpdater Notifications for events that might be interesting to more than just the delegate
// The updater will be the notification object
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
SU_EXPORT extern NSString *const SUUpdaterDidFinishLoadingAppCastNotification;
SU_EXPORT extern NSString *const SUUpdaterDidFindValidUpdateNotification;
SU_EXPORT extern NSString *const SUUpdaterDidNotFindUpdateNotification;
SU_EXPORT extern NSString *const SUUpdaterWillRestartNotification;
#define SUUpdaterWillRelaunchApplicationNotification SUUpdaterWillRestartNotification;
#define SUUpdaterWillInstallUpdateNotification SUUpdaterWillRestartNotification;

// Key for the SUAppcastItem object in the SUUpdaterDidFindValidUpdateNotification userInfo
SU_EXPORT extern NSString *const SUUpdaterAppcastItemNotificationKey;
// Key for the SUAppcast object in the SUUpdaterDidFinishLoadingAppCastNotification userInfo
SU_EXPORT extern NSString *const SUUpdaterAppcastNotificationKey;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
//	SUUpdater Delegate:
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*!
 Provides methods to control the behavior of an SUUpdater object.
 */
__deprecated_msg("Deprecated in Sparkle 2. See SPUUpdaterDelegate instead")
@protocol SUUpdaterDelegate <NSObject>
@optional

/*!
 Returns whether to allow Sparkle to pop up.
 
 For example, this may be used to prevent Sparkle from interrupting a setup assistant.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 */
- (BOOL)updaterMayCheckForUpdates:(SUUpdater *)updater;

/*!
 Returns additional parameters to append to the appcast URL's query string.
 
 This is potentially based on whether or not Sparkle will also be sending along the system profile.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param sendingProfile Whether the system profile will also be sent.
 
 \return An array of dictionaries with keys: "key", "value", "displayKey", "displayValue", the latter two being specifically for display to the user.
 */
- (NSArray<NSDictionary<NSString *, NSString *> *> *)feedParametersForUpdater:(SUUpdater *)updater sendingSystemProfile:(BOOL)sendingProfile;

/*!
 Returns a custom appcast URL.
 
 Override this to dynamically specify the entire URL.
 
 An alternative may be to use SUUpdaterDelegate::feedParametersForUpdater:sendingSystemProfile:
 and let the server handle what kind of feed to provide.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 */
- (nullable NSString *)feedURLStringForUpdater:(SUUpdater *)updater;

/*!
 Returns whether Sparkle should prompt the user about automatic update checks.
 
 Use this to override the default behavior.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 */
- (BOOL)updaterShouldPromptForPermissionToCheckForUpdates:(SUUpdater *)updater;

/*!
 Called after Sparkle has downloaded the appcast from the remote server.
 
 Implement this if you want to do some special handling with the appcast once it finishes loading.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param appcast The appcast that was downloaded from the remote server.
 */
- (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater didFinishLoadingAppcast:(SUAppcast *)appcast;

/*!
 Returns the item in the appcast corresponding to the update that should be installed.
 
 If you're using special logic or extensions in your appcast,
 implement this to use your own logic for finding a valid update, if any,
 in the given appcast.
 
 \param appcast The appcast that was downloaded from the remote server.
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 */
- (nullable SUAppcastItem *)bestValidUpdateInAppcast:(SUAppcast *)appcast forUpdater:(SUUpdater *)updater;

/*!
 Called when a valid update is found by the update driver.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param item The appcast item corresponding to the update that is proposed to be installed.
 */
- (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater didFindValidUpdate:(SUAppcastItem *)item;

/*!
 Called when a valid update is not found.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 */
- (void)updaterDidNotFindUpdate:(SUUpdater *)updater;

/*!
  Called just before the scheduled update driver prompts the user to install an update.

  \param updater The SUUpdater instance.

  \return YES to allow the update prompt to be shown (the default behavior), or NO to suppress it.
  */
 - (BOOL)updaterShouldShowUpdateAlertForScheduledUpdate:(SUUpdater *)updater forItem:(SUAppcastItem *)item;

 /*!
  Called after the user dismisses the update alert.

  \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
  \param permanently YES if the alert will not appear again for this update; NO if it may reappear.
  */
 - (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater didDismissUpdateAlertPermanently:(BOOL)permanently forItem:(SUAppcastItem *)item;

/*!
 Called immediately before downloading the specified update.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param item The appcast item corresponding to the update that is proposed to be downloaded.
 \param request The mutable URL request that will be used to download the update.
 */
- (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater willDownloadUpdate:(SUAppcastItem *)item withRequest:(NSMutableURLRequest *)request;

/*!
 Called immediately after successful download of the specified update.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param item The appcast item corresponding to the update that has been downloaded.
 */
- (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater didDownloadUpdate:(SUAppcastItem *)item;

/*!
 Called after the specified update failed to download.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param item The appcast item corresponding to the update that failed to download.
 \param error The error generated by the failed download.
 */
- (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater failedToDownloadUpdate:(SUAppcastItem *)item error:(NSError *)error;

/*!
 Called when the user clicks the cancel button while and update is being downloaded.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 */
- (void)userDidCancelDownload:(SUUpdater *)updater;

/*!
 Called immediately before extracting the specified downloaded update.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param item The appcast item corresponding to the update that is proposed to be extracted.
 */
- (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater willExtractUpdate:(SUAppcastItem *)item;

/*!
 Called immediately after extracting the specified downloaded update.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param item The appcast item corresponding to the update that has been extracted.
 */
- (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater didExtractUpdate:(SUAppcastItem *)item;

/*!
 Called immediately before installing the specified update.
 
 \param updater The SUUpdater instance.
 \param item The appcast item corresponding to the update that is proposed to be installed.
 */
- (void)updater:(SUUpdater *)updater willInstallUpdate:(SUAppcastItem *)item;
