===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Models/AttachmentRules.cs =====
// The size checks in ChatAreaView.prepareAttachment (Sources/VireoMac/Views/ChatAreaView.swift).
using System.Globalization;

namespace Vireo.Core.Models;

/// <summary>Error: refuse the file. Warning: ask the user before attaching it.</summary>
public sealed record AttachmentCheck(string? Error, string? Warning)
{
    public static readonly AttachmentCheck Fine = new(null, null);
}

public static class AttachmentRules
{
    public static readonly string[] ImageExtensions = [".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".webp"];

    /// <summary>Text files the Mac takes as text: Markdown, notes, data and code. The Mac's
    /// picker allows any plain text, which these stand in for.</summary>
    public static readonly string[] TextExtensions =
    [
        ".txt", ".md", ".markdown", ".csv", ".tsv", ".log", ".json", ".jsonl", ".xml", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".ini",
        ".html", ".css", ".js", ".ts", ".py", ".ps1", ".cs", ".sql", ".sh", ".swift", ".java", ".go", ".rs", ".c", ".cpp", ".h",
    ];

    /// <summary>What the file picker offers.</summary>
    /// <summary>Office files the Mac can't read, so the PC sends their text with them.</summary>
    public static readonly string[] ReadOnPcExtensions = [".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".pptx"];

    public static readonly string[] PickerExtensions = [.. ImageExtensions, ".pdf", ".doc", ".docx", .. ReadOnPcExtensions, .. TextExtensions];

    public static bool IsReadOnPc(string path) =>
        ReadOnPcExtensions.Contains(Path.GetExtension(path), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public static bool IsText(string path) =>
        TextExtensions.Contains(Path.GetExtension(path), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public static bool IsImage(string path) =>
        ImageExtensions.Contains(Path.GetExtension(path), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public static AttachmentCheck Check(string path, long sizeBytes)
    {
        double sizeMB = sizeBytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
        string size = sizeMB.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        bool isPdf = Path.GetExtension(path).Equals(".pdf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        if (isPdf && sizeMB > 25)
        {
            return new($"PDF file is too large ({size}MB). Maximum size is 25MB. Please try a smaller file or split the document.", null);
        }
        if (sizeMB > 30) return new($"File is too large ({size}MB). Maximum upload size is 30MB.", null);
        if (isPdf && sizeMB > 10)
        {
            return new(null, $"This PDF is {size}MB. Large PDFs will be limited to the first 100 pages and 20K characters to prevent GPU memory issues. Continue?");
        }
        if (sizeMB > 5 && !IsImage(path))
        {
            return new(null, $"This file is {size}MB. Large documents may take longer to process. Continue?");
        }
        return AttachmentCheck.Fine;
    }

    /// <summary>"1.2 MB" or "340 KB", as the attachment preview shows it.</summary>
    public static string FormatSize(long bytes) =>
        bytes >= 1_000_000
            ? (bytes / 1_000_000.0).ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " MB"
            : bytes >= 1000 ? $"{bytes / 1000} KB" : $"{bytes} bytes";
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Storage/PromptLibrary.cs =====
// Ported from Sources/VireoMac/Services/PromptLibrary.swift. The user's own
// prompts are kept on the PC, as the Mac keeps its own; skills come from the Mac.
using System.Text.Json;
using Vireo.Core.Api;
using Vireo.Core.Models;

namespace Vireo.Core.Storage;

/// <summary>The user's own slash commands, plus the built-in ones and one per enabled
/// skill. Saved in %LOCALAPPDATA%\VireoPrototype\prompts.json.</summary>
public sealed class PromptLibrary(string file, ChatApiClient? api = null)
{
    public static string DefaultFile => Path.Combine(
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "VireoPrototype", "prompts.json");

    private List<SlashCommand>? _custom;

    public event EventHandler? Changed;

    public IReadOnlyList<SlashCommand> Custom => _custom ??= AtomicFile.ReadJson<List<SlashCommand>>(file, ChatJson.Options) ?? [];

    public IReadOnlyList<SlashCommand> SkillCommands { get; private set; } = [];

    /// <summary>Custom commands first, so one can replace a built-in of the same name.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<SlashCommand> All =>
        Custom.Concat(SlashCommand.BuiltIns).Concat(SkillCommands).DistinctBy(c => c.Name).ToList();

    /// <summary>Adds the command, or replaces the one with its id.</summary>
    public void Save(SlashCommand command)
    {
        var custom = Custom.ToList();
        int index = custom.FindIndex(c => c.Id == command.Id);
        if (index >= 0) custom[index] = command;
        else custom.Add(command);
        Store(custom);
    }

    public void Delete(Guid id) => Store(Custom.Where(c => c.Id != id).ToList());

    /// <summary>A "/skill-name" command for each skill that's on in the Mac's library.</summary>
    public async Task RefreshSkillsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (api is null) return;
        try
        {
            SkillCommands = (await api.FetchSkillNamesAsync(cancellationToken))
                .Select(name => new SlashCommand(SlashCommand.NormalizedName(name), $"Use the {name} skill for this:\n\n{SlashCommand.Placeholder}", SlashCommandKind.Skill))
                .Where(c => c.Name.Length > 0)
                .ToList();
            Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        }
        catch (ApiException)
        {
            // An older Mac, or one that can't be reached: the other commands still work.
        }
    }

    private void Store(List<SlashCommand> custom)
    {
        _custom = custom;
        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(file, JsonSerializer.Serialize(custom, ChatJson.Options));
        Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Tests/VireoMacTests/ToolRunTests.swift =====
import XCTest
@testable import VireoMac

final class ToolRunTests: XCTestCase {
    private func call(_ tool: String, _ detail: String? = nil) -> ToolStep {
        ToolStep(type: "tool_call", tool: tool, detail: detail, result: nil)
    }

    private func result(_ tool: String, _ text: String) -> ToolStep {
        ToolStep(type: "tool_result", tool: tool, detail: nil, result: text)
    }

    func testCallsArePairedWithResultsInOrder() {
        let runs = ToolRun.pair([call("read_file", "/a"), call("read_file", "/b"), result("read_file", "A")])
        XCTAssertEqual(runs.map(\.result), ["A", nil])
    }

    func testAToolWithNoResultIsRunningOnlyWhileTheReplyIs() {
        let run = ToolRun.pair([call("remember")])[0]
        XCTAssertEqual(run.outcome(stillRunning: true), .pending)
        XCTAssertEqual(run.outcome(stillRunning: false), .stopped)
        XCTAssertFalse(ToolRun.Outcome.stopped.isFailure)
    }

    func testAFailedStepIsNotLabelledAsDone() {
        let failed = #"{"ok": false, "error": "validation_error", "message": "missing required argument(s): title"}"#
        let run = ToolRun.pair([call("create_pptx"), result("create_pptx", failed)])[0]
        let outcome = run.outcome(stillRunning: false)
        XCTAssertEqual(outcome, .failure)
        XCTAssertEqual(run.label(for: outcome), "Creating slide deck")
        XCTAssertEqual(outcome.note, "failed")

        let done = ToolRun.pair([call("create_pptx"), result("create_pptx", "Slide deck saved successfully: /tmp/d.pptx")])[0]
        XCTAssertEqual(done.label(for: done.outcome(stillRunning: false)), "Created")
        XCTAssertNil(ToolRun.Outcome.success.note)
    }

    func testWrittenFileComesFromTheResult() {
        let runs = ToolRun.pair([call("write_file", "notes.md"), result("write_file", "File written successfully: /tmp/x/notes.md")])
        XCTAssertEqual(runs.first?.producedFile, URL(fileURLWithPath: "/tmp/x/notes.md"))
    }

    func testExportedDocumentIgnoresTheDownloadLine() {
        let text = #"{"ok": true, "output": "PDF created successfully: /tmp/report.pdf\nDownload: /files/abc"}"#
        let runs = ToolRun.pair([call("create_pdf"), result("create_pdf", text)])
        XCTAssertEqual(runs.first?.producedFile, URL(fileURLWithPath: "/tmp/report.pdf"))
    }

    func testMovedAndRenamedFilesPointAtTheNewLocation() {
        let moved = ToolRun.pair([call("move_file", "/a/x.txt"), result("move_file", "Moved successfully: /a/x.txt -> /b/x.txt")])
        XCTAssertEqual(moved.first?.producedFile, URL(fileURLWithPath: "/b/x.txt"))
        let renamed = ToolRun.pair([call("rename_file", "/a/x.txt"), result("rename_file", "Renamed successfully: x.txt -> y.txt")])
        XCTAssertEqual(renamed.first?.producedFile, URL(fileURLWithPath: "/a/y.txt"))
    }

    func testFailedOrReadOnlyToolsProduceNoFile() {
        let failed = ToolRun.pair([call("write_file"), result("write_file", #"{"ok": false, "message": "Denied"}"#)])
        XCTAssertNil(failed.first?.producedFile)
        let read = ToolRun.pair([call("read_file", "/a"), result("read_file", "contents")])
        XCTAssertNil(read.first?.producedFile)
    }

    func testRetryableFailureIsOnlyRetryingWhileToolsRun() {
        let run = ToolRun(call: call("fetch_url"), result: #"{"ok": false, "retryable": true}"#)
        XCTAssertEqual(run.outcome(stillRunning: true), .retrying)
        XCTAssertEqual(run.outcome(stillRunning: false), .failure)
    }

    func testPreviewKindFollowsTheExtension() {
        XCTAssertEqual(PreviewFile.Kind(fileName: "README.md"), .markdown)
        XCTAssertEqual(PreviewFile.Kind(fileName: "app.py"), .text(language: "py"))
        XCTAssertEqual(PreviewFile.Kind(fileName: "Report.PDF"), .pdf)
        XCTAssertEqual(PreviewFile.Kind(fileName: "letter.docx"), .office(.word))
        XCTAssertEqual(PreviewFile.Kind(fileName: "Sales.XLSX"), .office(.spreadsheet))
        XCTAssertEqual(PreviewFile.Kind(fileName: "deck.pptx"), .office(.slides))
        XCTAssertEqual(PreviewFile.Kind(fileName: "old.doc"), .other)
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.WinUI/Views/MathBlockView.cs =====
// Ported from MathBlockView in Sources/VireoMac/Views/MathView.swift. The Mac
// typesets with SwiftMath; this uses CSharpMath, the .NET port of the same iosMath.
using CSharpMath.SkiaSharp;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media.Imaging;
using SkiaSharp;
using Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer;

namespace Vireo.WinUI.Views;

/// <summary>Display math ($$$$ or \[\]), typeset. If the LaTeX doesn't parse, the source
/// is shown as code so nothing is lost.</summary>
internal sealed class MathBlockView : Grid
{
    private const float FontSize = 17;
    // Drawn at twice the size, so it stays sharp on high-DPI screens.
    private const float PixelScale = 2;

    public MathBlockView(string latex)
    {
        Margin = new Thickness(0, 4, 0, 4);
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(this, latex);
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(this, latex);
        var copy = new MenuFlyoutItem { Text = "Copy LaTeX" };
        copy.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            var package = new DataPackage();
            package.SetText(latex);
            Clipboard.SetContent(package);
        };
        ContextFlyout = new MenuFlyout { Items = { copy } };
        _ = ShowAsync(latex);
    }

    private async Task ShowAsync(string latex)
    {
        if (Render(latex) is { } png)
        {
            using (png)
            {
                var bitmap = new BitmapImage();
                await bitmap.SetSourceAsync(png.AsRandomAccessStream());
                Children.Add(new Image
                {
                    Source = bitmap,
                    Width = bitmap.PixelWidth / PixelScale,
                    Height = bitmap.PixelHeight / PixelScale,
                    Stretch = Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media.Stretch.Uniform,
                    HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center,
                });
            }
            return;
        }
        Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = latex,
            FontFamily = Theme.Monospace,
            FontSize = 14,
            Foreground = Theme.TextSecondary,
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
            IsTextSelectionEnabled = true,
        });
    }

    /// <summary>A PNG of the typeset math, or null if it doesn't parse.</summary>
    private static Stream? Render(string latex)
    {
        try
        {
            var painter = new MathPainter
            {
                LaTeX = latex,
                FontSize = FontSize * PixelScale,
                // The theme's primary text: white at 88%, as on the Mac.
                TextColor = new SKColor(255, 255, 255, 224),
                DisplayErrorInline = false,
            };
            if (painter.ErrorMessage is not null) return null;
            var png = painter.DrawAsStream();
            return png is { Length: > 0 } ? png : null;
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is InvalidOperationException or ArgumentException or NotSupportedException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-engine/src/dylib.rs =====
//! Loads a shared library at runtime and finds functions in it, with the operating
//! system's own calls (`LoadLibraryW` / `GetProcAddress` on Windows, `dlopen` / `dlsym`
//! elsewhere).
//!
//! The engine loads GPU drivers this way, not by linking to them, so it starts on any
//! computer and uses a GPU only if its driver is there.

use std::ffi::{CString, c_void};

pub struct Library {
    handle: *mut c_void,
}

// A loaded library's functions can be called from any thread.
unsafe impl Send for Library {}
unsafe impl Sync for Library {}

impl Library {
    /// Loads the library `name` ("nvcuda.dll", "libcuda.so.1"), or `None` if it isn't
    /// installed.
    pub fn open(name: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        let handle = sys::open(name);
        (!handle.is_null()).then_some(Self { handle })
    }

    /// The function `name`, as a function pointer of type `F`, or `None` if the library
    /// doesn't have it.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// `F` must be a function pointer type matching the function's real signature and
    /// calling convention.
    pub unsafe fn function<F: Copy>(&self, name: &str) -> Option<F> {
        assert_eq!(
            size_of::<F>(),
            size_of::<*mut c_void>(),
            "F must be a function pointer"
        );
        let name = CString::new(name).ok()?;
        let address = sys::symbol(self.handle, &name);
        if address.is_null() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy::<*mut c_void, F>(&address) })
    }
}

impl Drop for Library {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        sys::close(self.handle);
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
mod sys {
    use std::ffi::{CStr, c_void};

    #[link(name = "kernel32")]
    unsafe extern "system" {
        fn LoadLibraryW(name: *const u16) -> *mut c_void;
        fn GetProcAddress(module: *mut c_void, name: *const u8) -> *mut c_void;
        fn FreeLibrary(module: *mut c_void) -> i32;
    }

    pub fn open(name: &str) -> *mut c_void {
        let wide: Vec<u16> = name.encode_utf16().chain([0]).collect();
        unsafe { LoadLibraryW(wide.as_ptr()) }
    }

    pub fn symbol(handle: *mut c_void, name: &CStr) -> *mut c_void {
        unsafe { GetProcAddress(handle, name.as_ptr().cast()) }
    }

    pub fn close(handle: *mut c_void) {
        unsafe { FreeLibrary(handle) };
    }
}

#[cfg(unix)]
mod sys {
    use std::ffi::{CStr, CString, c_char, c_int, c_void};

    const RTLD_NOW: c_int = 2;

    unsafe extern "C" {
        fn dlopen(name: *const c_char, flags: c_int) -> *mut c_void;
        fn dlsym(handle: *mut c_void, name: *const c_char) -> *mut c_void;
        fn dlclose(handle: *mut c_void) -> c_int;
    }

    pub fn open(name: &str) -> *mut c_void {
        match CString::new(name) {
            Ok(name) => unsafe { dlopen(name.as_ptr(), RTLD_NOW) },
            Err(_) => std::ptr::null_mut(),
        }
    }

    pub fn symbol(handle: *mut c_void, name: &CStr) -> *mut c_void {
        unsafe { dlsym(handle, name.as_ptr()) }
    }

    pub fn close(handle: *mut c_void) {
        unsafe { dlclose(handle) };
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn finds_a_system_function() {
        #[cfg(windows)]
        let (lib, function) = ("kernel32.dll", "GetTickCount64");
        #[cfg(unix)]
        let (lib, function) = ("libc.so.6", "getpid");
        let Some(library) = Library::open(lib) else {
            return; // a Unix without glibc
        };
        let f: Option<unsafe extern "system" fn() -> u64> = unsafe { library.function(function) };
        assert!(f.is_some());
        let missing: Option<unsafe extern "system" fn()> =
            unsafe { library.function("NoSuchFunction") };
        assert!(missing.is_none());
        assert!(Library::open("no-such-library-vireo.dll").is_none());
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Models/ChatModels.swift =====
import Foundation

struct ToolStep: Codable, Equatable {
    var type: String // "tool_call" | "tool_result"
    var tool: String
    var detail: String?   // query/path/url/pattern/command extracted from args
    var result: String?

    /// What a call was about, for the one-line step: its path, query or command. A call
    /// that reads several files or works out several figures names them all; those showed
    /// as a bare "read_file" or "calculate" before (2026-11-10).
    static func detail(from args: [String: Any]) -> String? {
        for key in ["query", "path", "template", "source", "url", "pattern", "command", "expression", "name", "title"] {
            if let value = args[key] as? String, !value.isEmpty { return value }
        }
        for key in ["paths", "expressions"] {
            guard let values = args[key] as? [String], !values.isEmpty else { continue }
            let shown = key == "paths" ? values.map { ($0 as NSString).lastPathComponent } : values
            return shown.prefix(4).joined(separator: ", ") + (shown.count > 4 ? " and \(shown.count - 4) more" : "")
        }
        return nil
    }
}

/// One line of the checklist the assistant keeps for a longer job (the server's
/// update_plan). Status is "pending", "in_progress", "done" or "skipped".
struct PlanStep: Codable, Equatable {
    var text: String
    var status: String
}

struct MessageMetadata: Codable, Equatable {
    var tokens: Int?
    var duration: String?
    var tokensPerSecond: String?
}

struct AgentStatus: Equatable {
    let phase: String
    let step: Int
    let maxSteps: Int
}

/// How much of the Mac a chat's replies may reach, picked above the chat box.
/// The server enforces it on every file tool.
enum AgentAccess: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    /// Only the folders chosen in Settings  Chats, and no shell commands.
    case folders
    case home
    case full

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .folders: return "Folders I choose"
        case .home: return "Home folder"
        case .full: return "Full access"
        }
    }

    var summary: String {
        switch self {
        case .folders: return "Only the folders in Settings  Chats. No shell commands."
        case .home: return "Files in your home folder."
        case .full: return "Files anywhere on this Mac."
        }
    }

    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .folders: return "folder"
        case .home: return "house"
        case .full: return "internaldrive"
        }
    }
}

/// "Undo this run" on a reply that changed files.
struct RunUndo: Codable, Equatable {
    var runId: String
    /// What the last attempt did, in the server's words.
    var summary: String?
    /// Nothing is left to try, so the button goes.
    var isFinished = false
}

/// One answer to a message. A regenerated reply keeps the earlier ones.
struct ReplyVersion: Codable, Equatable {
    var content: String
    var toolSteps: [ToolStep] = []
    var metadata: MessageMetadata?
    var isError: Bool = false
    var undo: RunUndo?
    var plan: [PlanStep] = []
    var reasoning: String?
    var record: String?

    init(content: String, toolSteps: [ToolStep] = [], metadata: MessageMetadata? = nil, isError: Bool = false,
         undo: RunUndo? = nil, plan: [PlanStep] = [], reasoning: String? = nil, record: String? = nil) {
        self.content = content
        self.toolSteps = toolSteps
        self.metadata = metadata
        self.isError = isError
        self.undo = undo
        self.plan = plan
        self.reasoning = reasoning
        self.record = record
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey { case content, toolSteps, metadata, isError, undo, plan, reasoning, record }

    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        content = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .content)
        toolSteps = try container.decodeIfPresent([ToolStep].self, forKey: .toolSteps) ?? []
        metadata = try container.decodeIfPresent(MessageMetadata.self, forKey: .metadata)
        isError = try container.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .isError) ?? false
        undo = try container.decodeIfPresent(RunUndo.self, forKey: .undo)
        plan = try container.decodeIfPresent([PlanStep].self, forKey: .plan) ?? []
        reasoning = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .reasoning)
        record = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .record)
    }
}

struct ChatMessage: Identifiable, Codable, Equatable {
    let id: UUID
    var role: String // "user" | "assistant"
    var content: String
    var createdAt: Date
    var isError: Bool = false
    var filePath: String?
    /// The attached document's id in document search, so an edited or
    /// regenerated turn can still search it.
    var docId: String?
    var toolSteps: [ToolStep] = []
    var metadata: MessageMetadata?
    var undo: RunUndo?
    /// The assistant's checklist for this reply, if it kept one.
    var plan: [PlanStep] = []
    /// The model's thinking for this reply, which the server sends apart from the answer
    /// (its `thinking` events): each thought, a blank line between them.
    var reasoning: String?
    /// A thought is being written now. Not saved: a reply that was stopped isn't thinking.
    var isThinking = false
    /// The reply's tool calls and what they returned, as the server wrote them down
    /// (`turn_record`). Sent back with the message on later turns, so the model still has
    /// what an earlier reply read. Not for display.
    var record: String?
    /// Every version of a regenerated reply, including the one shown; empty
    /// until the reply is regenerated. The shown one's fields mirror
    /// versions[versionIndex].
    var versions: [ReplyVersion] = []
    var versionIndex: Int = 0

    init(role: String, content: String, isError: Bool = false, filePath: String? = nil) {
        self.id = UUID()
        self.role = role
        self.content = content
        self.createdAt = Date()
        self.isError = isError
        self.filePath = filePath
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case id, role, content, createdAt, isError, filePath, docId, toolSteps, metadata, undo, plan, versions, versionIndex
        case reasoning, record
    }

    // Only role and content are required. A missing field (from an older or newer
    // version) must not make the whole conversation fail to load.
    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        id = try container.decodeIfPresent(UUID.self, forKey: .id) ?? UUID()
        role = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .role)
        content = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .content)
        createdAt = try container.decodeIfPresent(Date.self, forKey: .createdAt) ?? Date()
        isError = try container.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .isError) ?? false
        filePath = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .filePath)
        toolSteps = try container.decodeIfPresent([ToolStep].self, forKey: .toolSteps) ?? []
        metadata = try container.decodeIfPresent(MessageMetadata.self, forKey: .metadata)
        undo = try container.decodeIfPresent(RunUndo.self, forKey: .undo)
        plan = try container.decodeIfPresent([PlanStep].self, forKey: .plan) ?? []
        docId = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .docId)
        reasoning = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .reasoning)
        record = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .record)
        versions = try container.decodeIfPresent([ReplyVersion].self, forKey: .versions) ?? []
        versionIndex = min(try container.decodeIfPresent(Int.self, forKey: .versionIndex) ?? 0, max(versions.count - 1, 0))
    }

    private var currentVersion: ReplyVersion {
        ReplyVersion(content: content, toolSteps: toolSteps, metadata: metadata, isError: isError, undo: undo, plan: plan,
                     reasoning: reasoning, record: record)
    }

    private mutating func apply(_ version: ReplyVersion) {
        content = version.content
        toolSteps = version.toolSteps
        metadata = version.metadata
        isError = version.isError
        undo = version.undo
        plan = version.plan
        reasoning = version.reasoning
        record = version.record
        isThinking = false
    }

    /// Keeps the shown reply as a version and starts an empty one to stream into.
    mutating func startNewVersion() {
        if versions.isEmpty {
            versions = [currentVersion]
        } else {
            versions[versionIndex] = currentVersion
        }
        versions.append(ReplyVersion(content: ""))
        versionIndex = versions.count - 1
        apply(versions[versionIndex])
    }

    /// Records the shown reply in its version slot, once it has finished.
    mutating func saveCurrentVersion() {
        guard versions.indices.contains(versionIndex) else { return }
        versions[versionIndex] = currentVersion
    }

    mutating func showVersion(_ index: Int) {
        guard versions.indices.contains(index), index != versionIndex else { return }
        versions[versionIndex] = currentVersion
        versionIndex = index
        apply(versions[index])
    }
}

enum ConversationHistory {
    /// The turns to send to the model. A failed or empty reply is dropped together
    /// with the user turn that produced it: the error text ("Connection error: ")
    /// is not something the assistant said, and keeping the user turn alone would
    /// put two user turns in a row, which some chat templates reject.
    static func forModel(_ messages: [ChatMessage]) -> [ChatMessage] {
        var history: [ChatMessage] = []
        for var message in messages {
            // Replies stopped before this was fixed may still hold their unfinished thinking.
            if message.role == "assistant" { message.content = withoutUnfinishedThinking(message.content) }
            let isFailedReply = message.role == "assistant"
                && (message.isError || message.content.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty)
            guard isFailedReply else {
                history.append(noteUndo(in: message))
                continue
            }
            if history.last?.role == "user" {
                history.removeLast()
            }
        }
        return history
    }

    /// A reply's text without thinking that was never finished. A reply stopped while the
    /// model was still thinking ended in an open `<think>` block, which was then saved and
    /// shown as the reply itself: raw thoughts that can repeat the note Vireo adds to a
    /// message and what the user typed, a card number included (2026-11-10). Finished
    /// thinking, with its closing tag, is left as it is.
    static func withoutUnfinishedThinking(_ text: String) -> String {
        guard let open = text.range(of: "<think>", options: .backwards),
              text.range(of: "</think>", range: open.upperBound..<text.endIndex) == nil else { return text }
        return String(text[..<open.lowerBound]).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
    }

    /// The reply still says what it changed, so the model is told what went back.
    private static func noteUndo(in message: ChatMessage) -> ChatMessage {
        guard let summary = message.undo?.summary else { return message }
        var noted = message
        noted.content += "\n\n[The user then pressed Undo on this reply's file changes. \(summary)]"
        return noted
    }
}

struct WorkspaceDocument: Identifiable, Equatable {
    let id: String
    let filePath: String
    let name: String
    let chatId: String
    let chatTitle: String
    let addedAt: Date
}

/// Sampling settings sent with each request. The server clamps every value to
/// the same ranges (GENERATION_LIMITS in api_server.py).
struct GenerationSettings: Codable, Equatable {
    /// Leaves sampling to the server, which uses the loaded model's recommended
    /// settings (server/model_profiles.py). Changing any value below turns it off.
    var followsModel: Bool
    var temperature: Double { didSet { followsModel = false } }
    var topP: Double { didSet { followsModel = false } }
    /// 0 turns top-k off.
    var topK: Int { didSet { followsModel = false } }
    /// 0 turns min-p off.
    var minP: Double { didSet { followsModel = false } }
    /// 1 means no penalty.
    var repetitionPenalty: Double { didSet { followsModel = false } }
    /// nil follows Max Output Tokens in the local server settings.
    var maxTokens: Int?

    /// New chats follow the model's recommended settings. The values are what the
    /// sliders start from if the user changes one.
    static let standard = GenerationSettings(
        followsModel: true, temperature: 0.7, topP: 0.9, topK: 0, minP: 0, repetitionPenalty: 1, maxTokens: nil
    )

    static let temperatureRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 0...2
    static let topPRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 0.01...1
    static let topKRange: ClosedRange<Int> = 0...500
    static let minPRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 0...1
    static let repetitionPenaltyRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 0.5...2
    static let maxTokensRange: ClosedRange<Int> = 16...65536

    /// Body for the "generation" field of a chat request. Settings left at their
    /// "off" value are omitted so the runtime's own default applies.
    var requestPayload: [String: Any] {
        var payload: [String: Any] = [:]
        if let maxTokens { payload["max_tokens"] = maxTokens }
        if followsModel { return payload }
        payload["temperature"] = temperature
        payload["top_p"] = topP
        if topK > 0 { payload["top_k"] = topK }
        if minP > 0 { payload["min_p"] = minP }
        if repetitionPenalty != 1 { payload["repetition_penalty"] = repetitionPenalty }
        return payload
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case followsModel, temperature, topP, topK, minP, repetitionPenalty, maxTokens
    }

    init(followsModel: Bool = false, temperature: Double, topP: Double, topK: Int, minP: Double,
         repetitionPenalty: Double, maxTokens: Int?) {
        self.followsModel = followsModel
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.topP = topP
        self.topK = topK
        self.minP = minP
        self.repetitionPenalty = repetitionPenalty
        self.maxTokens = maxTokens
    }

    // A setting added in a later version falls back to its standard value.
    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        let standard = GenerationSettings.standard
        temperature = try container.decodeIfPresent(Double.self, forKey: .temperature) ?? standard.temperature
        topP = try container.decodeIfPresent(Double.self, forKey: .topP) ?? standard.topP
        topK = try container.decodeIfPresent(Int.self, forKey: .topK) ?? standard.topK
        minP = try container.decodeIfPresent(Double.self, forKey: .minP) ?? standard.minP
        repetitionPenalty = try container.decodeIfPresent(Double.self, forKey: .repetitionPenalty) ?? standard.repetitionPenalty
        maxTokens = try container.decodeIfPresent(Int.self, forKey: .maxTokens)
        // Saved before the setting existed: settings still at the old standard
        // (Balanced) were never chosen, so they follow the model now.
        followsModel = try container.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .followsModel)
            ?? (temperature == 0.7 && topP == 0.9 && topK == 0 && minP == 0 && repetitionPenalty == 1)
    }
}

/// Named starting points for the sampling settings.
enum GenerationPreset: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case recommended
    case balanced
    case precise
    case creative

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .recommended: return "Recommended"
        case .balanced: return "Balanced"
        case .precise: return "Precise"
        case .creative: return "Creative"
        }
    }

    var summary: String {
        switch self {
        case .recommended: return "The settings the model's makers recommend for it. Best for tools."
        case .balanced: return "Good for most chats."
        case .precise: return "Focused and repeatable. Good for code and facts."
        case .creative: return "More varied wording. Good for writing and brainstorming."
        }
    }

    /// Keeps the caller's max tokens: that is about reply length, not style.
    func applied(to settings: GenerationSettings) -> GenerationSettings {
        var result = settings
        switch self {
        case .recommended:
            result.followsModel = true
        case .balanced:
            result.temperature = 0.7; result.topP = 0.9; result.topK = 0; result.minP = 0; result.repetitionPenalty = 1
        case .precise:
            result.temperature = 0.2; result.topP = 0.9; result.topK = 40; result.minP = 0; result.repetitionPenalty = 1
        case .creative:
            result.temperature = 1.0; result.topP = 0.95; result.topK = 0; result.minP = 0.05; result.repetitionPenalty = 1.05
        }
        return result
    }

    /// The preset these settings match, if any.
    static func matching(_ settings: GenerationSettings) -> GenerationPreset? {
        if settings.followsModel { return .recommended }
        return allCases.first { $0 != .recommended && $0.applied(to: settings) == settings }
    }
}

struct Chat: Identifiable, Codable, Equatable {
    let id: String
    var title: String
    var createdAt: Date
    var updatedAt: Date
    var isPinned: Bool
    var isFavorite: Bool
    var tags: [String]
    var collection: String?
    /// Added to the built-in system prompt for this chat. Empty means none.
    var systemPrompt: String
    var generation: GenerationSettings
    /// The model this chat's replies use, loaded first if another one is. Nil
    /// means whichever model is loaded.
    var modelPath: String?
    var access: AgentAccess

    init(id: String, title: String, createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date? = nil,
         isPinned: Bool = false, isFavorite: Bool = false, tags: [String] = [], collection: String? = nil,
         systemPrompt: String = "", generation: GenerationSettings = .standard, modelPath: String? = nil,
         access: AgentAccess = .home) {
        self.id = id
        self.title = title
        self.createdAt = createdAt
        self.updatedAt = updatedAt ?? createdAt
        self.isPinned = isPinned
        self.isFavorite = isFavorite
        self.tags = tags
        self.collection = collection
        self.systemPrompt = systemPrompt
        self.generation = generation
        self.modelPath = modelPath
        self.access = access
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case id, title, createdAt, updatedAt, isPinned, isFavorite, tags, collection, systemPrompt, generation, modelPath, access
    }

    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        let createdAt = try container.decode(Date.self, forKey: .createdAt)
        self.init(
            id: try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .id),
            title: try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .title),
            createdAt: createdAt,
            updatedAt: try container.decodeIfPresent(Date.self, forKey: .updatedAt) ?? createdAt,
            isPinned: try container.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .isPinned) ?? false,
            isFavorite: try container.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .isFavorite) ?? false,
            tags: try container.decodeIfPresent([String].self, forKey: .tags) ?? [],
            collection: try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .collection),
            systemPrompt: try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .systemPrompt) ?? "",
            generation: try container.decodeIfPresent(GenerationSettings.self, forKey: .generation) ?? .standard,
            modelPath: try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .modelPath),
            // Chats from before the access menu reached the home folder.
            access: try container.decodeIfPresent(AgentAccess.self, forKey: .access) ?? .home
        )
    }
}

extension Chat {
    /// Where the chat came from, when it wasn't the main window. Shown in the sidebar.
    var sourceTag: String? {
        tags.first { ["quick ask", "shortcuts", "task"].contains($0) }
    }
}

/// A run of chats under one heading in the sidebar.
struct ChatGroup: Identifiable, Equatable {
    let title: String
    var chats: [Chat]

    var id: String { title }

    /// Keeps the order it's given: pinned chats first, then newest first, so each
    /// heading appears once and moving through the list stays in step with it.
    static func grouping(_ chats: [Chat], now: Date = Date(), calendar: Calendar = .current) -> [ChatGroup] {
        let today = calendar.startOfDay(for: now)
        let weekAgo = calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: -6, to: today) ?? today
        return chats.reduce(into: [ChatGroup]()) { groups, chat in
            let title: String
            if chat.isPinned {
                title = "Pinned"
            } else if chat.updatedAt >= today {
                title = "Today"
            } else if chat.updatedAt >= weekAgo {
                title = "This week"
            } else {
                title = "Older"
            }
            if groups.last?.title == title {
                groups[groups.count - 1].chats.append(chat)
            } else {
                groups.append(ChatGroup(title: title, chats: [chat]))
            }
        }
    }
}

// Transient  not persisted, cleared once approved/rejected.
struct ConfirmRequest: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let tool: String
    let args: [String: String]
    let preview: String?
    /// Set when this kind of action can be always allowed, e.g. "Don't ask again to rename files".
    var rememberLabel: String? = nil
    /// The chat whose reply asked.
    var chatId: String? = nil

    /// Small actions the user can see and put right themselves. They're approved
    /// inside the reply; file changes, deletes, sends and commands keep the sheet.
    private static let inlineTools: Set<String> = [
    ]

    var canApproveInline: Bool { Self.inlineTools.contains(tool) }

    /// The lines the server gave about the action (when, which list), if any.
    var details: [String] {
        (args["details"] ?? "").split(separator: "\n").map(String.init)
    }
}


/// A reply split into the model's reasoning and its answer. Reasoning arrives
/// inline as <think></think> (the server wraps llama.cpp's separate reasoning
/// the same way). Some chat templates open the tag in the prompt, so the reply
/// may carry only the closing tag.
struct ReplyParts: Equatable {
    var reasoning: String?
    var answer: String
    /// The closing tag hasn't arrived yet: the model is still thinking.
    var isThinking = false

    init(reasoning: String? = nil, answer: String, isThinking: Bool = false) {
        self.reasoning = reasoning
        self.answer = answer
        self.isThinking = isThinking
    }

    init(_ content: String) {
        let open = "<think>", close = "</think>"
        let trimmed = content.drop(while: \.isWhitespace)
        if trimmed.hasPrefix(open) {
            let rest = trimmed.dropFirst(open.count)
            if let end = rest.range(of: close) {
                self.init(reasoning: Self.clean(rest[..<end.lowerBound]), answer: Self.clean(rest[end.upperBound...]))
            } else {
                self.init(reasoning: Self.clean(rest), answer: "", isThinking: true)
            }
        } else if let end = content.range(of: close), !content[..<end.lowerBound].contains(open) {
            self.init(reasoning: Self.clean(content[..<end.lowerBound]), answer: Self.clean(content[end.upperBound...]))
        } else {
            self.init(answer: content)
        }
        if reasoning?.isEmpty == true, !isThinking { reasoning = nil }
    }

    private static func clean(_ text: Substring) -> String {
        text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
    }
}

extension ChatMessage {
    /// The reply's reasoning and answer: reasoning the server sent apart (`reasoning`),
    /// then any written inline in the text.
    var parts: ReplyParts {
        guard role == "assistant" else { return ReplyParts(answer: content) }
        var parts = ReplyParts(content)
        let sent = reasoning?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) ?? ""
        if !sent.isEmpty {
            parts.reasoning = [sent, parts.reasoning ?? ""].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: "\n\n")
        }
        if isThinking {
            parts.isThinking = true
            if parts.reasoning == nil { parts.reasoning = "" }
        }
        return parts
    }

    /// A thought's text as it arrives; a new thought starts a new paragraph.
    mutating func addReasoning(_ text: String, startsThought: Bool = false) {
        var all = reasoning ?? ""
        if startsThought, !all.isEmpty, !all.hasSuffix("\n\n") { all += "\n\n" }
        reasoning = all + text
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.WinUI/Views/ChatRow.cs =====
// A chat in the sidebar list. A plain Grid only answers a pointer, so this one also takes
// keyboard focus, opens with Enter or Space, and tells Narrator and other assistive tech it
// is a list item that can be opened and is selected, as the Mac's row Button does.
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.Peers;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.Provider;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Input;
using Windows.System;

namespace Vireo.WinUI.Views;

internal sealed partial class ChatRow : Grid
{
    /// <summary>Clicked, tapped, or opened from the keyboard or by assistive tech.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? Invoked;

    public bool IsSelected { get; init; }

    public ChatRow()
    {
        IsTabStop = true;
        UseSystemFocusVisuals = true;
        KeyDown += (_, e) =>
        {
            // Not when the key is for one of the row's own buttons.
            if (e.Key is VirtualKey.Enter or VirtualKey.Space && ReferenceEquals(e.OriginalSource, this))
            {
                Invoke();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        };
    }

    public void Invoke() => Invoked?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);

    protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer() => new ChatRowPeer(this);

    private sealed partial class ChatRowPeer(ChatRow row) : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer(row), IInvokeProvider, ISelectionItemProvider
    {
        protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore() => AutomationControlType.ListItem;

        protected override string GetClassNameCore() => nameof(ChatRow);

        protected override bool IsKeyboardFocusableCore() => true;

        protected override object? GetPatternCore(PatternInterface patternInterface) =>
            patternInterface is PatternInterface.Invoke or PatternInterface.SelectionItem ? this : base.GetPatternCore(patternInterface);

        public void Invoke() => row.Invoke();

        public bool IsSelected => row.IsSelected;

        public IRawElementProviderSimple? SelectionContainer => null;

        public void Select() => row.Invoke();

        public void AddToSelection() => row.Invoke();

        public void RemoveFromSelection() { }
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Views/PromptLibraryView.swift =====
import SwiftUI

/// Settings  Chats: the slash commands typed at the start of a message.
struct PromptLibraryView: View {
    @ObservedObject private var library = PromptLibrary.shared
    @State private var editing: SlashCommand?

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Text("Prompts").font(.headline)
            Text("Type / at the start of a message to use one. Put {{input}} where what you type after the command should go; without it, your text is added at the end. Every skill that's on also gets a command, like /code-review.")
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)

            ForEach(library.custom) { command in
                row(command, builtIn: false)
            }
            ForEach(SlashCommand.builtIns.filter { builtIn in !library.custom.contains { $0.name == builtIn.name } }) { command in
                row(command, builtIn: true)
            }

            Button("Add Prompt") {
                editing = SlashCommand(name: "", template: "{{input}}")
            }
        }
        .sheet(item: $editing) { command in
            PromptEditor(command: command) { saved in
                if let index = library.custom.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == saved.id }) {
                    library.custom[index] = saved
                } else {
                    library.custom.append(saved)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func row(_ command: SlashCommand, builtIn: Bool) -> some View {
        HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Text("/\(command.name)").font(.body.weight(.medium).monospaced())
                    if builtIn {
                        Text("Built-in")
                            .font(.caption2)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 5)
                            .background(.quaternary, in: Capsule())
                    }
                }
                Text(command.summary).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            Spacer()
            if builtIn {
                // Editing a built-in saves your own copy, which takes its place.
                Button("Customize") {
                    editing = SlashCommand(name: command.name, template: command.template)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.borderless)
            } else {
                Button { editing = command } label: { Image(systemName: "pencil") }
                    .buttonStyle(.borderless)
                    .help("Edit")
                Button { library.custom.removeAll { $0.id == command.id } } label: { Image(systemName: "trash") }
                    .buttonStyle(.borderless)
                    .help("Delete")
            }
        }
    }
}

private struct PromptEditor: View {
    @State var command: SlashCommand
    let onSave: (SlashCommand) -> Void
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    private var name: String { SlashCommand.normalizedName(command.name) }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            Text(command.name.isEmpty ? "New Prompt" : "Edit Prompt").font(.headline)
            TextField("Name, typed after the slash", text: $command.name)
                .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)
            if !name.isEmpty, name != command.name {
                Text("Typed as /\(name)").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            TextEditor(text: $command.template)
                .font(.system(size: 13))
                .frame(minHeight: 140)
                .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6).stroke(AppTheme.border))
            Text("{{input}} is replaced by what you type after the command.")
                .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            HStack {
                Spacer()
                Button("Cancel") { dismiss() }
                    .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)
                Button("Save") {
                    command.name = name
                    command.kind = .custom
                    onSave(command)
                    dismiss()
                }
                .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction)
                .disabled(name.isEmpty || command.template.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty)
            }
        }
        .padding(20)
        .frame(width: 460)
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Engine/ModelDownloads.cs =====
// Downloads GGUF files from Hugging Face into the models folder. Each file downloads to
// name.gguf.part, resumes with an HTTP range request after a pause or a restart of the app,
// and is checked against Hugging Face's SHA-256 before it's renamed into place: a file only
// counts as installed once it matches. Downloads in progress are listed in downloads.json,
// so they come back, paused, the next time the app starts.
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Vireo.Core.Models;
using Vireo.Core.Storage;

namespace Vireo.Core.Engine;

[JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter<DownloadState>))]
public enum DownloadState
{
    Downloading,
    /// <summary>Checking the part already downloaded, before resuming.</summary>
    Preparing,
    Paused,
    /// <summary>Downloaded; comparing its SHA-256 with Hugging Face's.</summary>
    Verifying,
    Failed,
    Completed,
}

public sealed class DownloadItem
{
    public required string Repository { get; init; }
    /// <summary>The file's path in the repository.</summary>
    public required string Path { get; init; }
    public required string Destination { get; init; }
    /// <summary>The size Hugging Face gives; 0 if it gave none.</summary>
    public long Size { get; init; }
    /// <summary>Hugging Face's SHA-256 of the file, in hex; null if it gave none.</summary>
    public string? Sha256 { get; init; }

    public DownloadState State { get; set; } = DownloadState.Paused;
    public string? Error { get; set; }

    [JsonIgnore] public long Received { get; internal set; }
    /// <summary>Bytes a second, averaged over the last few seconds.</summary>
    [JsonIgnore] public double Speed { get; internal set; }
    [JsonIgnore] public string Id => $"{Repository}/{Path}";
    [JsonIgnore] public string FileName => System.IO.Path.GetFileName(Path);
    [JsonIgnore] public string PartFile => Destination + ".part";
    [JsonIgnore] public double Fraction => Size > 0 ? Math.Clamp(Received / (double)Size, 0, 1) : 0;
    [JsonIgnore] public bool IsActive => State is DownloadState.Downloading or DownloadState.Preparing or DownloadState.Verifying;

    [JsonIgnore] internal CancellationTokenSource? Cancel;
    [JsonIgnore] internal bool Discard;

    public TimeSpan? Remaining => Speed > 0 && Size > Received ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds((Size - Received) / Speed) : null;
}

public sealed class ModelDownloads
{
    public static string DefaultStateFile => System.IO.Path.Combine(
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "VireoPrototype", "downloads.json");

    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Options = new(ChatJson.Options) { WriteIndented = true };
    private static readonly TimeSpan ProgressInterval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(250);

    /// <summary>How long a download may receive nothing before it fails (and can be resumed).</summary>
    public TimeSpan IdleTimeout { get; init; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);

    private readonly HttpClient _http;
    private readonly string _modelsRoot;
    private readonly string _stateFile;
    private readonly List<DownloadItem> _items = [];
    private readonly Lock _lock = new();
    private readonly Lock _saveLock = new();

    /// <summary>A download started, moved on, or changed state. Raised on a background thread.</summary>
    public event EventHandler<DownloadItem>? Changed;

    /// <summary>A file was verified and is in the models folder.</summary>
    public event EventHandler<DownloadItem>? Installed;

    public ModelDownloads(HttpClient http, string modelsRoot, string stateFile)
    {
        _http = http;
        _modelsRoot = modelsRoot;
        _stateFile = stateFile;
        Load();
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<DownloadItem> Items
    {
        get { lock (_lock) return _items.ToList(); }
    }

    /// <summary>Where a repository's file goes: Models\publisher\repository\file.gguf.</summary>
    public string DestinationFor(string repository, string path) =>
        System.IO.Path.Combine([_modelsRoot, .. repository.Split('/'), System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path)]);

    public DownloadItem? Find(string repository, string path)
    {
        lock (_lock) return _items.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Repository == repository && i.Path == path);
    }

    /// <summary>Starts (or resumes) downloading a file. Returns its download.</summary>
    public DownloadItem Start(HubFile file)
    {
        DownloadItem item;
        lock (_lock)
        {
            item = _items.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Repository == file.Repository && i.Path == file.Path)
                ?? new DownloadItem
                {
                    Repository = file.Repository,
                    Path = file.Path,
                    Destination = DestinationFor(file.Repository, file.Path),
                    Size = file.Size,
                    Sha256 = file.Sha256,
                };
            if (!_items.Contains(item)) _items.Add(item);
        }
        Resume(item);
        return item;
    }

    public void Resume(DownloadItem item)
    {
        CancellationToken token;
        lock (_lock)
        {
            if (item.IsActive) return;
            item.State = DownloadState.Preparing;
            item.Error = null;
            item.Discard = false;
            item.Cancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
            token = item.Cancel.Token;
        }
        Save();
        Raise(item);
        _ = Task.Run(() => RunAsync(item, token));
    }

    /// <summary>Stops, keeping what's downloaded so far.</summary>
    public void Pause(DownloadItem item)
    {
        lock (_lock) item.Cancel?.Cancel();
    }

    /// <summary>Stops and throws away what's downloaded.</summary>
    public void Cancel(DownloadItem item)
    {
        bool running;
        lock (_lock)
        {
            item.Discard = true;
            running = item.IsActive;
            item.Cancel?.Cancel();
        }
        if (!running) Discard(item);
    }

    /// <summary>Removes a finished or failed download from the list.</summary>
    public void Dismiss(DownloadItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsActive) return;
        if (item.State != DownloadState.Completed) DeletePart(item);
        lock (_lock) _items.Remove(item);
        Save();
        Raise(item);
    }

    /// <summary>Waits for a download to stop running: for tests.</summary>
    internal async Task WaitAsync(DownloadItem item, TimeSpan timeout)
    {
        var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow + timeout;
        while (item.IsActive || item.Cancel is not null)
        {
            if (DateTime.UtcNow > deadline) throw new TimeoutException($"{item.FileName} is still {item.State}.");
            await Task.Delay(10);
        }
    }

    private async Task RunAsync(DownloadItem item, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(item.Destination)!);
            using var hash = IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
            long existing = File.Exists(item.PartFile) ? new FileInfo(item.PartFile).Length : 0;
            if (item.Size > 0 && existing > item.Size)
            {
                File.Delete(item.PartFile);
                existing = 0;
            }
            if (existing > 0) await HashExistingAsync(item, hash, existing, cancel);

            item.Received = existing;
            bool complete = item.Size > 0 && existing == item.Size;
            if (!complete) complete = await DownloadRestAsync(item, hash, existing, cancel);
            if (!complete) throw new IOException("The download ended early. Resume to try again.");

            SetState(item, DownloadState.Verifying);
            string actual = Convert.ToHexStringLower(hash.GetHashAndReset());
            if (item.Sha256 is { Length: > 0 } expected && !string.Equals(actual, expected, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                DeletePart(item);
                item.Received = 0;
                Fail(item, "The downloaded file didn't match Hugging Face's checksum, so it was deleted. Try again.");
                return;
            }
            File.Move(item.PartFile, item.Destination, overwrite: true);
            lock (_lock) item.Cancel = null;
            SetState(item, DownloadState.Completed);
            Installed?.Invoke(this, item);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancel.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            if (item.Discard) Discard(item);
            else
            {
                lock (_lock) item.Cancel = null;
                SetState(item, DownloadState.Paused);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is HttpRequestException or IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or OperationCanceledException)
        {
            Fail(item, e is OperationCanceledException ? "Hugging Face stopped responding. Resume to try again." : Describe(e));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Feeds the part already on disk to the hash, so the whole file is checked.</summary>
    private async Task HashExistingAsync(DownloadItem item, IncrementalHash hash, long length, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        await using var part = new FileStream(item.PartFile, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, 1 << 20, useAsync: true);
        var buffer = new byte[1 << 20];
        long done = 0;
        var last = DateTime.UtcNow;
        while (done < length)
        {
            int read = await part.ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(0, (int)Math.Min(buffer.Length, length - done)), cancel);
            if (read == 0) break;
            hash.AppendData(buffer, 0, read);
            done += read;
            if (DateTime.UtcNow - last > ProgressInterval)
            {
                item.Received = done;
                Raise(item);
                last = DateTime.UtcNow;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <returns>Whether the whole file is now in the part file.</returns>
    private async Task<bool> DownloadRestAsync(DownloadItem item, IncrementalHash hash, long existing, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, HuggingFaceClient.ResolveUrl(item.Repository, item.Path));
        if (existing > 0) request.Headers.Range = new RangeHeaderValue(existing, null);
        using var response = await _http.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, cancel);

        if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable && existing > 0 && item.Size == 0) return true;
        if (response.StatusCode is HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized or HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
        {
            throw new HttpRequestException("Hugging Face asks for an account to download this model (it's gated).");
        }
        response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

        bool append = existing > 0 && response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.PartialContent
            && response.Content.Headers.ContentRange?.From == existing;
        if (!append && existing > 0)
        {
            // The server sent the whole file instead of the rest: start over.
            hash.GetHashAndReset();
            existing = 0;
        }
        item.Received = existing;
        SetState(item, DownloadState.Downloading);

        await using var output = new FileStream(item.PartFile, append ? FileMode.Append : FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.Read, 1 << 20, useAsync: true);
        await using var input = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancel);
        var buffer = new byte[1 << 20];
        var window = new Queue<(DateTime Time, long Bytes)>();
        var last = DateTime.UtcNow;
        using var idle = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancel);
        while (true)
        {
            idle.CancelAfter(IdleTimeout);
            int read = await input.ReadAsync(buffer, idle.Token);
            if (read == 0) break;
            await output.WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(0, read), cancel);
            hash.AppendData(buffer, 0, read);
            item.Received += read;
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            if (now - last > ProgressInterval)
            {
                window.Enqueue((now, item.Received));
                while (window.Count > 1 && now - window.Peek().Time > TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)) window.Dequeue();
                var (startTime, startBytes) = window.Peek();
                double seconds = (now - startTime).TotalSeconds;
                if (seconds > 0.5) item.Speed = (item.Received - startBytes) / seconds;
                Raise(item);
                last = now;
            }
        }
        await output.FlushAsync(cancel);
        return item.Size == 0 || item.Received == item.Size;
    }

    private static string Describe(Exception e) => e switch
    {
        HttpRequestException { StatusCode: HttpStatusCode.NotFound } => "The file is no longer on Hugging Face.",
        HttpRequestException { StatusCode: { } code } => $"Hugging Face answered {(int)code} {code}. Resume to try again.",
        HttpRequestException http => http.Message.StartsWith("Hugging Face", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            ? http.Message
            : "Couldn't reach Hugging Face. Check the internet connection, then resume.",
        IOException { HResult: unchecked((int)0x80070070) } => "The disk is full. Free some space, then resume.",
        _ => e.Message,
    };

    private void Fail(DownloadItem item, string error)
    {
        lock (_lock)
        {
            item.Error = error;
            item.Cancel = null;
        }
        SetState(item, DownloadState.Failed);
    }

    private void Discard(DownloadItem item)
    {
        DeletePart(item);
        lock (_lock)
        {
            item.Cancel = null;
            item.State = DownloadState.Paused;
            item.Received = 0;
            _items.Remove(item);
        }
        Save();
        Raise(item);
    }

    private static void DeletePart(DownloadItem item)
    {
        try { File.Delete(item.PartFile); } catch (IOException) { /* in use; the next download overwrites it */ }
    }

    private void SetState(DownloadItem item, DownloadState state)
    {
        lock (_lock) item.State = state;
        Save();
        Raise(item);
    }

    private void Raise(DownloadItem item) => Changed?.Invoke(this, item);

    private void Load()
    {
        var saved = AtomicFile.ReadJson<List<DownloadItem>>(_stateFile, Options) ?? [];
        foreach (var item in saved)
        {
            if (item.State == DownloadState.Completed) continue;
            // Whatever was running when the app closed waits to be resumed.
            if (item.State != DownloadState.Failed) item.State = DownloadState.Paused;
            item.Received = File.Exists(item.PartFile) ? new FileInfo(item.PartFile).Length : 0;
            _items.Add(item);
        }
    }

    private void Save()
    {
        List<DownloadItem> unfinished;
        lock (_lock) unfinished = _items.Where(i => i.State != DownloadState.Completed).ToList();
        lock (_saveLock) AtomicFile.WriteAllText(_stateFile, JsonSerializer.Serialize(unfinished, Options));
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core.Tests/MarkdownTests.cs =====
using Vireo.Core.Markdown;

namespace Vireo.Core.Tests;

public class MarkdownTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void BlocksAreSplitLikeTheMacs()
    {
        const string reply = """
            # Plan
            First line
            second line

            - one
            * two
            3. three
            ```swift
            let x = 1
            ```
            #hashtag stays text
            """;
        Assert.Equal([
            new HeadingBlock(1, "Plan"),
            new ParagraphBlock("First line\nsecond line"),
            new ListItemBlock("", "one"),
            new ListItemBlock("", "two"),
            new ListItemBlock("3.", "three"),
            new CodeBlock("swift", "let x = 1"),
            new ParagraphBlock("#hashtag stays text"),
        ], MarkdownParser.Parse(reply));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RulesAndChecklistsLikeTheMacs() =>
        Assert.Equal([
            new ParagraphBlock("Above"),
            new RuleBlock(),
            new TaskBlock(false, "Book the room"),
            new TaskBlock(true, "Send the invite"),
            new ListItemBlock("", "[y] not a box"),
            new RuleBlock(),
            new RuleBlock(),
            new ParagraphBlock("**bold** stays text"),
        ], MarkdownParser.Parse("Above\n---\n- [ ] Book the room\n* [X] Send the invite\n- [y] not a box\n* * *\n___\n**bold** stays text"));

    [Fact]
    public void AnUnclosedCodeFenceRunsToTheEndWhileStreaming() =>
        Assert.Equal([new ParagraphBlock("Here:"), new CodeBlock(null, "print(1)\nprint(2")],
            MarkdownParser.Parse("Here:\n```\nprint(1)\nprint(2"));

    [Fact]
    public void CodeKeepsItsIndentation() =>
        Assert.Equal([new CodeBlock("py", "def f():\n    return 1")], MarkdownParser.Parse("```py\r\ndef f():\r\n    return 1\r\n```"));

    [Fact]
    public void BoldItalicCodeAndLinks()
    {
        Assert.Equal([
            new InlineSpan("Use "),
            new InlineSpan("bold", InlineStyle.Bold),
            new InlineSpan(", "),
            new InlineSpan("italic", InlineStyle.Italic),
            new InlineSpan(", "),
            new InlineSpan("x = 1", InlineStyle.Code),
            new InlineSpan(" and "),
            new InlineSpan("the docs", Link: "https://example.com"),
            new InlineSpan("."),
        ], InlineMarkdown.Parse("Use **bold**, *italic*, `x = 1` and [the docs](https://example.com)."));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void StylesNest() =>
        Assert.Equal([new InlineSpan("very ", InlineStyle.Bold), new InlineSpan("important", InlineStyle.Bold | InlineStyle.Italic)],
            InlineMarkdown.Parse("**very _important_**"));

    [Fact]
    public void LooseDelimitersStayAsText()
    {
        Assert.Equal([new InlineSpan("2 * 3 * 4")], InlineMarkdown.Parse("2 * 3 * 4"));
        Assert.Equal([new InlineSpan("snake_case_name")], InlineMarkdown.Parse("snake_case_name"));
        Assert.Equal([new InlineSpan("**not closed")], InlineMarkdown.Parse("**not closed"));
        Assert.Equal([new InlineSpan("[not a link] (x)")], InlineMarkdown.Parse("[not a link] (x)"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CodeSpansIgnoreMarkdownInside() =>
        Assert.Equal([new InlineSpan("**x** and `y`", InlineStyle.Code)], InlineMarkdown.Parse("`` **x** and `y` ``"));

    [Fact]
    public void EscapesAndLineBreaksAreKept()
    {
        Assert.Equal([new InlineSpan("*literal* and C:\\Users")], InlineMarkdown.Parse("\\*literal\\* and C:\\Users"));
        Assert.Equal([new InlineSpan("line one\nline "), new InlineSpan("two", InlineStyle.Strikethrough)],
            InlineMarkdown.Parse("line one\nline ~~two~~"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PipeTablesBecomeTables()
    {
        var blocks = MarkdownParser.Parse("""
            Summary
            | Feature | Stumpjumper | Sentinel |
            | :--- | :---: | ---: |
            | **Best For** | All-day riding | Charging hard |
            | Code | `a|b` | x \| y |
            | Short |
            After
            """);

        Assert.Equal(new ParagraphBlock("Summary"), blocks[0]);
        var table = Assert.IsType<TableBlock>(blocks[1]);
        Assert.Equal(["Feature", "Stumpjumper", "Sentinel"], table.Header);
        Assert.Equal([TableAlignment.Left, TableAlignment.Center, TableAlignment.Right], table.Alignments);
        Assert.Equal(["**Best For**", "All-day riding", "Charging hard"], table.Rows[0]);
        Assert.Equal(["Code", "`a|b`", "x | y"], table.Rows[1]);
        Assert.Equal(["Short", "", ""], table.Rows[2]);
        Assert.Equal(new ParagraphBlock("After"), blocks[2]);
        // Equal by content, so streaming doesn't redraw an unchanged table.
        Assert.Equal(table, MarkdownParser.Parse("| Feature | Stumpjumper | Sentinel |\n|:---|:---:|---:|\n| **Best For** | All-day riding | Charging hard |\n| Code | `a|b` | x \\| y |\n| Short |")[0]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ATableWithoutItsSeparatorYetStaysText()
    {
        // While a reply streams, the separator row may not have arrived yet.
        Assert.Equal([new ParagraphBlock("| Feature | Stumpjumper |")], MarkdownParser.Parse("| Feature | Stumpjumper |"));
        Assert.Equal([new ParagraphBlock("a | b\nnot a separator")], MarkdownParser.Parse("a | b\nnot a separator"));
    }
}

// Ported from Tests/VireoMacTests/SyntaxHighlighterTests.swift.
public class SyntaxHighlighterTests
{
    private static List<(TokenKind Kind, string Text)> Tokens(string code, string language) =>
        SyntaxHighlighter.Tokens(code, SyntaxHighlighter.Spec(language)!).Select(t => (t.Kind, code[t.Start..t.End])).ToList();

    [Fact]
    public void SwiftKeywordsStringsCommentsAndTypes()
    {
        var result = Tokens("let name: String = \"hi\" // greet", "swift");
        Assert.Equal([TokenKind.Keyword, TokenKind.Type, TokenKind.String, TokenKind.Comment], result.Select(t => t.Kind));
        Assert.Equal(["let", "String", "\"hi\"", "// greet"], result.Select(t => t.Text));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PythonTripleQuotesAndHashComments() =>
        Assert.Equal(["def", "\"\"\"Doc\nmore\"\"\"", "return", "42", "# answer"],
            Tokens("def f():\n    \"\"\"Doc\nmore\"\"\"\n    return 42  # answer", "py").Select(t => t.Text));

    [Fact]
    public void EscapedQuotesStayInsideTheString() =>
        Assert.Equal(["const", "\"a \\\"b\\\" c\""], Tokens("const s = \"a \\\"b\\\" c\";", "js").Select(t => t.Text));

    [Fact]
    public void BlockCommentsAndNumbersInsideIdentifiers() =>
        Assert.Equal(["/* note */", "int", "0x1F"], Tokens("/* note */ int x1 = 0x1F;", "c").Select(t => t.Text));

    [Fact]
    public void RangeOperatorIsNotPartOfTheNumber() =>
        Assert.Equal(["for", "in", "0", "10"], Tokens("for i in 0..<10 {}", "swift").Select(t => t.Text));

    [Fact]
    public void SqlIsCaseInsensitive() =>
        Assert.Equal(["SELECT", "FROM", "-- all"], Tokens("SELECT id FROM users -- all", "sql").Select(t => t.Text));

    [Fact]
    public void UnterminatedStringStopsAtEndOfLine() =>
        Assert.Equal(["'open", "2"], Tokens("x = 'open\ny = 2", "python").Select(t => t.Text));

    [Fact]
    public void UnknownOrMissingLanguageIsPlain()
    {
        Assert.Null(SyntaxHighlighter.Spec(null));
        Assert.Null(SyntaxHighlighter.Spec("text"));
        Assert.Equal([new CodeSegment("let x = 1", null)], SyntaxHighlighter.Highlight("let x = 1", null));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HighlightKeepsTheTextAndColorsTokens()
    {
        const string code = "let  = \"\" // ok";
        var segments = SyntaxHighlighter.Highlight(code, "swift");
        Assert.Equal(code, string.Concat(segments.Select(s => s.Text)));
        Assert.True(segments.Count > 1);
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-engine/tests/gpu.rs =====
//! The CUDA kernels against the CPU reference, on real model weights. Skipped (with a
//! note) on a computer without an NVIDIA GPU or without the test model.

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::time::Instant;

use vireo_engine::cpu::{self, Matrix, Pool};
use vireo_engine::cuda::Gpu;
use vireo_engine::models::gemma4_cuda::Gemma4Cuda;
use vireo_engine::models::llama_cuda::LlamaCuda;
use vireo_engine::models::qwen35_cuda::Qwen35Cuda;
use vireo_engine::models::{Logits, Precision};
use vireo_engine::{GgufFile, Tokenizer};

fn open_gpu() -> Option<Gpu> {
    match Gpu::open() {
        Ok(gpu) => Some(gpu),
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("skipped: {e}");
            None
        }
    }
}

fn model(name: &str) -> Option<GgufFile> {
    let path = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
        .join("../../models")
        .join(name);
    if !path.exists() {
        eprintln!("skipped: {name} isn't in VireoPrototype/models");
        return None;
    }
    Some(GgufFile::open(path).unwrap())
}

fn matrix<'a>(file: &'a GgufFile, name: &str) -> Matrix<'a> {
    let t = file.tensor(name).unwrap();
    Matrix {
        kind: t.kind.unwrap(),
        cols: t.dims[0] as usize,
        rows: t.dims[1] as usize,
        data: file.tensor_data(t).unwrap(),
    }
}

/// Each named weight of `file`, multiplied on the GPU and on the CPU: they must agree to
/// f32 rounding. Prints each one's speed.
fn check_matvec(gpu: &Gpu, file: &GgufFile, names: &[&str]) {
    let pool = Pool::with_all_cores();
    for &name in names {
        let w = matrix(file, name);
        // A vector with both signs and a spread of sizes, like real activations.
        let x: Vec<f32> = (0..w.cols)
            .map(|c| ((c * 7919) % 1000) as f32 / 250.0 - 2.0)
            .collect();
        let mut expected = vec![0.0; w.rows];
        cpu::matvec(&pool, &w, &x, &mut expected);

        let weights = gpu.upload_weights(w.kind, w.data, w.rows, w.cols).unwrap();
        let x_gpu = gpu.upload_f32(&x).unwrap();
        let y_gpu = gpu.alloc(w.rows * 4).unwrap();
        let run = || {
            gpu.matvec(
                w.kind,
                weights.ptr(),
                x_gpu.ptr(),
                y_gpu.ptr(),
                w.rows,
                w.cols,
            )
            .unwrap()
        };
        run();
        let mut got = vec![0.0; w.rows];
        y_gpu.read_f32(&mut got).unwrap();

        // The same arithmetic, summed in a different order: equal to f32 rounding.
        let scale = expected.iter().fold(0f32, |m, v| m.max(v.abs()));
        let worst = expected
            .iter()
            .zip(&got)
            .map(|(a, b)| (a - b).abs())
            .fold(0f32, f32::max);
        assert!(
            worst <= scale * 1e-5,
            "{name}: worst difference {worst}, largest value {scale}"
        );

        // Speed: generation reads every weight once per token, so bytes per second is
        // what matters.
        let warm = Instant::now();
        while warm.elapsed().as_millis() < 200 {
            run();
            gpu.synchronize().unwrap();
        }
        let runs = 200;
        let started = Instant::now();
        for _ in 0..runs {
            run();
        }
        gpu.synchronize().unwrap();
        let gpu_time = started.elapsed() / runs;
        eprintln!(
            "{name:28} {:>5} {:>6}x{:<5} worst diff {:.1e} of {:>5.1}  GPU {:>7.1?} ({:>4.0} GB/s)",
            w.kind.name(),
            w.rows,
            w.cols,
            worst,
            scale,
            gpu_time,
            w.data.len() as f64 / gpu_time.as_secs_f64() / 1e9,
        );
    }
}

/// Each named weight times a batch of 100 vectors (not a whole number of the kernels'
/// tiles) on the GPU, against the CPU one vector at a time. Prints the speed.
fn check_matmul(gpu: &Gpu, file: &GgufFile, names: &[&str]) {
    let pool = Pool::with_all_cores();
    let tokens = 100;
    for &name in names {
        let w = matrix(file, name);
        let x: Vec<f32> = (0..w.cols * tokens)
            .map(|c| ((c * 7919) % 1000) as f32 / 250.0 - 2.0)
            .collect();
        let mut expected = vec![0.0; w.rows * tokens];
        for (xt, yt) in x.chunks(w.cols).zip(expected.chunks_mut(w.rows)) {
            cpu::matvec(&pool, &w, xt, yt);
        }
        let weights = gpu.upload_weights(w.kind, w.data, w.rows, w.cols).unwrap();
        let x_gpu = gpu.upload_f32(&x).unwrap();
        let y_gpu = gpu.alloc(w.rows * tokens * 4).unwrap();
        let run = || {
            gpu.matmul(
                w.kind,
                weights.ptr(),
                x_gpu.ptr(),
                y_gpu.ptr(),
                w.rows,
                w.cols,
                tokens,
            )
            .unwrap()
        };
        run();
        let mut got = vec![0.0; w.rows * tokens];
        y_gpu.read_f32(&mut got).unwrap();
        let scale = expected.iter().fold(0f32, |m, v| m.max(v.abs()));
        let worst = expected
            .iter()
            .zip(&got)
            .map(|(a, b)| (a - b).abs())
            .fold(0f32, f32::max);
        assert!(
            worst <= scale * 1e-5,
            "{name}: worst difference {worst}, largest value {scale}"
        );
        // Bring the GPU up to full clocks first: it idles at a fraction of them.
        let warm = Instant::now();
        while warm.elapsed().as_millis() < 300 {
            run();
            gpu.synchronize().unwrap();
        }
        let runs = 20;
        let started = Instant::now();
        for _ in 0..runs {
            run();
        }
        gpu.synchronize().unwrap();
        let time = started.elapsed() / runs;
        let flops = 2.0 * (w.rows * w.cols * tokens) as f64;
        eprintln!(
            "{name:28} {:>5} {:>6}x{:<5} x{tokens} worst diff {:.1e} of {:>5.1}  GPU {:>7.1?} ({:>5.2} TFLOPS)",
            w.kind.name(),
            w.rows,
            w.cols,
            worst,
            scale,
            time,
            flops / time.as_secs_f64() / 1e12,
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn matmul_kernels_match_the_cpu_on_real_weights() {
    let Some(gpu) = open_gpu() else { return };
    if let Some(file) = model("Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf") {
        check_matmul(
            &gpu,
            &file,
            &[
                "blk.0.ffn_gate.weight",
                "blk.0.ffn_down.weight",
                "blk.0.attn_k.weight",
            ],
        );
    }
    if let Some(file) = model("Qwen3.5-0.8B-Q4_K_M.gguf") {
        check_matmul(
            &gpu,
            &file,
            &["blk.0.attn_qkv.weight", "blk.0.ssm_alpha.weight"],
        );
    }
    if let Some(file) = model("gemma-4-E2B_q4_0-it.gguf") {
        check_matmul(
            &gpu,
            &file,
            &["blk.0.ffn_gate.weight", "per_layer_model_proj.weight"],
        );
    }
    // The same Llama weights decoded to f32 first: the arithmetic alone, without decoding.
    if let Some(file) = model("Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-from-Q4_K_M-F32.gguf") {
        check_matmul(&gpu, &file, &["blk.0.ffn_gate.weight"]);
    }
}
