        raise "Cannot find Italic Correction in GlyphInfo"

    glyphs = italic.Coverage.glyphs
    count = italic.ItalicsCorrectionCount
    records = italic.ItalicsCorrection
    italic_dict = {}
    for i in range(count):
        name = glyphs[i]
        record = records[i]
        if record.DeviceTable is not None:
            raise "Don't know how to process device table for italic correction."
        italic_dict[name] = record.Value
    return italic_dict

def get_accent_attachments(math_table):
    glyph_info = math_table.MathGlyphInfo
    if glyph_info is None:
        raise "Cannot find MathGlyphInfo in MATH table."
    attach = glyph_info.MathTopAccentAttachment
    if attach is None:
        raise "Cannot find Top Accent Attachment in GlyphInfo"

    glyphs = attach.TopAccentCoverage.glyphs
    count = attach.TopAccentAttachmentCount
    records = attach.TopAccentAttachment
    attach_dict = {}
    for i in range(count):
        name = glyphs[i]
        record = records[i]
        if record.DeviceTable is not None:
            raise "Don't know how to process device table for accent attachment."
        attach_dict[name] = record.Value
    return attach_dict

def get_v_variants(math_table):
    variants = math_table.MathVariants
    vglyphs = variants.VertGlyphCoverage.glyphs
    vconstruction = variants.VertGlyphConstruction
    count = variants.VertGlyphCount
    variant_dict = {}
    for i in range(count):
        name = vglyphs[i]
        record = vconstruction[i]
        glyph_variants = [x.VariantGlyph for x in
                record.MathGlyphVariantRecord]
        variant_dict[name] = glyph_variants
    return variant_dict

def get_h_variants(math_table):
    variants = math_table.MathVariants
    hglyphs = variants.HorizGlyphCoverage.glyphs
    hconstruction = variants.HorizGlyphConstruction
    count = variants.HorizGlyphCount
    variant_dict = {}
    for i in range(count):
        name = hglyphs[i]
        record = hconstruction[i]
        glyph_variants = [x.VariantGlyph for x in
                record.MathGlyphVariantRecord]
        variant_dict[name] = glyph_variants
    return variant_dict

def get_v_assembly(math_table):
    variants = math_table.MathVariants
    vglyphs = variants.VertGlyphCoverage.glyphs
    vconstruction = variants.VertGlyphConstruction
    count = variants.VertGlyphCount
    assembly_dict = {}
    for i in range(count):
        name = vglyphs[i]
        record = vconstruction[i]
        assembly = record.GlyphAssembly
        if assembly is not None:
            # There is an assembly for this glyph
            italic = assembly.ItalicsCorrection.Value
            parts = [part_dict(part) for part in assembly.PartRecords]
            assembly_dict[name] = { 
                    "italic" : assembly.ItalicsCorrection.Value,
                    "parts" : parts }
    return assembly_dict

def part_dict(part):
    return {
            "glyph": part.glyph,
            "startConnector" : part.StartConnectorLength,
            "endConnector" : part.EndConnectorLength,
            "advance" : part.FullAdvance,
            "extender" : (part.PartFlags == 1) }

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        usage(1)        
    font_file = sys.argv[1]
    plist_file = sys.argv[2]
    process_font(font_file, plist_file)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()


===== Windows/Vireo.Core.Tests/StreamEventParserTests.cs =====
using Vireo.Core.Api;
using Vireo.Core.Models;

namespace Vireo.Core.Tests;

public class StreamEventParserTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void ContentArrivesAsText() =>
        Assert.Equal(new ContentEvent("Hel"), StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"content": "Hel"}"""));

    [Fact]
    public void AReplysToolRecordIsKeptAsWritten()
    {
        Assert.Equal(new TurnRecordEvent("{\"steps\":[]}"),
            StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"type":"turn_record","record":"{\"steps\":[]}"}"""));
        Assert.Null(StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"type":"turn_record","record":""}"""));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnlyDataLinesCount()
    {
        Assert.Null(StreamEventParser.ParseLine(""));
        Assert.Null(StreamEventParser.ParseLine(": keep-alive"));
        Assert.Null(StreamEventParser.ParseLine("data: not json"));
        Assert.IsType<StreamEndEvent>(StreamEventParser.ParseLine("data: [DONE]\r"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AgentStatus()
    {
        Assert.Equal(new AgentStatusEvent(new AgentStatus("executing_tools", 2, 8)),
            StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"type":"agent_status","phase":"executing_tools","step":2,"maxSteps":8}"""));

        // Older Macs still send a plan; the reply doesn't show it any more.
        Assert.Null(StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"type":"agent_plan","currentStep":1,"steps":[{"id":"a","title":"Search"}]}"""));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToolCallsTakeTheirDetailFromTheFirstArgumentPresent()
    {
        var call = Assert.IsType<ToolCallEvent>(StreamEventParser.ParseLine(
            """data: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"fetch_url","args":{"url":"https://example.com","path":"/tmp/x"}}"""));
        Assert.Equal(new ToolStep("tool_call", "fetch_url", "/tmp/x", Args: """{"url":"https://example.com","path":"/tmp/x"}"""), call.Step);

        var noDetail = Assert.IsType<ToolCallEvent>(StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"get_current_datetime","args":{}}"""));
        Assert.Null(noDetail.Step.Detail);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ToolResults() =>
        Assert.Equal(new ToolResultEvent(new ToolStep("tool_result", "search_web", Result: "3 results")),
            StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"type":"tool_result","tool":"search_web","result":"3 results"}"""));

    [Fact]
    public void ConfirmationsKeepTheirArgumentsAsText()
    {
        var confirm = Assert.IsType<ConfirmRequiredEvent>(StreamEventParser.ParseLine(
            """data: {"type":"confirm_required","id":"c1","tool":"write_file","args":{"path":"/a.txt","overwrite":true,"lines":3},"preview":"Write a.txt","rememberLabel":"Don't ask again"}"""));
        Assert.Equal("c1", confirm.Request.Id);
        Assert.Equal("write_file", confirm.Request.Tool);
        Assert.Equal("/a.txt", confirm.Request.Args["path"]);
        Assert.Equal("true", confirm.Request.Args["overwrite"]);
        Assert.Equal("3", confirm.Request.Args["lines"]);
        Assert.Equal("Write a.txt", confirm.Request.Preview);
        Assert.Equal("Don't ask again", confirm.Request.RememberLabel);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AnErrorWinsOverDone() =>
        Assert.Equal(new ErrorEvent("Model crashed"), StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"error":"Model crashed","done":true}"""));

    [Fact]
    public void DoneCarriesTheReplyStatistics() =>
        Assert.Equal(new DoneEvent(new MessageMetadata(42, "1.50", "28.00")),
            StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"done":true,"tokens":42,"duration":"1.50","tokensPerSecond":"28.00"}"""));

    [Fact]
    public void EventsThisAppDoesNotUseAreSkipped() =>
        Assert.Null(StreamEventParser.ParseLine("""data: {"type":"client_tool_request","tool":"run_in_windows_sandbox"}"""));
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Engine/ModelFamilies.cs =====
// The model families Vireo tunes for, with their makers' recommended settings. The values
// follow server/model_profiles.py, which the Mac's server uses; keep the two in step.
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace Vireo.Core.Engine;

public enum ModelFamily
{
    Gemma4,
    Qwen,
    Muse,
    /// <summary>Any other model (Llama, for example).</summary>
    Other,
}

/// <summary>How a family's replies are sampled, and how it thinks.</summary>
public sealed record FamilyBehaviour
{
    public double Temperature { get; init; }
    public double TopP { get; init; }
    /// <summary>0 turns top-k off.</summary>
    public int TopK { get; init; }
    public double MinP { get; init; }
    /// <summary>Taken off the likelihood of every token the reply has already used. Keeps
    /// small thinking models from repeating themselves.</summary>
    public double PresencePenalty { get; init; }
    /// <summary>Whether the model reasons before answering. Families that can't think ignore it.</summary>
    public bool Thinking { get; init; }
    /// <summary>The most tokens one step may spend thinking; null for no cap.</summary>
    public int? ThinkingBudget { get; init; }
}

public sealed record FamilyInfo(
    ModelFamily Family,
    string Key,
    string Title,
    string Source,
    FamilyBehaviour Recommended,
    bool CanThink,
    /// <summary>Muse Glimmer always reasons: "off" is its low strength, and it takes no budget.</summary>
    bool HasThinkingBudget,
    string? ThinkingNote);

public static class ModelFamilies
{
    public static readonly FamilyInfo Gemma4 = new(ModelFamily.Gemma4, "gemma4", "Gemma 4", "Google's recommended settings",
        new FamilyBehaviour { Temperature = 1.0, TopP = 0.95, TopK = 64, MinP = 0, Thinking = true, ThinkingBudget = 2000 },
        CanThink: true, HasThinkingBudget: true, ThinkingNote: null);

    // Qwen 3.5 and later ship temperature 1.0 in generation_config.json, which the Mac's
    // server reads over model_profiles.py's 0.6; a GGUF has no such file, so it's here. Their
    // model cards add a presence penalty of 1.5 for thinking, without which the small ones
    // can circle ("Wait Actually") until the thinking budget runs out.
    public static readonly FamilyInfo Qwen = new(ModelFamily.Qwen, "qwen", "Qwen 3.5  3.8", "Qwen's recommended settings for thinking",
        new FamilyBehaviour { Temperature = 1.0, TopP = 0.95, TopK = 20, MinP = 0, PresencePenalty = 1.5, Thinking = true, ThinkingBudget = 2000 },
        CanThink: true, HasThinkingBudget: true, ThinkingNote: null);

    public static readonly FamilyInfo Muse = new(ModelFamily.Muse, "muse", "Muse Glimmer", "Meta's recommended settings",
        new FamilyBehaviour { Temperature = 1.0, TopP = 0.95, TopK = 64, MinP = 0, Thinking = true, ThinkingBudget = null },
        CanThink: true, HasThinkingBudget: false,
        ThinkingNote: "Muse Glimmer always reasons. On uses its high strength, off its low one.");

    public static readonly FamilyInfo Other = new(ModelFamily.Other, "other", "Other models", "Vireo's defaults",
        new FamilyBehaviour { Temperature = 0.7, TopP = 0.9, TopK = 0, MinP = 0, Thinking = false, ThinkingBudget = null },
        CanThink: false, HasThinkingBudget: false, ThinkingNote: null);

    public static IReadOnlyList<FamilyInfo> All { get; } = [Gemma4, Qwen, Muse, Other];

    public static FamilyInfo Info(ModelFamily family) => All.First(f => f.Family == family);

    private static readonly (Regex Pattern, ModelFamily Family)[] ByArchitecture =
    [
        (new(@"^gemma4"), ModelFamily.Gemma4),
        (new(@"^qwen3"), ModelFamily.Qwen),
        (new(@"^muse[-_]?glimmer"), ModelFamily.Muse),
    ];

    private static readonly (Regex Pattern, ModelFamily Family)[] ByName =
    [
        (new(@"gemma[-_ ]?4", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), ModelFamily.Gemma4),
        (new(@"qwen[-_ ]?3", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), ModelFamily.Qwen),
        (new(@"muse[-_ ]?glimmer", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), ModelFamily.Muse),
    ];

    /// <summary>The family from the GGUF architecture, or else from the name.</summary>
    public static ModelFamily Detect(string? architecture, string? name)
    {
        foreach (var (pattern, family) in ByArchitecture)
        {
            if (architecture is not null && pattern.IsMatch(architecture)) return family;
        }
        foreach (var (pattern, family) in ByName)
        {
            if (name is not null && pattern.IsMatch(name)) return family;
        }
        return ModelFamily.Other;
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Api/AssistantFeed.cs =====
// Ported from Sources/VireoMac/Services/AssistantFeed.swift: follows the Mac's activity log,
// so task results become chats, and what's worth knowing becomes a notification. The Mac
// follows its own log all the time; a PC is off more often, so a long catch-up is one notification.
using System.Text.Json;
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
using Vireo.Core.Models;
using Vireo.Core.Storage;

namespace Vireo.Core.Api;

public sealed partial class AssistantFeed : ObservableObject
{
    public static readonly TimeSpan PollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
    /// <summary>More than this from one check is summed up in a single notification.</summary>
    public const int MaxNotificationsAtOnce = 3;

    public static string DefaultFile => Path.Combine(
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "VireoPrototype", "assistant-feed.json");

    private readonly string _file;
    private readonly ServerConnection _connection;
    private readonly ChatApiClient _api;
    private readonly ChatStore _store;
    private bool _polling;

    /// <summary>Changes background tasks are waiting to make.</summary>
    [ObservableProperty] public partial IReadOnlyList<InboxApproval> Approvals { get; private set; } = [];

    /// <summary>Raised after the check that found it is saved, so it isn't raised twice.</summary>
    public event EventHandler<AssistantNotification>? NotificationReady;

    public AssistantFeed(string file, ServerConnection connection, ChatApiClient api, ChatStore store)
    {
        _file = file;
        _connection = connection;
        _api = api;
        _store = store;
    }

    public async Task PollAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (_polling || _connection.ServerUrl is not { } server) return;
        _polling = true;
        try
        {
            await FollowActivityAsync(server.ToString(), cancellationToken);
            await RefreshApprovalsAsync(cancellationToken);
        }
        finally
        {
            _polling = false;
        }
    }

    public async Task RefreshApprovalsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            Approvals = await _api.FetchInboxApprovalsAsync(cancellationToken);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is ApiException or JsonException)
        {
            // Keep what's known; the connection banner says what's wrong.
        }
    }

    private async Task FollowActivityAsync(string server, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Sequence numbers belong to one Mac, so another Mac starts again.
        var saved = AtomicFile.ReadJson<SavedPosition>(_file, ChatJson.Options);
        int? last = saved?.Server == server ? saved.LastSeq : null;
        ActivityPage page;
        try
        {
            page = await _api.FetchActivityAsync(last ?? 0, cancellationToken);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is ApiException or JsonException)
        {
            return;
        }
        var notifications = new List<AssistantNotification>();
        try
        {
            // On the first run, start from now rather than replaying old activity.
            if (last is { } seen)
            {
                foreach (var entry in page.Entries.Where(e => e.Seq > seen))
                {
                    if (Handle(entry) is { } notification) notifications.Add(notification);
                }
            }
            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(_file, JsonSerializer.Serialize(new SavedPosition(server, page.Latest), ChatJson.Options));
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            // Nothing was saved, so the next check goes over these again; AddTaskResult skips
            // chats that made it, and nothing has been announced yet.
            return;
        }
        foreach (var notification in AtOnce(notifications)) NotificationReady?.Invoke(this, notification);
    }

    /// <summary>The name the server gives the morning briefing's task (BRIEFING_NAME).</summary>
    private const string BriefingTaskName = "Morning briefing";

    private AssistantNotification? Handle(ActivityEntry entry)
    {
        switch (entry.Kind)
        {
            case "task_finished":
                if (entry is { ChatId: { } chatId, Result: { } result })
                {
                    _store.AddTaskResult(chatId, entry.ChatTitle ?? entry.Title, result,
                        entry.TaskName == BriefingTaskName ? [Chat.BriefingTag] : null, entry.UndoRunId);
                }
                return new(entry.Late == true ? $"{entry.Title} (ran late)" : entry.Title, entry.Summary, entry.ChatId, AssistantTab.Activity);
            case "task_failed":
                return new(entry.Title, entry.Summary, Tab: AssistantTab.Activity);
            case "approval_needed":
                string from = entry.TaskName is { } task ? $" ({task})" : "";
                return new($"Waiting for your approval{from}", entry.Body, Tab: AssistantTab.Approvals);
            case "skill_suggested" or "memory_suggested":
                return new(entry.Title, entry.Body, Tab: AssistantTab.Approvals);
            case "approval_failed":
                return new(entry.Title, entry.Body, Tab: AssistantTab.Activity);
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    private static IEnumerable<AssistantNotification> AtOnce(List<AssistantNotification> notifications)
    {
        if (notifications.Count <= MaxNotificationsAtOnce) return notifications;
        var tab = notifications.Any(n => n.Tab == AssistantTab.Approvals) ? AssistantTab.Approvals : AssistantTab.Activity;
        return [new AssistantNotification("While you were away", $"{notifications.Count} updates from Vireo", Tab: tab)];
    }

    private sealed record SavedPosition(string Server, int LastSeq);
}


===== crates/vireo-server/src/attach/markdown.rs =====
//! The Markdown a model writes for a document, split into blocks and styled runs: the
//! same headings, lists, tables, quotes, code and rules as the Windows app's
//! `MarkdownBlocks` (and the Mac's `document_writer.py` before it) make of it, so a Word
//! document built here is laid out as one built there.

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Block {
    Heading { level: usize, text: String },
    Paragraph(String),
    /// A list item: its nesting depth (0 at the top) and, for a numbered one, its number.
    Bullet { depth: usize, text: String },
    Numbered { depth: usize, number: u32, text: String },
    Quote(String),
    Code(String),
    /// A table's rows, its header first, and each column's alignment.
    Table { rows: Vec<Vec<String>>, alignments: Vec<Alignment> },
    Rule,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum Alignment {
    Left,
    Center,
    Right,
}

/// A piece of text and its styles; `link` is the address it links to.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Default)]
pub struct Run {
    pub text: String,
    pub bold: bool,
    pub italic: bool,
    pub code: bool,
    pub link: Option<String>,
}

pub fn parse(content: &str) -> Vec<Block> {
    let content = content.replace("\r\n", "\n");
    let lines: Vec<&str> = content.split('\n').collect();
    let mut blocks = Vec::new();
    // A paragraph's lines so far, as written.
    let mut paragraph: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
    fn flush(paragraph: &mut Vec<&str>, blocks: &mut Vec<Block>) {
        if !paragraph.is_empty() {
            blocks.push(Block::Paragraph(join_lines(paragraph)));
            paragraph.clear();
        }
    }
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < lines.len() {
        let line = lines[i];
        let stripped = line.trim();
        if stripped.starts_with("```") {
            flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
            let mut code = Vec::new();
            i += 1;
            while i < lines.len() && !lines[i].trim().starts_with("```") {
                code.push(lines[i]);
                i += 1;
            }
            blocks.push(Block::Code(code.join("\n")));
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if stripped.is_empty() {
            flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if stripped.contains('|') && i + 1 < lines.len() {
            let header = cells(stripped);
            let separator = cells(lines[i + 1]);
            if separator.len() == header.len() && separator.iter().all(|c| is_separator(c)) {
                flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
                let alignments = separator
                    .iter()
                    .map(|c| {
                        if c.len() > 1 && c.starts_with(':') && c.ends_with(':') {
                            Alignment::Center
                        } else if c.ends_with(':') {
                            Alignment::Right
                        } else {
                            Alignment::Left
                        }
                    })
                    .collect();
                let mut rows = vec![header.clone()];
                i += 2;
                while i < lines.len() && lines[i].contains('|') && !lines[i].trim().is_empty() {
                    let mut row: Vec<String> = cells(lines[i]).into_iter().take(header.len()).collect();
                    row.resize(header.len(), String::new());
                    rows.push(row);
                    i += 1;
                }
                blocks.push(Block::Table { rows, alignments });
                continue;
            }
        }
        if is_rule(stripped) {
            flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
            blocks.push(Block::Rule);
        } else if let Some((level, text)) = heading(stripped) {
            flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
            blocks.push(Block::Heading { level, text });
        } else if let Some((indent, number, text)) = numbered_item(line) {
            flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
            blocks.push(Block::Numbered { depth: depth(indent), number, text });
        } else if let Some((indent, text)) = bullet_item(line) {
            flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
            blocks.push(Block::Bullet { depth: depth(indent), text });
        } else if stripped.starts_with('>') {
            flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
            blocks.push(Block::Quote(stripped.trim_start_matches('>').trim().to_string()));
        } else {
            paragraph.push(line);
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    flush(&mut paragraph, &mut blocks);
    blocks
}

/// A document that opens with a top-level heading uses it as its title, rather than
/// showing the title and then nearly the same heading again.
pub fn split_title(title: &str, mut blocks: Vec<Block>) -> (String, Vec<Block>) {
    let first = blocks.iter().position(|b| *b != Block::Rule);
    if let Some(first) = first
        && let Block::Heading { level: 1, text } = &blocks[first]
    {
        let title = plain(text);
        blocks.drain(..=first);
        return (title, blocks);
    }
    (title.to_string(), blocks)
}

/// A paragraph's lines: wrapped prose is joined with spaces, but a field line ("To: CFO",
/// "**Date:** 4 November"), or a line after a Markdown hard break (two spaces or a
/// backslash at its end), starts a new line, kept as a line break.
fn join_lines(lines: &[&str]) -> String {
    let mut text = String::new();
    for (i, raw) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        let line = raw.trim();
        if i > 0 {
            let previous = lines[i - 1];
            let hard = previous.ends_with("  ") || previous.trim_end().ends_with('\\');
            text.push(if hard || is_field_line(line) { '\n' } else { ' ' });
        }
        text.push_str(match line.strip_suffix('\\') {
            Some(rest) => rest.trim_end(),
            None => line,
        });
    }
    text
}

/// `# Title`, `## Section ##`: one to six #, a space, the text (closing #s left off).
fn heading(stripped: &str) -> Option<(usize, String)> {
    let level = stripped.chars().take_while(|c| *c == '#').count();
    let rest = &stripped[level..];
    if !(1..=6).contains(&level) || !rest.starts_with(char::is_whitespace) {
        return None;
    }
    let text = rest.trim().trim_end_matches('#').trim_end();
    Some((level, text.to_string()))
}

fn indent_of(line: &str) -> (&str, &str) {
    let at = line.len() - line.trim_start().len();
    line.split_at(at)
}

/// `- item`, `* item`, `+ item`, ` item`: the indent before it and its text.
fn bullet_item(line: &str) -> Option<(&str, String)> {
    let (indent, rest) = indent_of(line);
    let mut chars = rest.chars();
    let mark = chars.next()?;
    let after = chars.as_str();
    if !matches!(mark, '-' | '*' | '+' | '') || !after.starts_with(char::is_whitespace) {
        return None;
    }
    Some((indent, after.trim().to_string()))
}

/// `1. item`, `2) item`: the indent, the number and the text.
fn numbered_item(line: &str) -> Option<(&str, u32, String)> {
    let (indent, rest) = indent_of(line);
    let digits = rest.chars().take_while(char::is_ascii_digit).count();
    let after = &rest[digits..];
    if digits == 0 || !(after.starts_with('.') || after.starts_with(')')) {
        return None;
    }
    let text = &after[1..];
    if !text.starts_with(char::is_whitespace) {
        return None;
    }
    Some((indent, rest[..digits].parse().unwrap_or(0), text.trim().to_string()))
}

/// `---`, `* * *`, `___`: three or more of one mark, with only spaces between.
fn is_rule(stripped: &str) -> bool {
    let Some(mark) = stripped.chars().next().filter(|c| matches!(c, '-' | '*' | '_')) else {
        return false;
    };
    stripped.chars().all(|c| c == mark || c.is_whitespace())
        && stripped.chars().filter(|c| *c == mark).count() >= 3
}

/// A line that stands on its own inside a paragraph, as in a memo header or an address
/// block: a short label and a colon ("To:", "**Date:**"), then a space or the line's end.
fn is_field_line(line: &str) -> bool {
    let mut rest = line;
    for mark in ["**", "__"] {
        if let Some(r) = rest.strip_prefix(mark) {
            rest = r;
            break;
        }
    }
    let mut chars = rest.char_indices();
    if !chars.next().is_some_and(|(_, c)| c.is_ascii_alphabetic()) {
        return false;
    }
    let mut label = 0;
    for (i, c) in chars {
        if c == ':' {
            let mut after = &rest[i + 1..];
            for mark in ["**", "__"] {
                if let Some(r) = after.strip_prefix(mark) {
                    after = r;
                    break;
                }
            }
            return after.is_empty() || after.starts_with(char::is_whitespace);
        }
        label += 1;
        let allowed = c.is_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '_' | ' ' | '&' | '/' | '(' | ')' | '.' | '\'' | '-');
        if !allowed || label > 30 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn is_separator(cell: &str) -> bool {
    let dashes = cell.trim_start_matches(':').trim_end_matches(':');
    let colons = cell.len() - dashes.len();
    !dashes.is_empty()
        && dashes.chars().all(|c| c == '-')
        && colons <= 2
        && (colons < 2 || (cell.starts_with(':') && cell.ends_with(':')))
}

/// A table row's cells: split on bars that aren't escaped or in `code`.
fn cells(line: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut row = line.trim();
    row = row.strip_prefix('|').unwrap_or(row);
    if row.ends_with('|') && !row.ends_with("\\|") {
        row = &row[..row.len() - 1];
    }
    let mut cells = Vec::new();
    let mut cell = String::new();
    let mut in_code = false;
    let mut chars = row.chars().peekable();
    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
        if c == '\\' && chars.peek() == Some(&'|') {
            cell.push('|');
            chars.next();
        } else if c == '|' && !in_code {
            cells.push(cell.trim().to_string());
            cell.clear();
        } else {
            if c == '`' {
                in_code = !in_code;
            }
            cell.push(c);
        }
    }
    cells.push(cell.trim().to_string());
    cells
}

fn depth(indent: &str) -> usize {
    (indent.replace('\t', "    ").len() / 2).min(3)
}

/// Text split into runs with their styles: `code`, **bold**, *italic* and [links](to).
pub fn runs(text: &str) -> Vec<Run> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    walk(&text.chars().collect::<Vec<_>>(), &Run::default(), &mut out);
    out
}

/// The text without its marks.
pub fn plain(text: &str) -> String {
    runs(text).into_iter().map(|r| r.text).collect()
}

fn add(piece: &[char], style: &Run, out: &mut Vec<Run>) {
    let mut text = String::with_capacity(piece.len());
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < piece.len() {
        // A backslash before a mark is the mark itself (not in code).
        if !style.code
            && piece[i] == '\\'
            && i + 1 < piece.len()
            && matches!(piece[i + 1], '\\' | '`' | '*' | '_' | '[' | ']' | '#' | '|')
        {
            i += 1;
        }
        text.push(piece[i]);
        i += 1;
    }
    if !text.is_empty() {
        out.push(Run { text, ..style.clone() });
    }
}

fn is_word(c: char) -> bool {
    c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '_'
}

/// The index after a mark that closes at the first `close` from `from`, when everything
/// before it passes `inside` and there's at least one character of it.
fn closing(s: &[char], from: usize, close: &[char], inside: impl Fn(char) -> bool) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut i = from;
    while i < s.len() {
        if s[i..].starts_with(close) {
            return (i > from).then_some(i);
        }
        if !inside(s[i]) {
            return None;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    None
}

fn walk(s: &[char], style: &Run, out: &mut Vec<Run>) {
    let mut done = 0;
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < s.len() {
        let rest = &s[i..];
        // A mark after a backslash is only itself.
        if rest[0] == '\\' && rest.len() > 1 {
            i += 2;
            continue;
        }
        // What starts here, tried in this order: code, bold, italic, a link. Each gives
        // the styled part's start and end and where the scan goes on.
        let found = if rest[0] == '`' {
            closing(s, i + 1, &['`'], |c| c != '`').map(|end| {
                (Run { code: true, ..style.clone() }, i + 1, end, end + 1, false)
            })
        } else if rest.starts_with(&['*', '*']) {
            closing(s, i + 2, &['*', '*'], |c| c != '*')
                .map(|end| (Run { bold: true, ..style.clone() }, i + 2, end, end + 2, true))
        } else if rest.starts_with(&['_', '_']) {
            closing(s, i + 2, &['_', '_'], |c| c != '_')
                .map(|end| (Run { bold: true, ..style.clone() }, i + 2, end, end + 2, true))
        } else {
            None
        };
        let found = found.or_else(|| {
            let first_ok = |mark: char| {
                rest.len() > 1 && rest[1] != mark && !rest[1].is_whitespace()
            };
            if rest[0] == '*' && first_ok('*') {
                closing(s, i + 1, &['*'], |c| c != '*')
                    .map(|end| (Run { italic: true, ..style.clone() }, i + 1, end, end + 1, true))
            } else if rest[0] == '_' && first_ok('_') && (i == 0 || !is_word(s[i - 1])) {
                closing(s, i + 1, &['_'], |c| c != '_')
                    .filter(|end| s.get(end + 1).is_none_or(|c| !is_word(*c)))
                    .map(|end| (Run { italic: true, ..style.clone() }, i + 1, end, end + 1, true))
            } else if rest[0] == '[' {
                // [text](address): no ] in the text, no ) or space in the address.
                closing(s, i + 1, &[']'], |c| c != ']').and_then(|text_end| {
                    if s.get(text_end + 1) != Some(&'(') {
                        return None;
                    }
                    let to = closing(s, text_end + 2, &[')'], |c| c != ')' && !c.is_whitespace())?;
                    let link: String = s[text_end + 2..to].iter().collect();
                    Some((Run { link: Some(link), ..style.clone() }, i + 1, text_end, to + 1, true))
                })
            } else {
                None
            }
        });
        match found {
            Some((inner, start, end, next, nested)) => {
                add(&s[done..i], style, out);
                if nested {
                    walk(&s[start..end], &inner, out);
                } else {
                    add(&s[start..end], &inner, out);
                }
                i = next;
                done = next;
            }
            None => i += 1,
        }
    }
    add(&s[done..], style, out);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn run(text: &str) -> Run {
        Run { text: text.into(), ..Run::default() }
    }

    #[test]
    fn blocks_of_every_kind() {
        let blocks = parse(
            "# Proposal\n\nFirst line\nwrapped on.\n\n## Costs ##\n- one\n  - nested\n1. first\n2) second\n\n> quoted\n\n---\n```\nlet x = 1;\n  y\n```\n| Item | CAD |\n|:--|--:|\n| A \\| B | 12 |\n| short |\nafter",
        );
        assert_eq!(
            blocks,
            vec![
                Block::Heading { level: 1, text: "Proposal".into() },
                Block::Paragraph("First line wrapped on.".into()),
                Block::Heading { level: 2, text: "Costs".into() },
                Block::Bullet { depth: 0, text: "one".into() },
                Block::Bullet { depth: 1, text: "nested".into() },
                Block::Numbered { depth: 0, number: 1, text: "first".into() },
                Block::Numbered { depth: 0, number: 2, text: "second".into() },
                Block::Quote("quoted".into()),
                Block::Rule,
                Block::Code("let x = 1;\n  y".into()),
                Block::Table {
                    rows: vec![
                        vec!["Item".into(), "CAD".into()],
                        vec!["A | B".into(), "12".into()],
                        vec!["short".into(), "".into()],
                    ],
                    alignments: vec![Alignment::Left, Alignment::Right],
                },
                Block::Paragraph("after".into()),
            ]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_memos_fields_keep_their_lines_and_a_first_heading_is_the_title() {
        let blocks = parse("To: Helen Achebe\nFrom: Maya\n**Date:** 12 November\nSee the notes  \nbelow, and\nthe rest.");
        assert_eq!(
            blocks,
            vec![Block::Paragraph(
                "To: Helen Achebe\nFrom: Maya\n**Date:** 12 November See the notes\nbelow, and the rest.".into()
            )]
        );
        let (title, rest) = split_title("Given", parse("---\n# **Real** title\ntext"));
        assert_eq!(title, "Real title");
        assert_eq!(rest, vec![Block::Paragraph("text".into())]);
        let (title, rest) = split_title("Given", parse("## Not a title\ntext"));
        assert_eq!((title.as_str(), rest.len()), ("Given", 2));
        // Not a heading, a list or a rule.
        assert_eq!(parse("#hashtag\n-dash\n--"), vec![Block::Paragraph("#hashtag -dash --".into())]);
        assert_eq!(parse("* * *"), vec![Block::Rule]);
        assert_eq!(parse("* item"), vec![Block::Bullet { depth: 0, text: "item".into() }]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn runs_with_their_styles() {
        assert_eq!(
            runs("Pay **CAD 12,085.35** by *Friday*, see `GL 6410` or [the guide](https://x.test/a)."),
            vec![
                run("Pay "),
                Run { bold: true, ..run("CAD 12,085.35") },
                run(" by "),
                Run { italic: true, ..run("Friday") },
                run(", see "),
                Run { code: true, ..run("GL 6410") },
                run(" or "),
                Run { link: Some("https://x.test/a".into()), ..run("the guide") },
                run("."),
            ]
        );
        // Marks inside bold, underscores inside words, escapes, and marks left open.
        assert_eq!(
            runs("__bold *and* more__ snake_case_name \\*kept\\* 2 * 3 * 4 **open"),
            vec![
                Run { bold: true, ..run("bold ") },
                Run { bold: true, italic: true, ..run("and") },
                Run { bold: true, ..run(" more") },
                run(" snake_case_name *kept* 2 * 3 * 4 **open"),
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(plain("**Total:** `x_y` _done_"), "Total: x_y done");
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Networking/LocalServerManager.swift =====
import AppKit
import Foundation

/// What the engine runs and where: the model, the folder models download to, and the port
/// chats reach it on.
struct LocalServerConfiguration: Codable, Equatable {
    var modelPath: String
    var modelsDirectory: String
    var apiPort: Int

    var activeModelPath: String { modelPath.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) }

    var activeModelName: String {
        activeModelPath.isEmpty ? "" : URL(fileURLWithPath: activeModelPath).lastPathComponent
    }

    init(modelPath: String, modelsDirectory: String, apiPort: Int) {
        self.modelPath = modelPath
        self.modelsDirectory = modelsDirectory
        self.apiPort = apiPort
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case modelPath, modelsDirectory, apiPort
        // Settings saved before the engine: their model is kept.
        case runtimeModelPath, mlxModel
    }

    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        let saved = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .modelPath)
            ?? container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .runtimeModelPath)
            ?? container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .mlxModel)
            ?? ""
        modelPath = saved
        modelsDirectory = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .modelsDirectory) ?? ModelStorage.modelsDirectory.path
        apiPort = try container.decodeIfPresent(Int.self, forKey: .apiPort) ?? 3100
    }

    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try container.encode(modelPath, forKey: .modelPath)
        try container.encode(modelsDirectory, forKey: .modelsDirectory)
        try container.encode(apiPort, forKey: .apiPort)
    }

    static var `default`: LocalServerConfiguration {
        LocalServerConfiguration(modelPath: "", modelsDirectory: ModelStorage.modelsDirectory.path, apiPort: 3100)
    }
}

struct LocalModel: Identifiable, Hashable {
    let path: String
    let name: String
    let sizeBytes: Int64
    /// A GGUF file's architecture (`general.architecture`); nil when it can't be read.
    var modelType: String? = nil
    /// Found in a folder the user added, rather than downloaded by the app.
    var isExternal = false
    var format: ModelFormat = .gguf

    var id: String { path }
}

enum LocalServerStatus: String {
    case stopped
    case starting
    case running
    case stopping
    case error

    var label: String {
        rawValue.capitalized
    }
}

struct LocalServiceState {
    var status: LocalServerStatus = .stopped
    var pid: Int32?
    var logLines: [String] = []
}

/// Starts and stops Vireo's engine (`vireo-server`, `LocalEngine.swift`) with the chosen
/// model. It runs the model on the GPU and serves the chat API, on the API port, with the
/// app's token; it stops when the app closes its standard input, which the app holds open.
@MainActor
final class LocalServerManager: ObservableObject {
    struct StartupPreflight {
        struct Result {
            let errors: [String]
            let warnings: [String]

            var isReady: Bool { errors.isEmpty }
        }

        static func evaluate(configuration: LocalServerConfiguration,
                             engineServer: URL? = LocalServerManager.engineServerURL) -> Result {
            var errors: [String] = []
            let modelPath = configuration.activeModelPath
            if modelPath.isEmpty {
                errors.append("Choose an installed model before starting the local server.")
            } else if !LocalServerManager.isGGUF(modelPath) {
                errors.append("Vireo's engine runs GGUF models. Open Model Manager and choose one.")
            } else if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: modelPath) {
                errors.append("The selected model file is missing. Open Model Manager and choose an installed model.")
            }
            if engineServer == nil {
                errors.append("This build doesn't include Vireo's engine (vireo-server). Build the app with build-test-app.sh.")
            }
            return Result(errors: errors, warnings: [])
        }
    }

    static let shared = LocalServerManager()

    @Published private(set) var engine = LocalServiceState()
    @Published private(set) var configuration: LocalServerConfiguration
    @Published private(set) var startupMessage = ""
    /// The settings the running engine was started with, so Settings can say when a saved
    /// change waits for a restart.
    @Published private(set) var startedConfiguration: LocalServerConfiguration?

    private var process: Process?
    private var input: Pipe?
    private var healthTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    private let configurationKey = "invurse_local_server_configuration"
    /// The PID of the engine this app launched, so one left behind by a crash or force quit
    /// can be shut down on the next launch instead of holding the port and the model's memory.
    private let managedPIDKey = "vireo_engine_pid"

    private init() {
        if let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: configurationKey),
           let decoded = try? JSONDecoder().decode(LocalServerConfiguration.self, from: data) {
            configuration = decoded
        } else {
            configuration = .default
        }
        Task { [weak self] in await self?.terminateOrphanedEngine() }
    }

    var overallStatus: LocalServerStatus { engine.status }

    var isRunning: Bool { overallStatus == .running }

    /// Saved settings differ from the ones the running engine started with.
    var needsRestart: Bool {
        guard isRunning, let startedConfiguration else { return false }
        return startedConfiguration != configuration
    }

    /// Whether the configured model can be started.
    var hasUsableModel: Bool {
        let path = configuration.activeModelPath
        return Self.isGGUF(path) && FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: path)
    }

    var inferenceServiceLabel: String { "Vireo Engine" }

    var inferenceStatusDetail: String {
        "Vireo's engine (vireo-server) runs this model on the GPU and serves chats on port \(configuration.apiPort)."
    }

    // MARK: - Starting and stopping

    func startAll() {
        Task { @MainActor in
            guard canStart(engine.status) else { return }
            let preflight = StartupPreflight.evaluate(configuration: configuration)
            guard preflight.isReady, let server = Self.engineServerURL else {
                startupMessage = preflight.errors.joined(separator: " ")
                setStatus(.error)
                return
            }
            startupMessage = ""
            startedConfiguration = configuration
            // Settings saved before the URL followed the port may still disagree.
            ServerConfig.baseURL = ServerConfig.url(ServerConfig.baseURL, followingAPIPort: configuration.apiPort)
            await terminateOrphanedEngine()
            start(server)
        }
    }

    func stopAll() {
        healthTask?.cancel()
        healthTask = nil
        guard let process, process.isRunning else {
            setStatus(.stopped)
            return
        }
        setStatus(.stopping)
        appendLog("[manager] Asking the engine to stop...")
        // Closing its input asks it to end: it saves the chat in use first, so the chat
        // reopens at once. If that takes too long, it's ended anyway.
        try? input?.fileHandleForWriting.close()
        input = nil
        Task { @MainActor [weak process] in
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(5))
            if let process, process.isRunning { process.terminate() }
        }
    }

    /// Stops the engine and waits for it to exit, killing it if it's still running after
    /// `timeout`. Used on quit, so a relaunch doesn't find the old one holding its port and
    /// the model's memory.
    func stopAllAndWait(timeout: TimeInterval = 7) async {
        stopAll()
        let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(timeout)
        while process?.isRunning == true, Date() < deadline {
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(100))
        }
        if let process, process.isRunning { kill(process.processIdentifier, SIGKILL) }
    }

    func restartAll() {
        stopAll()
        Task { @MainActor in
            // Start is skipped while the engine is still stopping, so wait for it to exit.
            let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(10)
            while engine.status == .stopping, Date() < deadline {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(200))
            }
            startAll()
        }
    }

    func clearLogs() {
        engine.logLines = []
    }

    private func start(_ server: URL) {
        setStatus(.starting)
        let process = Process()
        process.executableURL = server
        process.arguments = Self.engineServerArguments(
            modelPath: configuration.activeModelPath, port: configuration.apiPort, token: ServerConfig.engineToken)
        process.currentDirectoryURL = server.deletingLastPathComponent()
        let input = Pipe()
        let output = Pipe()
        process.standardInput = input
        process.standardOutput = output
        process.standardError = output
        output.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = { [weak self] handle in
            let data = handle.availableData
            guard !data.isEmpty else {
                // EOF: stop the handler, or it keeps firing with empty reads.
                handle.readabilityHandler = nil
                return
            }
            let text = String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self)
            Task { @MainActor in self?.appendLog(text) }
        }
        process.terminationHandler = { [weak self] terminated in
            Task { @MainActor in
                guard let self else { return }
                if UserDefaults.standard.integer(forKey: self.managedPIDKey) == Int(terminated.processIdentifier) {
                    UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: self.managedPIDKey)
                }
                // A late exit from an earlier process must not clobber its replacement.
                guard self.process === terminated else { return }
                self.process = nil
                self.input = nil
                self.healthTask?.cancel()
                self.healthTask = nil
                let failed = terminated.terminationStatus != 0 && terminated.terminationReason != .uncaughtSignal
                if failed {
                    // The engine's last words say why: a model it can't read, a port in use.
                    let last = self.engine.logLines.last { !$0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty }
                    self.startupMessage = last.map { "Vireo's engine stopped: \($0)" } ?? "Vireo's engine stopped."
                }
                self.setStatus(failed ? .error : .stopped)
            }
        }
        do {
            try process.run()
            self.process = process
            self.input = input
            engine.pid = process.processIdentifier
            UserDefaults.standard.set(Int(process.processIdentifier), forKey: managedPIDKey)
            appendLog("[manager] Started: \(server.path) \(configuration.activeModelName) on port \(configuration.apiPort)")
        } catch {
            appendLog("[manager] Failed to start: \(error.localizedDescription)")
            startupMessage = "Couldn't start Vireo's engine: \(error.localizedDescription)"
            setStatus(.error)
            return
        }
        // A large model takes a while to read in before the engine listens.
        pollHealth(URL(string: "http://localhost:\(configuration.apiPort)/api/metrics")!, timeout: 300)
    }

    // MARK: - Models

    func saveConfiguration(_ newConfiguration: LocalServerConfiguration) -> LocalServerConfiguration {
        configuration = newConfiguration
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(newConfiguration) {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: configurationKey)
        }
        return newConfiguration
    }

    func useModel(at path: String) {
        var updated = configuration
        updated.modelPath = path
        _ = saveConfiguration(updated)
    }

    /// Makes `path` the active model and loads it. The engine holds one model at a time,
    /// so a running one is restarted; a stopped one is started.
    func switchModel(to path: String) {
        guard path != configuration.activeModelPath || !isRunning else { return }
        useModel(at: path)
        if overallStatus == .stopped {
            startAll()
        } else {
            restartAll()
        }
    }

    nonisolated static func isGGUF(_ path: String) -> Bool {
        URL(fileURLWithPath: path).pathExtension.lowercased() == "gguf"
    }

    // MARK: - An engine left behind

    /// Shuts down an engine a previous run of the app launched and left behind (after a
    /// crash or force quit). The recorded PID is only signalled if that process has been
    /// orphaned (its parent is launchd) and is still `vireo-server`, so a reused PID or an
    /// engine owned by another running copy of the app is left alone.
    private func terminateOrphanedEngine() async {
        let pid = Int32(UserDefaults.standard.integer(forKey: managedPIDKey))
        guard pid > 0, process?.processIdentifier != pid else { return }
        if let info = await Self.processInfo(pid: pid), info.parentPID == 1, info.command.contains(Self.engineProgram) {
            appendLog("[manager] Stopping an engine left running by a previous session (pid \(pid)).")
            await Self.terminate(pid: pid)
        }
        UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: managedPIDKey)
    }

    private nonisolated static func processInfo(pid: Int32) async -> (parentPID: Int32, command: String)? {
        guard pid > 0, kill(pid, 0) == 0 else { return nil }
        return await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
            DispatchQueue.global(qos: .utility).async {
                let process = Process()
                let output = Pipe()
                process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/bin/ps")
                process.arguments = ["-o", "ppid=,command=", "-p", "\(pid)"]
                process.standardOutput = output
                process.standardError = FileHandle.nullDevice
                guard (try? process.run()) != nil else { return continuation.resume(returning: nil) }
                let data = output.fileHandleForReading.readDataToEndOfFile()
                process.waitUntilExit()
                let line = String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
                guard process.terminationStatus == 0, let space = line.firstIndex(of: " "),
                      let parentPID = Int32(line[..<space]) else { return continuation.resume(returning: nil) }
                continuation.resume(returning: (parentPID, String(line[space...])))
            }
        }
    }

    /// SIGTERM, then SIGKILL if the process is still alive after five seconds.
    private nonisolated static func terminate(pid: Int32) async {
        kill(pid, SIGTERM)
        for _ in 0..<25 {
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(200))
            if kill(pid, 0) != 0 { return }
        }
        kill(pid, SIGKILL)
    }

    // MARK: - Health

    private func pollHealth(_ url: URL, timeout: TimeInterval) {
        healthTask?.cancel()
        healthTask = Task { [weak self] in
            let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(timeout)
            while !Task.isCancelled, Date() < deadline {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                if await Self.isHealthy(url) {
                    self?.setStatus(.running)
                    return
                }
            }
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            self?.appendLog("[manager] The engine didn't answer in time.")
            self?.stopAll()
        }
    }

    /// The engine wants the app's token on every request.
    private nonisolated static func isHealthy(_ url: URL) async -> Bool {
        var request = URLRequest(url: url)
        request.setValue("Bearer \(ServerConfig.engineToken)", forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
        guard let (_, response) = try? await URLSession.shared.data(for: request),
              let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse else { return false }
        return isHealthyStatus(http.statusCode)
    }

    nonisolated static func isHealthyStatus(_ statusCode: Int) -> Bool {
        (200..<300).contains(statusCode)
    }

    // MARK: - State

    private func canStart(_ status: LocalServerStatus) -> Bool {
        status == .stopped || status == .error
    }

    private func setStatus(_ status: LocalServerStatus) {
        engine.status = status
        if status == .stopped || status == .error { engine.pid = nil }
    }

    private func appendLog(_ text: String) {
        let lines = text.split(whereSeparator: \.isNewline).map(String.init)
        engine.logLines.append(contentsOf: lines)
        engine.logLines = Array(engine.logLines.suffix(500))
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Api/PcTools.Projects.cs =====
// Git, project commands and the shell, run on the PC for a Windows client. Ported from
// server/api_server.py: _tool_git_status, _tool_git_diff, _detect_project_capabilities,
// _project_command, _tool_run_project_command and _run_shell_command, with the same
// results. Xcode and Swift become .NET, the Windows platform's own; the shell is
// PowerShell, as server/platform_support.py uses on Windows. The server blocks risky
// commands and asks before every shell command; this only runs them.
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using Vireo.Core.Models;

namespace Vireo.Core.Api;

/// <summary>A tool that ran but failed; the message is for the model.</summary>
public sealed class PcToolException(string message) : Exception(message);

public sealed partial class PcTools
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan GitTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
    private static readonly TimeSpan ProjectTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120);
    private static readonly TimeSpan ShellTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
    private const int MaxProjectOutput = 20_000;

    // Git

    private async Task<string> GitStatusAsync(string path, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        string root = await GitRootAsync(ProjectFolder(path), cancellationToken);
        var (exitCode, output) = await RunAsync(Git(), ["-C", root, "status", "--short"], root, GitTimeout, cancellationToken);
        return JsonSerializer.Serialize(new Dictionary<string, object>
        {
            ["ok"] = exitCode == 0,
            ["path"] = root,
            ["status"] = output.Trim() is { Length: > 0 } status ? status : "clean",
        });
    }

    private async Task<string> GitDiffAsync(string path, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        string full = Resolve(path);
        string root = await GitRootAsync(Directory.Exists(full) ? full : Path.GetDirectoryName(full)!, cancellationToken);
        var (exitCode, output) = await RunAsync(Git(), ["-C", root, "diff", "--", Path.GetRelativePath(root, full)], root, GitTimeout, cancellationToken);
        if (exitCode != 0) throw new PcToolException(output.Trim() is { Length: > 0 } error ? error : "Git diff failed");
        return output.Length > 0 ? output : $"No tracked Git diff for {full}";
    }

    private async Task<string> GitRootAsync(string folder, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var (exitCode, output) = await RunAsync(Git(), ["-C", folder, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], folder, GitTimeout, cancellationToken);
        if (exitCode != 0) throw new PcToolException($"No Git repository found for {folder}");
        // Git answers with forward slashes ("C:/Users/"). A repository that starts above
        // the folders this chat may reach would show files outside them.
        return Resolve(Path.GetFullPath(output.Trim()));
    }

    private static string Git() =>
        FindOnPath("git") ?? throw new PcToolException("Git isn't installed on this PC. It's available from git-scm.com.");

    // Projects

    private string ProjectFolder(string path)
    {
        string full = Resolve(path);
        if (File.Exists(full)) full = Path.GetDirectoryName(full)!;
        if (!Directory.Exists(full)) throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Project directory not found: {full}");
        return full;
    }

    /// <summary>What kind of project a folder is, from its files (the server's _detect_project_capabilities).</summary>
    public static IReadOnlySet<string> ProjectTypes(string folder)
    {
        var types = new HashSet<string>();
        bool Has(string pattern) => Directory.EnumerateFiles(folder, pattern).Any();
        if (Has("*.sln") || Has("*.slnx") || Has("*.csproj") || Has("*.fsproj")) types.Add("dotnet");
        if (Has("pyproject.toml") || Has("pytest.ini") || Has("requirements.txt")) types.Add("python");
        if (Has("package.json")) types.Add("node");
        if (Has("Makefile") || Has("makefile")) types.Add("make");
        return types;
    }

    /// <summary>The command for tests, build or linter, as file name and arguments (the server's _project_command).</summary>
    public static (string Program, string[] Arguments) ProjectCommand(string folder, string action)
    {
        var types = ProjectTypes(folder);
        (string, string[])? command = action switch
        {
            "tests" when types.Contains("dotnet") => ("dotnet", ["test"]),
            "tests" when types.Contains("python") => ("python", ["-m", "pytest"]),
            "tests" when types.Contains("node") => ("npm", ["test"]),
            "tests" when types.Contains("make") => ("make", ["test"]),
            "build" when types.Contains("dotnet") => ("dotnet", ["build"]),
            "build" when types.Contains("node") => ("npm", ["run", "build"]),
            "build" when types.Contains("make") => ("make", []),
            "linter" when types.Contains("dotnet") => ("dotnet", ["format", "--verify-no-changes"]),
            "linter" when types.Contains("python") => ("ruff", ["check", "."]),
            "linter" when types.Contains("node") => ("npm", ["run", "lint"]),
            "linter" when types.Contains("make") => ("make", ["lint"]),
            _ => null,
        };
        return command ?? throw new PcToolException($"Could not identify a supported {action} command in {folder}");
    }

    private async Task<string> RunProjectCommandAsync(string path, string action, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        string folder = ProjectFolder(path);
        var (program, arguments) = ProjectCommand(folder, action);
        string executable = FindOnPath(program) ?? throw new PcToolException($"{program} isn't installed on this PC, or isn't on its PATH.");
        var (exitCode, output) = await RunAsync(executable, arguments, folder, ProjectTimeout, cancellationToken);
        output = output.Trim();
        if (output.Length > MaxProjectOutput) output = output[^MaxProjectOutput..];
        return JsonSerializer.Serialize(new Dictionary<string, object>
        {
            ["ok"] = exitCode == 0,
            ["path"] = folder,
            ["command"] = (string[])[program, .. arguments],
            ["exitCode"] = exitCode,
            ["output"] = output.Length > 0 ? output : "(test command produced no output)",
        });
    }

    // Shell

    private async Task<string> RunShellCommandAsync(string command, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // A command can reach anywhere, so the server doesn't offer it with chosen folders either.
        if (_access.Level == AgentAccess.Folders)
        {
            throw new PcToolException("Shell commands are off while this chat's access is limited to chosen folders.");
        }
        // UTF-8 out, so names with accents come back as typed.
        string script = "[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; " + command;
        var (exitCode, output) = await RunAsync("powershell.exe", ["-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", script],
            _home, ShellTimeout, cancellationToken);
        output = output.Trim();
        if (exitCode != 0) throw new PcToolException($"Command exited with status {exitCode}: {(output.Length > 0 ? output : "no output")}");
        return output.Length > 0 ? output : "(command completed with no output)";
    }

    // Running programs

    /// <summary>Runs a program with no window, and returns its exit code and output (stdout, then stderr).</summary>
    private static async Task<(int ExitCode, string Output)> RunAsync(
        string program, IEnumerable<string> arguments, string folder, TimeSpan timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var start = new ProcessStartInfo(program)
        {
            WorkingDirectory = folder,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            RedirectStandardInput = true,
            StandardOutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8,
            StandardErrorEncoding = Encoding.UTF8,
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true,
        };
        foreach (string argument in arguments) start.ArgumentList.Add(argument);
        using var process = new Process { StartInfo = start };
        try
        {
            process.Start();
        }
        catch (Win32Exception e)
        {
            throw new PcToolException($"Couldn't start {Path.GetFileName(program)}: {e.Message}");
        }
        // Nothing to type: a command waiting for input would otherwise wait until it times out.
        process.StandardInput.Close();
        var stdout = process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(cancellationToken);
        var stderr = process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(cancellationToken);
        using var limit = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        limit.CancelAfter(timeout);
        try
        {
            await process.WaitForExitAsync(limit.Token);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true);
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            throw new PcToolException($"Timed out after {timeout.TotalSeconds:0} seconds.");
        }
        string output = string.Join('\n', new[] { await stdout, await stderr }.Where(s => s.Length > 0));
        return (process.ExitCode, output.ReplaceLineEndings("\n"));
    }

    /// <summary>A program on the PATH, with the extensions Windows tries (npm is npm.cmd).</summary>
    private static string? FindOnPath(string program)
    {
        string[] extensions = (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PATHEXT") ?? ".COM;.EXE;.BAT;.CMD").Split(';', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        foreach (string folder in (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH") ?? "").Split(Path.PathSeparator, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
        {
            foreach (string extension in extensions)
            {
                string candidate = Path.Combine(folder.Trim('"'), program + extension);
                if (File.Exists(candidate)) return candidate;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}


===== tools/reply_speed.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""How fast vireo-server writes four kinds of reply, one way of running it against another.

Each way is a set of server arguments (say "--mtp off" against none, to see what a draft
model adds). A server is started for each in turn (one loaded at a time: two may not fit
the GPU), and every way answers the same prompts in the same sitting:

  list     a document rewritten as a list (copied text: the chat's own guesses)
  code     a code file returned with one edit (copied text)
  story    a new story (nothing to copy: only a draft model can guess)
  explain  an explanation with a code example (nothing to copy)

  python3 tools/reply_speed.py --model models/gemma-4-E4B_q4_0-it.gguf \\
      --way "chat=--mtp off" --way "draft=" --out evals/speed/draft-e4b.json

Greedy (temperature 0) and at the model's own sampling, --rounds times each. Each row
has the writing speed, the guesses made and taken by their source, and how fast the
prompt was read. Standard
library only; the server's data goes in a temporary folder (see long_run.py).
"""

import argparse
import json
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

import long_run

DOCUMENT = """Notes from the harbour office, week 14.

The north quay crane was out of service from Monday to Wednesday while its slewing ring was replaced; the work was done by Halvorsen Marine and came in two days under the estimate. During that time the container ship Astrid Lund was moved to berth 4, which meant the ferry to Skarvik left from the old pier and passengers were told by text message and by a sign at the terminal. Fourteen passengers still went to the wrong pier on Monday morning and the ferry waited eleven minutes for them.

The dredging of the inner basin starts on the 22nd and will take about three weeks. Small boats moored along the east wall have to move to the visitors' pontoon before then; owners have been written to, and the harbour master will tow any boat still there on the 21st at the owner's cost, which is 450 kroner. The fuel dock stays open throughout but only from 07:00 to 15:00.

The winter storage price goes up by four percent from the first of October. Members of the sailing club keep the old price for one more season under the agreement signed in March. The new price list is on the notice board and on the website.

Finally, the office is closed on Friday for the staff outing. The duty phone is answered as usual, and the lock keeper has the spare keys to the fuel dock and the crane cabin."""

CODE = '''import csv
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path


@dataclass
class Reading:
    station: str
    day: str
    rain_mm: float
    wind_ms: float


def load_readings(path: Path) -> list[Reading]:
    """Reads a CSV of daily readings: station, day, rain_mm, wind_ms."""
    readings = []
    with path.open(newline="") as handle:
        for row in csv.DictReader(handle):
            readings.append(
                Reading(
                    station=row["station"].strip(),
                    day=row["day"],
                    rain_mm=float(row["rain_mm"] or 0),
                    wind_ms=float(row["wind_ms"] or 0),
                )
            )
    return readings


def total_rain(readings: list[Reading], station: str) -> float:
    """The rain a station measured over all its days."""
    return sum(r.rain_mm for r in readings if r.station == station)


def windiest_day(readings: list[Reading], station: str) -> str | None:
    """The day a station measured its strongest wind, if it has any readings."""
    own = [r for r in readings if r.station == station]
    if not own:
        return None
    return max(own, key=lambda r: r.wind_ms).day


def report(path: Path) -> str:
    readings = load_readings(path)
    lines = []
    for station in sorted({r.station for r in readings}):
        lines.append(
            f"{station}: {total_rain(readings, station):.1f} mm, "
            f"windiest on {windiest_day(readings, station)}"
        )
    return "\\n".join(lines)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(report(Path("readings.csv")))
'''

PROMPTS = {
    "list": DOCUMENT + "\n\nRewrite these notes as a bulleted list. Keep every fact and figure.",
    "code": "```python\n" + CODE + "```\n\nReturn the whole file with `total_rain` renamed to "
            "`rain_total` everywhere. Change nothing else, and say nothing besides the file.",
    "story": "Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.",
    "explain": "Explain how a hash map works, with a small example in Python.",
}

GUESSES = re.compile(r"(\d+) of (\d+) guesses from the ([a-z\- ]+?) taken")


def ask(server, prompt, max_tokens, greedy):
    server.new_log()
    generation = {"max_tokens": max_tokens}
    if greedy:
        generation["temperature"] = 0
    response = long_run.post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.port}/api/chat/completions", {
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], "generation": generation,
    }, server.token)
    reply = ""
    for event in long_run.events(response):
        if "content" in event:
            reply += event["content"]
        elif event.get("type") == "confirm_required":
            # A tool that asks first (a small model may call `remember` unasked): refused at
            # once, so the reply's time isn't the wait for an answer nobody gives.
            long_run.post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.port}/api/agent/confirm",
                          {"id": event["id"], "approved": False, "remember": False}, server.token).read()
    time.sleep(0.05)
    log = server.new_log()
    row = {"reply": reply}
    if m := server.REPLY.search(log):
        row.update(read=int(m[3]), read_s=float(m[4]), written=int(m[5]), write_s=float(m[6]))
    row["guesses"] = {m[3]: [int(m[1]), int(m[2])] for m in GUESSES.finditer(log)}
    return row


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    parser.add_argument("--model", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--way", action="append", required=True, metavar="NAME=ARGS",
                        help="a name and the server's arguments for it (may be none)")
    parser.add_argument("--prompts", default=",".join(PROMPTS))
    parser.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=400)
    parser.add_argument("--rounds", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--sampling", default="greedy,own", help="greedy, own or both (default)")
    parser.add_argument("--out")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    ways = [w.split("=", 1) for w in args.way]
    rows = []
    # One server at a time: two models at once may not fit the GPU, and the one that spills
    # into the PC's memory writes at half speed (Qwen 3.5 4B twice on 8 GB: a list at 51
    # tokens/s against 97). So a way's replies are all timed before the next way loads.
    for name, extra in ways:
        server = long_run.Vireo(args.model, 0, args.max_tokens, shlex.split(extra))
        try:
            # A server's first reply is slower (graphs recorded, caches cold): not timed.
            ask(server, "Say hello.", 16, True)
            for sampling in args.sampling.split(","):
                for prompt in args.prompts.split(","):
                    tokens, seconds, guesses, read, read_s = 0, 0.0, {}, 0, 0.0
                    for _ in range(args.rounds):
                        row = ask(server, PROMPTS[prompt], args.max_tokens, sampling == "greedy")
                        tokens += row.get("written", 0)
                        seconds += row.get("write_s", 0.0)
                        read += row.get("read", 0)
                        read_s += row.get("read_s", 0.0)
                        for source, (taken, guessed) in row["guesses"].items():
                            have = guesses.setdefault(source, [0, 0])
                            have[0] += taken
                            have[1] += guessed
                    rate = tokens / seconds if seconds else 0.0
                    rows.append({"sampling": sampling, "prompt": prompt, "way": name,
                                 "tokens": tokens, "seconds": round(seconds, 3),
                                 "tokens_per_s": round(rate, 1), "guesses": guesses,
                                 "read_tokens": read, "read_seconds": round(read_s, 3),
                                 "read_tokens_per_s": round(read / read_s) if read_s else 0})
                    taken = sum(g[0] for g in guesses.values())
                    print(f"{name:10} {sampling:6} {prompt:8} {rate:6.1f} tokens/s "
                          f"({100 * taken // max(tokens, 1)}% guessed)", flush=True)
        finally:
            server.stop()
            shutil.rmtree(server.dir, ignore_errors=True)
            time.sleep(2)
    # Side by side, a row a prompt.
    for sampling in args.sampling.split(","):
        for prompt in args.prompts.split(","):
            cells = [f"{r['way']} {r['tokens_per_s']:6.1f}" for r in rows
                     if r["sampling"] == sampling and r["prompt"] == prompt]
            print(f"{sampling:6} {prompt:8} " + "   ".join(cells), flush=True)
    if args.out:
        Path(args.out).write_text(json.dumps({"model": Path(args.model).name, "ways": dict(ways),
                                              "max_tokens": args.max_tokens, "rounds": args.rounds,
                                              "rows": rows}, indent=1) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Storage/CloudFolders.cs =====
// OneDrive and SharePoint folders synced to this PC, offered in Settings  Chat folders so a
// chat limited to chosen folders can reach work files in one click. They're ordinary folders
// to the file tools; only finding them is special.
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace Vireo.Core.Storage;

public sealed record CloudFolder(string Name, string Path);

public static class CloudFolders
{
    /// <summary>The OneDrive client's sync roots: one per OneDrive account and SharePoint library.</summary>
    private const string SyncProviders = @"Software\SyncEngines\Providers\OneDrive";

    /// <summary>The synced folders on this PC that exist, OneDrive first, each once.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<CloudFolder> Find() => Find(
        [Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OneDriveCommercial"), Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OneDriveConsumer"),
         Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OneDrive")],
        OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? MountPoints() : []);

    /// <param name="oneDrives">The OneDrive environment variables, unset ones null.</param>
    /// <param name="mountPoints">Where the OneDrive client syncs each library.</param>
    public static IReadOnlyList<CloudFolder> Find(IEnumerable<string?> oneDrives, IEnumerable<string> mountPoints)
    {
        var found = new List<CloudFolder>();
        foreach (string? folder in oneDrives.Concat(mountPoints))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(folder)) continue;
            string full = System.IO.Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(folder));
            if (!Directory.Exists(full) || found.Any(f => f.Path.Equals(full, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) continue;
            found.Add(new CloudFolder(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(full), full));
        }
        return found;
    }

    [System.Runtime.Versioning.SupportedOSPlatform("windows")]
    private static List<string> MountPoints()
    {
        var points = new List<string>();
        try
        {
            using var providers = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(SyncProviders);
            foreach (string name in providers?.GetSubKeyNames() ?? [])
            {
                using var provider = providers!.OpenSubKey(name);
                if (provider?.GetValue("MountPoint") is string point) points.Add(point);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is System.Security.SecurityException or UnauthorizedAccessException or IOException)
        {
            // Not readable here: the OneDrive folders from the environment are still offered.
        }
        return points;
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-engine/src/mmap.rs =====
//! Maps a file into memory, read-only, with the operating system's own calls
//! (`CreateFileMappingW` / `MapViewOfFile` on Windows, `mmap` elsewhere).
//!
//! A model's weights are gigabytes. Mapping them means nothing is read until it's used,
//! the operating system can drop pages it needs back and reread them later, and a GPU
//! upload can copy straight from the mapping.

use std::fs::File;
use std::io;
use std::ops::Deref;
use std::path::Path;
use std::ptr::NonNull;

/// A file's bytes, mapped read-only. Unmapped when dropped.
pub struct Mmap {
    ptr: NonNull<u8>,
    len: usize,
    /// The file, kept open for [`Mmap::release`].
    file: Option<File>,
}

// The mapping is read-only and owned by this value alone, so it can be shared and moved
// between threads like a `&[u8]` or a `Box<[u8]>`.
unsafe impl Send for Mmap {}
unsafe impl Sync for Mmap {}

impl Mmap {
    /// Maps the whole file at `path`.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// The file must not be changed or shortened while the mapping exists: the bytes
    /// would change under the caller, and reading past a shortened end crashes. Model
    /// files are only ever read, so this holds as long as nothing else rewrites them.
    pub unsafe fn open(path: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
        let file = File::open(path)?;
        let len = usize::try_from(file.metadata()?.len())
            .map_err(|_| io::Error::other("the file is too large to map on this computer"))?;
        if len == 0 {
            // Neither Windows nor POSIX maps an empty file.
            return Ok(Self {
                ptr: NonNull::dangling(),
                len: 0,
                file: None,
            });
        }
        let ptr = sys::map(&file, len)?;
        Ok(Self {
            ptr,
            len,
            file: Some(file),
        })
    }

    /// Gives the pages read so far back to the operating system; the bytes stay readable
    /// and are read from the file again when next used. For after a model's weights are
    /// copied to the GPU: until then the process holds the file's pages beside the copy,
    /// twice the model's size. Does nothing on Windows.
    pub fn release(&self) {
        if let Some(file) = &self.file {
            // Failing leaves the mapping as it was, pages and all.
            let _ = unsafe { sys::release(self.ptr, self.len, file) };
        }
    }
}

impl Deref for Mmap {
    type Target = [u8];

    fn deref(&self) -> &[u8] {
        // The mapping covers `len` readable bytes for as long as `self` lives.
        unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(self.ptr.as_ptr(), self.len) }
    }
}

impl Drop for Mmap {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.len > 0 {
            unsafe { sys::unmap(self.ptr, self.len) };
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
mod sys {
    use std::ffi::c_void;
    use std::fs::File;
    use std::io;
    use std::os::windows::io::AsRawHandle;
    use std::ptr::{NonNull, null, null_mut};

    type Handle = *mut c_void;

    const PAGE_READONLY: u32 = 0x02;
    const FILE_MAP_READ: u32 = 0x04;

    #[link(name = "kernel32")]
    unsafe extern "system" {
        fn CreateFileMappingW(
            file: Handle,
            attributes: *mut c_void,
            protect: u32,
            maximum_size_high: u32,
            maximum_size_low: u32,
            name: *const u16,
        ) -> Handle;
        fn MapViewOfFile(
            mapping: Handle,
            desired_access: u32,
            file_offset_high: u32,
            file_offset_low: u32,
            bytes_to_map: usize,
        ) -> *mut c_void;
        fn UnmapViewOfFile(base_address: *const c_void) -> i32;
