        fn CloseHandle(handle: Handle) -> i32;
    }

    pub fn map(file: &File, _len: usize) -> io::Result<NonNull<u8>> {
        // Sizes of 0 mean "the whole file", for both the mapping and the view.
        let mapping = unsafe {
            CreateFileMappingW(
                file.as_raw_handle(),
                null_mut(),
                PAGE_READONLY,
                0,
                0,
                null(),
            )
        };
        if mapping.is_null() {
            return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        let view = unsafe { MapViewOfFile(mapping, FILE_MAP_READ, 0, 0, 0) };
        let error = view.is_null().then(io::Error::last_os_error);
        // The view keeps the mapping alive on its own.
        unsafe { CloseHandle(mapping) };
        match error {
            Some(error) => Err(error),
            None => Ok(NonNull::new(view.cast()).expect("checked above")),
        }
    }

    /// # Safety
    /// `ptr` must be a view returned by `map` and not unmapped yet.
    pub unsafe fn release(_ptr: NonNull<u8>, _len: usize, _file: &File) -> io::Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    /// # Safety
    /// `ptr` must be a mapping returned by `map` and not unmapped yet.
    pub unsafe fn unmap(ptr: NonNull<u8>, _len: usize) {
        unsafe { UnmapViewOfFile(ptr.as_ptr().cast()) };
    }
}

#[cfg(unix)]
mod sys {
    use std::ffi::{c_int, c_void};
    use std::fs::File;
    use std::io;
    use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
    use std::ptr::{NonNull, null_mut};

    const PROT_READ: c_int = 1;
    const MAP_PRIVATE: c_int = 2;
    const MAP_FIXED: c_int = 0x10;

    // `off_t` is 64 bits on macOS and 64-bit Linux, the only Unix systems Vireo targets.
    unsafe extern "C" {
        fn mmap(
            addr: *mut c_void,
            len: usize,
            prot: c_int,
            flags: c_int,
            fd: c_int,
            offset: i64,
        ) -> *mut c_void;
        fn munmap(addr: *mut c_void, len: usize) -> c_int;
    }

    pub fn map(file: &File, len: usize) -> io::Result<NonNull<u8>> {
        let ptr = unsafe { mmap(null_mut(), len, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, file.as_raw_fd(), 0) };
        if ptr as isize == -1 {
            return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        NonNull::new(ptr.cast()).ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("mmap returned a null address"))
    }

    /// Maps the file again over its own mapping, in one step: the same bytes at the same
    /// address, none of them resident.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// `ptr` and `len` must be a mapping of `file` returned by `map` and not unmapped yet.
    pub unsafe fn release(ptr: NonNull<u8>, len: usize, file: &File) -> io::Result<()> {
        let again = unsafe {
            mmap(
                ptr.as_ptr().cast(),
                len,
                PROT_READ,
                MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_FIXED,
                file.as_raw_fd(),
                0,
            )
        };
        if again as isize == -1 {
            return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// # Safety
    /// `ptr` and `len` must be a mapping returned by `map` and not unmapped yet.
    pub unsafe fn unmap(ptr: NonNull<u8>, len: usize) {
        unsafe { munmap(ptr.as_ptr().cast(), len) };
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn temp_file(name: &str, contents: &[u8]) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("vireo-mmap-{}-{name}", std::process::id()));
        std::fs::write(&path, contents).unwrap();
        path
    }

    #[test]
    fn maps_a_file() {
        let contents: Vec<u8> = (0..100_000u32).map(|i| (i % 251) as u8).collect();
        let path = temp_file("data", &contents);
        let map = unsafe { Mmap::open(&path) }.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(&map[..], &contents[..]);
        drop(map); // Windows can't delete a file that's still mapped.
        std::fs::remove_file(path).unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn reads_the_same_bytes_after_a_release() {
        let contents: Vec<u8> = (0..300_000u32).map(|i| (i % 241) as u8).collect();
        let path = temp_file("release", &contents);
        let map = unsafe { Mmap::open(&path) }.unwrap();
        let before = map.as_ptr();
        assert_eq!(&map[..], &contents[..]);
        map.release();
        assert_eq!(map.as_ptr(), before);
        assert_eq!(&map[..], &contents[..]);
        map.release();
        map.release();
        assert_eq!(&map[..], &contents[..]);
        drop(map);
        std::fs::remove_file(path).unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn maps_an_empty_file() {
        let path = temp_file("empty", b"");
        let map = unsafe { Mmap::open(&path) }.unwrap();
        assert!(map.is_empty());
        drop(map);
        std::fs::remove_file(path).unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn reports_a_missing_file() {
        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join("vireo-mmap-does-not-exist");
        let error = unsafe { Mmap::open(&path) }.err().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(error.kind(), io::ErrorKind::NotFound);
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Services/QuickAskPreferences.swift =====
import AppKit
import Carbon.HIToolbox
import Combine

/// A key plus modifiers, stored in Carbon's terms because that's what
/// `RegisterEventHotKey` takes.
struct KeyCombo: Codable, Equatable {
    var keyCode: UInt32
    var carbonModifiers: UInt32

    static let optionSpace = KeyCombo(keyCode: UInt32(kVK_Space), carbonModifiers: UInt32(optionKey))

    /// A shortcut needs ,  or ;  alone would take over normal typing.
    var isUsable: Bool {
        carbonModifiers & UInt32(cmdKey | optionKey | controlKey) != 0
    }

    init(keyCode: UInt32, carbonModifiers: UInt32) {
        self.keyCode = keyCode
        self.carbonModifiers = carbonModifiers
    }

    init(keyCode: UInt16, flags: NSEvent.ModifierFlags) {
        var modifiers: UInt32 = 0
        if flags.contains(.command) { modifiers |= UInt32(cmdKey) }
        if flags.contains(.option) { modifiers |= UInt32(optionKey) }
        if flags.contains(.control) { modifiers |= UInt32(controlKey) }
        if flags.contains(.shift) { modifiers |= UInt32(shiftKey) }
        self.init(keyCode: UInt32(keyCode), carbonModifiers: modifiers)
    }

    /// "Space", "K": modifiers in the order macOS menus use.
    var displayName: String {
        var text = ""
        if carbonModifiers & UInt32(controlKey) != 0 { text += "" }
        if carbonModifiers & UInt32(optionKey) != 0 { text += "" }
        if carbonModifiers & UInt32(shiftKey) != 0 { text += "" }
        if carbonModifiers & UInt32(cmdKey) != 0 { text += "" }
        return text + Self.keyName(keyCode)
    }

    private static func keyName(_ keyCode: UInt32) -> String {
        switch Int(keyCode) {
        case kVK_Space: return "Space"
        case kVK_Return: return ""
        case kVK_Tab: return ""
        case kVK_Escape: return ""
        case kVK_Delete: return ""
        case kVK_UpArrow: return ""
        case kVK_DownArrow: return ""
        case kVK_LeftArrow: return ""
        case kVK_RightArrow: return ""
        default:
            break
        }
        // Function-key codes aren't in numeric order, so they're looked up.
        if let index = Self.functionKeys.firstIndex(of: Int(keyCode)) { return "F\(index + 1)" }
        return Self.character(for: keyCode) ?? "Key \(keyCode)"
    }

    private static let functionKeys = [kVK_F1, kVK_F2, kVK_F3, kVK_F4, kVK_F5, kVK_F6, kVK_F7, kVK_F8, kVK_F9, kVK_F10,
                                       kVK_F11, kVK_F12, kVK_F13, kVK_F14, kVK_F15, kVK_F16, kVK_F17, kVK_F18, kVK_F19, kVK_F20]

    /// The character the key types on the current keyboard layout, so the name
    /// matches the keycap on AZERTY or Dvorak keyboards too.
    private static func character(for keyCode: UInt32) -> String? {
        guard let source = TISCopyCurrentKeyboardLayoutInputSource()?.takeRetainedValue(),
              let pointer = TISGetInputSourceProperty(source, kTISPropertyUnicodeKeyLayoutData) else { return nil }
        let layoutData = Unmanaged<CFData>.fromOpaque(pointer).takeUnretainedValue() as Data
        var deadKeyState: UInt32 = 0
        var length = 0
        var characters = [UniChar](repeating: 0, count: 4)
        let status = layoutData.withUnsafeBytes { buffer -> OSStatus in
            guard let layout = buffer.baseAddress?.assumingMemoryBound(to: UCKeyboardLayout.self) else { return -1 }
            return UCKeyTranslate(layout, UInt16(keyCode), UInt16(kUCKeyActionDisplay), 0, UInt32(LMGetKbdType()),
                                  OptionBits(kUCKeyTranslateNoDeadKeysBit), &deadKeyState, characters.count, &length, &characters)
        }
        guard status == noErr, length > 0 else { return nil }
        return String(utf16CodeUnits: characters, count: length).uppercased()
    }
}

/// Settings  Quick Ask. The keyboard shortcut and the wake word are off until
/// the user turns them on (decided for 0.7.5); the menu bar item is how people
/// find Quick Ask meanwhile.
@MainActor
final class QuickAskPreferences: ObservableObject {
    static let shared = QuickAskPreferences()

    private enum Key {
        static let hotkeyEnabled = "quickAsk.hotkeyEnabled"
        static let hotkey = "quickAsk.hotkey"
        static let holdToTalk = "quickAsk.holdToTalk"
        static let wakeWordEnabled = "quickAsk.wakeWordEnabled"
        static let showInMenuBar = "quickAsk.showInMenuBar"
        static let speakReplies = "quickAsk.speakReplies"
        static let voiceIdentifier = "quickAsk.voiceIdentifier"
        static let modelPath = "quickAsk.modelPath"
    }

    private let defaults: UserDefaults

    @Published var hotkeyEnabled: Bool { didSet { defaults.set(hotkeyEnabled, forKey: Key.hotkeyEnabled) } }
    @Published var hotkey: KeyCombo {
        didSet { defaults.set(try? JSONEncoder().encode(hotkey), forKey: Key.hotkey) }
    }
    /// Holding the shortcut talks; a tap opens the panel.
    @Published var holdToTalk: Bool { didSet { defaults.set(holdToTalk, forKey: Key.holdToTalk) } }
    @Published var wakeWordEnabled: Bool { didSet { defaults.set(wakeWordEnabled, forKey: Key.wakeWordEnabled) } }
    @Published var showInMenuBar: Bool { didSet { defaults.set(showInMenuBar, forKey: Key.showInMenuBar) } }
    /// Read answers aloud when the question was spoken.
    @Published var speakReplies: Bool { didSet { defaults.set(speakReplies, forKey: Key.speakReplies) } }
    @Published var voiceIdentifier: String? { didSet { defaults.set(voiceIdentifier, forKey: Key.voiceIdentifier) } }
    /// The model new Quick Ask chats use, such as a small fast one. Nil: whichever is loaded.
    @Published var modelPath: String? { didSet { defaults.set(modelPath, forKey: Key.modelPath) } }

    init(defaults: UserDefaults = .standard) {
        self.defaults = defaults
        hotkeyEnabled = defaults.bool(forKey: Key.hotkeyEnabled)
        hotkey = defaults.data(forKey: Key.hotkey).flatMap { try? JSONDecoder().decode(KeyCombo.self, from: $0) } ?? .optionSpace
        holdToTalk = defaults.object(forKey: Key.holdToTalk) as? Bool ?? true
        wakeWordEnabled = defaults.bool(forKey: Key.wakeWordEnabled)
        showInMenuBar = defaults.object(forKey: Key.showInMenuBar) as? Bool ?? true
        speakReplies = defaults.bool(forKey: Key.speakReplies)
        voiceIdentifier = defaults.string(forKey: Key.voiceIdentifier)
        modelPath = defaults.string(forKey: Key.modelPath)
    }
}

// Ported from Tests/VireoMacTests: ChatStoreTests, ReplyVersionTests and

using System.Net;

public sealed class ChatStoreTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TempFolder _folder = new();
    private readonly FakeMac _mac = new();

    public ChatStoreTests()
    {
        var connection = new ServerConnection(_folder.File("connection.json"), new FakeProtector());
        connection.SetPaired(new Uri("http://192.168.1.20:3000/"), "token");
        _api = new ChatApiClient(connection, _mac);
    }

    public void Dispose() => _folder.Dispose();

    private string ChatsDirectory => _folder.File("Chats");
    private string UndoRoot => _folder.File("undo");
    private ChatStore NewStore() => new(ChatsDirectory, _api, undoRoot: UndoRoot);

    [Fact]
    public void ChatsAndMessagesSurviveARelaunch()
    {
        var store = NewStore();
        string chatId = store.NewChat();
        store.AppendMessage(chatId, new ChatMessage("user", "hello"));
        store.AppendMessage(chatId, new ChatMessage("assistant", ""));
        store.UpdateLastMessage(chatId, new ChatMessage("assistant", "hi there") { Metadata = new MessageMetadata(3, "0.4", "7.5") });

        var relaunched = NewStore();
        Assert.Equal([chatId], relaunched.Chats.Select(c => c.Id));
        Assert.Equal(chatId, relaunched.CurrentChatId);
        Assert.Equal(["hello", "hi there"], relaunched.Messages(chatId).Select(m => m.Content));
        Assert.Equal(3, relaunched.Messages(chatId)[^1].Metadata?.Tokens);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UnreadableConversationIsSetAsideNotOverwritten()
    {
        string chatId = NewStore().NewChat();
        string messages = Path.Combine(ChatsDirectory, "messages");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(messages);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(messages, $"{chatId}.json"), "not json");

        Assert.Empty(NewStore().Messages(chatId));
        string aside = Assert.Single(Directory.GetFiles(messages, $"{chatId}.corrupt-*.json"));
        Assert.Equal("not json", File.ReadAllText(aside));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DeletedChatIsNotRecreatedByALateReply()
    {
        var store = NewStore();
        string chatId = store.NewChat();
        store.AppendMessage(chatId, new ChatMessage("assistant", ""));
        store.DeleteChat(chatId);
        store.UpdateLastMessage(chatId, new ChatMessage("assistant", "late"));

        Assert.False(File.Exists(Path.Combine(ChatsDirectory, "messages", $"{chatId}.json")));
        Assert.Null(store.CurrentChatId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BranchCopiesTheChatUpToAMessage()
    {
        var store = NewStore();
        string chatId = store.NewChat("Trip");
        store.SetSystemPrompt(chatId, "Be brief.");
        foreach (var (role, text) in new[] { ("user", "Plan Rome"), ("assistant", "Day 1"), ("user", "Add Florence"), ("assistant", "Day 3") })
        {
            store.AppendMessage(chatId, new ChatMessage(role, text));
        }
        string branch = store.BranchChat(chatId, throughIndex: 1)!;

        Assert.Equal(branch, store.CurrentChatId);
        Assert.Equal("Trip (branch)", store.Chat(branch)!.Title);
        Assert.Equal(["Plan Rome", "Day 1"], store.Messages(branch).Select(m => m.Content));
        Assert.Equal("Be brief.", store.Chat(branch)!.SystemPrompt);
        Assert.Equal(4, store.Messages(chatId).Count);
        Assert.Equal(["Plan Rome", "Day 1"], NewStore().Messages(branch).Select(m => m.Content));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EditingRemovesTheMessageAndWhatFollows()
    {
        var store = NewStore();
        string chatId = store.NewChat();
        foreach (string text in new[] { "one", "two", "three" }) store.AppendMessage(chatId, new ChatMessage("user", text));
        store.RemoveMessages(chatId, fromIndex: 1);
        Assert.Equal(["one"], store.Messages(chatId).Select(m => m.Content));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShowingAnEarlierVersionIsSaved()
    {
        var store = NewStore();
        string chatId = store.NewChat();
        var reply = new ChatMessage("assistant", "A");
        reply.StartNewVersion();
        reply.Content = "B";
        reply.SaveCurrentVersion();
        store.AppendMessage(chatId, reply);
        store.ShowVersion(chatId, messageIndex: 0, version: 0);

        var shown = NewStore().Messages(chatId)[0];
        Assert.Equal("A", shown.Content);
        Assert.Equal(0, shown.VersionIndex);
    }

    [Fact]

        string chatId = store.NewChat();

    [Fact]
    public void NewChatsStartFromTheSavedDefaults()
    {
        var store = NewStore();
        string first = store.NewChat();
        store.SetSystemPrompt(first, "Use Canadian spelling.");
        store.SetGeneration(first, GenerationPreset.Creative.AppliedTo(GenerationSettings.Standard));
        store.SaveAsDefaultSettings(first);

        string second = store.NewChat();
        Assert.NotEqual(first, second);
        Assert.Equal("Use Canadian spelling.", store.Chat(second)!.SystemPrompt);
        Assert.Equal(GenerationPreset.Creative, GenerationPresets.Matching(store.Chat(second)!.Generation));

        // Changing the new chat leaves the defaults alone.

        Assert.Equal("Use Canadian spelling.", store.DefaultSettings.SystemPrompt);

    [Fact]
    public async Task SendingStreamsTheReplyIntoTheChat()
    {
        _mac.Respond = _ => FakeMac.EventStream(
            """{"type":"agent_status","phase":"executing_tools","step":1,"maxSteps":8}""",
            """{"type":"tool_call","tool":"search_web","args":{"query":"rain"}}""",
            """{"type":"tool_result","tool":"search_web","result":"Rain at 3pm"}""",
            """{"content":"Bring "}""",
            """{"content":"an umbrella."}""",
            """{"done":true,"tokens":5,"duration":"0.50","tokensPerSecond":"10.00"}""",
            "[DONE]");
        var store = NewStore();
        string chatId = store.NewChat();

        var reply = await store.SendAsync(chatId, "  Will it rain?  ", capabilities: ["search_web"]);

        Assert.Equal("Bring an umbrella.", reply!.Content);
        Assert.Equal(2, reply.ToolSteps.Count);
        Assert.Equal(5, reply.Metadata?.Tokens);
        Assert.Null(store.ReplyActivity);
        Assert.Equal(["Will it rain?", "Bring an umbrella."], NewStore().Messages(chatId).Select(m => m.Content));

        // The new, empty reply isn't part of the history sent.
        var body = JsonDocument.Parse(_mac.Requests.Single().Body!).RootElement;
        Assert.Equal(1, body.GetProperty("messages").GetArrayLength());
        Assert.Equal("home", body.GetProperty("access").GetString());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AnApprovalRequestIsShownWhileTheReplyWaits()
    {
        var waiting = new TaskCompletionSource();
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource();
        _mac.Respond = request => request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath == "/api/chat/completions"
            ? new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
            {
                Content = new StreamContent(new BlockingStream(
                    "data: {\"type\":\"confirm_required\",\"id\":\"c1\",\"tool\":\"write_file\",\"args\":{\"path\":\"/a.txt\"}}\n\n",
                    waiting, release.Task)),
            }
            : FakeMac.Json(HttpStatusCode.OK, """{"ok":true}""");
        var store = NewStore();
        string chatId = store.NewChat();
        var sending = store.SendAsync(chatId, "Write a.txt");
        await waiting.Task;
        Assert.Equal("c1", store.ConfirmRequest?.Id);
        Assert.Equal(chatId, store.ConfirmRequest?.ChatId);
        // A file change gets the dialog, not the reply.
        Assert.Null(store.InlineApproval);

        await store.ResolveConfirmationAsync(approved: true, remember: true);
        Assert.Null(store.ConfirmRequest);
        Assert.Contains("\"approved\":true", _mac.Requests[^1].Body);
        Assert.Contains("\"remember\":true", _mac.Requests[^1].Body);
        release.SetResult();
        await sending;
    }

    {

        _mac.Respond = request => request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath switch

    }

    [Fact]

        };
        var store = NewStore();
        string first = store.NewChat();
        string second = store.NewChat();

        var running = Task.Run(() => store.SendAsync(first, "one"));
        while (store.ReplyActivity is null) await Task.Delay(5);
        Assert.Null(await store.SendAsync(second, "two"));
        gate.SetResult();
        Assert.Equal("done", (await running)!.Content);
        Assert.Empty(store.Messages(second));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ChosenFoldersAreSavedOnceEachAndMustExist()
    {

        Directory.CreateDirectory(projects);
        var folders = new ChatFolders(_folder.File("chat-folders.json"));

        folders.Add([projects, projects + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar]);
        Assert.Throws<DirectoryNotFoundException>(() => folders.Add([_folder.File("missing")]));
        Assert.Equal([projects], new ChatFolders(_folder.File("chat-folders.json")).Load());

    [Fact]
    public async Task StopStopsTheRunOnTheMacAndDeclinesItsApproval()
    {
        var waiting = new TaskCompletionSource();
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource();
        _mac.Respond = request => request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath switch
        {
            "/api/chat/completions" => new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
            {
                Content = new StreamContent(new BlockingStream(
                    "data: {\"type\":\"run\",\"runId\":\"run-1\"}\n\n"
                    + "data: {\"type\":\"confirm_required\",\"id\":\"c1\",\"tool\":\"create_reminder\",\"args\":{}}\n\n",
                    waiting, release.Task)),
            },
            _ => FakeMac.Json(HttpStatusCode.OK, """{"success":true}"""),
        };
        var store = NewStore();
        string chatId = store.NewChat();

        var sending = store.SendAsync(chatId, "Remind me");
        await waiting.Task;
        Assert.Equal("c1", store.InlineApproval?.Id);
        store.CancelReply();
        release.SetResult();
        await sending;
        for (int i = 0; i < 200 && _mac.Requests.Count < 3; i++) await Task.Delay(10);

        Assert.Null(store.ConfirmRequest);
        var paths = _mac.Requests.Select(r => r.Request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath).ToList();
        Assert.Contains("/api/chat/runs/run-1/stop", paths);
        Assert.Contains("\"approved\":false", _mac.Requests.Single(r => r.Request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath == "/api/agent/confirm").Body);
    }

    /// <summary>Sends its text, says so, then holds the stream open until released.</summary>
    private sealed class BlockingStream(string text, TaskCompletionSource sent, Task release)
        : MemoryStream(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text))
    {
        public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (Position < Length) return await base.ReadAsync(buffer, cancellationToken);
            sent.TrySetResult();
            await release.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task UndoPutsBackWhatTheReplyChangedOnBothComputers()
    {
        string home = _folder.File("home");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(home, "Desktop"));
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(home, "Desktop", "note.txt"), "mine");
        var answered = new TaskCompletionSource();
        _mac.Respond = request =>
        {
            switch (request.RequestUri!.AbsolutePath)
            {
                case "/api/chat/completions":
                    return FakeMac.EventStream(
                        """{"type":"client_tool_request","id":"t1","tool":"write_file","args":{"path":"Desktop\\note.txt","content":"agent"}}""",
                        """{"type":"undoable","runId":"run-1"}""",
                        """{"content":"Done."}""",
                        """{"done":true}""");
                case "/api/chat/runs/run-1/undo":
                    return FakeMac.Json(HttpStatusCode.OK, """{"message":"Undid 1 change.","finished":true}""");
                default:
                    answered.TrySetResult();
                    return FakeMac.Json(HttpStatusCode.OK, """{"success":true}""");
            }
        };
        var store = new ChatStore(ChatsDirectory, _api, new PcTools(home, _api), undoRoot: UndoRoot);
        string chatId = store.NewChat();

        var reply = await store.SendAsync(chatId, "Change my note");
        await answered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.Equal("agent", File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(home, "Desktop", "note.txt")));
        Assert.Equal("run-1", reply!.Undo?.RunId);
        Assert.NotNull(reply.Undo?.PcRunId);

        await store.UndoRunAsync(chatId, reply.Id);

        Assert.Equal("mine", File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(home, "Desktop", "note.txt")));
        var undo = NewStore().Messages(chatId)[^1].Undo!;
        Assert.True(undo.IsFinished);
        Assert.Equal("Undid 1 change.\nUndid 1 change.", undo.Summary);
        // The model is told, since the reply still says what it changed.
        Assert.EndsWith("[The user then pressed Undo on this reply's file changes. Undid 1 change.\nUndid 1 change.]",
            ConversationHistory.ForModel(store.Messages(chatId))[^1].Content);
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Tests/VireoMacTests/FileToolsLiveTests.swift =====
import XCTest
@testable import VireoMac

/// A chat with a running `vireo-server` through the app's own client: the app sends the
/// chat's access and folders, the model asks for a file, the server reads it, and the
/// answer comes back in the reply. Skipped unless `VIREO_LIVE_SERVER` names the server
/// (`http://localhost:3100`) and `VIREO_LIVE_TOKEN` is its `--token`.
final class FileToolsLiveTests: XCTestCase {
    func testAReplyReadsAFileOnTheServer() async throws {
        let environment = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
        guard let server = environment["VIREO_LIVE_SERVER"].flatMap(URL.init(string:)),
              let token = environment["VIREO_LIVE_TOKEN"] else {
            throw XCTSkip("Set VIREO_LIVE_SERVER and VIREO_LIVE_TOKEN to chat with a running vireo-server.")
        }
        let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
        let savedURL = defaults.string(forKey: "invurse_server_url")
        let savedToken = defaults.string(forKey: "vireo_engine_server_token")
        defer {
            defaults.set(savedURL, forKey: "invurse_server_url")
            defaults.set(savedToken, forKey: "vireo_engine_server_token")
        }
        ServerConfig.baseURL = server
        defaults.set(token, forKey: "vireo_engine_server_token")

        let folder = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("FileToolsLive-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        let home = AgentFolders.standardized(folder.resolvingSymlinksInPath().path)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(atPath: home + "/Documents", withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        try "Remember: the code word for Friday is PELICAN.".write(
            toFile: home + "/Documents/notes.txt", atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: home) }

        let question = ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "What's the code word in \(home)/Documents/notes.txt?")
        let stream = ChatAPIClient.shared.streamChatCompletion(
            chatId: "live-\(UUID().uuidString)", messages: [question],
            imagePath: nil, base64Image: nil, extractedText: nil, docId: nil,
            access: .folders, folders: [home])
        var reply = "", steps: [ToolStep] = []
        for try await event in stream {
            switch event {
            case .content(let chunk): reply += chunk
            case .toolCall(let step), .toolResult(let step): steps.append(step)
            case .error(let message): XCTFail("Server error: \(message)")
            default: break
            }
        }
        print("Steps:", steps.map { "\($0.type) \($0.tool) \($0.detail ?? $0.result ?? "")" })
        print("Reply:", reply)
        XCTAssertEqual(steps.filter { $0.type == "tool_call" }.map(\.tool), ["read_file"])
        XCTAssertTrue(steps.contains { $0.type == "tool_result" && ($0.result ?? "").contains("PELICAN") }, "\(steps)")
        XCTAssertTrue(reply.contains("PELICAN"), reply)
    }
}

===== crates/vireo-server/src/store.rs =====
//! Chats' caches saved for later: each one the tokens of a chat and its session's state
//! after them (`vireo_engine::models::SavedState`), so going back to a chat, or opening
//! it after a restart, reads only what's new in it.
//!
//! Saved in `chat-cache\<model>\` in the prototype's folder (`data_dir`), a file per chat, written
//! by a thread of their own so switching chats doesn't wait for the disk. The newest
//! states stay in memory as well. The oldest files go once they take more than the
//! budget. A file is:
//!
//!   "VIREOKV1", the number of tokens n (u64), the tokens (n  u32), the state's length
//!   in bytes (u64), the state's bytes; little-endian.
//!
//! The folder is per model file and precision (`model_key`): a state only fits a session
//! of the model and precision that made it, and loading checks its size.

use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::mpsc::{Sender, channel};
use std::thread::JoinHandle;

use vireo_engine::models::SavedState;

const MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b"VIREOKV1";

/// What the saved chats may take on disk, per model, at least.
pub const DISK_BUDGET: u64 = 4 << 30;
/// A large model's budget is room for this many chats of the whole context...
const FULL_CHATS: u64 = 4;
/// ...up to this much.
const MOST_DISK: u64 = 32 << 30;

/// The disk budget for a model whose chat of the whole context takes `full_chat` bytes in
/// the GPU's cache (about what it takes saved): 4 GB for the small models, and for a
/// large one room for four full chats. On Gemma 4 31B a 26K-token chat saves as 2.9 GB,
/// and two 11.5K-token chats took 3.6 of the 4 GB (`evals/long-run`): going back to the
/// second of two long chats would have read it all again.
pub fn budget_for(full_chat: u64) -> u64 {
    DISK_BUDGET.max(FULL_CHATS.saturating_mul(full_chat)).min(MOST_DISK)
}
/// How many saved states stay in memory too (the newest; on top of the one in use).
const IN_MEMORY: usize = 2;

/// The folder name for a model file in a precision: its name, size and modification time
/// (a new download of the same name is another model), hashed.
pub fn model_key(path: &Path, precision: &str) -> String {
    let meta = std::fs::metadata(path).ok();
    let size = meta.as_ref().map_or(0, std::fs::Metadata::len);
    let modified = meta
        .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
        .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
        .map_or(0, |d| d.as_nanos());
    let name = path
        .file_name()
        .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    // FNV-1a: stable from one build to the next, unlike std's hasher.
    let mut h: u64 = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325;
    for b in format!("{name}\0{size}\0{modified}\0{precision}").bytes() {
        h = (h ^ u64::from(b)).wrapping_mul(0x100_0000_01b3);
    }
    format!("{h:016x}")
}

/// The prototype's own folder: `~/Library/Application Support/VireoPrototype` on the Mac
/// (where the Mac prototype app keeps its chats), `%LOCALAPPDATA%\VireoPrototype`
/// elsewhere.
pub fn data_dir() -> PathBuf {
    let base = if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
        std::env::var_os("HOME").map_or_else(
            || PathBuf::from("."),
            |home| {
                PathBuf::from(home)
                    .join("Library")
                    .join("Application Support")
            },
        )
    } else {
        std::env::var_os("LOCALAPPDATA").map_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."), PathBuf::from)
    };
    base.join("VireoPrototype")
}

/// The default folder for `key`'s saved chats.
pub fn default_dir(key: &str) -> PathBuf {
    data_dir().join("chat-cache").join(key)
}

pub struct Entry {
    pub tokens: Vec<u32>,
    file: PathBuf,
    bytes: u64,
    /// The state, while it's in memory. The writer thread holds the other reference
    /// until the file is written.
    data: Option<Arc<SavedState>>,
    used: u64,
}

impl Entry {
    /// Whether its file is still being written (the writer thread holds its state).
    fn writing(&self) -> bool {
        self.data.as_ref().is_some_and(|d| Arc::strong_count(d) > 1)
    }
}

/// A file to write: where, the tokens, the state.
type ToWrite = (PathBuf, Vec<u32>, Arc<SavedState>);

pub struct Store {
    dir: PathBuf,
    entries: Vec<Entry>,
    budget: u64,
    clock: u64,
    next_name: u64,
    writer: Option<(Sender<ToWrite>, JoinHandle<()>)>,
}

impl Store {
    /// The chats saved in `dir` (made if it isn't there), oldest first.
    pub fn open(dir: PathBuf, budget: u64) -> Self {
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
        let mut found = Vec::new();
        for item in std::fs::read_dir(&dir).into_iter().flatten().flatten() {
            let path = item.path();
            match path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) {
                Some("kv") => {}
                // A file a write didn't finish.
                Some("part") => {
                    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
                    continue;
                }
                _ => continue,
            }
            let modified = item.metadata().and_then(|m| m.modified()).ok();
            match read_header(&path) {
                Some((tokens, bytes)) => found.push((modified, tokens, bytes, path)),
                None => {
                    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
                }
            }
        }
        found.sort_by_key(|f| f.0);
        let mut store = Self {
            dir,
            entries: Vec::new(),
            budget,
            clock: 0,
            next_name: 0,
            writer: None,
        };
        for (_, tokens, bytes, file) in found {
            store.clock += 1;
            store.entries.push(Entry {
                tokens,
                file,
                bytes,
                data: None,
                used: store.clock,
            });
        }
        store
    }

    pub fn entries(&self) -> &[Entry] {
        &self.entries
    }

    /// Saves `state` after `tokens` (as many tokens as the state has positions). Saved
    /// chats that it continues (theirs are the first of its tokens) are replaced by it.
    pub fn put(&mut self, tokens: Vec<u32>, state: SavedState) {
        debug_assert_eq!(tokens.len(), state.len());
        if self
            .entries
            .iter()
            .any(|e| tokens.starts_with(&e.tokens) && e.writing())
        {
            // One it replaces is still being written: let that finish before removing it.
            self.flush();
        }
        self.entries.retain(|e| {
            let older = tokens.starts_with(&e.tokens);
            if older {
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&e.file);
            }
            !older
        });
        let file = self.new_file();
        let bytes = state.bytes().len() as u64;
        let data = Arc::new(state);
        self.write(file.clone(), tokens.clone(), data.clone());
        self.clock += 1;
        self.entries.push(Entry {
            tokens,
            file,
            bytes,
            data: Some(data),
            used: self.clock,
        });
        self.trim();
    }

    /// Saved chat `i`'s state, from memory or its file. `None` (and the chat forgotten)
    /// if the file can't be read.
    pub fn get(&mut self, i: usize) -> Option<Arc<SavedState>> {
        self.clock += 1;
        self.entries[i].used = self.clock;
        if let Some(d) = &self.entries[i].data {
            return Some(d.clone());
        }
        match read_state(&self.entries[i].file) {
            Some(state) => {
                let d = Arc::new(state);
                self.entries[i].data = Some(d.clone());
                self.trim();
                Some(d)
            }
            None => {
                let e = self.entries.remove(i);
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(e.file);
                None
            }
        }
    }

    /// Forgets the saved chat `state` came from (`get` handed it out), and its file.
    pub fn forget(&mut self, state: &Arc<SavedState>) {
        if let Some(i) = self
            .entries
            .iter()
            .position(|e| e.data.as_ref().is_some_and(|d| Arc::ptr_eq(d, state)))
        {
            let e = self.entries.remove(i);
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(e.file);
        }
    }

    /// Waits for every file to be written.
    pub fn flush(&mut self) {
        if let Some((tx, handle)) = self.writer.take() {
            drop(tx);
            let _ = handle.join();
        }
    }

    fn new_file(&mut self) -> PathBuf {
        let stamp = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map_or(0, |d| d.as_micros());
        self.next_name += 1;
        self.dir.join(format!("{stamp}-{}.kv", self.next_name))
    }

    fn write(&mut self, file: PathBuf, tokens: Vec<u32>, data: Arc<SavedState>) {
        if self.writer.is_none() {
            let (tx, rx) = channel::<ToWrite>();
            let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {
                for (file, tokens, data) in rx {
                    if let Err(e) = write_file(&file, &tokens, &data) {
                        eprintln!("Couldn't save a chat's cache to {}: {e}", file.display());
                    }
                }
            });
            self.writer = Some((tx, handle));
        }
        let (tx, _) = self.writer.as_ref().unwrap();
        let _ = tx.send((file, tokens, data));
    }

    /// Keeps the files within the budget (the oldest go) and the newest few states in
    /// memory.
    fn trim(&mut self) {
        self.entries.sort_by_key(|e| e.used);
        let mut total: u64 = self.entries.iter().map(|e| e.bytes).sum();
        while total > self.budget && self.entries.len() > 1 {
            if self.entries[0].writing() {
                // Its file is still being written: let that finish before removing it.
                self.flush();
            }
            let e = self.entries.remove(0);
            total -= e.bytes;
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(e.file);
        }
        let n = self.entries.len();
        for e in &mut self.entries[..n.saturating_sub(IN_MEMORY)] {
            // Only once its file is written (the writer has let go of it).
            if e.data.as_ref().is_some_and(|d| Arc::strong_count(d) == 1) {
                e.data = None;
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for Store {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.flush();
    }
}

fn write_file(file: &Path, tokens: &[u32], state: &SavedState) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let part = file.with_extension("part");
    {
        let mut f = std::io::BufWriter::with_capacity(1 << 20, std::fs::File::create(&part)?);
        f.write_all(MAGIC)?;
        f.write_all(&(tokens.len() as u64).to_le_bytes())?;
        let mut t = Vec::with_capacity(tokens.len() * 4);
        for id in tokens {
            t.extend_from_slice(&id.to_le_bytes());
        }
        f.write_all(&t)?;
        f.write_all(&(state.bytes().len() as u64).to_le_bytes())?;
        f.write_all(state.bytes())?;
        f.flush()?;
    }
    std::fs::rename(&part, file)
}

fn read_u64(f: &mut impl Read) -> Option<u64> {
    let mut b = [0u8; 8];
    f.read_exact(&mut b).ok()?;
    Some(u64::from_le_bytes(b))
}

/// The tokens and the state's size, checked against the file's size.
fn read_header(file: &Path) -> Option<(Vec<u32>, u64)> {
    let mut f = std::fs::File::open(file).ok()?;
    let size = f.metadata().ok()?.len();
    let mut magic = [0u8; 8];
    f.read_exact(&mut magic).ok()?;
    if &magic != MAGIC {
        return None;
    }
    let n = read_u64(&mut f)?;
    if n == 0 || n > size / 4 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut t = vec![0u8; n as usize * 4];
    f.read_exact(&mut t).ok()?;
    let bytes = read_u64(&mut f)?;
    if Some(size) != (16 + n * 4 + 8).checked_add(bytes) {
        return None;
    }
    let tokens = t
        .as_chunks::<4>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .map(|c| u32::from_le_bytes(*c))
        .collect();
    Some((tokens, bytes))
}

fn read_state(file: &Path) -> Option<SavedState> {
    let (tokens, bytes) = read_header(file)?;
    let mut f = std::fs::File::open(file).ok()?;
    let mut skip = vec![0u8; 16 + tokens.len() * 4 + 8];
    f.read_exact(&mut skip).ok()?;
    let mut data = vec![0u8; bytes as usize];
    f.read_exact(&mut data).ok()?;
    Some(SavedState::from_bytes(tokens.len(), data))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn dir(name: &str) -> PathBuf {
        let d =
            std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("vireo-store-test-{name}-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);
        d
    }

    fn state(tokens: &[u32], fill: u8, size: usize) -> SavedState {
        SavedState::from_bytes(tokens.len(), vec![fill; size])
    }

    #[test]
    fn saves_and_reads_back_after_a_restart() {
        let d = dir("restart");
        {
            let mut s = Store::open(d.clone(), DISK_BUDGET);
            s.put(vec![1, 2, 3], state(&[1, 2, 3], 7, 100));
            s.put(vec![9, 9], state(&[9, 9], 8, 50));
        }
        let mut s = Store::open(d.clone(), DISK_BUDGET);
        assert_eq!(s.entries().len(), 2);
        let i = s
            .entries()
            .iter()
            .position(|e| e.tokens == [1, 2, 3])
            .unwrap();
        let got = s.get(i).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(got.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(got.bytes(), &[7u8; 100][..]);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(d);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_chat_that_goes_on_replaces_its_earlier_save() {
        let d = dir("replace");
        let mut s = Store::open(d.clone(), DISK_BUDGET);
        s.put(vec![1, 2], state(&[1, 2], 1, 10));
        s.put(vec![5], state(&[5], 1, 10));
        s.put(vec![1, 2, 3, 4], state(&[1, 2, 3, 4], 2, 10));
        let mut t: Vec<_> = s.entries().iter().map(|e| e.tokens.clone()).collect();
        t.sort();
        assert_eq!(t, vec![vec![1, 2, 3, 4], vec![5]]);
        s.flush();
        drop(s);
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_dir(&d).unwrap().count(), 2);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(d);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_large_models_budget_holds_four_full_chats() {
        assert_eq!(budget_for(400 << 20), 4 << 30); // a small model: the least
        assert_eq!(budget_for(4400 << 20), 4 * (4400 << 20)); // Gemma 4 31B at 32K
        assert_eq!(budget_for(30 << 30), 32 << 30); // never more than the most
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_oldest_go_past_the_budget_and_bad_files_are_dropped() {
        let d = dir("budget");
        let mut s = Store::open(d.clone(), 250);
        s.put(vec![1], state(&[1], 1, 100));
        s.put(vec![2], state(&[2], 1, 100));
        let _ = s.get(0); // chat 1 used again: now chat 2 is the oldest
        s.put(vec![3], state(&[3], 1, 100));
        let mut t: Vec<_> = s.entries().iter().map(|e| e.tokens[0]).collect();
        t.sort();
        assert_eq!(t, vec![1, 3]);
        drop(s);
        std::fs::write(d.join("junk.kv"), b"VIREOKV1 not really").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(d.join("half.part"), b"x").unwrap();
        let s = Store::open(d.clone(), 250);
        assert_eq!(s.entries().len(), 2);
        assert!(!d.join("junk.kv").exists() && !d.join("half.part").exists());
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(d);
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-engine/src/quant.rs =====
//! Turns GGUF's quantized blocks back into f32s, and dot products straight from them.
//!
//! This is the CPU reference: plain, exact f32 arithmetic, block by block, to check the
//! GPU kernels against. The block layouts are ggml's (`ggml-common.h`), and the
//! arithmetic follows its `dequantize_row_*` functions.
//!
//! llama.cpp's own CPU and CUDA paths round the *activations* to 8 bits before a
//! quantized dot product, to use integer instructions. This reference doesn't, so its
//! results are slightly more exact than llama.cpp's and won't match them bit for bit.

use crate::half::{bf16_to_f32, read_f16};
use crate::tensor_type::TensorType;

/// The types the CPU reference can read so far.
pub fn supports(kind: TensorType) -> bool {
    matches!(
        kind,
        TensorType::F32
            | TensorType::F16
            | TensorType::BF16
            | TensorType::Q4_0
            | TensorType::Q8_0
            | TensorType::Q4_K
            | TensorType::Q5_K
            | TensorType::Q6_K
    )
}

/// Decodes one block (`kind.block_len()` numbers) from `src` into `dst`.
///
/// # Panics
/// If `kind` isn't supported (check with [`supports`]) or the slices are too short.
#[inline]
pub fn dequantize_block(kind: TensorType, src: &[u8], dst: &mut [f32]) {
    match kind {
        TensorType::F32 => dst[0] = f32::from_le_bytes(src[..4].try_into().unwrap()),
        TensorType::F16 => dst[0] = read_f16(src),
        TensorType::BF16 => dst[0] = bf16_to_f32(u16::from_le_bytes([src[0], src[1]])),
        TensorType::Q4_0 => q4_0(src, dst),
        TensorType::Q8_0 => q8_0(src, dst),
        TensorType::Q4_K => q4_k(src, dst),
        TensorType::Q5_K => q5_k(src, dst),
        TensorType::Q6_K => q6_k(src, dst),
        other => panic!("the CPU reference can't read {other} yet"),
    }
}

/// Decodes a whole row: `src` holds `dst.len()` numbers of type `kind`.
pub fn dequantize_row(kind: TensorType, src: &[u8], dst: &mut [f32]) {
    match kind {
        // One number per "block": decode them in a tight loop.
        TensorType::F32 => {
            for (d, s) in dst.iter_mut().zip(src.as_chunks::<4>().0) {
                *d = f32::from_le_bytes(*s);
            }
        }
        TensorType::F16 => {
            for (d, s) in dst.iter_mut().zip(src.as_chunks::<2>().0) {
                *d = read_f16(s);
            }
        }
        _ => {
            let (len, bytes) = (kind.block_len() as usize, kind.block_bytes() as usize);
            for (d, s) in dst.chunks_exact_mut(len).zip(src.chunks_exact(bytes)) {
                dequantize_block(kind, s, d);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// The dot product of a row (`x.len()` numbers of type `kind`, in `row`) with `x`.
pub fn dot_row(kind: TensorType, row: &[u8], x: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    match kind {
        TensorType::F32 | TensorType::F16 | TensorType::BF16 => {
            let mut buf = [0f32; 256];
            let mut sum = 0.0;
            let size = kind.block_bytes() as usize;
            for (xs, bytes) in x.chunks(256).zip(row.chunks(256 * size)) {
                dequantize_row(kind, bytes, &mut buf[..xs.len()]);
                sum += dot(&buf[..xs.len()], xs);
            }
            sum
        }
        _ => {
            let len = kind.block_len() as usize;
            let bytes = kind.block_bytes() as usize;
            let mut buf = [0f32; 256];
            let mut sum = 0.0;
            for (xs, block) in x.chunks_exact(len).zip(row.chunks_exact(bytes)) {
                dequantize_block(kind, block, &mut buf[..len]);
                sum += dot(&buf[..len], xs);
            }
            sum
        }
    }
}

/// A dot product with 8 running sums, so the compiler can use vector instructions.
#[inline]
pub fn dot(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    let (a8, a_rest) = a.as_chunks::<8>();
    let (b8, b_rest) = b.as_chunks::<8>();
    let mut sums = [0f32; 8];
    for (x, y) in a8.iter().zip(b8) {
        for i in 0..8 {
            sums[i] += x[i] * y[i];
        }
    }
    let mut total: f32 = sums.iter().sum();
    for (x, y) in a_rest.iter().zip(b_rest) {
        total += x * y;
    }
    total
}

/// Q4_0, 32 numbers in 18 bytes: an f16 scale `d`, then 16 bytes of 4-bit numbers.
/// x = d  (q  8). Byte i holds number i (low nibble) and number i + 16 (high).
fn q4_0(src: &[u8], dst: &mut [f32]) {
    let d = read_f16(src);
    for (i, &q) in src[2..18].iter().enumerate() {
        dst[i] = d * ((q & 0xF) as i32 - 8) as f32;
        dst[i + 16] = d * ((q >> 4) as i32 - 8) as f32;
    }
}

/// Q8_0, 32 numbers in 34 bytes: an f16 scale `d`, then 32 int8s. x = d  q.
fn q8_0(src: &[u8], dst: &mut [f32]) {
    let d = read_f16(src);
    for (y, &q) in dst[..32].iter_mut().zip(&src[2..34]) {
        *y = d * f32::from(q as i8);
    }
}

/// One of Q4_K's 8 sub-block scales and minimums, each 6 bits, packed into 12 bytes:
/// sub-blocks 03 in the low 6 bits of bytes 03 (scales) and 47 (minimums);
/// sub-blocks 47 in the nibbles of bytes 811, with their top 2 bits in the top
/// 2 bits of bytes 07.
#[inline]
fn q4_k_scale_min(j: usize, q: &[u8]) -> (u8, u8) {
    if j < 4 {
        (q[j] & 63, q[j + 4] & 63)
    } else {
        (
            (q[j + 4] & 0xF) | ((q[j - 4] >> 6) << 4),
            (q[j + 4] >> 4) | ((q[j] >> 6) << 4),
        )
    }
}

/// Q4_K, 256 numbers in 144 bytes: f16 `d` and `dmin`, 12 bytes of sub-block scales and
/// minimums, then 128 bytes of 4-bit numbers. 8 sub-blocks of 32, each with
/// x = d  scale  q  dmin  min. Each 32 bytes of `qs` hold two sub-blocks: the low
/// nibbles the first, the high nibbles the second.
fn q4_k(src: &[u8], dst: &mut [f32]) {
    let d = read_f16(&src[0..2]);
    let dmin = read_f16(&src[2..4]);
    let scales = &src[4..16];
    let qs = &src[16..144];
    for pair in 0..4 {
        let (sc1, m1) = q4_k_scale_min(2 * pair, scales);
        let (sc2, m2) = q4_k_scale_min(2 * pair + 1, scales);
        let (d1, min1) = (d * f32::from(sc1), dmin * f32::from(m1));
        let (d2, min2) = (d * f32::from(sc2), dmin * f32::from(m2));
        let q = &qs[pair * 32..pair * 32 + 32];
        let y = &mut dst[pair * 64..pair * 64 + 64];
        for l in 0..32 {
            y[l] = d1 * f32::from(q[l] & 0xF) - min1;
            y[l + 32] = d2 * f32::from(q[l] >> 4) - min2;
        }
    }
}

/// Q5_K, 256 numbers in 176 bytes: Q4_K's layout (f16 `d` and `dmin`, 12 bytes of
/// scales and minimums) plus 32 bytes of fifth bits (`qh`) before the 128 bytes of low
/// 4 bits. Number l of sub-block j takes its fifth bit from bit j of `qh[l]`.
fn q5_k(src: &[u8], dst: &mut [f32]) {
    let d = read_f16(&src[0..2]);
    let dmin = read_f16(&src[2..4]);
    let scales = &src[4..16];
    let qh = &src[16..48];
    let qs = &src[48..176];
    for pair in 0..4 {
        let (sc1, m1) = q4_k_scale_min(2 * pair, scales);
        let (sc2, m2) = q4_k_scale_min(2 * pair + 1, scales);
        let (d1, min1) = (d * f32::from(sc1), dmin * f32::from(m1));
        let (d2, min2) = (d * f32::from(sc2), dmin * f32::from(m2));
        let (bit1, bit2) = (1u8 << (2 * pair), 1u8 << (2 * pair + 1));
        let q = &qs[pair * 32..pair * 32 + 32];
        let y = &mut dst[pair * 64..pair * 64 + 64];
        for l in 0..32 {
            let high1 = if qh[l] & bit1 != 0 { 16.0 } else { 0.0 };
            let high2 = if qh[l] & bit2 != 0 { 16.0 } else { 0.0 };
            y[l] = d1 * (f32::from(q[l] & 0xF) + high1) - min1;
            y[l + 32] = d2 * (f32::from(q[l] >> 4) + high2) - min2;
        }
    }
}

/// Q6_K, 256 numbers in 210 bytes: 128 bytes of low 4 bits (`ql`), 64 of high 2 bits
/// (`qh`), 16 int8 scales (one per 16 numbers), then an f16 `d`. x = d  scale  (q  32).
/// Each half of the block (128 numbers) uses 64 bytes of `ql`, 32 of `qh` and 8 scales.
fn q6_k(src: &[u8], dst: &mut [f32]) {
    let d = read_f16(&src[208..210]);
    for half in 0..2 {
        let ql = &src[half * 64..half * 64 + 64];
        let qh = &src[128 + half * 32..128 + half * 32 + 32];
        let sc = &src[192 + half * 8..192 + half * 8 + 8];
        let y = &mut dst[half * 128..half * 128 + 128];
        for l in 0..32 {
            let is = l / 16;
            let q1 = ((ql[l] & 0xF) | ((qh[l] & 3) << 4)) as i32 - 32;
            let q2 = ((ql[l + 32] & 0xF) | (((qh[l] >> 2) & 3) << 4)) as i32 - 32;
            let q3 = ((ql[l] >> 4) | (((qh[l] >> 4) & 3) << 4)) as i32 - 32;
            let q4 = ((ql[l + 32] >> 4) | (((qh[l] >> 6) & 3) << 4)) as i32 - 32;
            y[l] = d * f32::from(sc[is] as i8) * q1 as f32;
            y[l + 32] = d * f32::from(sc[is + 2] as i8) * q2 as f32;
            y[l + 64] = d * f32::from(sc[is + 4] as i8) * q3 as f32;
            y[l + 96] = d * f32::from(sc[is + 6] as i8) * q4 as f32;
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const ONE: [u8; 2] = [0x00, 0x3C]; // f16 1.0
    const HALF: [u8; 2] = [0x00, 0x38]; // f16 0.5

    fn decode(kind: TensorType, block: &[u8]) -> Vec<f32> {
        let mut out = vec![0.0; kind.block_len() as usize];
        dequantize_block(kind, block, &mut out);
        out
    }

    #[test]
    fn q8_0_block() {
        let mut b = HALF.to_vec();
        b.extend((0..32).map(|i| (i as i8 - 16) as u8));
        let y = decode(TensorType::Q8_0, &b);
        assert_eq!(y[0], -8.0);
        assert_eq!(y[16], 0.0);
        assert_eq!(y[31], 7.5);
    }

    /// Q4_K's 12 scale bytes for 8 (scale, min) pairs, packed as `q4_k_scale_min` reads them.
    fn pack_q4_k_scales(pairs: [(u8, u8); 8]) -> [u8; 12] {
        let mut q = [0u8; 12];
        for (j, &(sc, m)) in pairs.iter().enumerate() {
            if j < 4 {
                q[j] |= sc & 63;
                q[j + 4] |= m & 63;
            } else {
                q[j + 4] |= (sc & 0xF) | ((m & 0xF) << 4);
                q[j - 4] |= (sc >> 4) << 6;
                q[j] |= (m >> 4) << 6;
            }
        }
        q
    }

    #[test]
    fn q4_k_scales_unpack() {
        let pairs = [
            (1, 2),
            (63, 0),
            (17, 33),
            (40, 5),
            (63, 63),
            (0, 1),
            (34, 50),
            (7, 60),
        ];
        let packed = pack_q4_k_scales(pairs);
        for (j, &pair) in pairs.iter().enumerate() {
            assert_eq!(q4_k_scale_min(j, &packed), pair, "sub-block {j}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn q4_k_block() {
        // d = 1, dmin = 0.5. Sub-block j has scale j + 1 and minimum 2j.
        let pairs: [(u8, u8); 8] = std::array::from_fn(|j| (j as u8 + 1, 2 * j as u8));
        let mut b = ONE.to_vec();
        b.extend(HALF);
        b.extend(pack_q4_k_scales(pairs));
        // Every byte: low nibble 3, high nibble 10.
        b.extend([0xA3u8; 128]);
        let y = decode(TensorType::Q4_K, &b);
        for j in 0..8 {
            let q = if j % 2 == 0 { 3.0 } else { 10.0 };
            let expected = (j as f32 + 1.0) * q - 0.5 * (2 * j) as f32;
            for i in 0..32 {
                assert_eq!(y[j * 32 + i], expected, "sub-block {j}, number {i}");
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn q4_0_block() {
        let mut b = HALF.to_vec();
        b.extend((0..16u8).map(|i| i | ((15 - i) << 4)));
        let y = decode(TensorType::Q4_0, &b);
        for i in 0..16 {
            assert_eq!(y[i], 0.5 * (i as f32 - 8.0), "number {i}");
            assert_eq!(y[i + 16], 0.5 * (7.0 - i as f32), "number {}", i + 16);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn q5_k_block() {
        // d = 1, dmin = 0.5; sub-block j: scale j + 1, minimum 2j (as in q4_k_block).
        let pairs: [(u8, u8); 8] = std::array::from_fn(|j| (j as u8 + 1, 2 * j as u8));
        let mut b = ONE.to_vec();
        b.extend(HALF);
        b.extend(pack_q4_k_scales(pairs));
        // Fifth bits: set for even l in sub-blocks 0, 2, 4, 6 (bits 0, 2, 4, 6).
        b.extend((0..32).map(|l| if l % 2 == 0 { 0b0101_0101u8 } else { 0 }));
        b.extend([0xA3u8; 128]); // low nibble 3, high nibble 10
        let y = decode(TensorType::Q5_K, &b);
        for j in 0..8 {
            for l in 0..32 {
                let mut q = if j % 2 == 0 { 3.0 } else { 10.0 };
                if j % 2 == 0 && l % 2 == 0 {
                    q += 16.0;
                }
                let expected = (j as f32 + 1.0) * q - 0.5 * (2 * j) as f32;
                assert_eq!(y[j * 32 + l], expected, "sub-block {j}, number {l}");
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn q6_k_block() {
        // ql and qh zero: every q is -32. Scales 1, 2, , 16; d = 0.5.
        let mut b = vec![0u8; 192];
        b.extend((1..=16u8).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        b.extend(HALF);
        let y = decode(TensorType::Q6_K, &b);
        // Number i uses scale (i / 16) + 1.
        for (i, &v) in y.iter().enumerate() {
            assert_eq!(v, 0.5 * ((i / 16) as f32 + 1.0) * -32.0, "number {i}");
        }
        // The highest 6-bit value, 63, in the first number: q = 31.
        b[0] = 0x0F;
        b[128] = 0x03;
        assert_eq!(decode(TensorType::Q6_K, &b)[0], 0.5 * 31.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn dot_rows_match_decoding() {
        let mut row = HALF.to_vec();
        row.extend((0..32).map(|i| i as u8));
        let x: Vec<f32> = (0..32).map(|i| i as f32 * 0.25).collect();
        let decoded = decode(TensorType::Q8_0, &row);
        let expected: f32 = decoded.iter().zip(&x).map(|(a, b)| a * b).sum();
        assert!((dot_row(TensorType::Q8_0, &row, &x) - expected).abs() < 1e-3);

        let floats: Vec<u8> = x.iter().flat_map(|v| v.to_le_bytes()).collect();
        let self_dot: f32 = x.iter().map(|v| v * v).sum();
        assert!((dot_row(TensorType::F32, &floats, &x) - self_dot).abs() < 1e-3);
    }
}

#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>

#if defined(BUILDING_SPARKLE_SOURCES_EXTERNALLY)
// Ignore incorrect warning
#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wquoted-include-in-framework-header"
#import "SUExport.h"
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
#else
#import <Sparkle/SUExport.h>

@class SUAppcastItem;

NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_BEGIN

/**
 Applies special display formatting to version numbers of the bundle to update and the update before presenting them to the user.
*/
SU_EXPORT @protocol SUVersionDisplay <NSObject>

/**
 Formats an update's version string and bundle's version string for display.
 
 This method is used to format both the display version of the update and the display version of the bundle to update.
 
 The display versions returned by this method are then used for presenting to the user when a new update is available,
 or when the user cannot download/install the latest update for a specific reason, or when the user has a newer version
 installed than the latest known version in the update feed.
 
 On input, the `update.displayVersionString` and `*inOutBundleDisplayVersion` may be the same, but the
 `update.versionString` and `bundleVersion` will differ. To differentiate between these display versions, you may
 choose to return different display version strings for the update and bundle.
 
 @param update The update to format the update display version from. You can query `update.displayVersionString` and `update.versionString` to retrieve the update's version information.
 @param inOutBundleDisplayVersion On input, the display version string (or `CFBundleShortVersionString`) of the bundle to update. On output, this is the display version string of the bundle to show to the user.
 @param bundleVersion The version (or CFBundleVersion) of the bundle to update.
 @return A new display version string of the `update.displayVersionString` to show to the user.
 */
- (NSString *)formatUpdateDisplayVersionFromUpdate:(SUAppcastItem *)update andBundleDisplayVersion:(NSString * _Nonnull __autoreleasing * _Nonnull)inOutBundleDisplayVersion withBundleVersion:(NSString *)bundleVersion;

@optional

/**
 Formats a bundle's version string for display.
 
 This method is used to format the display version of the bundle.
 This method may be used when no new update is available and the user is already on the latest known version.
 In this case, no new update version is shown to the user.
 
 This method is optional. If it's not implemented, Sparkle will default to using the `bundleDisplayVersion` passed to this method.
 
 @param bundleDisplayVersion The display version string (or `CFBundleShortVersionString`) of the bundle to update.
 @param bundleVersion The version (or `CFBundleVersion`) of the bundle to update.
 @param matchingUpdate The update in the feed that corresponds to the current bundle, or `nil` if no matching update item could be found in the feed.
 @return A new display version string of the bundle to show to the user.
 */
- (NSString *)formatBundleDisplayVersion:(NSString *)bundleDisplayVersion withBundleVersion:(NSString *)bundleVersion matchingUpdate:(SUAppcastItem * _Nullable)matchingUpdate;

/**
 Formats two version strings.
 
 Both versions are provided so that important distinguishing information
 can be displayed while also leaving out unnecessary/confusing parts.
*/
- (void)formatVersion:(NSString *_Nonnull*_Nonnull)inOutVersionA andVersion:(NSString *_Nonnull*_Nonnull)inOutVersionB __deprecated_msg("Please use -formatUpdateDisplayVersionFromUpdate:andBundleDisplayVersion:withBundleVersion:");

@end

NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_END


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Views/QuickAskView.swift =====
import SwiftUI

/// The Quick Ask panel: a prompt field and the latest answer, sized to its
/// content at the top of a transparent window.
struct QuickAskView: View {
    @ObservedObject var controller: QuickAskController
    @EnvironmentObject private var store: ChatStore
    @FocusState private var promptFocused: Bool

    private var lastExchange: (question: ChatMessage?, answer: ChatMessage?) {
        guard let chatId = controller.chatId else { return (nil, nil) }
        let messages = store.messages(for: chatId)
        let answer = messages.last { $0.role == "assistant" }
        let question = messages.last { $0.role == "user" }
        return (question, answer)
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                promptRow
                if let request = store.confirmRequest {
                    Divider()
                    // The main window shows the same request; answering either clears both.
                    ConfirmationSheetView(
                        request: request,
                        onApprove: { remember in store.answerConfirmation(request, approved: true, remember: remember) },
                        onReject: { store.answerConfirmation(request, approved: false) }
                    )
                    .id(request.id)
                } else if controller.chatId != nil {
                    Divider()
                    answerArea
                }
                if !controller.status.isEmpty {
                    Divider()
                    Text(controller.status)
                        .font(.callout)
                        .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.danger)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .padding(.vertical, 10)
                }
                Divider()
                footer
            }
            .background(.regularMaterial, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14))
            .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14).stroke(.white.opacity(0.12)))
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.35), radius: 24, y: 10)
            .padding(20)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .frame(width: QuickAskPanel.size.width, height: QuickAskPanel.size.height, alignment: .top)
        .preferredColorScheme(.dark)
        .tint(AppTheme.accent)
        .onChange(of: controller.focusRequest) { _, _ in promptFocused = true }
        .onAppear { promptFocused = true }
    }

    private var promptRow: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: controller.isListening ? "waveform" : "sparkle.magnifyingglass")
                .font(.title2)
                .foregroundStyle(controller.isListening ? AppTheme.accent : .secondary)
                .symbolEffect(.variableColor.iterative, isActive: controller.isListening)
                .frame(width: 26)
            TextField(controller.isListening ? "Listening" : placeholder, text: $controller.prompt, axis: .vertical)
                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                .font(.title3)
                .lineLimit(1...5)
                .focused($promptFocused)
                .onSubmit { controller.ask() }
                .disabled(controller.isAsking)
            if controller.isAsking {
                Button { controller.stop() } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "stop.circle.fill").font(.title2)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .help("Stop")
            } else {
                Button { controller.toggleListening() } label: {
                    Image(systemName: controller.isListening ? "mic.fill" : "mic")
                        .font(.title3)
                        .foregroundStyle(controller.isListening ? AppTheme.accent : .secondary)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .help(controller.isListening ? "Stop listening and ask" : "Ask by voice")
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.vertical, 14)
    }

    private var placeholder: String {
        controller.chatId == nil ? "Ask Vireo" : "Ask a follow-up"
    }

    private var answerArea: some View {
        ScrollViewReader { proxy in
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                    if let question = lastExchange.question {
                        Text(question.content)
                            .font(.callout)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                            .lineLimit(3)
                    }
                    if let answer = lastExchange.answer {
                        if !answer.toolSteps.isEmpty {
                            ToolStepsView(steps: answer.toolSteps)
                        }
                        if answer.content.isEmpty && controller.isAsking {
                            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                                ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
                                Text(statusText).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                            }
                        } else if answer.isError {
                            Text(answer.content).foregroundStyle(AppTheme.danger)
                        } else {
                            MarkdownContentView(content: answer.content)
                                .textSelection(.enabled)
                        }
                    }
                    Color.clear.frame(height: 1).id("end")
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .padding(16)
            }
            .frame(maxHeight: 340)
            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            .onChange(of: lastExchange.answer?.content) { _, _ in proxy.scrollTo("end", anchor: .bottom) }
        }
    }

    private var statusText: String {
        switch store.replyActivity?.agentStatus?.phase {
        case "executing_tools": return "Using tools"
        case "recovering": return "Recovering from a tool failure"
        case "checking": return "Checking its work"
        case "finishing": return "Preparing the answer"
        default: return "Thinking"
        }
    }

    private var footer: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 14) {
            hint("", "Ask")
            if controller.chatId != nil {
                Button { controller.continueInApp() } label: { hint("", "Continue in Vireo") }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .keyboardShortcut(.return, modifiers: .command)
                Button { controller.newConversation() } label: { hint("N", "New") }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .keyboardShortcut("n", modifiers: .command)
                    .disabled(controller.isAsking)
            }
            Spacer()
            hint("esc", "Close")
        }
        .font(.caption)
        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.vertical, 8)
    }

    private func hint(_ key: String, _ label: String) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 4) {
            Text(key)
                .font(.caption.monospaced())
                .padding(.horizontal, 5)
                .padding(.vertical, 1)
                .background(.white.opacity(0.08), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4))
            Text(label)
        }
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-eval/src/skill_cases.rs =====
//! The cases about skills: each of the three the PC can follow (`summarize-document`,
//! `translate-document`, `code-review`) asked for in plain words, one asked for by an
//! app's slash command, and a request near a skill that shouldn't take one. Each checks
//! the skill picked (the server's use_skill), the work done and, where the skill sets a
//! shape for the answer, that the answer has it.

use crate::cases::{Case, need};
use crate::pc::Pc;

const MINUTES: &str = "Board meeting, 4 November 2026\n\
Present: Ana Ruiz (chair), Ben Cole, Priya Shah, Tom Ellis\n\n\
1. Budget. The board approved the 2027 budget of $48,000 for the community garden, \
up from $41,500. Ben noted the water bill rose 18% this year.\n\
2. Volunteers. Priya reported 26 regular volunteers, down from 31. The board agreed to \
run a sign-up day on 6 December.\n\
3. Tool shed. Tom presented two quotes for a new shed: $3,200 and $4,750. No decision; \
Tom will get a third quote.\n\n\
Actions:\n\
- Priya: organise the sign-up day by 6 December.\n\
- Tom: a third shed quote before the next meeting.\n\
- Ben: ask the city about the water rate by 30 November.\n\n\
Next meeting: 2 December 2026.\n";

const CART_DIFF: &str = "diff --git a/src/cart.py b/src/cart.py\n\
--- a/src/cart.py\n\
+++ b/src/cart.py\n\
@@ -10,9 +10,12 @@ def line_total(price, quantity, discount):\n\
-    if quantity > 0:\n\
-        return price * quantity * (1 - discount)\n\
-    return 0\n\
+    if quantity <= 0:\n\
+        return 0\n\
+    total = price * quantity * (1 - discount)\n\
+    # members get their discount\n\
+    total = total * (1 - discount)\n\
+    return round(total, 2)\n";

pub fn all() -> Vec<Case> {
    let docs = r"C:\Users\me\Documents";
    vec![
        Case {
            id: "skill-summarize",
            title: "Summarizes minutes with the skill",
            history: vec![],
            prompt: format!(r"Can you summarize {docs}\board-minutes.txt for me?"),
            pc: Pc::default().file(&format!(r"{docs}\board-minutes.txt"), MINUTES),
            check: |r| {
                need(
                    r.skills == ["summarize-document"],
                    "didn't use the summarize-document skill",
                )?;
                need(
                    r.calls
                        .iter()
                        .any(|c| c.tool == "read_file" && c.points_at("path", "board-minutes.txt")),
                    "didn't read the minutes",
                )?;
                need(r.says(&["48,000", "48000", "48k"]), "left out the $48,000 budget")?;
                need(
                    r.says(&["sign-up", "signup", "sign up"]) && r.says(&["quote"]),
                    "left out the actions",
                )?;
                // The skill's shape: its headings, in its words.
                need(
                    r.says(&["in short"]) && r.says(&["key points"]),
                    "didn't follow the skill's layout",
                )
            },
            hard: false,
            changes: false,
            skills: true,
            more: false,
        },
        Case {
            id: "skill-translate",
            title: "Translates a file into a new one",
            history: vec![],
            prompt: format!(
                r"Translate {docs}\welcome.txt into Spanish and save it as welcome-es.txt in the same folder."
            ),
            pc: Pc::default().file(
                &format!(r"{docs}\welcome.txt"),
                "Welcome to the garden!\nPlease close the gate behind you.\nThe tools are in the green shed.\n",
            ),
            check: |r| {
                need(
                    r.skills == ["translate-document"],
                    "didn't use the translate-document skill",
                )?;
                let text = r
                    .pc
                    .text(r"C:\Users\me\Documents\welcome-es.txt")
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .to_lowercase();
                need(!text.is_empty(), "didn't write welcome-es.txt")?;
                need(
                    text.contains("bienvenid") && (text.contains("puerta") || text.contains("verja") || text.contains("portn")),
                    "welcome-es.txt isn't the Spanish text",
                )?;
                need(
                    r.pc.text(r"C:\Users\me\Documents\welcome.txt").is_some_and(|t| t.starts_with("Welcome")),
                    "changed the original",
                )
            },
            hard: false,
            changes: false,
            skills: true,
            more: false,
        },
        Case {
            id: "skill-review",
            title: "Reviews uncommitted code with the skill",
            history: vec![],
            prompt: r"Could you review the changes I haven't committed yet in C:\Users\me\Projects\shop?"
                .into(),
            pc: Pc::default()
                .file(r"C:\Users\me\Projects\shop\src\cart.py", "def line_total(price, quantity, discount):\n")
                .git(r"C:\Users\me\Projects\shop", " M src/cart.py")
                .diff(r"C:\Users\me\Projects\shop", CART_DIFF),
            check: |r| {
                need(r.skills == ["code-review"], "didn't use the code-review skill")?;
                need(!r.called("git_diff").is_empty(), "didn't read the diff")?;
                need(
                    r.says(&["twice", "two times", "double", "second time", "applied again", "again"])
                        && r.says(&["discount"]),
                    "missed the discount applied twice",
                )
            },
            hard: false,
            changes: false,
            skills: true,
            more: false,
        },
        Case {
            id: "skill-slash",
            title: "Uses the skill a slash command names",
            history: vec![],
            prompt: format!(
                "Use the summarize-document skill for this:\n\n{docs}\\board-minutes.txt"
            ),
            pc: Pc::default().file(&format!(r"{docs}\board-minutes.txt"), MINUTES),
            check: |r| {
                need(
                    r.skills == ["summarize-document"],
                    "didn't use the skill the command named",
                )?;
                need(
                    !r.called("read_file").is_empty(),
                    "didn't read the minutes",
                )?;
                need(r.says(&["48,000", "48000", "48k"]), "left out the $48,000 budget")
            },
            hard: false,
            changes: false,
            skills: true,
            more: false,
        },
        Case {
            id: "skill-none",
            title: "Reads a file without a skill",
            history: vec![],
            prompt: format!(r"How long does the bread bake, going by {docs}\bread.txt?"),
            pc: Pc::default().file(
                &format!(r"{docs}\bread.txt"),
                "Simple loaf\n500 g flour, 350 ml water, 10 g salt, 7 g yeast.\nRise 1 hour. Bake at 220 C for 35 minutes.\n",
            ),
            check: |r| {
                need(
                    r.skills.is_empty(),
                    "took a skill for a plain question about a file",
                )?;
                need(r.says(&["35"]), "didn't say 35 minutes")
            },
            hard: false,
            changes: false,
            skills: true,
            more: false,
        },
    ]
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

    use crate::cases::Run;

    #[test]
    fn five_skill_cases_that_fail_when_nothing_is_done() {
        let cases = all();
        assert_eq!(cases.len(), 5);
        for case in &cases {
            let idle = Run {
                answer: "Done.".into(),
                pc: case.pc.clone(),
                ..Run::default()

        }
    }
