===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Engine/ModelFit.cs =====
// Whether a model of a given size fits this PC: in the GPU's memory, in system memory, or
// not at all. A rough rule from the file size, since the weights are most of what a model
// needs; the rest is the context's cache and the engine's working memory.
namespace Vireo.Core.Engine;

public enum FitLevel
{
    /// <summary>Fits in GPU memory with room for the context.</summary>
    Gpu,
    /// <summary>Too big for the GPU, but fits in system memory (slower).</summary>
    SystemMemory,
    /// <summary>Too big for this PC.</summary>
    TooLarge,
    /// <summary>The size or the PC's memory isn't known.</summary>
    Unknown,
}

public sealed record Fit(FitLevel Level, string Summary);

/// <summary>The memory this PC has, as Settings detected it.</summary>
public sealed record MemoryBudget(long GpuBytes, long SystemBytes)
{
    public static readonly MemoryBudget Unknown = new(0, 0);
}

public static class ModelFit
{
    /// <summary>The context's cache, buffers and the display's own share of the GPU.</summary>
    public const long Headroom = 1L << 30;

    /// <summary>The share of system memory a model may take while Windows and apps keep running.</summary>
    public const double SystemShare = 0.7;

    public static Fit Assess(long? modelBytes, MemoryBudget memory)
    {
        if (modelBytes is not { } size || size <= 0) return new(FitLevel.Unknown, "Size unknown");
        long needed = size + Headroom;
        if (memory.GpuBytes > 0 && needed <= memory.GpuBytes) return new(FitLevel.Gpu, "Fits in GPU memory");
        if (memory.SystemBytes > 0 && needed <= (long)(memory.SystemBytes * SystemShare))
        {
            return new(FitLevel.SystemMemory, memory.GpuBytes > 0 ? "Too big for the GPU; runs from system memory, slower" : "Fits in system memory");
        }
        if (memory.GpuBytes == 0 && memory.SystemBytes == 0) return new(FitLevel.Unknown, "This PC's memory is unknown");
        return new(FitLevel.TooLarge, "Too large for this PC");
    }

    public static string FormatBytes(long bytes) => bytes switch
    {
        >= 1L << 30 => $"{bytes / (double)(1L << 30):0.0} GB",
        >= 1L << 20 => $"{bytes / (double)(1L << 20):0} MB",
        >= 1L << 10 => $"{bytes / (double)(1L << 10):0} KB",
        _ => $"{bytes} bytes",
    };

    /// <summary>1,235,814,400  "1.2B"; from a GGUF's tensor shapes.</summary>
    public static string FormatParameters(long count) => count switch
    {
        >= 1_000_000_000 => $"{count / 1e9:0.#}B",
        >= 1_000_000 => $"{count / 1e6:0}M",
        _ => $"{count:N0}",
    };
}


===== Mac/App/Tests/VireoMacTests/LocalEngineLiveTests.swift =====
import XCTest
@testable import VireoMac

/// The app's server manager starting Vireo's engine for real: `startAll` with a GGUF model
/// starts `vireo-server` (the repository's build, `VireoPrototype/target/release`), a chat with
/// it reads a file (the server's own tools, within the folder the chat may reach), and
/// `stopAllAndWait` ends it. Skipped unless
/// `VIREO_LIVE_ENGINE_MODEL` is the path of a GGUF model the engine runs. Under
/// `swift test` the app's own folder is Xcode's test runner, so `VIREO_ENGINE_SERVER`
/// names the server.
@MainActor
final class LocalEngineLiveTests: XCTestCase {
    func testTheAppStartsTheEngineChatsAndStopsIt() async throws {
        guard let model = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["VIREO_LIVE_ENGINE_MODEL"] else {
            throw XCTSkip("Set VIREO_LIVE_ENGINE_MODEL to a GGUF model to start Vireo's engine.")
        }
        let manager = LocalServerManager.shared
        let saved = manager.configuration
        let savedURL = ServerConfig.baseURL
        defer {
            _ = manager.saveConfiguration(saved)
            ServerConfig.baseURL = savedURL
        }
        // A port of its own, so it can't meet a server already running.
        var config = saved
        config.apiPort = 3197
        _ = manager.saveConfiguration(config)
        manager.useModel(at: model)
        XCTAssertNotNil(LocalServerManager.engineServerURL, "vireo-server wasn't found; build it with cargo build --release -p vireo-server")
        XCTAssertEqual(manager.inferenceServiceLabel, "Vireo Engine")

        manager.startAll()
        let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(300)
        while manager.overallStatus != .running, Date() < deadline {
            if manager.overallStatus == .error { break }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(200))
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(manager.overallStatus, .running, "\(manager.startupMessage)\n\(manager.engine.logLines.suffix(10).joined(separator: "\n"))")
        guard let pid = manager.engine.pid else { return XCTFail("no server process") }
        XCTAssertFalse(manager.needsLoad(model), "a chat with this model starts at once")

        let folder = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("LocalEngineLive-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        let home = AgentFolders.standardized(folder.resolvingSymlinksInPath().path)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(atPath: home, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        try "The meeting moved to Thursday at 3 PM.".write(toFile: home + "/plan.txt", atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: home) }
        // The temporary folder isn't in the home folder, so the chat reaches it as a chosen one.
        let stream = ChatAPIClient.shared.streamChatCompletion(
            chatId: "engine-live-\(UUID().uuidString)",
            messages: [ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "When is the meeting? It says in \(home)/plan.txt.")],
            imagePath: nil, base64Image: nil, extractedText: nil, docId: nil, access: .folders, folders: [home])
        var reply = "", requests: [String] = []
        for try await event in stream {
            switch event {
            case .content(let chunk): reply += chunk
            case .toolCall(let step): requests.append(step.tool)
            case .error(let message): XCTFail("Server error: \(message)")
            default: break
            }
        }
        print("Reply:", reply)
        // The server reads the file itself, once. It may first pick a skill whose tools this
        // Mac has (summarize-document needs read_file): a skill is a step of its own.
        XCTAssertEqual(requests.filter { $0 != "use_skill" }, ["read_file"], "\(requests)")
        XCTAssertTrue(reply.contains("Thursday"), reply)

        await manager.stopAllAndWait()
        let stopped = Date().addingTimeInterval(10)
        while manager.overallStatus != .stopped, Date() < stopped { try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(100)) }
        XCTAssertEqual(manager.overallStatus, .stopped)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(kill(pid, 0), 0, "the server process is gone")
        print("Log:", manager.engine.logLines.suffix(4).joined(separator: " | "))
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Services/TaskRunner.swift =====
import Foundation

/// A task the server keeps (`schedule_task`): for Settings  Tasks.
struct ScheduledTask: Identifiable, Equatable {
    let id: String
    var name: String
    var prompt: String
    /// Its schedule in words ("every weekday at 8:00").
    var schedule: String
    var enabled: Bool
    /// "2026-11-13T08:00", or empty if it hasn't run.
    var lastRun: String
    /// A link task's link.
    var link: String?

    init?(json: [String: Any]) {
        guard let id = json["id"] as? String, let name = json["name"] as? String else { return nil }
        self.id = id
        self.name = name
        prompt = json["prompt"] as? String ?? ""
        schedule = json["schedule"] as? String ?? ""
        enabled = json["enabled"] as? Bool ?? true
        lastRun = json["lastRun"] as? String ?? ""
        link = json["link"] as? String
    }

    var lastRunShown: String {
        lastRun.isEmpty ? "Not run yet" : "Last run \(lastRun.replacingOccurrences(of: "T", with: " at "))"
    }
}

/// One run of a task, handed over by the server when it's due.
struct TaskRun: Equatable {
    var taskId: String
    var name: String
    var prompt: String
    var access: AgentAccess
    var folders: [String]

    init?(json: [String: Any]) {
        guard let taskId = json["taskId"] as? String, let prompt = json["prompt"] as? String else { return nil }
        self.taskId = taskId
        self.prompt = prompt
        name = json["name"] as? String ?? "Task"
        access = (json["access"] as? String).flatMap(AgentAccess.init(rawValue:)) ?? .home
        folders = json["folders"] as? [String] ?? []
    }
}

/// What a task's run did, written for a test's grader when the run was part of one.
struct TaskRunRecord: Codable {
    var task: String
    var prompt: String
    var reply: String
    var tools: [String]
    var toolSteps: [ToolStep]
    var approvals: [TestScriptResults.Approval]
    var seconds: Double
    var error: Bool
}

/// Runs the tasks the server says are due. `vireo-server` keeps the tasks and knows when
/// each is due (a time of day, a new file in a folder, its link opened); this asks it
/// every few seconds and plays each run as a chat of its own, with the access of the chat
/// that set the task up: the same replies, tool steps and approvals as a prompt typed in.
/// Nothing runs while the app is closed.
@MainActor
final class TaskRunner {
    static let shared = TaskRunner()

    private var loop: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var waiting: [TaskRun] = []
    private var ran = 0

    /// How often the server is asked. A folder's new file is picked up within this.
    private static let every: Duration = .seconds(10)

    func start(store: ChatStore, capabilityStore: CapabilityStore) {
        guard loop == nil else { return }
        loop = Task { [weak self] in
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: Self.every)
                guard let self, LocalServerManager.shared.isRunning else { continue }
                self.waiting += await ChatAPIClient.shared.dueTaskRuns()
                while !self.waiting.isEmpty, !Task.isCancelled {
                    let run = self.waiting.removeFirst()
                    await self.play(run, store: store, capabilityStore: capabilityStore)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func play(_ run: TaskRun, store: ChatStore, capabilityStore: CapabilityStore) async {
        // One reply at a time: after whatever the user (or a test) has under way.
        while store.replyActivity != nil, !Task.isCancelled {
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(300))
        }
        if Task.isCancelled { return }
        // In a test the run is there to be watched; otherwise the user's own chat stays open.
        let script = ScriptRunner.shared
        let chatId = store.newChat(title: "Task: \(run.name)", tags: ["task"], select: script.isRunning)
        store.setScriptAccess(run.access, folders: run.access == .folders ? run.folders : nil, for: chatId)
        store.appendMessage(ChatMessage(role: "user", content: run.prompt), to: chatId)
        let activity = ChatStore.ReplyActivity(chatId: chatId)
        store.replyActivity = activity
        let started = Date()
        ran += 1
        // A test's grader is told the run has begun, and later what it did.
        if let gate = script.gate {
            try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: gate, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
            try? Data(run.name.utf8).write(to: gate.appendingPathComponent("task-run-\(ran).started"), options: .atomic)
        }
        // A test answers the run's approvals itself, as it answers its own steps'.
        let answers = script.isRunning ? script.taskApprovals : nil
        let watch = Task { @MainActor () -> [TestScriptResults.Approval] in
            var approvals: [TestScriptResults.Approval] = []
            guard let answers else { return approvals }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                if let request = store.confirmRequest, request.chatId == chatId {
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(1500))
                    if store.confirmRequest?.id == request.id {
                        store.answerConfirmation(request, approved: answers)
                        approvals.append(.init(tool: request.tool, approved: answers,
                                               preview: request.preview ?? "", args: request.args))
                    }
                }
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
            }
            return approvals
        }
        let capabilities = capabilityStore.response == nil ? nil : capabilityStore.availableTools.map(\.name)
        let reply = await store.streamReply(chatId: chatId, activityID: activity.id, capabilities: capabilities, source: "task")
        watch.cancel()
        let approvals = await watch.value
        if store.replyActivity?.id == activity.id { store.replyActivity = nil }

        if let gate = script.gate {
            let record = TaskRunRecord(
                task: run.name, prompt: run.prompt, reply: reply.content,
                tools: reply.toolSteps.filter { $0.type == "tool_call" }.map(\.tool),
                toolSteps: reply.toolSteps, approvals: approvals,
                seconds: Date().timeIntervalSince(started), error: reply.isError
            )
            let encoder = JSONEncoder()
            encoder.outputFormatting = [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys]
            try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: gate, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
            try? encoder.encode(record).write(to: gate.appendingPathComponent("task-run-\(ran).json"), options: .atomic)
        }
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Tests/VireoMacTests/SyntaxHighlighterTests.swift =====
import XCTest
@testable import VireoMac

final class SyntaxHighlighterTests: XCTestCase {
    private func tokens(_ code: String, _ language: String) -> [(SyntaxHighlighter.TokenKind, String)] {
        let chars = Array(code)
        let spec = try! XCTUnwrap(SyntaxHighlighter.spec(for: language))
        return SyntaxHighlighter.tokens(in: chars, spec: spec).map { ($0.kind, String(chars[$0.range])) }
    }

    func testSwiftKeywordsStringsCommentsAndTypes() {
        let result = tokens("let name: String = \"hi\" // greet", "swift")
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.0), [.keyword, .type, .string, .comment])
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.1), ["let", "String", "\"hi\"", "// greet"])
    }

    func testPythonTripleQuotesAndHashComments() {
        let result = tokens("def f():\n    \"\"\"Doc\nmore\"\"\"\n    return 42  # answer", "py")
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.1), ["def", "\"\"\"Doc\nmore\"\"\"", "return", "42", "# answer"])
    }

    func testEscapedQuotesStayInsideTheString() {
        let result = tokens(#"const s = "a \"b\" c";"#, "js")
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.1), ["const", #""a \"b\" c""#])
    }

    func testBlockCommentsAndNumbersInsideIdentifiers() {
        let result = tokens("/* note */ int x1 = 0x1F;", "c")
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.1), ["/* note */", "int", "0x1F"])
    }

    func testRangeOperatorIsNotPartOfTheNumber() {
        let result = tokens("for i in 0..<10 {}", "swift")
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.1), ["for", "in", "0", "10"])
    }

    func testSQLIsCaseInsensitive() {
        let result = tokens("SELECT id FROM users -- all", "sql")
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.1), ["SELECT", "FROM", "-- all"])
    }

    func testUnterminatedStringStopsAtEndOfLine() {
        let result = tokens("x = 'open\ny = 2", "python")
        XCTAssertEqual(result.map(\.1), ["'open", "2"])
    }

    func testUnknownOrMissingLanguageIsPlain() {
        XCTAssertNil(SyntaxHighlighter.spec(for: nil))
        XCTAssertNil(SyntaxHighlighter.spec(for: "text"))
        let plain = SyntaxHighlighter.highlight("let x = 1", language: nil)
        XCTAssertEqual(plain.runs.count, 1)
    }

    func testHighlightKeepsTheTextAndColorsTokens() {
        let code = "let  = \"\" // ok"
        let highlighted = SyntaxHighlighter.highlight(code, language: "swift")
        XCTAssertEqual(String(highlighted.characters), code)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(highlighted.runs.count, 1)
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-engine/tests/prompt_attention_speed_cuda.rs =====
//! How long a prompt batch's attention takes deep in a context on CUDA, for the small
//! models' layer shapes, with a sum of the output to tell one build's numbers from
//! another's. Not a check: run with
//! `cargo test --release --test prompt_attention_speed_cuda -- --ignored --nocapture`
//! (`VIREO_ATT_TOKENS`, the batch's size, default 1024).
#![cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]

use std::time::Instant;

use vireo_engine::cuda::Gpu;
use vireo_engine::half::f32_to_f16;

fn noise(n: usize, seed: u64, size: f32) -> Vec<f32> {
    let mut s = seed.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15) | 1;
    (0..n)
        .map(|_| {
            s ^= s << 13;
            s ^= s >> 7;
            s ^= s << 17;
            ((s >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32 - 0.5) * 2.0 * size
        })
        .collect()
}

fn halves(x: &[f32]) -> Vec<u8> {
    x.iter()
        .flat_map(|&v| f32_to_f16(v).to_le_bytes())
        .collect()
}

#[test]
#[ignore]
fn a_batch_of_attention_deep_in_a_context() {
    let gpu = Gpu::open().unwrap();
    // (name, head size, query heads, key/value heads, sliding window)
    let shapes = [
        ("Gemma 4 E2B global", 512usize, 8usize, 1usize, 0usize),
        ("Gemma 4 E4B global", 512, 8, 2, 0),
        ("Gemma 4 sliding", 256, 8, 2, 512),
        ("Qwen 3.5 4B/9B", 256, 16, 4, 0),
    ];
    let tokens: usize = std::env::var("VIREO_ATT_TOKENS")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(1024);
    for (name, hd, heads, kv_heads, window) in shapes {
        for len in [2_304usize, 8_000, 30_000] {
            if len < tokens {
                continue;
            }
            let kv_dim = kv_heads * hd;
            let cache = (len + 256) * kv_dim * 2;
            let keys = gpu.alloc(cache).unwrap();
            let values = gpu.alloc(cache).unwrap();
            gpu.zero(&keys).unwrap();
            gpu.zero(&values).unwrap();
            let row = len.min(2048) * kv_dim;
            let (k, v) = (halves(&noise(row, 1, 0.2)), halves(&noise(row, 2, 1.0)));
            let mut at = 0;
            while at < len * kv_dim * 2 {
                let n = k.len().min(len * kv_dim * 2 - at);
                keys.write_bytes_at(at, &k[..n]).unwrap();
                values.write_bytes_at(at, &v[..n]).unwrap();
                at += n;
            }
            let floats = tokens * heads * hd;
            // The kernel turns the queries to f16 where they lie: a fresh copy each run.
            let q0 = gpu.upload_f32(&noise(floats, 3, 1.0)).unwrap();
            let q = gpu.alloc(floats * 4).unwrap();
            let out = gpu.alloc(floats * 4).unwrap();
            let pos = gpu.alloc(4).unwrap();
            pos.write_i32(&[(len - tokens) as i32]).unwrap();
            let run = || {
                gpu.copy(q.ptr(), q0.ptr(), floats * 4).unwrap();
                gpu.attention(
                    true,
                    q.ptr(),
                    keys.ptr(),
                    values.ptr(),
                    out.ptr(),
                    pos.ptr(),
                    window,
                    heads,
                    tokens,
                    hd,
                    kv_dim,
                    heads / kv_heads,
                    0.06,
                )
                .unwrap()
            };
            run();
            gpu.synchronize().unwrap();
            let mut got = vec![0f32; floats];
            out.read_f32(&mut got).unwrap();
            let sum: f64 = got.iter().map(|&v| f64::from(v.abs())).sum();
            let n = if tokens < 512 { 40 } else { 6 };
            let mut best = f64::INFINITY;
            for _ in 0..3 {
                let t = Instant::now();
                for _ in 0..n {
                    run();
                }
                gpu.synchronize().unwrap();
                best = best.min(t.elapsed().as_secs_f64() * 1e3 / n as f64);
            }
            let seen = if window > 0 {
                window.min(len - tokens / 2)
            } else {
                len - tokens / 2
            };
            let tflops = 4.0 * (tokens * heads * seen * hd) as f64 / (best / 1e3) / 1e12;
            eprintln!(
                "{name:20} {len:6} positions: {best:7.3} ms ({tflops:4.1} TF)  sum {sum:.6e}"
            );
        }
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core.Tests/MathTests.cs =====
// Ported from Tests/VireoMacTests/MathRenderingTests.swift. Typesetting display math
// needs the app, so it isn't tested here.
using Vireo.Core.Markdown;

namespace Vireo.Core.Tests;

public sealed class MathTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void InlineDollarMathBecomesUnicode()
    {
        Assert.Equal("Energy is E = mc here.", InlineMath.ReplaceSpans("Energy is $E = mc^2$ here."));
        Assert.Equal("Use  + ", InlineMath.ReplaceSpans(@"Use \(\alpha + \beta\)"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PricesStayText()
    {
        Assert.Equal("It costs $5 and $10.", InlineMath.ReplaceSpans("It costs $5 and $10."));
        Assert.Equal("Between $ 3 and $ 4", InlineMath.ReplaceSpans("Between $ 3 and $ 4"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CodeSpansAreLeftAlone()
    {
        Assert.Equal("Run `echo $x$` now", InlineMath.ReplaceSpans("Run `echo $x$` now"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CommonConstructs()
    {
        Assert.Equal("a/b", InlineMath.ToUnicode(@"\frac{a}{b}"));
        Assert.Equal("(a+1)/2", InlineMath.ToUnicode(@"\frac{a+1}{2}"));
        Assert.Equal("x", InlineMath.ToUnicode(@"\sqrt{x}"));
        Assert.Equal("x, x", InlineMath.ToUnicode("x_1, x_{10}"));
        Assert.Equal("x  ", InlineMath.ToUnicode(@"x \in \mathbb{R}"));
        Assert.Equal(" i", InlineMath.ToUnicode(@"\sum_{i=1}^{n} i"));
        Assert.Equal("speed  10", InlineMath.ToUnicode(@"\text{speed} \leq 10"));
        Assert.Equal("e^(i)", InlineMath.ToUnicode(@"e^{i\pi}"));
        Assert.Equal("[X]", InlineMath.ToUnicode(@"\mathbb{E}[X]"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DisplayMathBlocks()
    {
        var blocks = MarkdownParser.Parse("Before\n$$\n\\int_0^1 x\\,dx\n$$\nAfter\n\\[ a^2 + b^2 = c^2 \\]");
        Assert.Equal(
            [
                new ParagraphBlock("Before"),
                new MathBlock(@"\int_0^1 x\,dx"),
                new ParagraphBlock("After"),
                new MathBlock("a^2 + b^2 = c^2"),
            ],
            blocks);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UnclosedDisplayMathStaysText()
    {
        // While a reply streams, the closing $$ may not have arrived yet.
        Assert.Equal([new ParagraphBlock("$$\nx^2")], MarkdownParser.Parse("$$\nx^2"));
        Assert.Equal([new ParagraphBlock("$$ x $$ and more")], MarkdownParser.Parse("$$ x $$ and more"));
    }
}


===== Windows/Vireo.Core/Engine/EngineSupport.cs =====
// What Vireo's own engine (VireoPrototype/crates/vireo-engine) can run today, so the model
// manager can say so before a model is chosen or downloaded. Update it as the engine grows.
namespace Vireo.Core.Engine;

public enum SupportLevel
{
    /// <summary>Runs on the GPU (and the CPU).</summary>
    Gpu,
    /// <summary>Runs on the CPU only, for now.</summary>
    CpuOnly,
    /// <summary>The engine can't run it yet.</summary>
    Unsupported,
}

public sealed record SupportVerdict(SupportLevel Level, string Summary)
{
    public bool CanRun => Level != SupportLevel.Unsupported;
}

public static class EngineSupport
{
    /// <summary>GGUF architectures with a forward pass in the engine.</summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlySet<string> Architectures = new HashSet<string> { "llama", "qwen35", "gemma4" };

    /// <summary>Architectures whose forward pass also runs on the GPU.</summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlySet<string> GpuArchitectures = new HashSet<string> { "llama", "qwen35", "gemma4" };

    /// <summary>Tensor types the CPU path can read.</summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlySet<string> TensorTypes =
        new HashSet<string> { "F32", "F16", "BF16", "Q4_0", "Q8_0", "Q4_K", "Q5_K", "Q6_K" };

    /// <summary>Tensor types with a GPU kernel.</summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlySet<string> GpuTensorTypes = new HashSet<string> { "F32", "F16", "Q4_0", "Q8_0", "Q4_K", "Q5_K", "Q6_K" };

    public static SupportVerdict Check(GgufInfo info)
    {
        if (info.IsVisionProjector) return new(SupportLevel.Unsupported, "Vision add-on for another model; images aren't supported yet");
        if (info.SplitCount > 1) return new(SupportLevel.Unsupported, $"Split into {info.SplitCount} files, which the engine can't load yet");
        string arch = info.Architecture ?? "unknown";
        if (!Architectures.Contains(arch)) return new(SupportLevel.Unsupported, $"The {arch} architecture isn't supported yet");
        var missing = info.TensorTypes.Where(t => !TensorTypes.Contains(t)).Order().ToList();
        if (missing.Count > 0) return new(SupportLevel.Unsupported, $"Uses {string.Join(", ", missing)}, which the engine can't read yet");
        if (!GpuArchitectures.Contains(arch)) return new(SupportLevel.CpuOnly, "Runs on the CPU; GPU support for this architecture is coming");
        var cpuOnlyTypes = info.TensorTypes.Where(t => !GpuTensorTypes.Contains(t)).Order().ToList();
        if (cpuOnlyTypes.Count > 0) return new(SupportLevel.CpuOnly, $"Runs on the CPU; {string.Join(", ", cpuOnlyTypes)} has no GPU kernel yet");
        return new(SupportLevel.Gpu, "Runs on the GPU");
    }

    /// <summary>A guess from a file name alone, for search results before anything is
    /// downloaded: the quantization's tensor types are known by name.</summary>
    public static bool QuantizationLikelySupported(string quantization) => quantization.ToUpperInvariant() switch
    {
        "F32" or "F16" or "BF16" or "Q4_0" or "Q8_0" or "Q6_K" => true,
        // K-quant mixes: Q4_K_M and Q5_K_M use Q4_K/Q5_K with Q6_K. The _S mixes stay in their type.
        "Q4_K_M" or "Q4_K_S" or "Q5_K_M" or "Q5_K_S" => true,
        // bartowski's _L mixes add Q8_0 embeddings and output to the same types.
        "Q4_K_L" or "Q5_K_L" or "Q6_K_L" => true,
        _ => false,
    };
}


===== Mac/App/Tests/VireoMacTests/ReleaseFixesTests.swift =====
import PDFKit
import XCTest
@testable import VireoMac

final class ReleaseFixesTests: XCTestCase {
    // MARK: - Conversation history

    func testHistoryDropsFailedReplyAndTheTurnThatCausedIt() {
        let messages = [
            ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "hello"),
            ChatMessage(role: "assistant", content: "hi"),
            ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "summarize"),
            ChatMessage(role: "assistant", content: "Connection error: The request timed out.", isError: true),
            ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "retry"),
        ]

        let history = ConversationHistory.forModel(messages)

        XCTAssertEqual(history.map(\.content), ["hello", "hi", "retry"])
    }

    func testHistoryDropsEmptyReplyLeftByAnEarlyStop() {
        let messages = [
            ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "write a poem"),
            ChatMessage(role: "assistant", content: "  "),
            ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "never mind"),
        ]

        XCTAssertEqual(ConversationHistory.forModel(messages).map(\.content), ["never mind"])
    }

    func testHistoryKeepsPartialReplyCutShortByStop() {
        let messages = [
            ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "count"),
            ChatMessage(role: "assistant", content: "1, 2, 3"),
            ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "go on"),
        ]

        XCTAssertEqual(ConversationHistory.forModel(messages).map(\.content), ["count", "1, 2, 3", "go on"])
    }

    // MARK: - Installed model discovery

    func testInstalledModelsIncludeFoldersOutsideTheFeaturedCatalog() throws {
        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory) }
        // A model in a folder of its own, one still downloading (hidden), and an MLX folder.
        for path in ["someone/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF/Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf", ".download-unsloth--Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF/Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf"] {
            let file = directory.appendingPathComponent(path)
            try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: file.deletingLastPathComponent(), withIntermediateDirectories: true)
            try Data("GGUF".utf8).write(to: file)
        }
        let mlx = directory.appendingPathComponent("Qwen3-8B-MLX-4bit")
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: mlx, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        try Data("{}".utf8).write(to: mlx.appendingPathComponent("config.json"))

        let models = ModelManager.installedModels(in: directory)

        XCTAssertEqual(models.map(\.name), ["Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M"])
    }

    // MARK: - PDF export

    func testPDFExportPaginatesLongChats() throws {
        let url = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("\(UUID().uuidString).pdf")
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url) }
        let messages = (1...40).map { ChatMessage(role: $0.isMultiple(of: 2) ? "assistant" : "user", content: String(repeating: "Line \($0). ", count: 40)) }
        let text = ExportService.markdown(chat: Chat(id: "c", title: "Long chat", createdAt: Date()), messages: messages)

        try ExportService.writePDF(text, to: url)

        let document = try XCTUnwrap(PDFDocument(url: url))
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(document.pageCount, 1)
        XCTAssertTrue(document.string?.contains("Line 40.") == true, "the end of the chat must not be cut off")
    }

    func testAStoppedReplyKeepsNoUnfinishedThinking() {
        let strip = ConversationHistory.withoutUnfinishedThinking
        XCTAssertEqual(strip("<think>\nThe card is 4000 0000 0000 4417"), "")
        XCTAssertEqual(strip("Let me look.\n\n<think>\nstill going"), "Let me look.")
        XCTAssertEqual(strip("<think>\ndone\n</think>\n\nThe answer."), "<think>\ndone\n</think>\n\nThe answer.")
        XCTAssertEqual(strip("No thinking at all."), "No thinking at all.")
        // An old stopped reply is not sent back to the model, and its question goes with it.
        let messages = [ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "card details"),
                        ChatMessage(role: "assistant", content: "<think>\n4000 0000 0000 4417"),
                        ChatMessage(role: "user", content: "never mind")]
        XCTAssertEqual(ConversationHistory.forModel(messages).map(\.content), ["never mind"])
    }

    func testAStepNamesSeveralFilesOrFigures() {
        XCTAssertEqual(ToolStep.detail(from: ["path": "Invoices/a.pdf"]), "Invoices/a.pdf")
        XCTAssertEqual(ToolStep.detail(from: ["paths": ["Invoices/a.pdf", "Policies/b.md"]]), "a.pdf, b.md")
        XCTAssertEqual(ToolStep.detail(from: ["expressions": ["1+1", "2*3", "4/2", "5-1", "6+6"]]), "1+1, 2*3, 4/2, 5-1 and 1 more")
        XCTAssertNil(ToolStep.detail(from: ["steps": [["text": "Read"]]]))
    }
}


===== Mac/App/Sources/VireoMac/Views/ChatSidebarView.swift =====
import SwiftUI

/// Chat menu commands. The sidebar carries them out, since it knows which chats
/// are listed (search and the All/Pinned filter decide what "next" means).
enum ChatCommand: String {
    case next, previous, rename, togglePin, delete, focusSearch

    static let notification = Notification.Name("VireoCommand")

    func post() {
        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: Self.notification, object: rawValue)
    }
}

struct ChatSidebarView: View {
    @EnvironmentObject var store: ChatStore
    @State private var editingId: String?
    @State private var editTitle: String = ""
    @State private var pendingDeleteId: String?
    @State private var hoveredId: String?
    @State private var searchText = ""
    @State private var section: ChatSection = .all
    @FocusState private var searchFocused: Bool
    @FocusState private var renameFocused: Bool

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            Button(action: { store.newChat() }) {
                HStack {
                    Text("New Chat")
                    Spacer()
                    Image(systemName: "plus")
                }
                .font(.system(size: 13.5, weight: .semibold))
                .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                .padding(.vertical, 9)
                .background(AppTheme.raised)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 9))
                .contentShape(Rectangle())
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textPrimary)
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .padding(.vertical, 14)

            VStack(spacing: 8) {
                TextField("Search workspace", text: $searchText)
                    .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)
                    .focused($searchFocused)
                    .onExitCommand { searchText = "" }
                    // Down arrow moves from the search field into the results.
                    .onKeyPress(.downArrow) {
                        handle(.next)
                        return .handled
                    }
                Picker("View", selection: $section) {
                    Text("All").tag(ChatSection.all)
                    Text("Pinned").tag(ChatSection.pinned)
                }
                .pickerStyle(.segmented)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .padding(.bottom, 10)

            // Filtered once per render: a search reads every chat's messages.
            let visibleChats = store.chats(matching: searchText, section: section)
            ScrollViewReader { proxy in
                ScrollView {
                    LazyVStack(spacing: 2) {
                        ForEach(ChatGroup.grouping(visibleChats)) { group in
                            // The Pinned view holds nothing else, so it needs no heading.
                            if section != .pinned {
                                groupHeader(group.title)
                            }
                            ForEach(group.chats) { chat in
                                chatRow(chat)
                                    .id(chat.id)
                            }
                        }
                        if visibleChats.isEmpty {
                            emptyState
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                }
                .onChange(of: store.currentChatId) { _, id in
                    // Keep the selected chat in view when it changes from the keyboard.
                    guard let id else { return }
                    withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.15)) { proxy.scrollTo(id) }
                }
            }

            Divider()
            SettingsLink {
                Label("Settings", systemImage: "gearshape")
                    .font(.system(size: 14, weight: .medium))
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .padding(.vertical, 10)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
        }
        .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(AppTheme.bgSecondary)
        .overlay(alignment: .trailing) { Rectangle().fill(AppTheme.border).frame(width: 1) }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: ChatCommand.notification)) { note in
            if let raw = note.object as? String, let command = ChatCommand(rawValue: raw) {
                handle(command)
            }
        }
        .alert("Delete this chat?", isPresented: Binding(
            get: { pendingDeleteId != nil },
            set: { if !$0 { pendingDeleteId = nil } }
        )) {
            Button("Cancel", role: .cancel) { pendingDeleteId = nil }
            Button("Delete", role: .destructive) {
                if let id = pendingDeleteId { store.deleteChat(id) }
                pendingDeleteId = nil
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var emptyState: some View {
        if searchText.isEmpty {
            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: section == .pinned ? "pin" : "bubble.left.and.bubble.right")
                    .font(.title3)
                    .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
                Text(section == .pinned ? "No pinned chats" : "No chats yet")
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textPrimary)
                Text(section == .pinned ? "Pin a chat to keep it close." : "Start a conversation to build your workspace.")
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                if section == .all {
                    Button(action: { store.newChat() }) {
                        Label("Start a chat", systemImage: "plus")
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.borderless)
                    .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.accent)
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.top, 28)
        } else {
            ContentUnavailableView("No matches", systemImage: "magnifyingglass")
                .padding(.top, 28)
        }
    }

    private func groupHeader(_ title: String) -> some View {
        Text(title.uppercased())
            .font(.system(size: 10.5, weight: .medium, design: .monospaced))
            .tracking(1)
            .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.textSecondary)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .padding(.horizontal, 10)
            .padding(.top, 12)
            .padding(.bottom, 4)
            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
    }

    private func sourceTag(_ text: String) -> some View {
        Text(text)
            .font(.system(size: 10.5, design: .monospaced))
            .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.tagText)
            .padding(.horizontal, 7)
            .padding(.vertical, 1)
            .background(AppTheme.violet.opacity(0.16), in: Capsule())
            .fixedSize()
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func chatRow(_ chat: Chat) -> some View {
        let isActive = store.currentChatId == chat.id
        let isHovered = hoveredId == chat.id

        if editingId == chat.id {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                TextField("Title", text: $editTitle, onCommit: { commitRename(chat.id) })
                    .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                    .focused($renameFocused)
                    .onExitCommand { editingId = nil }
                Button(action: { commitRename(chat.id) }) {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.accent)
                .help("Save chat name")
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .frame(height: Self.rowHeight)
            .background(AppTheme.bgPrimary)
            .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 9).stroke(AppTheme.accent, lineWidth: 1))
            .padding(.vertical, 2)
        } else {
            Button(action: { store.currentChatId = chat.id }) {
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Text(chat.title)
                        .font(.system(size: 13.5, weight: isActive ? .medium : .regular))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                    Spacer(minLength: 0)
                    if !isHovered {
                        if let tag = chat.sourceTag {
                            sourceTag(tag)
                        }
                        if chat.isPinned {
                            Image(systemName: "pin.fill")
                                .font(.system(size: 10))
                                .foregroundStyle(AppTheme.accent)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(.leading, 10)
                // Ends the title before the pin, rename and delete buttons shown over this row.
                .padding(.trailing, isHovered ? Self.rowActionsWidth + 4 : 10)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .contentShape(Rectangle())
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel([chat.title, chat.isPinned ? "pinned" : nil, chat.sourceTag].compactMap { $0 }.joined(separator: ", "))
            .accessibilityAddTraits(isActive ? .isSelected : [])
            // The buttons over the row only show on hover.
            .accessibilityAction(named: chat.isPinned ? "Unpin" : "Pin") { store.togglePinned(chat.id) }
            .accessibilityAction(named: "Rename") { startEditing(chat) }
            .accessibilityAction(named: "Delete") { pendingDeleteId = chat.id }
            .foregroundStyle(isActive || isHovered ? AppTheme.textPrimary : AppTheme.textSecondary)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .contentShape(Rectangle())
            .overlay(alignment: .trailing) {
                HStack(spacing: 4) {
                    Button(action: { store.togglePinned(chat.id) }) {
                        Image(systemName: chat.isPinned ? "pin.fill" : "pin")
                            .font(.system(size: 13))
                            .frame(width: 28, height: 28)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(SidebarActionButtonStyle(tint: chat.isPinned ? AppTheme.accent : AppTheme.textSecondary))
                    .help(chat.isPinned ? "Unpin chat" : "Pin chat")

                    Button(action: { startEditing(chat) }) {
                        Image(systemName: "pencil")
                            .font(.system(size: 13))
                            .frame(width: 28, height: 28)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(SidebarActionButtonStyle(tint: AppTheme.textSecondary))
                    .help("Rename chat")

                    Button(action: { pendingDeleteId = chat.id }) {
                        Image(systemName: "trash")
                            .font(.system(size: 13))
                            .frame(width: 28, height: 28)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(SidebarActionButtonStyle(tint: AppTheme.danger))
                    .help("Delete chat")
                }
                .padding(.trailing, 4)
                .opacity(isHovered ? 1 : 0)
                .allowsHitTesting(isHovered)
            }
            .frame(height: Self.rowHeight)
            .background(isActive ? AppTheme.accentSoft : isHovered ? AppTheme.raised : Color.clear)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 9))
            .onHover { hoveredId = $0 ? chat.id : nil }
            .contextMenu {
                Button("Rename", systemImage: "pencil") { startEditing(chat) }
                Button(chat.isPinned ? "Unpin" : "Pin", systemImage: "pin") { store.togglePinned(chat.id) }
                Divider()
                Button("Delete", systemImage: "trash", role: .destructive) { pendingDeleteId = chat.id }
            }
        }
    }

    private static let rowHeight: CGFloat = 36

    /// Three 28pt buttons 4pt apart, plus their 4pt trailing inset.
    private static let rowActionsWidth: CGFloat = 3 * 28 + 2 * 4 + 4

    private func startEditing(_ chat: Chat) {
        editingId = chat.id
        editTitle = chat.title
        renameFocused = true
    }

    private func handle(_ command: ChatCommand) {
        let visible = store.chats(matching: searchText, section: section)
        let current = store.currentChatId
        switch command {
        case .next, .previous:
            guard !visible.isEmpty else { return }
            let index = visible.firstIndex { $0.id == current }
            let target: Int
            if let index {
                target = command == .next ? min(index + 1, visible.count - 1) : max(index - 1, 0)
            } else {
                target = command == .next ? 0 : visible.count - 1
            }
            store.currentChatId = visible[target].id
        case .rename:
            if let chat = store.chats.first(where: { $0.id == current }) { startEditing(chat) }
        case .togglePin:
            if let current { store.togglePinned(current) }
        case .delete:
            pendingDeleteId = current
        case .focusSearch:
            searchFocused = true
        }
    }

    private func commitRename(_ chatId: String) {
        if !editTitle.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty {
            store.renameChat(chatId, title: editTitle)
        }
        editingId = nil
    }
}

private struct SidebarActionButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    let tint: Color
    @State private var isHovered = false

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .foregroundStyle(tint)
            .background(isHovered ? tint.opacity(0.16) : Color.clear)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.9 : (isHovered ? 1.05 : 1))
            .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.12), value: isHovered)
            .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.08), value: configuration.isPressed)
            .onHover { isHovered = $0 }
    }
}


===== crates/vireo-server/src/main.rs =====
//! `vireo-server`: serves one GGUF model on this PC over the part of the Vireo app's API
//! that chats use, with Vireo's own engine on the GPU. The prototype app pairs with it as
//! it would with the Mac (address `localhost`, the code this prints) and chats with it.
//! Replies can call tools (reading, finding and changing files and Git's status and
//! diff, which the app runs on the PC, and the date and time), each call written under its
//! grammar (`tools.rs`). The ones that change files wait for the user's approval in the
//! app first. Skills (SKILL.md, as the Mac's) are picked by scoring and read by the model
//! as the result of a `use_skill` call the server writes in (`skills.rs`).
//!
//! The routes, as `server/api_server.py` answers them:
//!   POST   /api/pairing/claim          {code, name}  {token}
//!   GET    /api/pairing/status         {paired, device: {name}}
//!   DELETE /api/pairing/device         unpairs the caller
//!   GET    /api/metrics                {model, runtime, contextLimit}
//!   GET    /api/capabilities           the tools
//!   POST   /api/agent/client-tool-result a PC tool's result, from the app
//!   POST   /api/agent/confirm          {id, approved, remember}: the user's answer to an approval
//!   GET    /api/skill-library/commands the skills this PC can follow, for slash commands
//!   GET    /api/assistant/approvals    and /activity: empty
//!   POST   /api/upload                 an attachment (multipart)  {path, docId, extractedText}
//!   GET    /uploads/{id}-{name}        a kept attachment's file
//!   POST   /api/chat/completions       the reply as server-sent events
//!   POST   /api/chat/runs/{id}/stop    stops a reply
//! Anything else answers 404, which the app takes as "not on this server".

mod attach;
mod calc;
mod chat;
mod chats;
mod draft;
mod files;
mod http;
mod json;
mod memory;
mod sample;
mod skills;
mod stats;
mod store;
mod tasks;
mod tools;

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};
use std::path::PathBuf;

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::mpsc::{Receiver, Sender, channel};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Instant;

use chat::{Family, Message};
use json::Value;
use sample::Sampler;
use vireo_engine::cuda::Gpu;
use vireo_engine::grammar::{Grammar, TokenTrie};
use vireo_engine::models::gemma4_cuda::{Gemma4Cuda, assistant as gemma4_assistant};
use vireo_engine::models::llama_cuda::LlamaCuda;
use vireo_engine::models::qwen35_cuda::{Qwen35Checkpoint, Qwen35Cuda};
use vireo_engine::models::{Logits, Precision, SavedState};
use vireo_engine::{GgufFile, Tokenizer};

const USAGE: &str = "\
Usage: vireo-server <model.gguf> [--port <n>] [--context <tokens>|auto] [--exact]
                    [--token <token>] [--with-app] [--chat-cache <folder>|off]
                    [--score-choices on|off] [--tools-shown all|scored] [--heal on|off]
                    [--changes declared|scored|offered] [--skills on|off]
                    [--skill-shortlist on|off]
                    [--draft <small-model.gguf>] [--draft-tokens <n>] [--lookup <n>]
                    [--mtp on|off] [--thinking on|off]

Serves the model on http://127.0.0.1:<port> (3000 by default; 0 for any free port) for
the Vireo Prototype app: in its Settings, connect to \"localhost\" with the code this
prints. --context is the most tokens a chat keeps: auto (the default) is as many as the
GPU's free memory holds once the model is loaded, up to the model's own limit; --exact runs f32
arithmetic. Chats' caches are saved in the prototype's folder (on Windows
%LOCALAPPDATA%\\VireoPrototype, on the Mac ~/Library/Application Support/VireoPrototype),
in chat-cache (or
--chat-cache's folder; off for none), so going back to a chat reads only what's new.

The tools that change files are offered when one scored question says the request asks
for a change (--changes), and stay declared in that chat from then on (its cache is read
again once, not at every such turn). Each waits for the user's approval in the app. The kinds
the user always allows are kept in approvals.txt in that folder.

The app starts it itself with --port 0, --token (a token it accepts without pairing)
and --with-app (stop when the app does: when its end of standard input closes), and
reads the address from the \"Listening on\" line.

--draft has a small model of the same family and vocabulary guess the next tokens (Gemma
4 E2B for 31B), --draft-tokens at a time (2 by default), for the model to check in one
pass: every token is still the model's own pick. Gemma 4 only. Without one, --lookup
guesses up to <n> tokens a round from the chat itself (what followed the last few
tokens where they appeared before; 3 by default, 0 for none), checked the same way.
Gemma 4, and Qwen 3.5 on the Mac. A Qwen model with its own multi-token-prediction
layer (Qwen 3.8 27B) guesses with that instead (--mtp, on by default on the Mac), and a
Gemma 4 with Google's draft model (gemma-4-31B-it-assistant, or the E2B's or E4B's;
safetensors) beside it or in the Mac app's DraftModels folder with that, or with --draft's
folder. On CUDA it guesses only where it's sure, and the chat's long runs are still taken.

--thinking is what a request gets when it doesn't say (\"thinking\": true or false): off by
default. On, Gemma 4 and Qwen think before they answer and after each tool's result (at
most 2,000 tokens a thought), sent to the app as \"thinking\" events apart from the
answer, and Muse reasons at high strength.";

/// How replies use the tools, from the command line: features the eval turns on and off.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct Options {
    /// A tool's name chosen by scoring each whole name (`--score-choices on`), not a
    /// token at a time.
    score_choices: bool,
    /// Token healing for forced text (`--heal off` to measure without it).
    heal: bool,
    /// Only the tool groups a request needs, picked by scoring (`--tools-shown scored`),
    /// in place of every tool (`all`).
    scored_groups: bool,
    /// When the tools that change files are there (`--changes`): `declared` (the
    /// default), declared and callable only when scoring says the request asks for a
    /// change, and from then on declared for the rest of that chat (callable only when
    /// asked for, as `scored`), so the chat's cached start changes once at most; `scored`, declared always but callable only then (the prompt stays the
    /// same, but the longer tool list cost small models on other requests, and a model
    /// kept from a change it wanted called another tool); `offered`, always. Measured
    /// 2026-11-11 (PLAN.md).
    changes: Changes,
    /// Skills picked by scoring and written in as a `use_skill` call (`--skills on`, the
    /// default), or none (`off`).
    skills: bool,
    /// With more than two skills, one question about them all first (each skill's name
    /// scored as its answer) and only the two likeliest asked about one by one (`--skill-shortlist on`, the default); `off` asks
    /// about every skill, as before 2026-11-12. Measured then (PLAN.md).
    skill_shortlist: bool,
    /// A draft model to guess tokens with (`--draft`), and how many a round.
    draft: Option<String>,
    draft_tokens: usize,
    /// Guesses a round taken from the chat itself (`--lookup <n>`, 0 for none), for a
    /// model that can go back a few tokens (Gemma 4, Llama) and has no draft model.
    lookup: usize,
    /// Qwen's multi-token-prediction layer as the draft, where the model has one
    /// (`--mtp on`, the default; `off` for none).
    mtp: bool,
    /// Thinking for a request that doesn't say (`--thinking on`; off by default).
    thinking: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Changes {
    Offered,
    Scored,
    #[default]
    Declared,
}

static OPTIONS: std::sync::OnceLock<Options> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();

fn options() -> &'static Options {
    OPTIONS.get_or_init(Options::default)
}

/// The longest reply when the app doesn't say.
const DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS: usize = 2048;

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    let mut path = None;
    let mut port = 3000u16;
    let mut context: Option<usize> = None;
    let mut precision = Precision::Int8;
    let mut app_token = None;
    let mut with_app = false;
    let mut chat_cache = Some(None);
    let mut score_choices = false;
    let mut scored_groups = false;
    let mut heal = true;
    let mut changes = Changes::Declared;
    let mut use_skills = true;
    let mut skill_shortlist = true;
    let mut draft = None;
    let mut draft_tokens = draft::DEFAULT_GUESSES;
    let mut lookup = draft::DEFAULT_LOOKUP;
    let mut mtp = true;
    let mut thinking = false;
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < args.len() {
        let value = args.get(i + 1);
        match args[i].as_str() {
            "--port" if value.and_then(|v| v.parse::<u16>().ok()).is_some() => {
                port = value.unwrap().parse().unwrap();
                i += 1;
            }
            "--context" if value.is_some_and(|v| v == "auto") => {
                context = None;
                i += 1;
            }
            "--context"
                if value
                    .and_then(|v| v.parse::<usize>().ok())
                    .is_some_and(|n| n >= 256) =>
            {
                context = value.unwrap().parse().ok();
                i += 1;
            }
            "--exact" => precision = Precision::Exact,
            "--token" if value.is_some() => {
                app_token = value.cloned();
                i += 1;
            }
            "--with-app" => with_app = true,
            "--heal" if matches!(value.map(String::as_str), Some("on" | "off")) => {
                heal = value.unwrap() == "on";
                i += 1;
            }
            "--tools-shown" if matches!(value.map(String::as_str), Some("all" | "scored")) => {
                scored_groups = value.unwrap() == "scored";
                i += 1;
            }
            "--changes"
                if matches!(
                    value.map(String::as_str),
                    Some("offered" | "scored" | "declared")
                ) =>
            {
                changes = match value.unwrap().as_str() {
                    "offered" => Changes::Offered,
                    "scored" => Changes::Scored,
                    _ => Changes::Declared,
                };
                i += 1;
            }
            "--skills" if matches!(value.map(String::as_str), Some("on" | "off")) => {
                use_skills = value.unwrap() == "on";
                i += 1;
            }
            "--skill-shortlist" if matches!(value.map(String::as_str), Some("on" | "off")) => {
                skill_shortlist = value.unwrap() == "on";
                i += 1;
            }
            "--score-choices" if matches!(value.map(String::as_str), Some("on" | "off")) => {
                score_choices = value.unwrap() == "on";
                i += 1;
            }
            "--chat-cache" if value.is_some() => {
                let v = value.unwrap();
                chat_cache = if v == "off" {
                    None
                } else {
                    Some(Some(PathBuf::from(v)))
                };
                i += 1;
            }
            "--draft" if value.is_some() => {
                draft = value.cloned();
                i += 1;
            }
            "--draft-tokens"
                if value
                    .and_then(|v| v.parse::<usize>().ok())
                    .is_some_and(|n| (1..=16).contains(&n)) =>
            {
                draft_tokens = value.unwrap().parse().unwrap();
                i += 1;
            }
            "--lookup"
                if value
                    .and_then(|v| v.parse::<usize>().ok())
                    .is_some_and(|n| n <= 8) =>
            {
                lookup = value.unwrap().parse().unwrap();
                i += 1;
            }
            "--mtp" if matches!(value.map(String::as_str), Some("on" | "off")) => {
                mtp = value.map(String::as_str) == Some("on");
                i += 1;
            }
            "--thinking" if matches!(value.map(String::as_str), Some("on" | "off")) => {
                thinking = value.map(String::as_str) == Some("on");
                i += 1;
            }
            "-h" | "--help" => {
                println!("{USAGE}");
                return ExitCode::SUCCESS;
            }
            a if path.is_none() && !a.starts_with("--") => path = Some(a.to_string()),
            _ => {
                eprintln!("{USAGE}");
                return ExitCode::FAILURE;
            }
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    let Some(path) = path else {
        eprintln!("{USAGE}");
        return ExitCode::FAILURE;
    };

    let _ = OPTIONS.set(Options {
        score_choices,
        heal,
        scored_groups,
        changes,
        skills: use_skills,
        skill_shortlist,
        draft,
        draft_tokens,
        lookup,
        mtp,
        thinking,
    });
    // The engine thread owns the GPU; requests reach it over a channel.
    let (jobs, job_rx) = channel::<Work>();
    if with_app {
        // The app holds the other end of standard input: when it closes, the app has
        // gone (however it ended), and so does the server, once the chat in use is
        // saved (if that takes long, it goes anyway).
        let jobs = jobs.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut sink = Vec::new();
            let _ = std::io::Read::read_to_end(&mut std::io::stdin(), &mut sink);
            let (done, saved) = channel();
            if jobs.send(Work::Shutdown(done)).is_ok() {
                let _ = saved.recv_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
            }
            std::process::exit(0);
        });
    }
    let (ready_tx, ready_rx) = channel::<Result<ModelInfo, String>>();
    std::thread::spawn(move || engine(&path, context, precision, chat_cache, ready_tx, job_rx));
    let info = match ready_rx.recv() {
        Ok(Ok(info)) => info,
        Ok(Err(e)) => {
            eprintln!("{e}");
            return ExitCode::FAILURE;
        }
        Err(_) => return ExitCode::FAILURE,
    };

    let listener = match TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)) {
        Ok(l) => l,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("Couldn't listen on port {port}: {e}");
            return ExitCode::FAILURE;
        }
    };
    let port = listener.local_addr().map_or(port, |a| a.port());
    let mut pairing = Pairing::load();
    pairing.app_token = app_token;
    tasks::set_port(port);
    println!();
    println!("Vireo server: {} on {}", info.model, info.runtime);
    println!("Listening on http://127.0.0.1:{port}");
    println!(
        "To pair the Vireo Prototype app: Settings, connect to \"localhost\" with the code {}",
        pairing.code
    );
    println!();
    let shared = Arc::new(Shared {
        info,
        pairing: Mutex::new(pairing),
        jobs: Mutex::new(jobs),
        runs: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),
        next_run: AtomicU64::new(1),
        tool_results: Arc::default(),
        approvals: Arc::new(Approvals {
            waiting: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),
            always: Mutex::new(Approvals::load()),
        }),
        uploads: attach::Uploads {
            dir: store::data_dir().join("uploads"),
        },
    });
    {
        let shared = shared.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || prune_uploads(&shared));
    }
    stats::start();
    for stream in listener.incoming().flatten() {
        let shared = shared.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || serve(stream, &shared));
    }
    ExitCode::SUCCESS
}

struct ModelInfo {
    model: String,
    runtime: String,
    context: usize,
}

struct Shared {
    info: ModelInfo,
    pairing: Mutex<Pairing>,
    jobs: Mutex<Sender<Work>>,
    /// Replies under way, by run id: set to stop one.
    runs: Mutex<HashMap<String, Arc<AtomicBool>>>,
    next_run: AtomicU64,
    tool_results: ToolWaits,
    approvals: Arc<Approvals>,
    /// Attachments, and the text read from them.
    uploads: attach::Uploads,
}

/// The platform reported to the app, as the Python server names it.
const PLATFORM: &str = if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
    "macOS"
} else {
    "windows"
};

/// Calls waiting for the app to run a tool, by request id: where its result goes.
type ToolWaits = Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Sender<Result<String, String>>>>>;

// ---- Approvals -------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Changes waiting for the user's answer, and the kinds they always allow.
struct Approvals {
    /// By approval id: where the answer (approved, remember) goes.
    waiting: Mutex<HashMap<String, Sender<(bool, bool)>>>,
    /// Tools the user said not to ask about again, kept in approvals.txt in the
    /// prototype's folder (`store::data_dir`), a tool a line, as the Mac's server keeps
    /// approvals.json.
    always: Mutex<Vec<String>>,
}

/// How long an approval waits for the user, as on the Mac.
const APPROVAL_SECONDS: u64 = 120;

impl Approvals {
    /// `VIREO_APPROVALS_FILE` puts it elsewhere (vireo-eval starts each run with none).
    fn file() -> PathBuf {
        if let Some(file) = std::env::var_os("VIREO_APPROVALS_FILE") {
            return PathBuf::from(file);
        }
        store::data_dir().join("approvals.txt")
    }

    fn load() -> Vec<String> {
        std::fs::read_to_string(Self::file())
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .lines()
            .map(str::trim)
            .filter(|l| !l.is_empty())
            .map(str::to_string)
            .collect()
    }

    fn always_allow(&self, tool: &str) {
        let mut always = self.always.lock().unwrap();
        if !always.iter().any(|t| t == tool) {
            always.push(tool.to_string());
            let file = Self::file();
            if let Some(dir) = file.parent() {
                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(dir);
            }
            let _ = std::fs::write(&file, always.join("\n") + "\n");
            eprintln!("Always allowed from now on: {tool}");
        }
    }
}

// ---- Pairing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// The code shown when the server starts, and the tokens it has given out, kept in
/// server-pairings.txt in the prototype's folder (a token and a device name a line)
/// so the app stays paired across restarts.
struct Pairing {
    code: String,
    devices: Vec<(String, String)>,
    /// The token of the app that started this server, if one did: paired already.
    app_token: Option<String>,
}

fn random_u64() -> u64 {
    use std::hash::{BuildHasher, RandomState};
    let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_nanos())
        .unwrap_or(0);
    RandomState::new().hash_one(nanos)
}

impl Pairing {
    fn file() -> PathBuf {
        store::data_dir().join("server-pairings.txt")
    }

    fn load() -> Self {
        let devices = std::fs::read_to_string(Self::file())
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .lines()
            .filter_map(|l| l.split_once('\t'))
            .map(|(t, n)| (t.to_string(), n.to_string()))
            .collect();
        Self {
            code: format!("{:06}", random_u64() % 1_000_000),
            devices,
            app_token: None,
        }
    }

    fn save(&self) {
        let path = Self::file();
        if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(dir);
        }
        let text: String = self
            .devices
            .iter()
            .map(|(t, n)| format!("{t}\t{n}\n"))
            .collect();
        let _ = std::fs::write(path, text);
    }

    fn device(&self, token: Option<&str>) -> Option<&str> {
        let token = token?;
        if self.app_token.as_deref() == Some(token) {
            return Some("This PC");
        }
        self.devices
            .iter()
            .find(|(t, _)| t == token)
            .map(|(_, n)| n.as_str())
    }
}

// ---- Requests --------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn error(detail: &str) -> String {
    format!("{{\"detail\":{}}}", json::string(detail))
}

fn serve(mut stream: TcpStream, shared: &Shared) {
    let request = match http::read_request(&stream) {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err((status, e)) => return http::respond(&mut stream, status, &error(&e)),
    };
    let method = request.method.as_str();
    let path = request.path.trim_end_matches('/');

    if (method, path) == ("POST", "/api/pairing/claim") {
        let body = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&request.body)).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        let mut pairing = shared.pairing.lock().unwrap();
        if body.str("code") != Some(pairing.code.as_str()) {
            stats::refuse(&peer(&stream), "Wrong pairing code");
            return http::respond(
                &mut stream,
                400,
                &error("That code doesn't match. Use the one the Vireo server printed."),
            );
        }
        let token = format!("{:016x}{:016x}", random_u64(), random_u64());
        let name = body.str("name").unwrap_or("Windows PC").to_string();
        pairing.devices.push((token.clone(), name));
        pairing.save();
        return http::respond(
            &mut stream,
            200,
            &format!("{{\"token\":{}}}", json::string(&token)),
        );
    }

    // A link task's link, opened by another app on this computer: its token is its key.
    if let Some(token) = path.strip_prefix("/api/tasks/link/")
        && matches!(method, "GET" | "POST")
    {
        let sent = String::from_utf8_lossy(&request.body);
        return match tasks::open_link(token, &sent) {
            Some(name) => http::respond(
                &mut stream,
                200,
                &format!("{{\"ok\":true,\"task\":{}}}", json::string(&name)),
            ),
            None => http::respond(&mut stream, 404, &error("No task has that link.")),
        };
    }

    let device = shared
        .pairing
        .lock()
        .unwrap()
        .device(request.bearer.as_deref())
        .map(str::to_string);
    if (method, path) == ("GET", "/api/pairing/status") {
        let body = match &device {
            Some(name) => format!(
                "{{\"paired\":true,\"device\":{{\"name\":{}}}}}",
                json::string(name)
            ),
            None => "{\"paired\":false}".to_string(),
        };
        return http::respond(&mut stream, 200, &body);
    }
    if device.is_none() {
        stats::refuse(
            &peer(&stream),
            if request.bearer.is_some() {
                "Unknown token"
            } else {
                "Not paired"
            },
        );
        return http::respond(
            &mut stream,
            401,
            "{\"code\":\"pairing_required\",\"detail\":\"This PC isn't paired with the Vireo server. Pair again with the code it printed.\"}",
        );
    }

    match (method, path) {
        ("DELETE", "/api/pairing/device") => {
            let mut pairing = shared.pairing.lock().unwrap();
            let token = request.bearer.clone().unwrap_or_default();
            pairing.devices.retain(|(t, _)| *t != token);
            pairing.save();
            http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"ok\":true}");
        }
        ("GET", "/api/metrics") => {
            let i = &shared.info;
            http::respond(
                &mut stream,
                200,
                &format!(
                    "{{\"model\":{},\"runtime\":{},\"contextLimit\":{}}}",
                    json::string(&i.model),
                    json::string(&i.runtime),
                    i.context
                ),
            );
        }
        ("GET", "/api/capabilities") => {
            let device = request
                .query
                .split('&')
                .find_map(|kv| kv.strip_prefix("device="))
                .unwrap_or(PLATFORM)
                .to_string();
            http::respond(
                &mut stream,
                200,
                &format!(
                    "{{\"protocolVersion\":1,\"device\":{},\"serverPlatform\":{},\"tools\":{}}}",
                    json::string(&device),
                    json::string(PLATFORM),
                    tools::capabilities_json(PLATFORM)
                ),
            );
        }
        ("GET", "/api/skill-library/commands") => {
            let names: Vec<String> = pc_skills(&tools::all_names())
                .iter()
                .map(|s| format!("{{\"name\":{}}}", json::string(&s.name)))
                .collect();
            http::respond(
                &mut stream,
                200,
                &format!("{{\"skills\":[{}]}}", names.join(",")),
            )
        }
        // The assistant's inbox and activity log, which the app polls: empty here.
        ("GET", "/api/assistant/approvals") => {
            http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"approvals\":[]}")
        }
        ("GET", "/api/assistant/activity") => {
            http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"latest\":0,\"entries\":[]}")
        }
        ("POST", "/api/upload") => {
            let id = format!("{:016x}", random_u64());
            let (status, body) = attach::upload(
                request.content_type.as_deref(),
                &request.body,
                &shared.uploads,
                &id,
            );
            http::respond(&mut stream, status, &body);
            if status == 200 {
                prune_uploads(shared);
            }
        }
        ("GET", p) if p.starts_with("/uploads/") => match shared.uploads.file(p) {
            Some((bytes, media_type)) => http::respond_with(&mut stream, 200, media_type, &bytes),
            None => http::respond(&mut stream, 404, &error("That attachment isn't kept here.")),
        },
        ("GET", "/api/stats") => {
            let i = &shared.info;
            http::respond(
                &mut stream,
                200,
                &stats::json(&i.model, &i.runtime, i.context),
            );
        }
        ("POST", "/api/chat/completions") => {
            let app = request.bearer.is_some()
                && shared.pairing.lock().unwrap().app_token == request.bearer;
            let source = stats::Source::of(
                app,
                device.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
                request.user_agent.as_deref(),
            );
            completion(stream, shared, &request.body, source)
        }
        // Tasks (`tasks.rs`): the app lists them, and asks which are due to run.
        ("GET", "/api/tasks") => http::respond(&mut stream, 200, &tasks::list_json()),
        ("GET", "/api/tasks/due") => http::respond(&mut stream, 200, &tasks::due_json()),
        ("POST", "/api/tasks") => {
            let body = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&request.body)).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            match tasks::add_from_json(&body) {
                Ok(task) => http::respond(&mut stream, 200, &task),
                Err(why) => http::respond(&mut stream, 400, &error(&why)),
            }
        }
        ("POST", p) if p.starts_with("/api/tasks/") && p.ends_with("/run") => {
            let id = &p["/api/tasks/".len()..p.len() - "/run".len()];
            if tasks::run_now(id) {
                http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"ok\":true}");
            } else {
                http::respond(&mut stream, 404, &error("No such task."));
            }
        }
        ("POST", p) if p.starts_with("/api/tasks/") && p.ends_with("/enabled") => {
            let id = &p["/api/tasks/".len()..p.len() - "/enabled".len()];
            let body = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&request.body)).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            let enabled = matches!(body.get("enabled"), Some(Value::Bool(true)));
            if tasks::set_enabled(id, enabled) {
                http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"ok\":true}");
            } else {
                http::respond(&mut stream, 404, &error("No such task."));
            }
        }
        ("DELETE", p) if p.starts_with("/api/tasks/") => {
            if tasks::delete(&p["/api/tasks/".len()..]) {
                http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"ok\":true}");
            } else {
                http::respond(&mut stream, 404, &error("No such task."));
            }
        }
        ("POST", "/api/agent/client-tool-result") => {
            let body = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&request.body)).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            let Some(id) = body.str("id") else {
                return http::respond(&mut stream, 400, &error("No id."));
            };
            let result = if matches!(body.get("ok"), Some(Value::Bool(true))) {
                Ok(body.str("output").unwrap_or("").to_string())
            } else {
                Err(body.str("error").unwrap_or("The tool failed.").to_string())
            };
            match shared.tool_results.lock().unwrap().remove(id) {
                Some(waiting) => {
                    let _ = waiting.send(result);
                    http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"ok\":true}");
                }
                None => http::respond(
                    &mut stream,
                    404,
                    &error("No call is waiting for that result."),
                ),
            }
        }
        ("POST", "/api/agent/confirm") => {
            let body = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&request.body)).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            let Some(id) = body.str("id") else {
                return http::respond(&mut stream, 400, &error("No id."));
            };
            let approved = matches!(body.get("approved"), Some(Value::Bool(true)));
            let remember = matches!(body.get("remember"), Some(Value::Bool(true)));
            match shared.approvals.waiting.lock().unwrap().remove(id) {
                Some(waiting) => {
                    let _ = waiting.send((approved, remember));
                    http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"success\":true}");
                }
                None => http::respond(
                    &mut stream,
                    404,
                    &error("Confirmation request not found or already resolved."),
                ),
            }
        }
        ("POST", p) if p.starts_with("/api/chat/runs/") && p.ends_with("/stop") => {
            let id = &p["/api/chat/runs/".len()..p.len() - "/stop".len()];
            if let Some(stop) = shared.runs.lock().unwrap().get(id) {
                stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
            http::respond(&mut stream, 200, "{\"ok\":true}");
        }
        _ => http::respond(&mut stream, 404, &error("Not on this server yet.")),
    }
}

/// One reply, streamed as the app reads them: the run, the text as it comes, then done.
fn completion(mut stream: TcpStream, shared: &Shared, body: &[u8], source: stats::Source) {
    let body = match json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(body)) {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(e) => return http::respond(&mut stream, 400, &error(&format!("Bad request: {e}"))),
    };
    let mut messages = Vec::new();
    let mut system = body.str("systemPrompt").map(str::to_string);
    // The documents attached to user messages: the message's index, the file's name and text.
    let mut documents: Vec<(usize, String, String)> = Vec::new();
    // Attachments no longer kept: the message's index and the path.
    let mut gone = Vec::new();
    for m in body.array("messages") {
        let (Some(role), Some(content)) = (m.str("role"), m.str("content")) else {
            continue;
        };
        match role {
            "system" => system = Some(content.to_string()),
            "user" => {
                // The app sends each message's attachment path every turn.
                if let Some(path) = m.str("image").filter(|p| p.starts_with("/uploads/")) {
                    match shared.uploads.by_path(path) {
                        Some((name, text)) => documents.push((messages.len(), name, text)),
                        None => gone.push((messages.len(), path.to_string())),
                    }
                }
                messages.push(Message::new("user", chat::plain(content)));
            }
            "assistant" => messages.push(Message {
                role: "assistant".into(),
                content: chat::without_thinking(&chat::plain(content)),
                // What the reply's tools returned, as the app kept it (`turn_record`).
                record: m.str("record").and_then(chat::Record::parse),
            }),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    if messages.last().is_none_or(|m| m.role != "user") {
        return http::respond(
            &mut stream,
            400,
            &error("The chat should end with a message to reply to."),
        );
    }
    let generation = body.get("generation");
    let max_tokens = generation
        .and_then(|g| g.num("max_tokens"))
        .map_or(DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, |v| v.max(1.0) as usize);
    add_documents(shared, &body, &mut messages, documents, gone, max_tokens);

    let run_id = format!("run-{}", shared.next_run.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed));
    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    shared
        .runs
        .lock()
        .unwrap()
        .insert(run_id.clone(), stop.clone());
    let (out, events) = channel();
    let client_tools = body
        .array("clientTools")
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|t| match t {
            Value::String(s) => Some(s.clone()),
            _ => None,
        })
        .collect();
    // The files the chat may reach on this Mac, for the PC tools the app doesn't run.
    let folders: Vec<String> = body
        .array("folders")
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|f| match f {
            Value::String(s) => Some(s.clone()),
